In addition to being able to fly at high speed, it is also capable of vertical take-off and landing, as well as hovering thanks to its legs. It is a bit of an oddball in that its hobby is performing reconnaissance, so it will always have a good grasp of what is going on in its surroundings.
jazarichmon: A Digimon that flies at the speed of sound, and has been specialized for aerial battles. Dogfights are its specialty, and the number of enemies it has fought and shot down is immeasurable. It is considered to be top class in the Digital World when it comes to aerial combat matches, and is said to compare favorably with Wingdramon.
jesmongx: The final form of JESmon that awakened to its true power by undergoing harsh training with Gankoomon, and fully mastering it. Its form, in which its whole body is brimming with fighting spirit and sense of justice, is clad in the red color of blazing flames.    The "Unlimitive Gauntlet", which is now its main weapon, is a piece of equipment used for both offense and defense that switches between its respective Sword, Knuckle, and Shield Modes depending on the situation.
justimonXAntibody: A "Hero of Justice"-type Digimon wearing a flapping red muffler. Its sense of justice burns hot, and as it is a Digimon that never overlooks unjust acts or evil deeds, it is an existence which Baby Digimon aspire to. It comes along like the wind, swings down its hammer of Justice, and leaves like the wind.
keramonXAntibody: A Child Digimon that evolved from Tsumemon. Its physique has gotten larger, and with its huge mouth, it can eat away at much more data than Tsumemon could. Because it eats away at more than 100 megabytes of data per second, the data is destroyed the instant it enters Keramon.
ladydevimonXAntibody: A fallen angel Digimon in the form of a female with noble presence. Because it hides Dark Side Power of incomparable purity, it is said that there are virtually no instances of it being raised continually on personal computers. Its Special Move is "Darkness Wave", which releases countless creatures of darkness similar to bats which burn the opponent to cinders.
abbadomon: A mysterious Digimon that evolved enormously by absorbing the negative data that the Network is overflowing with beyond its limit. It bites into Digimon and the Digital World itself with the large mouth at its center and the mouths on its numerous tentacles, and after doing so, only empty, blank data is left behind.
agumonYukinokizuna: The strong bond between Agumon and its Partner, it is a legendary, final evolution that was achieved after countless possibilities. The indomitable "Courage" of its Partner turned into hot flames that spurt out from its whole body, and appears as proof of their deep trust. It has a deeper understanding of humans owing to the long amount of time they spent together, and so this evolved form has also taken on a near-humanoid shape.
algomonBabyI: A Baby Digimon that was born from a bug in an algorithm. It has a habit of finding and converging on places where high-capacity data leaks. They gather one by one, and form hordes and then blanket it.
algomonBabyIi: The form that a newborn Algomon grows into. It clings to places where high-capacity data leaks, and consumes that data through the mouth on its underside. When an enemy draws near, it spits out "San no Awa" from its giant eye-like pattern.
algomonChild: The Child-evolved form of Algomon. It watches over young Algomon that are consuming data, and intercepts enemies when they draw near. algomonAdult: A form of Algomon that evolved to Adult whose processing ability has increased abnormally. Its Special Moves are restraining the enemy with the tentacles that extend from its mouth (Imprisonment), and sending an electric shock through them (Volt Line).
baboongamon: A very territorial Beast Digimon. It builds its nest in places that differ in elevation such as cliffs or rocky mountains. The characteristic rocks covering parts of its skin regenerate and become harder each time they break.
baluchimon: A Holy Beast Digimon confirmed to exist in herds in ruins unearthed from beneath Folder Continent. It turns outs that the ruins were once used as a fortress for Angel-species Digimon, and it is presumed that the Baluchimon were the ones that protected the fortress. Although it has a calm and quiet personality, it also has a ferocious side that mercilessly attacks the enemy.
bibimon: A Lesser Digimon that evolved from Dokimon. It lacks composure, and is always moving around mischievously. However, because it is not used to dealing with four legs yet, it very often loses its balance in the middle of running and rolls over.
boutmon: A Digimon that evolved from the data of combat sports such as karate. It is a courteous sportsman who has learned the rules of every type of martial arts, and values ​​fighting in the game format its opponent wants. Although there is a wide variety of techniques used by Boutmon, nonexistent techniques like those in fighting games as well as sports show up from time to time.
bulkmon: A Digimon that evolved via the data of a body composition monitor​ that measures muscle mass. It has a bellicose personality, and the power brought about by its unnaturally well-developed upper body muscles is top-class even among Adult Digimon. Its reaction speed is extremely high despite its large size, and it overwhelms its enemies with its tremendous power and speed.
darkmaildramon: A form of Maildramon, who is Knightmon's servant and acquired the power of "Miracles", that found righteousness in evil after abandoning justice. Its Chrome Digizoid armor has been dyed a dark color, and it is looking for a heart of darkness in its master, Knightmon. If it is a Knightmon with a strong evil heart, then it will be obedient to them, but if it senses even a shred of conscience, it will crush even its own master under its bulk.
dokimon: A Slime Digimon that was born from human vital data. You can't tell from just its appearance, but when picked up, its whole body vibrates at a constant rhythm. The rhythm of these vibrations seems to reflect that of the heartbeat of the person who is holding it.
donedevimon: A form of Devimon that took in negative data to its limit and became an Ultimate. Its mental state is between normal and abnormal, and once it is angered, its intelligence vanishes, and it attacks in a ferocious manner. Digimon that are attacked by a berserk Done Devimon disappear without a trace.
entmon: A Plant Digimon with a body woven and fused together from dead trees. Its whole body has rotted away in places, and mold grows on parts where the bark has been exposed. Its body is packed with a large number of insects, serving as the muscles that move its body around.
eosmonAdult: An artificial Digimon that was created based on a certain Digimon. The prevailing view that the Child level is the final form of artificial Digimon has been refuted due to the passion of researchers with the changing times, allowing them to evolve to the Adult level. Because Eosmon lacks emotion and moves according to the researcher's instructions, its good or wicked actions are down to the researcher.
eosmonPerfect: The form Adult-level Eosmon evolved into when a problem occurred as it was carrying out a mission. It deploys even more transparent panels, and has acquired high-speed movement with its enormous wings and high offensive power with its gigantic hands. In addition, it can also create illusions by using them as mirrors to bewilder the enemy.
eosmonUltimate: An Ultimate-level Eosmon that was born after several of the Eosmon that were created formed a single collective entity as a result of a researcher losing control when things didn't go as planned. It will destroy any obstacle, and act violently just as instructed. It is able to generate new Perfect-level Eosmon from its swollen tail, increasing its subordinates.
exermon: A Digimon that evolved from yoga lesson data. It mainly lives in high mountainous regions, and fights using its own style of taijutsu, which incorporates unique movements similar to those of a mollusk. It has an excellent sense of balance in that it supports its own weight with the stinger on its rump, and its core always remains stable regardless of what unnatural pose it takes.
eyesmon: A Digimon capable of concealing itself in shadows. The more data it accumulates, the stronger it becomes, and its power surpasses even that of Perfects depending on how much it has stored. It possesses many eyes, and does not turn a blind eye to any of the enemy's movements.
eyesmonScatterMode: The scattered form of Eyesmon. It monitors social networking services where large volumes of data flow, and consumes and accumulates larger data. Their power is weak due to them being scattered about, but once they sense that they are in danger, they will converge into one and counterattack.
gabumonYujonokizuna: The strong bond between Gabumon and its Partner, it is a legendary, final evolution that was achieved after countless possibilities. The undying "Friendship" of its Partner turned into elegant armor which covers its body, and appears as proof of the trust coursing through both of them. It is able to fly by generating photon light wings on its back, but it can also transform into its Motorcycle Mode, which is its Partner's favorite vehicle, and ride fast together.
machmon: A Cyborg Digimon that yearns for speed. Dust clouds over barren plains are often caused by Machmon racing noisily. Despite its motorcycle-like appearance, it doesn't have a seat, and no one wants to ride it.
manticoremon: A ferocious Demon Beast Digimon that prefers the Digicores of Virus Digimon. It is employed by Angel-species Digimon, who noticed its fixation on fiendish viruses. It lacks intelligence and reason, and its sole raison d'être is simply to crave for and consume the data of others.
marinchimairamon: A Composite Digimon that was created by putting together the parts of various Aquatic Digimon. It is thought to have been produced using the same technology as Chimairamon, but other than that, it is a complete mystery. It appears out of nowhere like a gust of wind, bringing devastation to ecosystems with its terrifying destructive impulses, and then disappears somewhere else.
metalgreymonAlterousMode: Metal Greymon, who acquired immense power by mechanizing its upper body, has been updated with further mechanization to its right arm. With the accumulation of fierce battles that it has lived through, it transformed its right arm into a huge energy cannon called "Alterous" so that it can fight against tough enemies that draw near. Its Special Moves are concentrating energy into the "Alterous" and firing subluminal bombardments (Positron Blaster), and a positron sword in which it converts the energy it has accumulated into a blade (Alter Blade).
mimicmon: An Adult Digimon that is thought to have mutated from security software used for protecting computer terminals. As a result of capturing and taking in Virus-types that invade its territory like a trap, its own Attribute has become Virus as well. There are numerous Digimon sealed within its body, and the arms and horn coming out of its cage all originate from other Digimon.
mitamamon: A holy Digimon that is said to send the souls of Digimon who have done good deeds in their past lives to heaven. A collection of the four energies of fire, water, lightning and wind, it lacks physical form except for its Digicore. Despite being visible, it cannot be touched; only those who have been recognized by Mitamamon itself or Digimon who are on the brink of death are allowed to touch it.
morphomon: A Digimon whose ears and hands are composed of butterfly wings. It has feelings of enjoyment toward nature and a carefree personality. It touches anyone it has seen for the first time to determine whether they are safe to be around or not, and if they are, and if it has taken a liking to them, it will follow them.
namakemon: A Puppet Digimon that has ended up only finding joy in life from eating and sleeping. Its dislike of strenuous exercise has even erased its combat instincts as a Digimon, and it has come to live in elevated areas such as on treetops so that no one can approach it. Because both of its arms are often being used to grasp onto tree branches, it is also able to use its long, well-developed tongue skilfully as a third arm.
negamon: A Baby Digimon that grew up immersed in the negative data that the Network is overflowing with. It lives quietly in jet-black darkness, constantly awaiting its death. It appears before approaching Digimon, and makes them prey on themselves with the curse of its "Downer Eye".
nidhoggmon: A colossal Digimon that takes vast amounts of energy into its body, and is in a constant state of thermal runaway. The light emitted from its wings indicates what stage of thermal runaway it is in; the more it approaches the danger level, the redder it becomes. Nidhoggmon repeatedly destroys and absorbs things, leaving nothing behind in its wake.
sunarizamon: A Reptile Digimon that mainly acts in groups while camouflaging itself in desert areas. By controlling the amount of sand that makes up its body, it is able to expand and contract, and transform its limbs and tail. It is difficult to detect once it has blended in with the desert, and it is not uncommon for one to think that there is quicksand, but turns out to be hordes of Sunarizamon.
tobiumon: An Aquatic Digimon that corners its targeted prey at high speed. Its oddly developed fins allow it to fly, and its large arms enable it to move on the ground. It holds the alias of "Hunter Fish" due to bringing down its targets regardless of whether they are on land, in the sea, or in the air.
toropiamon: A Plant Digimon that inhabits jungles. It is thought to have evolved into this gaudy appearance by taking in the data of various trees and fruits. Its scent, which is like a mixture of all kinds of fruits, is so intense that those who are not used to it will get knocked out cold.
weregarurumonSagittariusMode: A form that acquired "Sagittarius", mobility equipment that makes up for the agility that it lost when it evolved from Garurumon. It has gained firepower, in addition to high-speed movement and the ability to fly thanks to the Sagittarius' booster function. Its loyal personality remains unchanged, and it has developed into a more reliable battlefield professional that will rescues its master in any predicament.
parasaurmon: A gentle Dinosaur Digimon that lives in a warm climate. The fruit-like organs around its long neck sprinkle a sweet scent into its surroundings. This scent has the role of informing the herd of their position, and it seems that the scent differs slightly depending on the individual.
piranimon: A ferocious Aquatic Digimon that acts in large schools. The exoskeleton covering its head amplifies the power of its jaws so that it can reliably bring down the enemy with its sharp fangs. That power is said to rival that of a Mammon stomping.
pomumon: Although it looks like a Bird-type, it is a Plant Digimon whose body is packed with juices with high sugar content like that of a fruit. For that reason, it has many natural predators such as Bird and Insect Digimon. Despite having wings, it is mainly active on land because its flight speed is so slow that it becomes defenseless.
rebellimon: A Cyborg Digimon equipped with a high-powered engine. It is said to have evolved from a Digimon driven to the brink of death that took in junk data from its surroundings. It is an outlaw who loots parts from other Machine-species Digimon in order to further strengthen and remodel its body, which is made out of junk.
regalecusmon: An aloof Aquatic Digimon that hates crowds. It is a pirate who repeatedly assaults and plunders the feeding grounds and territories of other Digimon, and also the ruler of the abyss that stands at the apex of the food chain due to its overwhelming power. Its sword, which it made after tearing off a Zudomon's horn, and the giant pincer on its left arm are symbols of awe that strike fear into those who lay their eyes upon them.
runnermon: A Beast Digimon that evolved via the data from a treadmill. It is capable of running without any loss in speed even through areas with poor footing such as mountainous areas or swamplands. However, rather than its speed or ability to cover distances, its stamina deserves special mention; it is able to continue running for long periods while maintaining its top speed the entire time.
sangomon: A Mollusk Digimon that lives in the shallows of the Net Ocean. It often mingles with other species due to its gentle disposition and cheerfulness. It uses the backs of Shellmon as a resting spot, and Ganimon have been witnessed trimming the coral protruding from its head.
gusokumon: A Crustacean Digimon that lurks at the bottom of the ocean, at a depth that light fails to reach. It is also known for being a long-lived Digimon, capable of long-term biological activity while consuming a miniscule amount of energy. Weak, injured Digimon that occasionally sink to the bottom of the ocean turn into its prey.
heavyleomon: A Machine Digimon with the heaviest build, rare even among the various Leomon families. Its power is the greatest among Machine-types thanks to its charging power, so it is difficult to stop Heavy Leomon from charging head-on. The source of Heavy Leomon's charging power is its passionate fighting spirit, and its strength doubles the more its fighting spirit burns.
junkmon: A Puppet Digimon with a habit of tossing junk parts into the cannon on its back. It creates a comfortable environment by dismantling structures in its surroundings. If a well-known factory disappears before you know it, then a large number of Junkmon may be responsible.
kazuchimon: An Ultimate Digimon that evolved by tempering its body and soul to the limit through unimaginable training. To Kazuchimon, fighting is something it has devoted everything to, and is a sacred rite that must never be desecrated. It is a natural-born warrior who is so immersed in refining its tactics and strategies that it forgets to eat and sleep, and once in battle, it turns into a raging war god and exhibits the strength to take on a thousand warriors.
abbadomoncore: The main body that exists within Abbadomon, it is its true form. It seeks nothingness, prefers nothingness, and rejects everything except nothingness. After it turns everything into nothingness, it disappears itself, fulfilling its purpose.
achillesmon: An Ultimate Digimon that evolved by becoming adept in every kind of sport from all times and places, and mastering them. It possesses heart, technique, and physique, and is a true seeker that is always training, and never boasts about its tenacious power. Its extreme physical ability has no weaknesses, and so it achieves victory without leaving any openings, not only in sports, but also in battle.
ajatarmon: A Plant Digimon that lives in groups similar to tribes. They have established small civilizations deep in the jungle. Generally speaking, they are taciturn and do not speak very much, and when hunting in groups, they contact each other through hand gestures and bring down their prey with excellent coordination.
angoramon: A Beast Digimon characterized by its long ears and the fur that covers its whole body. It hates fighting and has a calm personality, and avoids battle by detecting the approach of enemies from a distance with its long ears. Also, its long ears spin, allowing it to fly slowly.
betelgammamon: A form in which Gammamon grew up, and its body turned red due to the flames of its blazing heart. Its agility has increased, and its power and speed in close combat have risen even more. The power of its attacks doubles as the excitement of its emotions swells.
blacktailmonuver: A form that Black Tailmon transformed into by absorbing large amounts of courier service data that flowed into the Digital World in recent years. Its mean personality has completely gone, and it delivers ordered packages with full dedication, whatever the day. It is often seen delivering things while clinging to the back of Pistmon, who it is on good terms with.
bloomlordmon: A Fairy Digimon in the form of a plant clad in armor, it is a kind-hearted knight that fights to protect nature. It accumulates energy by absorbing sunlight through the flowers on its shoulders. The power it exhibits once that energy has been raised to its limit is said to even rival that of the Royal Knights.
bosamon: A Lesser Digimon that evolved from Pyonmon. Its bangs have grown out, hiding its eyes, so it can now move around without worrying about others looking at it. Its shy personality has changed into one that is calm.
canoweissmon: A Sky Dragon Digimon with large wings, its body surface has turned a high-purity white as a result of the flames of its blazing heart further intensifying. It prefers fair matches in terms of power and speed, and shows a joyful expression as the battle heats up. However, it will not permit injustice or unjust actions, and takes them on in a righteous manner to overcome them.
climbmon: An Insect Digimon that evolved via bouldering course data. The pickaxes on its arms are used not only for piercing things such as cliffs, but also for tapping and driving the kunai-shaped pitons it carries in the underside of its wings into sturdy rocks. Skillfully using its pickaxes and pitons, it clings onto any dangerous spot, and moves quickly and brilliantly like a ninja.
curimon: A Baby Digimon characterized by the single horn on its brow and its frill. It is so active that before it is even born its Digitama bounces, and after hatching it moves around vigorously. The horn on its brow and the frill on its head are still immature and soft, and although they cannot be used in battle yet, they help it to keep its balance while moving around and to defend itself even when hit.
divemon: A Digimon that evolved via data which studied the swimming styles of top swimmers. Although it has a merman-like appearance, it is capable of bipedal activities on land. Its swimming speed is top-class even among Aquatic Digimon, and its four eyes never lose sight of its underwater prey.
frosvelgrmon: A Giant Bird Digimon that rarely appears before others. It is considered to be a symbol of awe in certain regions, and according to legend, it appears before those who are stranded on snowy mountains and assesses their lives. It is said that those who are deemed worthy of saving descend the mountain on Fros Velgrmon, but those who are deemed unworthy are given a peaceful death with its freezing breath.
frozomon: A Machine Digimon that inhabits areas with heavy snowfall and removes snow vigorously. Contrary to its reliable side that rescues those who get lost in snowstorms and the like, it is also a troublesome Digimon who uses all its strength to eliminate those that get in the way of its rescues, even if they are Babies. It is a specialist when it comes to cold regions who is capable of not only removing snow, but also melting ice with its red-hot sword.
gaioumonIttoMode: The form of a Gaioumon defeated in battle that acquired new strength after unimaginable training. The oni data sleeping within its Digicore has awakened, and its fighting style has changed to Ittō-ryū. Having mastered "Tenrin Ittō-ryū", kenjutsu passed down through the Eastern Digital World, Gaioumon specializes in "silent" swordplay in which it instantly cuts down its opponents without even making a sound.
gammamon: A very rare, young, white Ceratopsian Digimon that was recently discovered. Gammamon's evolution is said to be linked to a "digital signal that came from extragalactic space". The two hard horns that grow from its brow are weapons that are useful for offense and defense.
lamortmon: A Perfect Digimon whose hidden feral instincts have been unleashed. It will immediately swoop down on Digimon that express their disgust towards it and keep smashing them until they stop breathing. Although it is an impetuous Digimon that has uncontrollable impulses, it seems that there are some individuals who are ashamed of and despise their own impulses.
lovelyangemon: A close combat specialist renowned for being an angel that descended to earth. It is always bright and cheerful, and adorns itself in a fashionable manner, and has a lovely personality that enjoys eating delicious things while walking about. However, Lovely Angemon contains the data of magical fighters who engage in hand-to-hand combat, and deals fiendish enemies that it can never forgive with a breathtaking combo of combat techniques.
sunamon: A Slime Digimon whose body is made of sand. Despite being a Baby, it has an aggressive personality, and is territorial. It has a body that falls apart like sand, or conversely, hardens like clay at will, but its pacifier never changes shape.
symbareangoramon: The Adult form of Angoramon that has shed the long, soft fur covering it in pursuit of agility. Although it has lost its defensive ability due to the cushioned fur covering its body, its movements have become nimble. It strives for beauty in its behavior and movements, and in battle, it dodges the enemy's attacks as if it were dancing, in lockstep with its own attacks.
tempomon: A Bird Man Digimon that evolved via dance music data. It is a natural-born dancer who always performs to the rhythm and unleashes its taijutsu while dancing, even in battle. It is a performer who dances to things ranging from cheerful music to mellow, moody songs, and whenever its headphones come off or the music stops, it gets into a bad mood and starts acting violently.
teslajellymon: The Adult form of Jellymon that has grown by absorbing data from combat sports like steel cage death matches while in search of stimulation and pleasure. Its electric shock techniques have been further enhanced, and there are even more techniques adapted from things such as karate and professional wrestling in the fighting it unleashes. It easily dodges the enemy's attacks by capitalizing on the softness of its body.
thetismon: An Aquatic Beast Man Digimon which has the appearance of a woman, records show that it was discovered in the deepest trenches of the "Net Ocean", the birthplace of Digimon. It brings peace to its own vast territory, and immediately approaches and brings down the hammer on Digimon that tumultuously disturb it. Although it shows no mercy to those who invade its territory, it is kind to Digimon in need of help, guiding them to safety, and has a spirit that fights for the weak against the strong.
ukkomon: A mythical Ancient Species Digimon whose activity records remain in the ancient Digital World. Rumor has it that Ukkomon can grant the wishes of others, and it is said that because of this, many Digimon gathered around Ukkomon and flourished, forming villages. However, records of Ukkomon's activities were lost with the destruction of the ancient Digital World, and it is thought that it had become extinct.
vulturemon: A Digimon whose cruelty is unrivaled, it prioritizes its own interests above all else. Feared as the "Reaper of Dust", it has excellent eyesight such that it can shoot its targets even in sandstorms. It wears its camouflage cloak in open areas, hides itself and waits for an opportunity to arise.
wezengammamon: The Adult of Gammamon that has taken on a quadrupedal appearance, it now has an imposing attitude and a generous heart. It is equipped with firearms on various parts of its body; the two horns on its calvaria have turned into long-range cannons, the horn on its snout has turned into a anti-aircraft gun, and the tips of its four feet have turned into small autocannons, and it is capable of firing them. The normal pace of its actions is sluggish.
pistmon: A Plant Digimon that evolved via a training program used by road racers. Its bicycle-like wheels and body are fully integrated with each other, and it has a remarkable sense of balance that allows it to stand still even when it is not running. Its thorny vines, which act as tires, are capable of changing shape, allowing it to run across even rough roads speedily without going flat.
potamon: A gourmet Digimon that read data on all kinds of fries. As it walks about eating fries, it wants many Digimon to know how delicious they are, and goes around sharing fries that it recommends. It views those who criticize its fries as complainers, and bashes its "Shubashuba Potato", which sends razor-sharp fries flying, and its big, flat, piping hot "Bashed Potato" down from the sky, and lets those who have apologized to it enjoy the splendor of its fries.
puyomon: A soft and sticky Slime Digimon that was discovered in the "Net Ocean". Its single, lens-like eye lacks emotional expression, so you can't tell what it's thinking, but it drifts through the sky or the sea, trying to stick to objects and other Digimon with its tentacles. Once it sticks onto something, it will emit tingling static electricity (Pachipachi Gas), but this seems to be a form of communication unique to Puyomon rather than an attack.
puyoyomon: Puyomon evolved by taking in jellyfish data. It grew several tentacles by copying the biological features of jellyfish. As you can tell from its round eyes that are brimming with curiosity, it has grown its own preferences, and once it sticks to something that it likes, it will not let go.
pyonmon: A Baby Digimon covered in tufty body hair that has a single large ear. It was shy the moment it was born, so if someone stares at it, it will instantly lower its head. However, it is also friendly, and can be seen rubbing its body against Digimon that it is interested in, actively engaging in skin-to-skin contact.
rareraremon: The Perfect form of Raremon, who survived the progressive decay of its body through further mechanization, and took on a bizarre appearance. Its body repeatedly breaks down and reconstitutes itself, and eyes and mouths keep emerging and decaying. The foul stench it gives off from its entire body has increased so much that even Ultimates have difficulty approaching it.
shivamon: An Ultimate Digimon that evolved by achieving enlightenment through yoga. It is a pursuer of peace that possesses both a gentle heart and the rigor of trying to guide others. It shows its violent disposition to those who lack decorum or disturb the peace, and annihilates them without mercy.
shootmon: A Machine Digimon that evolved via the data of various ball games from around the world. With a cannon in one hand capable of shooting all kinds of balls, it plans to popularize ball games throughout the Digital World. Shootmon is nicknamed the "Laughing Oni Coach" by Digimon that fear it because it approaches them with a smiling face that never changes whether it is angry or happy.
shroudmon: A Demon Man Digimon that evolved when a certain Digimon tempered its body beyond its limit during unimaginable training. As a result of it just fighting repeatedly like an Asura, it came to be known as the "Fierce God". Its mind is already broken, and it has even forgotten the reason why it sought strength.
goromon: A Baby Digimon that grows by eating rocks. Because its digestive system is not fully developed yet, it stores an amount of ore in its body unimaginable given its small size, and gradually converts it into nourishment. The site in which its eye is located also serves as its mouth, and it seems to turn completely blind while eating.
gulusgammamon: A ferocious Digimon that evolved when the evil heart hidden within Gammamon was unleashed. It rejects interference from those around it and is only interested in fighting, and once it catches an opponent that comes into sight, it will not stop attacking them until they breathe their last breath. It puts up ferocious battles where it attacks regardless of whether its limbs get broken.
gurimon: A Baby Digimon that grew up from Curimon and now has two horns on its brow. It bounces around energetically, and when it finds large, hard rocks, it strikes them with its horn-charging Signature Move "Chikuchiku Attack". It enjoys coming across whole rocks, and runs around bursting with energy to become even stronger.
hiyarimon: A Lesser Digimon that evolved from Yukimi Botamon. The fluffy cilia it once had are now gone, and instead the surface of its body is always covered with snow. It lives mostly in snowy mountains, and its body melts when exposed to sunlight, so it is active after sunset.
hydramon: A gigantic Plant Digimon that primarily takes root in swampland. It constantly secretes a highly-toxic liquid from its whole body, which it mercilessly uses to dissolve anyone that touches it and preys on them. Also, it has a habit of expelling large amounts of that liquid from its abdomen, melting the ground and creating swamps to expand its nest.
jellymon: A Mollusk Digimon with a squishy head like a jellyfish. Its whole body is flexible, which allows it to retract its body into its head, and it usually lives with just its head showing. While it is in this form, it is light enough to fly just by being blown by the wind.
kausgammamon: A form in which Gammamon grew up, and its body turned blue due to its calm and clear mind. It soars like a glider by spreading the membranes under both of its arms, allowing it to fly far from high places, or rise just briefly while gliding using the jet ports on its knees. It is always calm, cool, and collected, and fights by seeing through the opponent's movements.
kodokugumonchild: A Child Digimon with the appearance of a spider that behaves in clusters with Dokugumon. It is usually docile and hangs from things such as tree branches with its body curled into a ball, but if an enemy approaches, it attacks en masse from overhead. It wears gloves with a strong poison on the claws because it is unable to produce a strong poison of its own yet.
komondomon: A vehicle Digimon that loves to move around while carrying other Digimon. It feels like it is taking a walk wherever it goes and has a carefree personality that doesn't mind wherever it sets foot. It can dive and navigate underwater by spinning its tail.
amphimon: A Cyborg Digimon that wanders about everywhere in the vast "Net Ocean", forging connections with various marine Digimon. It is capable of diving into ultra-high pressure zones thanks to the Bodysuit that covers its whole body, and has even intruded the "Abyss Sanctuary", which is constructed at the extreme depths of the sea. Like Angel Digimon and God Man Digimon, it is permitted to pass judgment upon those judged to be evil in the Net Ocean.
arcturusmon: A mysterious Digimon that is said to have evolved by concentrating dark, evil energy to the extreme. In a study on certain Digimon that produce the secretion known as GRB Factor, it was found that they "theoretically" evolved when a simulation was conducted in which large amounts of GRB Factor were injected into the Digimon that produce it themselves to their limit. Although the simulation was repeated hundreds of times, all of the simulation results confirmed that they would evolve into this Digimon, so it is theorized to be a Digimon that can manifest even in the real Digital World as long as the conditions are met.
baalmonXAntibody: As an enlightened Digimon that excels in all knowledge, it is called the "Sublime Lord". According to one theory, it is surely another form of a certain Demon Lord Digimon. It is said that in exchange for the reader's soul, it will grant one page of information from the "Red Book of Appin", which records all of its knowledge.
bombermon: The self-proclaimed "Explosive Artist" who loves explosions more than anything else. Its sole governing principle is about how beautifully the bombs it creates will detonate, and has no feelings regarding the damage caused by their explosions. It is capable of generating its standalone "BB" bombs by snapping the fingers on its left hand.
chamblemon: A Plant Digimon in the shape of an extremely poisonous mushroom. It is a mystery whether it evolved from Mushmon, or if it is another variant. Although it is often seen as being weak, it is quite the ruffian.
diarbbitmon: An astute Beast Knight Digimon that protects the nature-rich land inhabited by many Beast Digimon. It has a gentle personality and prefers spending its time quietly while interacting with the Digimon around it. If an enemy that threatens the land appears, it will draw its two cherished swords, "Móralltach" and "Beagalltach", and drive the enemy back with its nimble movements.
espimon: A Cyborg Digimon that immediately flies in to investigate whenever it catches wind of gossip and suspicion flowing into the Digital World. It will bravely infiltrate places in order to find out the truth, even if they are inhabited by dangerous Digimon. When it switches its eyes to Search Mode, it is able to clearly see objects several kilometers away.
fumamon: A ninja Digimon that has mastered the excellent assassination technique of Fuma-ryu Ninjutsu. It makes its living as an assassin, disposing of its targets upon receiving a request. It specializes in melee attacks that capitalize on its outstanding physical ability, but since it also utilizes projectile weapons such as shuriken, it has attack styles that leave few openings, even at mid and long-range.
lianpumon: A Mutation Digimon that wears a distinctive mask. It has a cheerful personality that loves the festive atmosphere, and will switch between various masks to try to liven up the mood. If a mask is removed, another one will immediately emerge from beneath, so no one has seen its true face behind the mask.
oboromon: An Undead Digimon that lives in graveyards like a ghost, it is a berserker who never backs down against superior opponents and fights by any means necessary. It is thought that the reason it has an unusually intense obsession with victory is because it has taken in a large amount of hatred data from the Digimon it has defeated. On the other hand, it has virtually no sense of self, and when it isn't fighting, it wanders around the graveyard foolishly, and has occasionally been witnessed conversing suspiciously with the beast skull fused to its left arm.
oleamon: An Insectivorous Plant Digimon confirmed to inhabit the forest regions of the Digital World. The scent emitted from its flower lures Insect Digimon in particular. It wraps its tongue around prey entranced by its scent to taste them, and then preys on them with its "Jameal", in which it spreads its petals wide.
xiangpengmon: A Holy Bird Digimon referred to as a phantom, it has a body large enough to cover a mountain. It usually sleeps peacefully at the depths of the Net Ocean. While sleeping, Xiangpengmon's data regulates the surrounding environment.
xingtianmon: An Oni (Warrior) Digimon with a unique appearance resembling an enormous face with limbs growing from it. It may sound good to say that it has an indomitable fighting spirit, but it is actually a stubborn Digimon that never accepts defeat, no matter how disadvantageous the situation is.    If someone makes fun of its appearance or its battle situation becomes disadvantageous, it will express its anger by letting out a war cry while swinging the axe in its right hand.
xiquemon: A different kind of Bird Digimon that travels freely in the air and water. It contains fish data within its Digicore, and dives directly into the water from a flying position, swimming and hunting as if it were flying. It is said that the reason why it wears goggles is to protect its vision while swimming.
zanmetsumon: A swordmaster Digimon that freely wields five swords. It wanders the Digital World and devotes itself to battle, thinking only about honing its sword techniques. It is capable of unleashing slash attacks in all directions from the swords it holds in its four hands and the one equipped to its tail, so it is difficult even for those with considerable skill to avoid them completely.
proximamon: A mysterious Digimon that is said to govern over destruction and creation, and possess immense power. Since it is a Digimon whose "theoretical" manifestation was predicted in a simulation on a high-speed computing device, it is unknown whether it exists in the real Digital World. It has the ability to generate the opposing forces of holy energy and evil energy, and is said to be capable of disassembling every constituent substance in the Digital World with evil energy, and reconstructing the disassembled substances with holy energy to create new ones.
publimon: A Mutation Digimon wearing a shell hood that loves observing other Digimon, and transmits the data it has compiled on them throughout the Digital World. Since the content is very trivial, it will occasionally report things regardless of whether it puts its life at risk, for example, clashing with Angel Digimon for taking an interest in the Three Archangels. Although it is supported by a large number of readers due to the content that it publishes, there are many readers who detest it.
regulusmon: An Evil Dragon Digimon that plots to rule through rage and fear. Despite being a Perfect, it boasts a power that is reminiscent of Megidramon, one of the Four Great Dragons Digimon who is renowned for being the most evil, and so Regulusmon's arrival is nothing short of a disaster. Its body is the source of an infection known as "GRB" (Gulus Realm Burst), and it is said that Digimon infected with "GRB Factor" have their personalities altered and become frenzied.
shinmonzaemon: A Puppet Digimon that evolved as a result of Monzaemon taking in nightmare-related analysis data. At first glance, it is shaped like a teddy bear, but it is actually a fluffy, amorphous Digimon with a mysterious nature, like a cross between slime and clouds. It is a moody Digimon that has a childish personality and does not act intelligently.
siriusmon: An Ultimate-level Light Dragon Digimon that is affiliated with the group of justice, the Virus Busters. Whenever it senses a voice crying for help or malice, even from far away, it will descend like a comet and bring down the enemy with the "Sylvia" composite cannon-blades equipped to both its arms. However, it is a kind-hearted being who brightens up everything around it such that if it senses a change of heart in its opponent during battle, it will lay down its arms and open up to them.
ghilliedhumon: A Digimon that inhabits forested areas and specializes in sniping. Its skill as a hunter is very high, and it blends in with the forest using the camouflage suit that covers its whole body and snipes without its prey knowing its location. Although it is a Digimon with a calm disposition, it has a strong attachment to its territorial hunting grounds, so those who carelessly step into Ghilliedhumon's hunting grounds will be sniped without warning.
greymonBlueXAntibody: A Virus attribute Greymon with a bluish-black body. While it has been called a feral Greymon, befitting its more violent disposition, it is in no way a lone wolf and possesses enough intelligence to work together with its allies as a team. Its Special Move is a blast of high-temperature flames spewed from its mouth (Mega Flame).
gyukimon: A Demon Beast Digimon with an ox-like upper body and a spider lower body. With a brutal and insidious personality, it is a monster that chases after those who see it for days, and launches surprise attacks from behind every night. Despite its large build, it skillfully uses its spider legs to move quietly without making a sound.
hoverespimon: Having succeeded in multiple investigations, Espimon has become highly mobilized so that it can obtain more accurate information. It can now navigate over long distances, fly, and dive, and its field of activity extends to the depths of the "Net Ocean" and altitudes of up to 20,000m, making it possible for it to investigate hidden Digimon. Its "Divanish" optical camouflage has also been updated.
huanglongmonRuinMode: A form of Huanglongmon that went berserk after being imbued with malice energy. Having lost its goodness and light, it became a being inclined towards evil and darkness alone, and rampages to bring the world to ruin. According to records, the Four Holy Beasts joined forces and succeeded in subduing the rampant Huanglongmon.
huankunmon: A giant Aquatic Digimon whose whole body is covered in scales boasting a hardness rivaling that of Chrome Digizoid. It has a gentle personality, prefers clear water, and protects the areas around lakes from environmental pollution. When feeding, it will jump out of the lake, move as if it is swimming in the air, and swallow flying Digimon whole to satisfy its appetite.
arkhaiangemon: A Principality-type Perfect Digimon of equal rank to Holy Angemon and Angewomon. It has a strong sense of concern for others, and is frequently seen interacting with various Digimon. Perhaps it is because of this personality that its fighting style specializes in defense, and since it also excels in ingenuity, it acts as both an adviser and commander in its assigned unit.
bigukkomon: A Digimon that is thought to have appeared the moment the ancient Digital World was destroyed. It is said that it sacrificed its own life to summon a Digitama from the sorrow of the Digimon that disappeared one after another as a result of the destruction. However, there are no records of whether this act had been accomplished or not.
bowmon: A Lesser Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. It takes interest in everything it sees, and has a habit of sniffing them out. Although it is an active Digimon, it immediately tumbles over when running due to its short legs.
brigadramon: D-Brigade had perfected an Ultimate Digimon as their weapon of last resort in the past, but this individual caused a fiasco when it broke out after running wild. After reflecting upon their failure to produce the strongest and most unique Digimon to represent their organization, they evolved and developed a Digimon as a command aircraft for managing troops efficiently—Brigadramon. It circles above the mission area, searching for and destroying threats on the ground or at low altitudes.
cargodramon: A Digimon in charge of troop transport for the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said to have evolved by taking in tiltrotor aircraft design data from the Real World obtained via hacking. It has excellent maneuverability that allows it to hover and fly at high-speed by adjusting the angle of the propellers on both of its wings.
cthyllamon: Cthyllamon inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean, and is known by the alias "Phantom of the Ocean" due to the fact that only the skull pattern on its chest can be seen floating eerily in the dark sea. Instead of actively fighting on its own, it employs aquatic Digimon that are a lower Level than itself by brainwashing them, and has a crafty and cunning disposition. Because of its appearance, and since it is rarely ever seen, it shares many similarities with Marin Angemon, but the relationship between them remains unknown.
dijiangmon: A Mutation Digimon with a grotesque appearance whose whole body is covered in leather. Since it doesn't speak nor try to express anything with its body, it usually just stands on the spot in an eerie silence. Generally speaking, it has no interest in self-expression, and is an evil Digimon that specializes only in robbing others of life.
fenriloogamon: Fenriloogamon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a Digicore". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the Interface on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the data of the warg from real-world mythology within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is an "Ultimate Demon Beast", clad in silver armor and wielding an inexhaustible supply of magical power.
fenriloogamonTakemikazuchi: The ornament around Fenriloogamon's neck, known as "Gleipnir", is inscribed with ancient magic, and it is said that when Fenriloogamon's Digicore is filled with strong "emotions", that magic is invoked, and is capable of materializing those "emotions". Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi is a form achieved by causing Kazuchimon to undergo a miraculous evolution using the effects of this magic. Its Special Move is "Shūkyoku Senjin Takemikazuchi", a deadly slash attack that it unleashes, harboring the power of lightning and magical flames within the "Takemikazuchi" greatsword held in its mouth.
fusamon: A Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. Although it is a Digimon brimming with curiosity that loves to move around, it spends most of its time sleeping due to it tiring easily. When danger draws near, it will emit a high-pitched, threatening cry called "Puppy Noise".
loogamon: A Demon Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. It is said that the data of the warg from real-world mythology is embedded within the deepest parts of its Digicore, and it exhibits behavior so violent that you would not expect it from a Child. At first glance, it looks like a cute puppy, but if one approaches it carelessly, they will be on the receiving end of a fierce counterattack.
loogarmon: A Demon Beast Digimon that generates an enormous amount of magical power within its body. The amount of magical power it generates is extraordinary, so it constantly releases it from its mouth in the form of flames. These flames have enough burning and spreading power to incinerate its surroundings just by roaring.
luxmon: An Angel Digimon with a small, child-like body that belongs to the lowest rank among angels. It is often teased by Impmon and Pico Devimon, possibly because of its pure, innocent nature which makes it incapable of seeing through lies. It does not possess much power due to it being a Child, but once in battle, it is able to demonstrate its true strength in fighting against superior opponents by working together with other Luxmon.
soloogarmon: A Digimon that succeeded in controlling the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. Program code written in a special language lines the inside of the armor that covers its whole body, suppressing its enormous amount of magical power, which is transformed into raging magical flames, as if it were sealed magic. Soloogarmon is able to freely manipulate the magical flames by modifying the program code, and these manipulated flames can be utilized for all kinds of actions, such as attacking, moving, and posture control.
takutoumon: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone.
tlalocmon: A Mineral Digimon that can be said to be the avatar of nature, ruling over rain and thunder. It has the ability to bless dry land with rain, and inflict divine punishment upon those who destroy nature with lightning to purify them. It is usually cheerful and calm, but occasionally displays ferocity to the point of being brutal.
pteromon: A Bird Dragon Digimon that flies about freely through the skies over vast forests. The horns on its head are soft, and serve more as sensory organs than they do for offense. It can acutely perceive changes in climate by reading the wind striking against its horns.
quantumon: An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which floats above the vast "Net Ocean", shrouded by enormous clouds. Quantumon extracts huge amounts of data from the Net Ocean using the expansion devices installed on Larc, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Together with its Digimon followers, Quantumon implements the best measures it has formulated against disasters that are predicted to occur in the Digital World.
shoemon: A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If someone tries to touch it, it will jump quickly and immediately flee. Due to its timid nature, it can acutely sense vibrations in the floor or ground it is in contact with, and quickly detect the presence of invading enemies.
helloogarmon: A Digimon in a chaotic state, overflowing with an enormous amount of magical power, whose form was released through the Interface on its brow by the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. That enormous amount of magical power is transformed into magical flames, which keep spewing forth endlessly. The ultra-high-temperature magical flames have consumed even Helloogarmon itself, so nearly its entire body has been replaced by those flames.
hiCommandramon: A heavy infantry Digimon from the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said that many of those that are not chosen in "Selection-D", a special selection test that screens through 100 Commandramon, evolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a "shield", and defend assault troops of Commandramon with its enormous build and protective shield.
cendrillmon: An Ultimate Digimon born from the data of the fairy tale "Cinderella". Despite its appearance, it inhabits volcanic regions. It is based at "Cinderella Castle", which is made of volcanic ash, and lives quietly so as to not attract the attention of others.
chaperomon: A Perfect Digimon whose body is composed of data from ornamental dolls and fairy tales. It has taken on a humanoid form, but since its body is similar to a doll, its joints bend in the wrong direction, so it surprises those who see it. It carries a large amount of "Mini Monzaemon Gummies" in its basket, and eats them whenever it has free time, even when it isn't hungry.
erlangmon: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It acts in accordance with its conviction to rid all Digimon of their wicked hearts, and others refer to it as an upright Digimon due to the way it is honest.    A master that wields the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo as freely as its own limbs, it is also accompanied by its sentient treasure tool "Kōtenken", which resembles the head of a giant dog, and cherishes it as its companion, appearing anywhere in an instant regardless of the situation when summoned, and excelling in surprise attacks.
fluffymon: A Small Bird Digimon that operates while hiding within the luscious leaves of the forest trees. Although it is still unable to fly due to its wings being undeveloped, it is agile enough to dash up vertical tree trunks in one go. Its Special Move is a headbutt that capitalizes on its speed (Birdy Head).
galemon: A Bird Dragon Digimon characterized by its large wings and blade-like horns. Its hardened horns are even more developed than Pteromon's, allowing it to quickly perceive any abnormalities in its surroundings through the wind they detect, akin to a sixth sense. It is an intelligent species that strikes the first blow by predicting not only environmental changes, but also threats such as enemy invasions or attacks.
takutoumonWrathMode: The form that Takutoumon boldly Mode Changes into when throwing itself into great battles. The Bǎo Tǎ has materialized into armor, its white mouse-shaped karakuri has transformed into a trident, and its appearance is a manifestation of the data of an "Eastern God" who is identified with a legendary warrior.    It amplifies its own power by releasing the vast amount of fighting spirit it had stolen and sealed within the Bǎo Tǎ all at once.
yolkmon: A Slime Digimon that still wears the shell from its Digitama. It has a carefree personality and lives its life by slipping into the nests of other Digimon. Because its Digitama shell acts as camouflage, it evolves while hardly being spotted.
zephagamon: An Ultimate Digimon known as the God of Wind, it is an embodiment of the wind data that flows in the Digital World. It primarily operates in forest regions, and uses the wind to carry warm air, ripening the fruits of the trees, and protects not only Digimon but also the environment itself.     Zephagamon's Digicore, the source of its power, is situated beneath the wings on its chest, and is constantly protected by whirling winds.
shoeshoemon: An agile Puppet Digimon that travels as if it is gliding through treetops on roller skates. It moves around restlessly, and dislikes staying still.    Its cheek pouches, where it usually keeps its food in, have a larger capacity than they look, and it can also place important items besides food in them to carry around.
grandgalemon: A large Perfect Digimon renowned as King of the Forest. The armor covering it up to its wings and beak is coated with magic. It skillfully blends into its surroundings by reflecting light in a special way, and despite having large wings, it is also able to muffle sounds by flapping them.
ryugumon: A Digimon with a beautiful appearance that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World. It constantly emits a faint light from its translucent body, charming those who see it.    Not only does it have a beautiful appearance, but also extremely high combat ability.
shagaramon: A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryūshōgu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.    Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryūshōgu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryūshōgu by Ryugumon.
skadimon: An Ice-Snow Digimon that rules over "Thrymheimr", a small, snow country somewhere in the snowy mountains. It appears to be a Digimon in the form of a giant snowman, but most of it resembles a powered suit made of ice. Skadimon's true form is the adorable fairy-like Digimon sitting inside the snow globe on its head.
vespamon: A Cyborg Digimon that is considered to be one of the elite within the aerial, covert honey base, "Royal Base". While Cannonbeemon protects the base over a vast range with its large body, Vespamon is in charge of defending key facilities, using its inexhaustible supply of stamina and speed as assets. Protecting the queen, Queenbeemon—the highest ranked at the base—above all else, Vespamon are known as the "Royal Guard" elite guards, and it is said that a handful of the strongest among them are awarded codenames and evolve into Tiger Vespamon.
forgebeemon: A Cyborg Digimon that belongs to the mysterious aerial, covert honey base, "Royal Base". While Waspmon is in charge of security for the base, Forgebeemon is responsible for the construction of the Royal Base. Its arm is equipped with an adhesive glue gun, and it uses the "Honey Glue" produced in its abdomen to bond materials together.
heavymetaldramon: A Digimon that evolved into the form of an ominous dragon that overwhelms those who see it by taking in data from heavy metal culture. It thinks of its battles as a show, has a belligerent personality in which it wanders around seeking "strong opponents" that are crucial for exciting its audience further, and will sometimes venture into the Dark Area, where evil beings thrive, in search of more exhilarating battles.    Its Black Digizoid-clad body makes the sound of metal rubbing against metal whenever it rushes about, and constantly emits some kind of "noise", such as making a roaring sound, from its guitar-shaped wings.
invisimon: Remodeled by the Crack Team to be pivotal in diversionary tactics, Invisimon is an Ultimate Digimon that is endowed with optical camouflage functions, and also possesses outstanding mobility due to its body being made of Blue Digizoid. Due to its excellent stealth abilities, even the cracker that it is under the employ of may lose track of its whereabouts, despite its large build. Unless one is extremely skilled, it will be difficult for them to handle Invisimon.
jougamon: A God Man Digimon that contains the data of a Chinese moon goddess. It is a calm and beautiful Digimon that usually lives in solitude on its ship known as the Kōkankyū, which resembles the moon. Although it seldom has the chance to show it off, Jougamon is a master of Ch'uan Fa, and uses its specialty kicking techniques and high mobility to make sport of the opponent in battle.
lamiamon: A Dragon Man Digimon with delicate scales and fins resembling a dress. It has the ability to synthesize various types of poison, such as those that paralyze the enemy, or those that melt substances. Making poisons that gradually shorten the opponent's life is Lamiamon's number one specialty, and it is said that this is because it takes pleasure in watching its opponents suffer.
nezhamon: A Cyborg Digimon with control over flame, born from the data of a certain young god from Chinese legend. It possesses three treasure tools, and has the ability to wield them skillfully.    Despite its short appearance, it is an arrogant ruffian with a belligerent personality.
oblivimon: Whenever a Digimon loses their memories or their behavior becomes erratic, those around it should beware of Oblivimon's presence. Covered in a flying saucer-like shell, this Cyborg Digimon vanishes as it silently draws near. After drawing nearer until it is directly above its target, it captures them by freely manipulating its tentacles, and takes them into its body.
polarbearmon: An Ice-Snow Digimon that Digimon from snowy areas evolve into by taking in data related to winter sports. It has the ability to create tools made of ice, and typically makes skis and poles to freely slide around snow fields. It enters the dens of Mojyamon and Hyougamon as it skis about, and often causes trouble.
cernumon: A Holy Beast Digimon that has been sighted in the various forest regions of the Digital World since ancient times. The huge horns on its head and the pipes growing from its abdomen have a structure similar to wind instruments, allowing it to play a variety of music.    It usually has a calm disposition, spending its time playing music along with the bird Digimon that perch on its huge horns, but on the other hand, Cernumon will severely punish invading enemies that try to enter and cause harm to the forest while letting out a loud warning sound in order to protect it.
dimetromon: A Reptile Digimon characterized by its large, frill-shaped sail. Its sail has the special characteristic of instantly healing wounds, even when damaged in battle. Since its sail grows larger each time it regenerates, individuals that have survived competition tend to have larger sails.
dinomon: Dinomon is a pinnacle that Dinosaur Digimon finally reach after long battles.    An Ultimate Digimon that has awakened an ancient power, its tremendous energy appears as a glow on the surface of its body. Boasting astounding stamina and power, it tramples down the enemy with overwhelming force.
elizamon: A Reptile Digimon characterized by its frill, which is soft like fabric. Its ears, which look like ribbons, are so good at picking up noises that they can react to even the slightest of sounds in their surroundings. It usually prefers inhabiting quiet areas, and folds its ears to shut out noise when sleeping.
erlangmonBlastMode: The awakened form Erlangmon puts on display after unleashing its power to the utmost limit only when eliminating enemies that it is incapable of defeating, even if they are observed with its third eye. It wears a transformed Kōtenken as armor, and the third eye above its head has the power to see through everything.    It fights while "observing" all things, including the opponent's thoughts as well, with its awakened third eye, and tears the enemy to pieces with the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo, which has turned into a gigantic energy form.
landramon: A Mineral Digimon whose configuration data is made up mostly of sand. It claims the desert as its territory, moving around by blending into the sand in search of food. It bands together with herds of Sunarizamon to brace itself against invading enemies.
loudmon: A Digimon that evolved by taking in data from a variety of musical equipment and violent rock music, the armor covering its whole body is equipped with several features, such as speakers that amplify the sound taken in from the mic on its chest, and an effector that processes its voice. It deploys its main speakers during battle, and starts singing at a very loud volume.    Those who face it are unable to perform at their best due to being exposed to the roaring sound emitted from its entire body, while Loudmon itself becomes even more excited by the sound.
marinbullmon: A Mollusk Digimon whose whole body is covered in a mucus-like veil, it is often seen coexisting with Digimon such as Shellmon and Sangomon, who are also classified as Mollusk-types. Although it has an extremely strong sense of territoriality, and is merciless towards invading enemies that enter its territory, it also has a side with a strong sense of kinship, in which it tries to protect the Digimon it is in a symbiotic relationship with.    The mucus that covers its entire body is slimy, and reduces friction to the utmost limits.
medusamon: A Dragon Man Digimon that evolved via data from a mythological monster. During battle, the sentient serpent-dragons growing from its head drive the enemy away, so its true form rarely moves and often assumes an elegant stance. Even if someone is able to endure the serpent-dragons' attacks, it can deal with them easily in close combat with its fanged boots and the stinger on its tail.
proganomon: A Mineral Digimon with a turtle-like appearance that primarily inhabits desert regions. It uses its drills and excavators to break through bedrock and move underground, but each time it does so, it triggers earthquakes, causing hollows in the ground and the ground to collapse. At night, it retracts its hind legs into its shell, and travels long distances by expelling the sand and gravel stored in its body in search of a safe place to sleep.
punkmon: A Digimon that evolved by taking in data on music and fashion from punk rock culture. Its personality is aggressive and rebellious, as if embodying the anarchic spirituality of punk rock. It is an anarchist at heart who rarely listens to what others say, and hates being ordered around or being part of a group.
pyramidimon: A Digimon with an enormous figure that some Digimon evolve into by taking in data from ancient ruins scattered throughout the Digital World. Its body is comprised of sand data, and because it is constantly surrounded by a sandstorm, it keeps ordinary Digimon at bay.    As a result of absorbing ruins and the ancient data stored within them, it possesses extremely high intelligence and the power to hold its own, even when facing large armies.
queenbeemon: A Cyborg Digimon that is the ruler of the "Royal Base", serving as its "Queen", and also has an ambitious side that seeks the endless expansion of the base. Possessing high scientific and technological prowess, it designed and developed the Royal Base itself.    In addition, it boasts remarkable information processing abilities, such as handling defensive layouts and commanding formations during battle all by itself.
necromon: A Ghost Digimon of the highest class that took in data from various ghosts and horrors on the Net. Its characteristic gravestone-like sword, the "Grave-Blade", is a brutal weapon that brings death to those who touch it, despite being blunt. If it encounters a superior Digimon as it wanders around, it will bring them down by stabbing them with the Grave-Blade without making a sound.
nezhamonCrimsonMode: A form that the once-boisterous Nezhamon transformed into upon realizing that it should use its power properly. The "Fukanirin" have turned into a motorcycle with flaming tires, and the short body it used to have has grown larger as well. It has gained two pairs of adjustable Cyber Arms, becoming a Cyborg Digimon that uses six arms.
acalaExalted: Lord Acala has awakened to his ultimate power through the deep bond between humans and Yo-kai. By accumulating experience alongside the master of the Stormweaver, he was able to attain this final form.
afronaut: This Yo-kai's dream of exploring space is being ruined by his inability to fit his magnificent afro within a helmet.
agentSpectHare: This master uses her natural beauty and smarts to dig up all sorts of information. Nothing gets by those cute ears!
allnyta: The bags under his eyes from playing video games all night are enough to make anyone worry for this Yo-kai's health.
almi: When Almi Inspirits you, you'll want to treat others all the time. Your wallet will be empty before you know it.
amplifly: Those Inspirited by this excessively gaudy Yo-kai go over the top and exaggerate everything they do.
appak: Appak can cut just about anything with his water sword. He wanders the world in order to heighten his skills
arachnevil: This Yo-kai is a direct descendent of an oni clan. He is one of the few Yo-kai who can sacrifice his own life force to raise his power.
arachnia: A poison specialist. He is a guy who likes very girly plans, like putting poison in cakes or kissing people while having poison lipstick on.
auntieHeart: Regardless of how bad a Yo-kai is, Auntie Heart's healing hug will make it pure again. That is some true kindness!
azukiaraiYokaiWatch: As his name suggests, he is a Yo-kai that just keeps washing azuki beans. He is trying to catch up other people up with how cool it is to wash the beans, but even if other people saw it, they wouldn't be able to tell the difference between it and regular beans.
babblong: Don't agree to listen to Babblong or else he'll talk and talk and talk and talk and talk and talk. He's a terrible listener.
baddinyan: Jibanyan gone bad. REAL BAD. With an impressive pompadour haircut and classy tails, he's a delinquent with no cause.
badude: This gang leader runs into enemy territory wielding his brutal nail bat. That's his way of taking care of his gang.
baiking: The king of bacteria, he stands at the top of all bacteria in the world. He once ran rampant in the seas, but was chased out because of his smell, and now he lives alone in ruins, cultivating various bacteria.
bananose: This Yo-kai is made of banana and is often bothered by circling flies. No relation to Babblong.
banchou: A Banchō Yo-kai, who appears when the weak are being bullied, punishes the bullies and sends them to hell. He is an encouraging ally to good children, but shows no mercy to bad guys.
bbqvil: This Yo-kai firmly believes that there's nothing better than a barbecue—one with plenty of meat!
beelzebold: Timidevil at full power! He still gets nervous every so often, though.
benzaiten: One of the Seven Gods of Fortune. She's trying to master the electric guitar to bring fortune with a fresh brand of hard rock.
bishamonten: One of the Seven Gods of Fortune. A patron of warriors, he is said to ward off disasters and evil with his fierce scowl.
bisonBurly: Burly, finally given the promotion he so richly deserves. He's still a fired up guy who dashes out onto the front lines.
blips: If you see someone get out of a pool with blue lips, they might just be inspirited by Blips...
blobgoblin: Legend has it that this Yo-kai feeds off dead humans to nourish their flesh. If they like you, they will tear their flesh, said to help grant eternal youth, to pieces and give it to you.
blowkade: Blowkade is one weird Yo-kai. Nobody knows why he puts his all into blocking people's paths.
boogiemum: A Yo-kai born from the gathered feelings of shy people that dream of a gorgeous world! Let’s dance our self-taught, unique dance with our friends, every night!
boyclops: Not the most intimidating of Yo-kai, but he saves so much on contact lenses that he doesn't really care.
brokenbrella: A Yo-kai born from the pain of a flimsy plastic umbrella who desperately wished he was a sturdier model.
brushido: A foot soldier who loves cleaning. His spotless reputation means he's sure to be a shogun someday.
buchinyan: A combination of Jibanyan and Whisper. Despite their obvious differences, it actually works pretty well.
buhu: This bird Yo-kai is always bummed out. People it Inspirits get depressed and distracted a lot.
butteredBlue: A boxer who always gets beaten black and blue. He's nice and chewy, but that won't help him in the ring.
cadable: Cadin has trained his 'cicada ninjitsu' to its peak. Now Cadable claims it's a worthy martial art! *crickets* *cicadas*
camellia: Born from a flower, this beautiful Yo-kai princess is loved by her subjects for her powers of healing.
capNRex: The last in a long line of legendary pirates. His motto ""Full steam ahead!" has sunk every ship he's sailed on, as well as his family legacy. He's known as Captain Shipwreck by sailors everywhere.
carniboy: A red-blooded Yo-kai who uses a gorgeous tan, luscious golden locks, and robust supply of one- liners to wow the ladies.
casanuva: This narcissist makes every lady he sees fall in love with him, regardless of appearance.
casteliusIi: Castelius II will always lock you in second place. Not bad, but you could have done a bit better...?
chatalie: All talk and no action. If she inspirits you, you'll be the same and lose the trust of others.
cheeksqueek: A Yo-kai that can't stop farting. There's a rumor that it just has really bad breath... but I'm not going to clear the air here.
chiMaTree: A giant tree in The Sea of Trees that became a Yo-kai by absorbing the hatred generated by humans. Whenever he finds a lost person, he plots to eat them, but they always escape.
chippa: An eternal optimist that never worries about anything. Being Inspirited by him can be worse that you think.
chummer: Chummer loves eating kids. He'll make them loiter after school before devouring them. He likes asparagus too.
compunzer: Even though he wants to make people laugh, Compunzer's jokes fall flat and just lead to awkward silences.
cornfused: You won't understand anything when this guy's around, no matter how well it's explained.
cueTee: Cue-Tee's cue cards make you do whatever is written on them! She might look shy, but her orders can be pretty harsh!
cupistol: This debonair Yo-kai is quite a hit with the ladies. Anyone he shoots will love you. He's just the greatest! *swoon*
cuttaNah: A lazy katana Yo-kai that can drain all of your motivation. He's strangely sharp for being so lazy.
cuttaNahNah: Too lazy to get a haircut, but not too lazy to slash enemies with his untidy strands.
cynake: This sulky snake Yo-kai will make you sulk at the slightest problem. Hmph!
dStroy: T-Wrecks is all grown up and now uses his incredible strength to completely demolish things in his path.
dWanna: D'wanna's chants will weaken your resolve! This can make you give up on... y'know, stuff and whatever.
daiz: Daiz just stares off into space, sometimes not moving for three whole days. What's he thinking about all that time...?
dameDredful: A witch who has spent years studying black magic. Her spells are imbued with a lifetime of bitterness and are extra powerful as a result. In her spare time, she likes to morph into a tin can.
damona: The princess of a small netherworld region. Her power is immense, but she lacks the power to feel any emotions.
darumacho: Now a truly macho Yo-kai, this one worked tirelessly in a mountain retreat to train away his dullness.
decidevible: This despot makes big decisions without any concern for others! He might work well with indecisive people.
demandi: Uses her unbelievable cuteness to get others to listen to her impossible demands. Enjoys watching the resulting panic.
demuncher: A terrifying Yo-kai who opens his huge mouth and swallows demons whole. Has very bad indigestion.
devourerYokaiWatch: He sucks the energy out of his victims but leaves their bodies intact so that they look like they've simply fallen asleep.
dimmy: Being Inspirited by Dimmy will tone down your presence. Dimmy uses this for his job as a ninja.
doubleTime: This Yo-kai lives at twice the speed of your run-of-the-mill spirit. The only time he slows down is to read his comic books.
draaagin: A desperately indecisive dragon. Don't expect that anything at all will get done when he's around.
dracunyan: Jibanyan has taken the form of a vampire, but his victims really don't need to worry—they'll feel a bit dizzy at worst.
draggie: A dragon kid who wants attention. He can see the hidden strengths of others with the ball on his head.
drenchetta: Being close to Drenchetta alone makes you damp. The sister of Dismarelda, pray you never have to face the two of them together!
drizzle: Drizzle creates rain cloud wherever it goes. You can find it in places that are thoroughly wet.
dromp: Fairy tales tell of the monstrous Dromp building mountains and digging ponds.
droplette: Droplette makes his way to places that don't get much sun and makes them damp and moldy...Gross.
dubbles: Dubbles will inspirit you and point you toward an unknown fate. Even he doesn't know if it'll be a good or bad one.
dulluma: He looks like a lucky daruma, but his real body is inside the shell. Dull and sluggish, he can really slow you down.
elderBloom: This legendary Hungramps supposedly once filled a city with spirit-invigorating cherry blossoms.
emenyan: A Yo-kai made of emerald. If you could sell him, he'd be worth more than 100 million dollars.
enefly: A butterfly Yo-kai who makes those it Inspirits cut ties with their best friends. Often mistaken for Enerfly.
enerfly: A butterfly Yo-kai who brings those it inspirits to their peak condition. Often mistaken for Enefly.
espy: Espy gets a kick out of reading people's minds. It's totally not fair that no one can read hers... and now she knows that too.
eyellure: The eyes that cover his body are made of jewels and give off a light so bright that he sometimes blinds even himself.
faysoff: This most classic of Classic Yo-kai can give anyone he Inspirits a completely blank expression.
fishpicable: Fishpicable sees only the bad in people and slaps things he hates with his tail. His tail is very busy.
flippa: Dame Dredful's opening act Yo-kai. Floppa is her partner that she met as a first-year student at the witch training school, and she is not her real sister. Her harmonious combination magic is now in the realm of mastery. The name of her combination with Floppa is "Flippa and Floppa".
flippit: Appears besides those fast asleep and flips over their pillows. If you've ever had a restless night, he's probably paid you a visit.
flumpy: Flumpy can make even the coolest person unfashionable and awkward. He hates being so unstylish.
foiletta: Toiletta's now in high school, where her love of curses and disruptive behavior has earned her a new nickname.
fuuKun: A mischievous and unpredictable wind Yo-kai who works alongside his partner, Rai-chan, as Lord Ananta's capable right-hand man. He is a mischievous and curious little guy who is always looking for someone to play with.
gilgaros: The strongest oni ever born. His power is so great that it needs no explanation. None. At all. Even this is too much...
gimme: Why borrow people's stuff when you can just steal it? Stores his loot in the bag on his head.
glitzyBones: Gutsy Bones got himself covered in diamonds, but he's more interested in seeing what comes out of the Crank-a-kai next than in the fact that he's now the most valuable Yo-kai in the world!
