kawazumo: Captivated by a traditional sport from a faraway land, it trains tirelessly. Just when you think it's about to engage in an honorable match, it suddenly hurls a bomb at you.
lamour: With its large, [[Strawberry (Item)|strawberry]]-like ears wobbling on its head, Lamour is said to be able to make everyone who sees it feel happy. It is the number one most popular monster among women.
korunu: A close-combat type monster. It overwhelms opponents with its high [[Power|strength]] and [[Defense|durability]]. It learns intelligence-based techniques of each element, but these are more difficult to use than its strength-based techniques.
lesione: This is a spoiled baby monster whose cry for its mother caused it to become a Lesihorne. Other Lesiones start crying when they hear it cry.
madillo: A monster of very few words, it trains hard in silence. It'd like to do something better with its life but it doesn't know how. It trains hard in silence again today.
magic: An elusive and shy monster who's always in disguise.
mamou: A monster with a massive, mammoth-like body. As its appearance suggests, it is very sturdy, and it excels at physical attacks that utilize its size. An update changed its motion, allowing it to handle mid-range and long-range attacks (Its mid-range attacks, in particular, have a decent attack speed). Its close-to-mid-range attacks are earth-elemental and its mid-to-long-range attacks are ice-elemental.
mewMonsterRancher: Bears a strong resemblance to a cat-like doll figure.
metalner: It is considered to have come from a planet far from here.
maya: A flexible monster with a glowing aura on its wings. When its angry, it spreads its wing of aura wide to get into a battle. Its posture with wings wide open is beautiful, but cold appearance.
mocchi: Its sticky skin and cute movements attract a lot of trainers.
mogi: It uses the big drill on its head to dig through the ground on a 16-beat rhythm. It's kind of like a [[mole]].
mock: This tree-like monster has a crooked character.
monol: He has a very special way of reducing foe's [[damage]].
momoMonsterRancher: Momo likes to be calm and move at its own pace. It always carries that large walnut for its aroma-therapeutic effects.
nagaMonsterRancher: Most violent of the monsters. He lives for battles.
niton: When something surprises it, it hides in its shell quickly.
ogyo: This magnificent maiden is the most elegant of them all. Because of its great pride, you must be careful how you treat it.
octopee: Octopee is usually very docile, but once it gets upset, it won't stop. When you see its eyes change, RUN!
pancho: A huge pumpkin-turned-monster. Like a hermit crab, the shell doesn't grow, so a new one has to be found periodically. That's why it makes such a mess.
phoenixMonsterRancher: This is a legendary monster that never gives up.
piroro: It looks like an eye that floats inside a mouth. The mysteriousness is somewhat cute. A clown-like monster who uses its body freely to do many performances.
psiroller: This monster was recently discovered, and many things are still unknown. Is it just a rhino, or is the roller alive too? It's still often debated.
plant: A very quiet fellow who's quite popular among all.
pixieMonsterRancher: A popular one who's selfish and hard to breed.
raiden: This monster never misses daily training. It does not bother with small things, thinking only about ways to become stronger.
ripperMonsterRancher: A speedy monster that can control wind and ice at will. The sharp sickles it has on it's elbows can slice whole rocks in two.
salamander: Specializes in fire-element attacks. Normally has a cute cry, but when it breathes fire, it makes a terrifying sound. Its third eye opens when it enters combat mode.
shigue: A bird that breathes fire, even though fire is not its main attribute. In addition to fire-based techniques, it also has poisoning techniques and excels in mid-range combat.
shignil: A dragon-type monster that manipulates wind. It learns strength and intelligence techniques simultaneously, and can even learn healing, making it adept at fighting at any range.
suezo: His specialty is stealing an opponent's will.
suzurin: [[Dr. Shiroki]] found this fairy monster. The doctor found this monster so sweet that he just had to scream 'Woweee!'
thine: A monster with a hard, durable shell that prefers to live in dark places such as caves. Many are aggressive by nature and stalk their prey under the cover of darkness. They have excellent night vision, but if suddenly exposed to a bright light, they may become unable to move.
tigerMonsterRancher: He is very popular with all types of people.
undine: This is a legendary monster living deep in the ocean.
zan: The only thing this monster knows is how to fight. The [[Tochika]]ns saw this as a danger and sealed the monster away, but a [[Nahze|scientist]] recently revived it...
zilla: Few trainers keep it because it is a glutton and is too big.
wracky: It carries the grudges of the monsters killed in the battle.
wormMonsterRancher: His elastic tusk is useful in hitting foes at long range.
xenon: The most powerful monster ever known has been reborn from the age of myths! Legend tells of Xenon being granted the title
zecca: A species that lives quietly in rocky outcrops found in the wastelands. Most are gentle and mild-tempered; however, once they begin defending their territory, they reveal a ferocious side and will continue fighting until they have brought down the intruder. They are especially adept at attacks that harness the power of lightning.
zuum: It's pedigree is considered to be similar to the Dino species.
aero: Has high [[Speed]] and will obey you well. Can be KO'ed easily.
alohaSaurian: Girls dream of riding on this one when they get married.
akihabana: A mysterious monster who is said to have come from the legendary [[Electri-City|Electri-city]]. They say its face sometimes shows this faraway cityscape.
allure: Her mysterious eyes have a way of making you docile.
queenPlant: Pollen and dust are constantly getting into his eyes.
ambush: The Ambush was made for jungle fighting. With its camouflage body, once you lose sight of it, it's very difficult to find it again.
abata: Originally a Zan prototype, it still has many of the original features of its robot beginnings. But it's unreliable, and once it runs wild there's no stopping it.
aguila: Often mistaken for the [[Garu]]'s father, it's a different species entirely. Raised in a similar environment, their colors are similar, though.
angel: You're lucky to be able to raise such a great monster.
abyssIsh: Magic of the Abyss has taken three dimensional form, resulting in this special monster. Its existence is a mystery, and a lot of breeders have their eye on it.
ace: Equipped with ability worthy of its name. Let’s raise an Ace among Aces!
alhambra: Alhambra is said to be a spontaneous mutation of Doodle. With its serious and sincere gaze, it always seems to be checking something.
aloha: This islander is a fashion plate who loves the ladies.
abyssinian: Made with the premise of activity in the water. But stay under too long and water can leak in. Beware!
omoroKnight: The long boots it received from [[King Marche|the king]] are more precious to it than its own life. Could they really possess a life of their own?
angas: The armor of a man who rose from being a woodcutter to a knight was possessed by the spirit of the earth, becoming its guardian.
anathemaMonsterRancher: It has killed countless people. Its scythe is red because it has continued to absorb blood.
ablessie: The Ablessie is able to swim between here and the afterlife. It's famous for the perplexing banded markings on its neck and body.
agi: By allowing parasitic plants to live within its body and controlling them at will as weapons, it gained formidable combat power. Unfortunately, being plant-based means it is weak against fire, just as you'd expect.
ammon: It usually stays completely still in one place, like a fossil.
actopee: While monsters have been doing theatre for a long time, Actopee's performances seem especially popular among women.
akashic: This slate-shaped monster is said to have everything from the beginning to the end of the universe recorded on it. Yet no one has been able to translate the unusual writing.
amabile: It has a great sense of rhythm, but what makes it especially popular is its irresistible charm, something not seen in other Mogis. Apparently, people love how affectionate and cuddly it is.
afro: There is a {{wk|wikipedia|planetarium}} inside. Since the shell kind of looks like a human face, this monster was once thought to bring bad luck.
amenhotep: A dignified one who is loved by many noble people.
angolmor: It is a Golem under control of [[Joker]]'s soul.
amonMonsterRancher: Although many consider its appearance strange, Amon thinks itself to be very cool. The spines on its head are its hairstyle.
ainz: Also known as the 'Lord of Death,' this Joker-type monster is the most skilled in necromancy, among its many magical abilities. It seems to be hiding a secret weapon called 'Super-Tier Magic.'
albedo: This species is characterized by its pure white dress and beautiful raven hair. It always acts calm in battle, and they say it carries a pillow with Ainz's image embroidered on it as a treasure.
alcadeias: Said to be [[Hakuoh]]'s trump card, possessing the ability to seal all [[Henger]]s that do not transform into [[Mystery Disc]]s. Its special move is 'A*Spark,' which destroys enemies with pure, white light.
antlanRed: One of the Antlan Rangers, a team of superheroes. It hates evil! With its bright red body and just heart, it's the leader of the group.
armocchi: Some sections of its body have been hardened like armor.
aquaWool: Its shiny hair always looks like it just came out of the water and it has a slight mint smell. Its lovely behavior makes it a popular monster.
anquihare: It looks like it's always just spacing out but actually, nothing could be further from the truth. It can be reckless at times but it has a heart full of hope.
antMew: Its blue face is actually just a mask. (A hero of justice never shows its true face!) Its fervor impresses all it meets, but it never can quite pull off the look.
armorDragon: They say it was used by humans for the ancient battles.
anki: Covered with rocks, he has good power, but is slow.
antkoro: The serious AntKoro always works hard and supports the others in its group. Humans could learn a lot from it. Watch it closely the next time you get a chance!
armorcho: This monster is a big coward and rarely emerges from its protective, harder-than-stone shell. It takes some time for its [[breeder]] to become friends with it.
arborMogi: Nobody'd better get unruly in its jungle, or it'll use its miraculous power on them! Nicknamed the
anquiloden: The huge armor it was born with is extremely tough, so its muscles are flexible and it's very fluid in its battle moves. Knock it down and it stands back up again.
antlanBlue: One of the Antlan Rangers, a team of superheroes. It lost its memory long ago, but it's doing OK now. Deftly displaying its abilities, it pulls the group together.
antlanYellow: One of the Antlan Rangers, a team of superheroes. Big and strong, it loves to eat. It can be scatterbrained at times, but the team loves him, anyway.
antares: It is expected to function well both in water and on land.
apocolis: Imitating bamboo, this [[Dragon]] is like an illusion you can't really see. I can't tell if it's only sleeping - there is still no one who knows for sure.
arokken: It distracts its opponents with strange movements, then attacks with a sharp beak! It is not to be underestimated.
aquaMask: Wears a fabric that protects him from fire and water.
aquaKnight: A monster clad in armor modeled after a [[crocodile]]. Despite its appearance, it has a surprisingly gentle and dignified personality - quite the gentleman, in fact.
archreaper: Originally, it was a god, but an evil heart sprouted within it, and it was banished by [[Deities|the others]]. Its ancient power still remains strong.
ardebaren: One time master of the Castle of the Damned. Now reformed.
mailRipper: The MailRipper gives up some of its [[speed]] for a strong [[defense]]. Its steel scythe is razor sharp. This monster just smells of danger...
anubisMonsterRancher: Anubis lives alone in the desert, and it is very difficult to tame. It takes an experienced [[breeder]] to train it. You might be a good match.
armadiroller: The thorny points come from the skin of Armadiroller. It is always curled up motionless behind the rocks, because it is just too hot.
aquaCutter: Very similar to Jell monsters. He has a very soft body.
anguish: A selfish brat who is always worried about things.
arunelo: A relative of the Antero that lives in regions with heavy snowfall. During the summer it forms herds, while in the winter it spends its time traveling alone in search of food. Because it has an exceptionally gentle and people-friendly temperament, it is also commonly raised as livestock.
aquaMew: A monster mix which has given this one very high [[Defense|Def]]..
aquamarine: A monster with a transparent body. The head is different in texture and is as hard as a jewel. It seems that many people keep it as an ornamental animal.
asakura: He always gives a laid-back impression, casually enjoying nature alone in the grasslands. But in battle, he is sharp and quick-witted, and the band he wears on his head appear to be earmuffs that produce sound.
baseballBoy: Its ultimate dream: a grand slam, walk-off home run. It's a pretty silly dream but nobody around it can get up the nerve to say so.
battleRocks: It is said that a giant's armor turned into this monster.
bargest: From the time this monster is born in hell it has only one mission - to strip its opponents of all dignity. Its faintly glowing eyes are just looking for its chance.
futorunner: Its great strides are moving to behold. Some say the name originally came from the fact that it often finds itself running subconsciously.
baum: This Golem is made from a 1000-year-old oak tree. Birds build nests among the leaves.
bakuroller: Its howl sounds like a horn and can be heard from a great distance. When the BakuRoller's herd starts getting rough, nobody can stop them.
babyDino: A monster that lives in an ancient dinosaur-egg fossil. Even though it has some dinosaur blood in its veins, it's a peaceful monster. It doesn't like conflict.
battleleon: Long ago, when nobles used to enjoy indoor battles, the Battleleon held an unbeaten record. It's a reliable monster that carries out orders to the letter.
bazoo: It resides in a harsh location, and has its own values.
bastet: Bastet is normally a gentle monster, but when its wrath is unleashed, an extremely fearful side is revealed. Bastet is a cat lover, and will probably treat those well who bring along a cat.
bakuClown: It was born as a tool of devils, but it forgets its evil duty.
baksheesh: The tusks on the lower jaw can throw anyone. Only rarely does this Baku turn violent, but once it starts to turn, no one can stop it.
bakuIsh: Baku-ish will eat anything. Once it got something stuck in its throat and turned blue, barely surviving the incident. But to this day it remains that odd bluish color.
avalanche: The horn is as cold as an icicle and radiates cold air. When two horns of these monsters touch, they freeze together!
athena: Everybody agrees on its strength, but few agree on its looks.
automaton: It is said that it was made as a prototype for Henger.
avaoner: It can fly swiftly in the air using its large wings. On the ground, however, its wings get stuck in alleys and doorways. Very inconvenient.
astraal: A soul born from the earth is returned to the earth. For that purpose, it is said to have been created.
bakky: It never used to be bought at the shop, but it has become popular.
babyDoll: This monster is a doll of Pixie with a wicked soul.
basiliskMonsterRancher: It confuses its enemies with a special pattern on its body.
assasiripper: The AssasiRipper is nocturnal. It tears around at high speed no matter how dark it is. But during the day, the sunlight bothers it and it slows down considerably.
dandelion: His long, fluffy fur makes him look much larger.
baskerville: It's as if it were bad since it was born, but it actually just does not like being alone and is a little twisted. So, Breeders, don't be afraid and take good care of it.
asphaltum: Don't try and sneak up on this strange monster.
motoroller: Its name is BariRoller. No one can run faster. Its eyes are full of the sadness and happiness of running.
bazula: Very precise vision with his small eyes make him feared.
aspis: As the deadly colors on its skin show, it has poisonous fangs, claws, and tail. They say it cannot help dancing when it hears a flute melody.
weed: A poisonous plant that's made from some rancid water.
blackPlant: Although his true color is green, he appears black.
bambiimew: This Mew has adapted to a forest setting. The pattern on its back resembles light streaming through the leaves of a tree, for great camouflage.
astro: It is said that this monster contains a Metalner in it.
axer: Its sculpted body and performance make it popular. Has a killer move.
babyDragonMonsterRancher: Like a Dragon, it can breathe fire and has wings, but they are too small to allow it to fly.
mewbear: A mysterious and popular one who's stronger than he looks.
beetleMocchi: The BettleMochi is crazy about sweets. Of course, it watches the calories, too. It's great friends with the [[Draco Mocchi|Draco Moch]], another member of the Mocchi family.
beakie: Its odd hat is a symbol of the important position it used to hold. But it's long since forgotten this fact, and now wears it because it thinks it looks good.
owlmochi: The best martial artist of all Mocchis, it's never been beaten. At least, that's the rumor that's been going around. (It's a little upset about this rumor.)
bigKorobocci: It has many faces, but it only has one true head. When it wakes up in the morning, all of its eyes open at the same time. ...Kind of creepy, huh?
bighand: This kind of monsters are considered to be extinct.
beerock: Its rocky body may be hollow inside, because it can fly.
beegator: Its large, sharp claws are powerful enough to rip steel with just one swipe. It used to use its giant mouth, but it's degenerated so much it won't even open now.
berserker: The soul of a bandit chief came to dwell within this suit of armor. Its no-rules, anything-goes fighting style is truly terrifying!
beetleFish: The Beetle Fish has looked exactly the same for thousands of years, and so it's nicknamed the
blakkus: It favors the darkness over the light. It has a bad mouth, but it isn’t truly bad deep down.
triEye: A battle legend who charges across the arena with flowing blonde hair. It is said that its stubborn personality might be its only flaw.
blackLion: Its black body helps it avoid being seen. Some even take advantage of that to sneak out and play at night - quite the mischief-makers.
beeslim: Although it often works out, it is not seeing much result. It is still looking for the dumbbells it lost last week.
beaclonIsh: This monster changed its color to hide from young breeders obsessed with beetles. But now that it's no longer sought after, life's gotten a little more lonely.
bethelgeus: The image of its flying in the sky is called 'Death's Dance.'
bercouger: Forever the rival of Beaklon, its pincers are just as powerful as Beaklon's horn.
beralsekt: Even ordinary Madillos have hard shells, but this monster's whole body is so hard nobody can hurt it! It's nocturnal, so it sleeps during the day.
blackRex: Above average in all areas. Doesn't trust anyone though.
bengal: All Jills are gluttons.This one loves to eat fruits.
blackHenger: Once wielded an evil power. He no longer has it.
beowulf: A brave and fearless knight with no desire for personal gain. It is said to have defeated countless villains, and its exploits have even become the subject of famous stories.
benemale: Sometimes kind, sometimes mean — it's hard to tell which is its true nature. Perhaps justice and evil are constantly fighting inside its heart?
beretta: Beretta was born of a picture book to hunt down evildoers. If it even senses a hint of evil, it will not rest until its target is brought to justice.
biansnow: Be careful not to mess with its hairstyle, because it gets very upset. Make sure you redo its hair after every battle.
blackWorm: His sleek black shell makes him good at pulling things.
blackSaurian: Its body with a black luster attracts fashionable people.
blizzarin: Blizzarin comes in December and gives presents to children, but if you've been bad, you may not get any.
birdie: Say, 'Nice shot!' when you want to praise it for its good work.
bluePhoenix: Unlike other Phoenix monsters, it is very violent.
bearroller: One day, a [[Tochika|Tochikan]] girl was taking a walk in the woods when she found this monster. Since the monster kept following her, she decided to keep it.
hooligan: Living on the streets, it is never without its sunglasses. Shrewder than the other Mogis, it often ditches [[training]].
blackMocchi: Black Mocchi loves to drape itself in dark colors, and even tried to blacken its heart once. That didn't go over too well with the fan base, so apparently it killed that idea.
bikini: This 'poser' likes to show everyone his great build.
bigTokobot: A [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karakuri_puppet Karakuri]-Combination type Tokobot. Its firm body deflects all attacks, drawing strength from 8 bots! But its slow movement can be lifetaking.
blackGolem: His stealth colored body makes him hard to see.
bigBlue: An ice-carved giant who is better known as 'Ice Rock.'
bowbow: It took a nap on the ground one day and wound up this color! It stores up its energy during sleep and then uses it all in battle. Then it goes back to sleep again.
boochin: Its big nose can vacuum up anything. Its power is so great, it once sucked up all the mushrooms in the [[Morx|Morx Forest]].
blobster: A vicious monster with scorpion poison strong enough to lay even the great [[Baku]] low. Its powerful scorpion claws make a can opener unnecessary.
pulscorn: Known to have dark, trusting eyes which show good [[loyalty]].
bowmew: An odd mix of part doll, part cat, and part [[Tiger]].
blocken: This monster's duck-like shape is made up of several rocks.
bugBugFlower: The Gobbler Flower has three mouths so it eats more than you'd think. (It takes in whatever else it needs through its roots.) This one is expensive to feed!
evilbeak: This monster is a respected demon warrior. It has an iron will and follows its orders to the letter, so it can seem brutal at times. Be careful how you approach it!
boxerBajarl: It has great footwork even without feet.
bossy: Although lazy, this one is a top-notch monster.
blueThunder: This tribe is considered to be the descendant of Thor.
brickidee: Even with the influence of [[Monol]], the Monster Association says this rare monster is quite cute. Because of its solid personality, it's valued by the experts.
bouken: A reckless troublemaker. It confuses its opponents with unpredictable, chaotic movements.
brinjalen: It looks just like an eggplant, but it is actually a mysterious object of unknown origin. However, everyone believes it is just an eggplant.
bloodyEye: Its unique red eyes have caused it to be put on public display.
brownMask: An elegant one who doesn't wish to be conservative.
bloss: It is inhabited by the soul of an honest swordsman who, after cutting down a cherry tree, properly confessed to his parents.
booMonsterRancher: A monster that has come from the far East, devoting itself to scaring people. The bandana around its head is a symbol of proof of it winning the championship to scare people.
brownieMonsterRancher: It has a gentle and mild-mannered personality, unusual for a Gitan. Only children are said to be able to see it. Apparently, it’s friends with the Mitsubara.
blueTerror: It painlessly kills its enemy with one deadly attack.
bloodshed: This is the most aggressive monster of all the Joker species.
jellyHare: His transparent body shows the odd tail that he has.
blueKato: Its quick movements make its enemy confused.
bui: As a result of living under the strong desert sun, unnecessary body water has evaporated. This is how this monster became lighter and faster than a normal Zan.
bree: This clown-like monster has a small body but a fierce heart in battle, using various tricks and movements to win.
bronzeSuezo: It is another rare one, for its body is the color bronze.
blueSponge: His firm body and soft, rich fur would make for a good bed.
crimsonEyed: He doesn't like to battle any weak monsters. Loves to fight.
bloodstra: Far deep into the [[Devil's Forest|forest of the demons]], take the lives of those who visit the castle with its sharp fangs. It is a monster to be feared, although it's rumored to have a lot of weaknesses.
breeza: Said to be shown in conjunction with the aurora. It has been nicknamed the 'Snowfield Queen.'
bosco: This monster likes reed whistles, and walks around whistling all the time. Since it tries to use all kinds of grasses, sometimes its lips get swollen.
bluePlant: Besides having a nice smile, he is very easy to breed.
bonsai: This little guy is extremely popular among landscapers.
brix: It has the flexibility of an octopus. It can even confuse its opponents and escape when necessary.
bolshack: [[Shobu]]'s trump card, a valiant dragon with a [[Aura|Red aura]], is said to have destroyed any city it has entered. Its ultimate attack, 'B-Fire,' burns everything to ashes.
chaosRipper: One of the three beast gods that ruled over the monsters long ago. Its disagreeable temperament is a problem but it has god-like [[speed]] that doesn't let anything near.
captainBird: With a just heart that fits the title of a captain. Permitting no wrong, it uses its polished skill to enforce justice everywhere.
bunny: Very popular among the male breeders. Can hide in battle.
burningWall: This one escaped from its trainer while its stable was on fire.
caloriena: This monster never ceases its exercise and diet regiment.
fairyHare: It has a weak, out-of-shape, and flabby stomach.
centurion: Its body is covered with well-designed solid armor.
chaosDragon: One of the three beast gods that ruled over the monsters long ago. It has god-like power, but its tendency to think very highly of itself makes the other two scoff.
chaosDurahan: One of the three beast gods that ruled over the monsters long ago. A dark, majestic war deity with armor polished through countless battles with strong men.
ceto: The Ceto is a strong, fast machine. It's programmed to know all of the Naga's maneuvers, but that program is broken so you'll have to start from scratch.
carroller: A powerful and high-precision Rhinoroller, it has a well-balanced body and smooth suspension. Quality from top to bottom! It's got lots of great options, too.
pharaohEye: A loner who loves going on long journeys. The red sunset reflects well on it.
carame: Its body is covered with sand, but the inside is full of Jell water. They sometimes help desert wanderers with this water.
chaser: No matter how the opponent tries to escape, its scissors that can shrink or extend, and it won't let them get away!
capitano: A performer with ample pride and heart. Battling is a stage to it. Its battle spectacle never lets spectators down.
centaurIsh: Centaur-ish is tired of walking on 4 legs, and is working hard to grow 2 more. It is often scolded by others for its silly thoughts and poor concentration in battle.
chariot: It is said that it holds the souls of Durahan and Centaur.
celious: It is a loner and does not like to cluster.
cantalos: Cantalos emits a sweet odor from its body to confuse its enemies. Don't go too close, because the smell will stay with you for days!
chaoshead: A dragon whose high [[intelligence]] ended up turning into cunning. It is deeply vengeful, so if it ever sets its sights on you, you’re in serious trouble.
cawken: Some people consider this monster to be unlucky.
chacken: It has evolved, gaining the power of the [[Element|earth]]. Memories of the [[Timeline of Pangaean History|ancient times]] may soon begin to awaken...
capsular: It may look a bit unappealing, but its body is said to be filled with medicine. People call it a 'walking first-aid kit' and treasure it.
burstliner: The heaviest of all the Hengers. It is good at making roads and tunnels, and its earthshaking attacks are very powerful.
bushiDo: A master swordsman who came from the east. Its skill can sever even iron, and it devotes its life entirely to refining its swordsmanship.
tactics: Cabaree came from a different world called [[Worn Hope]]. Its 'Superior Lance' technique is touted as an art form.
burrole: Burrole loves to chatter, but never listens to what anyone else has to say! Those big ears are only there so it can hear its own voice.
campanella: A monster that lives on the boundary between dreams and reality. If you become friends with it, it might even invite you on a journey to the [[DreamWorld|world of dreams]].
cactun: This cactus always stands silently, but sometimes it just has to jump. It's affectionate toward people, but nothing can save the person it attacks.
celeris: Celeris is not very popular, but once you actually raise one, you’ll realize that is a mistake. It’s surprisingly capable after all.
chaosXenon: One of the most powerful monsters from the age of myths. An ancient curse has taken hold, shrouding it in a dark aura.
caesar: Caesar is a brutal killing machine modeled after Xenon. It has no emotions, and only acts on response to orders. But lately it has been experiencing something close to feelings.
cabalos: A troublemaker who will run away often and come back wild.
cari: A very strong one who has saved the lives of many.
butcherKing: A character with a passion for battles more than other Golems and a very wild character. It also possesses a degree of mischievousness, and its fickleness is unequaled in comparison.
clownLessie: From bustling [[Kaniwa|Naniwa]], it loves lively places and can't relax when it's quiet. Some think it's cute and others think it's gross, but it doesn't care either way.
clearSuezo: He likes to eat and is always sure to brush his teeth.
mucchi: Research proves touching this monster's skin has a restorative affect. Currently, it's enjoying a huge popularity among women. Hope it's not just another fad...
chumew: This healing monster has a beautiful singing voice. Especially popular with small children.
succhi: 'Welcome!' Succhi says this all the time, but it doesn't make much sense. It had two friends, but after a fight, they left. It likes to wake up early.
cocadrille: The Cocadrille does not like drawing attention to itself, but it grows very quickly. One day, it may suddenly become gigantic overnight.
cookun: His goal is to become the world's best chef, so every day he is busy studying. But, the truth is that his own body is the most delicious thing.
corkasus: It is difficult to find it since it hardly leaves its homeland.
comedykoro: These monsters love the comic-strip characters in their breeders' magazines. They all wear masks but it's the one with the sunglasses that always has bad luck.
coconutty: Coconutty's flower petals work like radar. It's good at gathering information and fights methodically, looking over the data it collects on its opponents first.
condorin: Its fierce determination doesn't seem to go with its tiny body. It really wants to win, but when it comes time for the actual battle, it has a hard time.
cosmicAbyss: This special creature was born in ancient times to bring order to the universe. Its fight to change chaos to cosmos still continues to this day.
chinois: The dish that it cooked tastes so good that makes you smile.
couscous: Among the Garus, the CousCous is especially impatient and easily flustered. However, it always does its best, which makes it very popular with everyone.
colorPandoraIsh: Each of the Color Pandora-ish bodies are extremely shy, and don't want people staring at them, so they all painted their faces the same color.
crabDragon: It inhabits a lake and rules that lake.
chef: It flies around cooking a large variety of food at one time.
colorful: This weary monster can't last very long in battles.
darkBringer: Its hand is a knife, and it can see in the dark. Thus, people say that this monster must have been an assassination device in ancient times.
cinderBird: Contrary to its looks, it is burning furiously inside.
corone: He is a quiet guy who looks like he is a stuffed-animal.
coltan: Despite the glowing body, sharp eyes, and stern looks, it's really just lonely, and wants some friends to play with.
clocker: The king of a [[Nettle Kingdom|certain country]] created a Joker doll to frighten his people. Then one day, it began moving all by itself.
churamaya: Its flexible and smooth body considered to be the most beautiful out of all Maya species quickly attracts many breeders. But it has very deep pride, and does not accept cheap food.
citronie: It likes using a fighting style that confuses its enemies.
crabSaurian: It can swim fast in water and it is also a fast runner.
clockdog: It is a masterpiece created by [[Dr. Zarnycie]] using the gadget technology. It still awaits the return of the doctor, even after his death upon completion.
clearShell: Its gelled section is almost as hard as its shell.
chloroJell: Be sure to keep him wet, or he will get dehydrated.
cowbird: A Cowbird here from the edge of the wilds. It puts on its prideful hat, and with its quick-draw Western punch aims for the loot.
coconut: It moves by drifting in the ocean, so it was thought to be a tiny island. They even called this monster 'Floating Isle.'
chopanjel: A monster that seems like a refreshing dessert, with jelly-like body contained in a jelly-like bowl. Its popularity raises dramatically during the summer.
cosmocchi: It was predicted this Mocchi will one day save the world. But it doesn't know that yet, and lives every day peacefully, calm and relaxed.
crabDino: Thanks to its smooth shell, it is able to swim feely underwater. Handshakes are strictly prohibited, as it has pincers for hands.
cheshire: A laid-back and elusive personality. They have fun messing with their Breeders, using pranks to gage their reactions.
deathWing: This monster is formed from evil feelings. Because of all these emotions inside it often behaves strangely, but it never harms people. It hates all other monsters.
darkcell: A certain monster was so mad it got beat by a Joker that its rage took form and became this monster. Now it'll do everything to beat that Joker!
pinkGolem: A shy, quiet guy who is loved by many. Has high [[Intelligence|Int]]..
datonare: No one equals its speed when it runs through the forest.
darkwhip: The DarkWhip has a scary face, but it's just a gentle monster that eats nothing but fruit. Apparently, it uses its sickle arms to peel this fruit.
crevasse: It has a habit of hiding things like a dog.
diaboros: It is said that this dragon was resurrected by Joker's power.
curevis: This phantom knight, clad in pumpkin armor, uses its hatchet to punish monsters who dare to wreak havoc in its pumpkin patch. It wears a pumpkin god on its waist.
kagemusha: Clad in dark armor, it hides within the darkness and eliminates its enemies. If it stands as your ally, there is no greater reassurance.
cyclopsMonsterRancher: Although he has only one eye, he is powerful. Has high [[intelligence]].
cybernetico: Its steel drill makes its enemies tremble in fear. It spins at high speed, sending sparks flying, so even its [[Breeder]] needs to be careful.
darkAntlan: With the strength of the three beast gods and the heart of the Antlan Rangers, it's a powerful dark hero. The dark blade in its hands slashes through evil.
mocchigaru: Having Mocchi’s blood in its lineage, its body is extremely soft and very stretchy. The fact that it can’t swim is not well known.
cyangaru: CyanGaru loves the sea and is always swimming or diving. If left alone, it will keep swimming all day long. It’s a very tough creature.
cutey: A human-mix that has an attractiveness about it.
darkPiercer: When pierced in the heart by a dark spear, it did not die, but its heart was blackened. Some say the Dark Piercer pierced its own heart on that fateful day.
cuekan: The mimic-loving Cuekan even repeats scoldings back to you. Raising it might require a lot of patience.
cuChulainn: A hero who has been granted a portion of divine power. Once it makes a promise, it will keep it even if it costs its own life — the embodiment of true [[loyalty]].
fourEyed: If you look closely at him, you will see his 4 eyes.
cupidHare: This cute pink Hare has, at some point, come to be known as the god of love. If you have an unrequited love, why not try raising one?
crescent: An evil spirit is dwelling in it because of a forbidden drink.
daton: He will hit an opponent from out of nowhere. Breed him well.
deathClown: A feared monster who is known as a clown from hell. It serves the monster king, although its true intentions are not known. Is it with you? Or against you? That is up to the breeder to decide.
dalphi: This is a rare black and white Octopee! I've heard there are only 102 in the whole world!
crawl: This monster is absolutely confident in its swimming ability. With its high-tech swimming suit on, it trains every day to become #1 in the world.
dackPlant: A monster with petals coming in three flamboyant colors. It is said to be getting energy by exposing those petals to wind and turning them around like windmills.
creamPuff: Although it's wrapped in a shell that looks like a delicious puff, this shell is actually a lot harder than it looks and enhances its defense like other Pancho breeds. What's troublesome is to see children crying after they learn they can't have one.
dao: It moves each part of its body by using a mysterious magic.
elebus: This shiny and highly visible Golem is made entirely of ice. It is very popular during hot summer days.
dagon: Its hard body can even resist the pressures in the deep ocean.
dango: Scary-looking, but gentle and caring. Likes listening to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enka Enka].
denken: The middle-aged men who meet Denkun end up getting home late, so it isn’t popular with their wives. It’s an idol to uncles everywhere.
dracoMocchi: Contrary to its cute movements, it is a violent monster.
devi: The Devi is the leader of some group. It runs around town trying to get everyone together. If you see it in the streets, let it know you're rooting for it!
dracoHopper: Though its potential is high, few people raise such a scary looking monster.
drarin: A monster from the [[land of Night]]. Though it looks dangerous, it actually will faint if it sees blood. It is very popular in the land of Night.
dixie: This one has razor sharp claws to cut one to pieces.
devimadillo: The DeviMadillo is from the [[Land of Chaos|demon world]]. A strict dojo coach, it swings its bamboo sword around threateningly.
dice: This monster has strange patterns on its body.
disrupt: This monster has a unique black and white coloration.
dragcatze: A monster with a body and claws that shine brilliantly, and a cruel nature that makes it toy with its enemies.
diva: It reigns above all monsters. Its existence is completely shrouded in mystery.
dragster: It is gentle and cute, making it popular among the Dragon species. The ease of raising it is also part of its appeal.
dragonIsh: Legend tells of a Dragon slayer with a holy lance, who once challenged a Dragon that turned blue and fled in fright. Today that Dragon is known as the
dokken: It polishes its acorn body until it is shiny. The woodland creatures then use it as a mirror.
dokoo: It carries a type of poison that paralyzes other monsters.
dickens: Dickens is always pulling pranks. But the truth is, it only does it because it wants attention. If you let it join your group, it will stop causing mischief.
depstalker: It is said that the souls of the citizens of an [[Sunken Temple|ancient city]] that sank into the sea became Depstalkers.
drabitt: Covered in hard red scales, it looks like a flame, although it has fondness for sweet and cold food. It earned a reputation as a cut and affectionate monster once it gets close to the breeder.
dracoKato: It contains Dragon's violent blood and likes battle.
diamante: The horns that grow out every year become valuable gemstones. Many wedding rings are made from them. Girls often long for one.
deluxeLiner: It swims confidently but there is something anxious about it.
dracoDoll: The original version of this doll is sold at a premium price.
doborIT: This Tiger once saved a girl from a burning house. Its fur burned away and gave it this new look.
dorara: A monster with its pride held up high with the soul of a [[Dragon]] resided in it. But it is not able to blow fire. It keeps on training day and night, to build up its skills and performance.
discNiton: It has a pattern design that looks like a disc stone.
dominos: These monsters like to gather and form a line.
devilMew: A monster that came into being by the residing of the monster king inside the Mew doll. It can be tamed quite easily as it purrs while it is stroked below its chin.
dreamGolem: An amber body filled with happiness and sorrow. Just like a dream.
dreamy: Illumina and Mew dolls have bodies with surprisingly similar texture, giving this monster a cute appearance that is very popular, especially with young women.
diablo: In the world that it comes from, it is known as one of the primordial demons. It is said to resemble the devil, but its demeanor is genteel. It seems to absolutely adore [[Rimuru]].
hipzo: The Hipzo is very proud of its big hat. But there's a rumor going around that it's actually so heavy it's thinking about taking it off and throwing it away.
drillMocchi: The DrillMochi is a great dancer, is up on the trends and is really particular about fashion. Despite all this, it's really shy and often hides in holes.
eagleKing: The Eagle King has huge rock talons to grab its opponents with. It loves high places, and dreams of flying through the sky one day. It might have to diet first, though.
eggukken: A rumor suggests there is a raw Eggukkung and a boiled Eggukkung, though it's probably just a bad joke by Breeders who missed breakfast.
ducklon: It has a spring that has to be wound each morning.
drimole: The Drimole smells great. You can always tell it's there (even from far away) by the fragrance. Its was discovered only recently, so nobody knows much about it.
duckFever: It is very good at playing ball; however, it’s a bit of a troublemaker that cares more about the game than its Breeder.
electrieel: This monster mutated from a huge [[Lantern Fish]]. They say lightning hitting the fish is what triggered the transformation.
emeraldEye: It is said that it loves to eat jewelry, especially emeralds.
ecologia: The Ecologia loves nature and is the protector of the forest. Enjoying the flowers and plants, it patrols among the trees. Nobody had better disturb the forest's peace!
dryadMonsterRancher: This monster is a tree fairy. It inhabits in the forest.
eggplantern: It is said that those who waste food are scolded by this monster.
earedMew: This monster comes as part of the Hare monster type.
drividillo: It revs its roaring engine, and hopes to one day be the star of the racing circuit. Put the pedal to the metal! The word
druger: This divine dragon used to be called ''Pi-Long''. It has been fighting so long it has forgotten anything else exists in the world.
duckis: Duckis looks very intimidating in its black armor, but it's actually akin to a spoiled child. Play video games all day, and your mom's gonna yell at you!
duckenIsh: This creature was made in a rush, and its creator forgot to paint it, so it's still the color of its original material, whatever that material may be...
endBringer: This mechanical monster's soul has been infused by Joker.
durahanIsh: A drawing of a suit of armor seems to have become a monster. It may be an odd color, but it's strong as steel with tough armor and a sharp weapon.
drydon: The reincarnation of a man born, raised, and killed at sea. The ax of blue metal is said to be strong enough to slice into other dimensions.
ellyllon: Ellyllon is a kind-hearted monster whose favorite food is kinko. Try searching near some kinko — you’re sure to find its home there.
ebony: This monster lives to confuse and surprise humans.
drillTusk: The sharp horn on his head is his weak-point in battle.
dribbler: 'Kickball' is the most popular sport in the [[IMa]] area.
earthKeeper: A monster who loves the great outdoors and enjoys nature.
edgehog: This monster can be very violent. Hence, he must be bred.
eega: This eerie eel-shaped monster often squeals with laughter, though it too can't seem to figure out what's so funny.
echidnaMonsterRancher: A black Naga that came from the darkness. Its powers are unknown. A very mysterious monster.
duckMew: A new product, Ducken doll, which has become very popular with its confusing design. But it has got possessed for some reason and turned into a monster!
ecologuardia: Although mostly quiet, he is a terror when he gets angry.
durandal: A monster created using all kinds of modern technology, it is said to be a reproduction of a legendary monster that was once believed to be immortal.
fantuger: A strange fairy that came from the land of [[Chuka]]. Some maniacs really love this monster. It is looking for a particular scroll...
eyebee: The Eyebee can see through absolutely anything with its huge, green eye. (But, to tell the truth, it's kind of sick of being able to see everything...)
pengimochi: It is similar to a penguin, but they are not related at all.
eyengel: Aside from the glittering halo over its head, the most remarkable feature of this monster is the alarming yellow color of its teeth. It is known to hate dentists.
fang: The most ferocious and dangerous of all Zans. (Maybe it's because of the curse a white weasel once put on it?) Beware of the Blade on a moonlit night!
fakeGraffiti: The old Doodle with a new shape! Completely improved, it's now pretty impressive with its serious battle skills and slim body. (But it's still kind of a joke.)
evilFish: Like a ninja, it sneaks stealthily up and lays its opponent out in one blow. When it wants some attention from its [[breeder]], it creeps up and startles them.
eval: It will beat its enemy senseless with its fast and powerful attacks. An antihero, hated by many.
falcolan: The Falcolan guards over the skies. It's rather aloof, but when it's really needed, it comes flying up at Mach speed.
entMonsterRancher: The Ent lives deep in the forest, protecting it from intruders. It always makes sure to
wallMimic: A brat who is able to change his appearance into a fence.
eyeJell: He studies you with his x-ray eye ball that can see all.
ferious: It has the upper body of a Pixie and the lower body of a horse.
featergold: A sacred monster whose entire body is covered in golden scales. Its radiance is clearly on a completely different level from that of other Dragons.
fafneel: This smart Dragon first immobilizes its opponent with the poisonous thorns on its jaw. However, sometimes it accidentally pricks itself…
falcoIsh: Falco-ish is a peace-loving, gentle monster, and probably isn't very popular with boys because of its odd coloring.
fairyHopper: It can jump a little higher than other Hoppers.
fangedMask: Wears [[Sapphire (Item)|an item]] which was made special by the Shrine Master.
enkiMonsterRancher: There once was a country that was at war with [[Tochika]]. Enki is said to be the armor used in that country, feared because it is cursed.
eyeFan: As a big fan of Suezo, he has become quite a monster.
fireJoker: Fire Joker is wrapped in sacred flames, and is able to work miracles. It may look frightening, but is actually quite brave and surprisingly dependable.
evilHare: Though born of evil descent, he can be changed.
faylay: Its speed is certainly worth being called the embodiment of the wind. The air turns into a sharp blade as it runs through in top speed. It is not the monster you want on the wrong side.
eyeWorm: His 4 different eyes can scare an opponent silly.
expressWorm: None can compete with its speed as long as it is on its line.
fairySaurian: We can ride on its back because it has no wings on its back.
fenril: It is said this monster once fought with the [[Ragnarok|legendary Dragon]], but we don't know for sure. The scar on its forehead is rumored to be from that battle.
fairLessie: Its glossy sheen is second to none. Apparently, wealthy breeders compete to raise one so they can show it off as a status symbol.
eren: It looks exactly like '''Eren''' when he transforms into a titan. It has a reckless side, and apparently some Breeders cannot handle them at all.
escanor: It is incredibly muscular and possesses immense strength. However, because it is very arrogant, their Breeders have no end to their struggles.
gamba: This tree lover has pointy ears and good [[Speed|quickness]].
fukazo: Fukazo is often mistaken for a [[shark]], and this makes it angry. And when it's angry, it's far scarier than a measly shark!
float: The cherry attached to its head is actually a special tactile sensor that reacts to changes in atmospheric pressure. Its weather predictions make it a valuable monster.
gadgeterG: The Gadgeter G is a steel war gadget told of in the legends of a [[Earth|distant planet]]. Gadgeter G defends the land again today with its mighty G power!
flazer: The Flazer's skin grows thick to protect it from the severe heat of volcanoes. Its devastatingly sharp horns go well with its ferocious personality.
guy: This monster has the fastest airspeed. They say it learned how to fight in midair from a falcon living in the woods.
freebird: The wings on the Freebird's head stand for its youth and freedom. It spreads its wings and heads into a bright tomorrow. Nobody can fetter the Freebird.
flamingoMonsterRancher: The only female Raiden and a dedicated martial artist, she flies through the sky as if swimming and displays her magnificent battle skills. (A bit stubborn, though.)
funbaba: The Funbaba, always sleepy looking, really hates conflict. But when it comes to food, it can throw big temper tantrums and thrash around. Quite a handful.
futurity: Its looks may be what humans look like in the future.
flameJell: This is a monster made from a slimy material that looks like scales in pattern form. There are many mysteries surrounding this monster, but its firm body holds high potential in battles.
galeant: A crimson body and a fiery spirit. No matter the enemy, it will continue to fight with no fear. With its kabuto beetle-like horn, it will pierce through evil.
fukazukin: Its shape came to resemble a shark after it adapted to the marine environment. It also need not worry about getting eaten by a shark this way...
flasher: It is said to make its body shine to blind its foes before attacking, and that is supposedly how it got its name.
furDragon: The fur of the Fur Dragon is extremely durable and very warm, making it especially popular with mothers.
francois: A very high-end, luxury Ducken. A toy company produced it as a commemorative model, sparing no expense.
gabooSoldier: This monster is hot blooded, but often makes careless mistakes.
frozenGaboo: Its body temperature is always kept low even during summer.
frogHopper: It likes to play battle games with kids and be mischievous.
franken: An old monster brought to life with the power of electricity. By some kind of chance, it obtained a soul and started to move on its own.
forestra: The ancient White Knight. Its sword has the magic power of repelling evil. Many have witnessed it sitting quietly in the woods.
fortiKnight: In order to become stronger, it has modified its own body, casting everything else aside in pursuit of [[power|strength]] alone. Its fierce determination is unmatched.
galaxy: This monster relates to the [[Sky]] monster in the [[FIMBA]] area.
flareDeath: A descendant of a dragon has turned into an atrocious Joker.
flowerWorm: This TV star has been in plenty of commercials.
folkes: The most noticeable feature of the Folkes are its large ears. These ears not only distinguish sounds well but are also used to adjust its body temperature.
jellyHound: His 'cool' look makes him a hit when things get hot.
kerorin: On rainy days Kerorin plays outside then comes inside soaking wet. Some say that Kerorin causes the rain to pour.
flower: It has great talent in performance with its light and flexible movements like leaves being blown in the wind. Scientists are not so sure of its ability in battles however.
flyEye: A monster who tends to see everything as a blur.
flaminden: A cute monster whose wooing dance charms those who lose themselves in its beauty. But when it comes to battles, it transforms itself into a combat type monster.
furredWall: Make sure to take good care of his fur and keep fleas off.
galion: May be better off being being a monster reborn instead.
galberra: A happy monster born where varicolored flowers bloom. The scent must have resulted in some sort of monster therapy...
fleece: This monster is good at winter sports and is often called 'Prince of the Snow Field.' However, the best thing about it is its ability to make a snowhouse.
flyPlant: A spoiled brat who won't listen well to your orders.
sumocchi: He has mastered the Eastern art of wrestling called 'Sumo.' He retired the rank of Yokozuna (champion), and now entered the arena of Monster Battles!!
forwardGolem: This monster has a strong will to rush into its goals.
gameprobot: Four-eyed Dragon' s older brother who would rather spend his days showing off his shiny metallic skin to strangers. Just don't use his chest as a mirror.
generalDeath: This cruel and vicious general is said to have come from outer space. It lives for combat, and only respects those of equal or greater rank than itself.
geemo: This huge, peculiar creature is from the planet [[Onlyne]], and is something between a hippo, pig, and Baku. It hates the water on this planet, but has accepted the fact it can never return to its own.
gelatine: Its flabby looking body is actually firmer than it appears.
gigabio: The outstanding features of the Giga Bio are its purple body and large fangs. Kids often start crying when they see it, but it really only wants to play...
gentleMocchi: It is a phantom monster and only a skillful and lucky trainer can get it.
garum: Galum's fur repels water, so it never really gets wet. That's why it can move so swiftly underwater.
genocider: It is said that a curse has been put upon this armor.
ghars: Some of its parts are transparent, made of a gas-like substance. (That's why it's so good at evading.) Born of a young boy's dream, nobody knows what it really is.
gattcharin: With all the funny quirks of the Ducken, the GattchaRin accidentally breaks everything around it. But when it apologizes so sadly, all you can do is forgive it.
gargoyleMonsterRancher: Betrayed by humans, the Gargoyle sold its soul to a demon. For the power it received, it lost the ability to smile. It wishes it could trust people again.
giliant: A hot-blooded monster that dreams of being a hero one day, it's the only Gitan with a fair and just heart. His favorite expression is 'Do a good thing every day.'
galloptan: Galloptan's dream for the future is to be a G1 jockey. It does image training every single day without fail. (It just looks like it's playing horsey, though.)
muddyJell: His clay body allows him to turn into many shapes.
nobleJell: He trains all the time to be considered legendary.
gekko: The crescent moon on its forehead is a sign of justice. Whomever and wherever it is, everyone knows this monster is a hero.
gibberer: His mean acts make him less than popular among others.
gigapint: It is quiet and patient. Its body of gel is very flexible.
geisha: Even though it appears to be lazy, it does work very hard.
gallop: A regular thoroughbred who has a lot of potential.
gariel: He happens to have the most [[intelligence]] of the dragons.
gateKeeper: It is said that somewhere in this world there is an [[Warp Gate|entrance to another world]]. Legend says that it stands guard over that gate.
gidras: This dragon has the mysterious power of [[Metalner]].
galirous: Wears an item which has a special break-proof coating.
galiIsh: After suffering through 1,000 years of sun basking to become a [[Gali]], it realized the sun screen it used was untested, turning it this odd bluish color.
gamer: He is a regular sportsman who likes to fight rough.
gaiaHenger: This unlucky one is cursed by the wicked soul of Golem.
garlant: It is considered to be a phantom monster in the [[FIMBA]] area.
garudaMonsterRancher: It is said that the legendary general [[Garuda (Character)|Garuda]] used to wear it.
galooda: A quick and agile warrior with a soul as hot as the desert sun. It used to fly freely in the air.
gespenst: Wears a silver mask and wields a red-hot sickle. Those monsters cut by its weapon are engulfed in flames and end up being consumed.
gappaya: It is rumored that the third eye on its forehead emits a beam to turn a liar into stone. But it is only a rumor, so breeders feel safe about training it.
gangster: A powerful guy who totes an Uzi machine gun in hand.
gigalon: It was believed the ocean had eyes until it was discovered.
geo: Said to be the guardian deity of the earth, there is even a legend that its fists can cause earthquakes.
goronya: The breeder's most popular monsters of [[Mew]] with a sub-type of [[Dolan]]. I think you have a breeder and are fine, Dolan derived breeders have a monster of the few I'm afraid yet? I did the
gizumocchi: The Gizumocchi has a very strong sense of justice and hates wrongdoing. But it also loves to play in the sand. Maybe it's just a big kid after all.
gingie: The Gingie looks different from other monsters. It seems scary, but it's as gentle as it is strong. It loves to be called 'The Ginster!' Right, Ginster?
gobi: It is said that this monster was a weapon for the ancient war.
granity: Looks like a human with wings and a tail.
grapaduck: Grapen's dream is to fill battle arenas to capacity. It’s a natural-born entertainer!
gontar: It is curious and wants to accept all kinds of challenges.
glacier: Its helmet is shaped like a Tiger's figure.
grapie: Influenced by the [[Naga]], it has decided to try acting a little rebellious. However, since it's naturally so well-behaved, it's having a hard time pulling it off.
gilolitan: It carries magical sand that can put people to sleep. But every now and then, it accidentally sprinkles the sand on itself and ends up feeling very tired...
goroGoro: Despite its thunder-like roar and abundance of lightning techniques, it actually has only a little bit of static with its body. Be especially careful when petting it during the winter.
goku: The bushy-eyebrowed Goku once went on a big adventure carrying a strange and mysterious weapon. The band around its head reminds it of those adventure days.
gillon: With its spiky, unruly hair and selfish attitude, Gillon is rough around the edges in every way. Yet that very immaturity is also part of its charm.
goldDust: It seems to be decadent, but it is actually a hard worker.
gooaall: This monster is a big time fan of the soccer sport.
grape: A Dino-Naga mix with high [[Power]] and low [[Intelligence]].
glitter: It continues to slash at opponents as if devouring them. Although many Breeders look on them with disdain, its power is undeniable.
leafHare: It is a real freedom-fighter. Look at his tattoo.
gordish: This monster seems to take a philosophical view of life.
gooji: With its huge horn, it can even sink a large ship.
gramper: It was born with that great looking beard, which can be combined with the horn on its head to see things far, far away.
goldPiroro: Gold Piroro is known as the genius performance monster. Its performance moves anyone who comes by to watch, and generally acknowledged to be a genius who mesmerizes spectators even in battle.
goldSuezo: This is a very rare monster, for its body is the color gold.
grandie: It slow dances to the rhythm of darkness. But those very movements are the perfected form of a dance stripped of all unnecessary motion.
sampler: Noble people love this guy and his flashy style.
gorenu: A subspecies of Korunu distinguished by its crystallized horns. Like Korunu, it is normally gentle and mild-mannered, and is especially popular with children.
golemIsh: Golem-ish is the shyest of all Golem types, and hates to be stared at. When hiding, its rock body was altered, but it doesn't really mind at all.
gogmagog: It possesses such incredible power that it can sink even a large ship with a single strike. It attacks anything that comes near, without exception!
gobiMarine: Gobi Marine, the legendary weapon. If it had ever been used, the creatures of the sea would surely have been wiped out completely.
gunbitt: An unusual Hare said to have come from the moon. Its favorite thing is pounding rice for mochi, so it's always happily pounding away.
redburn: A fighter who uses its body to protect the peace of the world. This makes it the object of admiration for the smaller monsters.
greenSuezo: More of a sun bather than a fighter. He's easy to breed.
hachiro: It is more intelligent than people think it is.
hanaro: Its big flower makes it very popular with young women. It's said to have a very fresh smell which has a relaxing effect.
guanYuDuck: This rowdy monster just eats or breaks everything. It goes through its opponents easily. As it has swords for hands, it sometimes cuts off its own beard
haktak: The HakTak has a Naga's temperament and a Ripper's aloofness. It can see right into its opponent's soul. It's hard to raise but it can be a reliable partner.
gunbits: Try to imagine an entire army of GunBits. (Too overwhelming to think about?) If you train it right, the GunBits will be a mighty ally!
griffonite: Basically, it's a Raiden, but top martial arts training has been passed down through its blood. It's never taken off its armor once in its life.
grindink: The faces on its stomach and tail have minds of their own and sometimes get into arguments. In the end, it's always the face on the tail that settles things.
halloween: It has a pumpkin over its head from the time it's born so even it has never seen its own face. Sometimes you can see its eyes through the holes, and they're pretty cute.
gyoruna: Covered in hard scales, the Gyoruna can even swim through magma unscathed. Because it has such a ferocious temperament, it's pretty hard to break it in.
grasbie: Grasbie is said to be faster when it jumps than when it runs. If you look at those short legs, you might understand.
gyororo: When the fighting spirit that has entered the eye exert strong spill so big highlight features, usually has a lot of charm to your eyes.
gurlok: Who loves the ''Official US PlayStation Magazine''? Gurlok! He gets so much snazzy info from OPM that he's had a tattoo proclaiming his love for the mag inked onto his belly.
hagiDragon: More than anything else, what catches the eye are its beautiful wings. They are not only beautiful, but also light and incredibly strong, making them extremely valuable.
grupus: Grupus was born when moss grew on a Dragon hibernating underground. It can photosynthesize, so it can live for many days without eating.
gullken: A cool [[seagull]] that travels from sea to sea. However, according to some, it may simply be restless.
wildHare: This guy is very happy with his thick eye brows.
gremlinMonsterRancher: A rare type of monster with a talent for tinkering with mechanical devices. It's very [[Intelligence|intelligent]], but it uses those skills to pull pranks, making it quite a troublesome rascal.
pickle: Normally, it's very calm and gentle, but on nights lit by the full moon, it undergoes a dramatic transformation! It becomes an incredibly ferocious monster!
grimReaper: A KARAKURI-Combination type Tokobot. At one look the Reaper seems adorable, but shows its true appearance when defeating its enemies. The scythe is not to be underestimated.
grasster: The ancient battlefields have become its home. No one maintains [[Plains of Aspia|these grasslands]], and yet they are neatly trimmed...because there is someone who does it.
haman: A precious species that possesses a beautiful white body. In the eastern lands, it is praised as an agent of God, and is believed to bring luck and swipe away evil.
grilief: The leaf is for camouflage reasons. Its hiding ability is so great that even their Breeders can't find them.
han: The slender body and the beautiful combat style has many fans. It is only to be trained to see that it does live up to its expectations.
grayWolfMonsterRancher: He has a beautiful coat of silver fur. Howls at night.
griphyon: This bird is revered as the King of the Sands, but it is really rather modest. It must be quietly training somewhere in the desert right now...
grayMew: It is rumored that it has a dagger under his sleeves, despite its innocent look. Don't get too close and keep your guard up, as it is said to use its sharp claws to launch a surprise attack.
gymBajarl: Great personality; can't hate it no matter what. Has a mysterious past.
hamunofuji: A rare member of the Kawazumo species, this monster is covered in soft, fluffy fur. It has many admirers, who simply can't get enough of its delightfully round, chubby appearance.
guren: A monster with a right arm that resembles a weapon called a Radiation Wave. True to its intimidating appearance, it is said to be very reliable on the battlefield.
harlequin: It inflicts damage to its enemies taking advantage of its agility and light footwork. The mysterious poker face that conceals its intentions is also said to be the secret of its strength.
hellPierrot: Though it is a descendant from Joker, it cannot turn into a complete fiend.
helmHound: A scientist once wondered if this monster wouldn't be just another dog if it didn't have its shell. He tried valiantly to remove it but failed miserably.
hipMew: Hey, rock 'n' roll, baby! Me and my rockin' friends will show you our cool moves on the dance floor. And when it comes to battle, I'm at the top of the charts!
higante: It has an abundant knowledge, but is not good at applying it.
hippopochaos: It's descended from a species that knows the ways of the wind but it seems to have forgotten everything. Now it only knows the ways of the afternoon nap.
hermes: It is said to be equipped with legendary footwear that allows it to run through the sky.
hibis: The flower on its tail grows bigger as Hibis gets older. Perfumes created from this flower are a special product made solely in Kalaragi.
highroller: The red-bodied Highroller can't stop once it starts running. Some say it's three times as fast as the regular Rhinoroller, but that hasn't been proven.
heelOw: Looks and personality befit its name. When raising a hero, that time is now!
harken: In its desire for strength, it endlessly punches rocks everyday. Its well-trained punch will destroy any obstacle.
hicken: A passionate, hot-blooded fighter with a burning heart. However, its face doesn’t often convey that passion.
happyMask: Its bright expression will make you forget about your worries.
heuy: You will be surprised to see it flying around in the air fast.
hengerIsh: This monster was sealed beneath the earth by an [[Pendant Ruins|ancient super civilization]]. Years of volcanic heat changed its metal to an odd color.
highlander: An armor monster adapted to the snow. They say it used to be the soul of a warrior who died on a quest for a legendary place.
heimdall: It is said to stand between this world and the [[Land of Chaos]]. If the demons ever invade, it is prepared to be the first to face them.
herbert: A monster said to be the soul of a master swordsman with cat-like agility dwelling within his beloved suit of armor.
hercules: It has excellent strength and a dull sword won't even scratch it.
hellHeart: According to legend, it was an atrocious monster.
usabaSuezoSub: If you don't discipline this monster, he'll become a brat.
hellLord: From the deepest depths of darkness came a murderer. Both his mask and cloak are stained red -- it is the blood splatter of his opponents.
hareIsh: Once a rabbit was given prohibited pet food by its owner, and was turned into Hare-ish as a result. Although rejected by its owner, it can't forget him and continues to search for him.
hariluro: A monster as cute as a stuffed toy. Since it is rare outside of [[Age]], tourists come just to hold and cuddle it.
hengerDoll: It is a doll of Henger with a wicked soul.
haze: Not only its cat-like claws, but also the sharp blades on its back can slice through anything. The way it toys with its prey before finishing it off sends chills down the spine of anyone watching.
heptameron: Its character is quiet, but it is brave when protecting animals.
hareHound: His big, dark eyes mesmerize one into a relaxing state.
holstarin: People were curious about where this monster gets the milk it brings, so they finally decided to follow it, only to see something they shouldn't have.
hawkclaw: Its cooing is said to be the cutest among the Piroro species. There are breeders who train this monster because it wants to hear it coo, but beware as it does so from very early in the morning.
hohocto: This Octopee lives in trees. However, they are very bad at climbing, so once they fall out of a tree, they can't get back up again.
harePlant: He's so fast sometimes that he can make himself dizzy.
hinatcho: Often mistaken for a Chuparo's chick, it has a spoiled and quiet personality. When bad things happen it hides itself in an empty eggshell, but it's yellow legs can still be seen.
haukutoriki: A polite and serious monster with a dignified demeanor that gives off the feeling of a veteran warrior.
higanbana: A monster with a strong will, seen in its large eye. It has wing-like parts on its sides, but they are too small to fly.
hao: Contrary to her gentle, smiling expression, her personality is extremely cruel. At times, she acts as if she can see right through you. Even her jokes should never be taken lightly...
haniel: Stylish and incredibly pretentious for one of the Ark species, it transforms into a handsome young man who can charm many women. It feels competitive toward those who are more handsome than him.
hareClaus: Among the [[Santa]]s, this monster has the most delivery experience and only the purest of hearts will transform into this monster. The gifts that it delivers are still the same, though, so don't be disappointed.
hornie: Be weary of his sharp horn that can injure a [[breeder]].
izuna: Only a few people have seen Izuna before. It is said this is because Izuna has mastered the martial art of Ninjutsu.
tobita: Inaba Hare may have a cute face, but it's surprisingly crafty and calculating. Unfortunately, it always says one thing too many, so even its carefully planned pranks often end up failing.
icebergy: It is a glutton, so ordinary people do not raise it.
homura: Homura's origin of the name comes from gathering flames. When its crimson body starts to enflame, it will burn everything in its vicinity without a shadow left to be seen.
huskyGill: The HuskyGill loves the cold ocean water. Because it's always right there when the floating ice comes in, everyone fondly calls it the 'Messenger of Winter.'
icyJell: On a cold and frozen winter day, this guy will freeze.
insebel: There are creepy rumors that this monster can be found in the cocoons made by the worms. Its battling abilities are highly regarded.
ingarul: Ingarul is one of the most complete and refined in spirit amongst the Garu species. However, observation of his daily activities casts a doubt on that reputation.
hotFoot: An evolved monster who can get very cold at times.
iceCandy: His face is well protected, but his body isn't.
homunculusMonsterRancher: An improved breed of Hare created by human hands. It is extremely [[intelligent]] and highly knowledgeable, but its [[Life|lifespan]] is very short.
irabuya: Its smooth, scaly body divides Breeders. However, its ability in combat receives no complaint, and once you get used to it, it is rather cute.
ibuki: Some believe it is a larval form of Zan, but its abilities surpass even those of Zan itself!
houndSaurian: It can run fast, so it is often used to deliver express mail.
hotrod: This monster runs in the desert at night. It doesn't really mind that it can only run in straight lines. Its shiny mane is the symbol of a Zoom.
howlzapper: The HowlZapper, with the characteristics of both the Tiger and Ripper, is said to be the fastest in the world. By the time the opponent hears it, it's too late.
horowitz: It is entirely covered in jelly, and its softness is one of a kind. Its attacks take advantage of its flexibility and inflict painful damages on its opponents quickly.
ivoryWall: His mask has the markings of an [[Deities|almighty god]].
immelk: A monster who parallels Antero, though this monster is said to be more aggressive. Its appearance is somewhat enigmatic and its face resembles a jeweled visor or crown.
isobe: Isobe was the most famous creature in Goat, until they found [[Octopee]]. Go Isobe! Show them you're still the best!
ichigo: A monster that absolutely loves a [[Strawberry (Item)|certain fruit]]. Not only does it enjoy eating the fruit itself, but it also seems to spend all its time spreading the word so that everyone can discover how delicious it is.
hypnos: When its green eyes glow, it is said to induce drowsiness in those who are watching. Sailors are always afraid of encountering Hypnos at sea.
iblis: The Ark species can only stay transfigured for a very short time. Such inconvenience has created building resentment inside with no release, so this monster is seeking revenge on the [[Joker]] who created him.
jailkeeper: It was born as the guardian of an [[Promiass|island]] where criminals were imprisoned. With its sharp eyes, it never lets anyone escape.
jaguarbeat: The Jaguar Beat looks similar to the [[Jagd Hound]], a Tiger and [[Worm]] mix, but this monster is really popular with kids. Jaguar Beats with glossy coats are rare.
jackoranta: With its pumpkin head, it doesn't need an umbrella. It loves the rain! It gets lonely so it likes groups, and it gets really attached to its breeder.
jelaydon: With its sharp edges, its entire body is a weapon. That's why the Monster Association is always asking breeders to be careful. It's light despite its size.
rockDragon: He's shy, but has the most [[Power]] of all the Dragons.
janne: It is brave but its heart is a little bit too delicate to defeat enemies.
jungler: He enjoys a camouflage disguise to confuse foes.
skyhorn: Not only is it fast, but its sky-blue color lets it blend in with its surroundings in the water or air. With its low body temperature, it loves to sunbathe.
jet: It aims to be a cool villain, and uses its natural [[speed]] to cause mischief. Even its failures happen at record-breaking speed!
jaba: It is said that this monster was made to be used as an assassin.
wormJell: He has an odd pair of shiny green eyes that stare at you.
jellnico: Shows kindness towards reds and fury towards blues. It is full of kindness life, but reveals its fury when it comes to battles. This large gap in personality is sure to surprise you.
juniorMonsterRancher: The name 'Junior' may not sound like much, but this monster is a highly-skilled assassin. It trains on a daily basis to stay on top of the 'food chain' as it says.
jaggernaut: Its carmine eyes show its wickedness.
jaques: He has a strange flower growing from his head.
jabberwock: The Jabberwock is known for its comical movements, like those of a clown. Despite that, its ferocity surpasses that of an ordinary Dragon.
jock: Jock is training hard to become the ultimate athlete. It thinks the main secret to greatness is spinning in circles. Silly? Yes. But it's actually kind of working so... props to the Jock.
jellyGaboo: It is similar to Jell, but it has no core like that of Jell.
jammhat: A robot covered entirely in flashy armor, still under development. It doesn't seem to act according to its programming.
jokerIsh: When a Joker decided to change its evil ways and live among humans, it was stripped of its evil powers and reborn as Joker-ish.
juggler: It uses the scythe like an extension of its own body. It plays with the lives of other monsters as if they were toys.
jiro: This monster can curl up into a highly armored ball. But if the wind blows when it's like this, it will be rolling around all over the place.
jellysaurus: Its body beaming with the sunlight reflected off the surface of the sea as it's swimming through the ocean is a beautiful sight. Many people have visited to look at such monster.
jerod: May look scary but is actually very nice and kind-hearted.
jellyWorm: His flabby appearance makes him so lovable.
jellySaurian: Its body is made up gel and can be a comfortable type of cushion.
jagdHound: This unique guy has 4 eyes that help him see far and near.
jojo: Panko is an unconventional dresser and loves to travel. It might be coming to your town soon!
jiji: A slightly mature monster with a heart as hot as fire and a mind as cool as snow.
junglePlum: Its dance is so amazing that toys were made to mimic it. I used to have one growing up.
jackInTheCho: When it finds a treasure chest, it slips inside and makes itself at home. It attacks anybody that opens the chest, so it's greatly feared by many adventurers.
jelline: This [[Jell]] completely transformed in the relentless pursuit of cuteness. Because it is good at getting its way and is confident in its appearance, occasionally it will be flirty in order to ask for things.
melloncho: It appears in the hot months of summer. All it wants to do is eat [[watermelon]] all season. They say it lives out the winter underground, but few have ever seen it.
kittenMonsterRancher: A musical based on Kitten's life has played a long run.
kapukkoro: People say that watching Kapukkoro will cure colds and other common ailments. Kapukkoro do not appreciate this kind of superstition.
kero: Kero adapted to a water environment differently than [[Tortboy]]. It is said it sometimes sings a song to bring rain.
kingTutDuck: For some reason, Karakkung is afraid of triangles. When it sees one, it starts meditating. I wonder why?
kasumi: Its breasts tend to get more attention than its battles.
kagura: Nobody knows whether it fell from heaven or came up out of the earth. Everybody's hero, the Kagura travels all over the world, hating the sin but loving the sinner.
karma: Good deeds shall be rewarded, and bad deeds shall be punished. People today often forget such common sense, but Karma is here to help them remember.
kakao: Thanks to the heat of the jungle, Kakao is very easy-going. On a moonlit night, you might be able to see its Jell Dance, though you'll lose [[Guts]] Points.
justin: Just like its name, its personality is burning with justice. But to some people it’s a little bit too hot. Raise them in moderation.
kijimunaMonsterRancher: Though it carries Octopee’s bloodline, it lives deep in the forest. It is skilled at fishing, so if you go fishing with it, you’re always guaranteed a big catch!
kingApe: This monster is feared as the dominator of the [[Parepare Jungle]].
kobu: They say at the top of its head you can find the legendary
kautroarkaut: It is used as a means of transportation by some people.
