kanabron: Its horns are very good, but its claws are its main weapon. The sharp claws are known as 'Iron Claws,' and you would not want it on your bad side. Things would get ugly.
kokken: A proud Ducken, awakened to the spirit of chivalry, but it has yet to gain true composure.
kinken: A Ducken that evolved after being attacked by a cat and studying its power! However, it still doesn’t like cats.
kelmadics: This stone armor is too heavy for normal people to wear.
knightNiton: Its shell is the hardest of all the Niton species.
kaduka: This one's a born fighter. Has high [[Intelligence]] and [[Power]].
kamui: It escaped being executed for killing humans.
kablo: Wait under the big tree in the forest and cover it with honey. It might be lured by the smell of honey and come wondering about. Very popular among kids who like insects.
kiki: Mischievous Kiki likes to jump from tree to tree and drop nuts on people walking below. Watch out!
juraWall: This hot-head can be a little short with his temper.
kesshoka: When the wind blows, its beautiful song can be heard. The melody makes you sleepy and sometimes you get lost.
karaoke: This monster tries to mimic all of the top singers.
kaio: It is said this Golem is modeled after a Sea God in a fairy tale. This is the only Golem not afraid of water.
kachoFugetsu: A monster who seems gentle and demure. However, she enjoys seeing men attracted to her.
koinobori: The patterns on its body are so beautiful that they captivate anyone. In a certain region, there is an annual event where this monster makes an appearance, and it seems to be popular with children.
kagamimochi: The Kagami mochi ornament, created based on the legend that good fortune will come to a household that contains one, is popular on New Years Eve in many homes.
kappachi: A mysterious Mocchi who lives in [[Nurse Wetlands|a certain region]]. But there is one thing that is known about it - it can't swim! Apparently, it's just too heavy.
ragnarok: A dark soul that has been accused of mass destruction.
lamew: A cute and fluffy breed of Mew, popular with girls. Popular as a healing monster with a quiet personality.
koroball: The Korottama and the Puchi Otome are rivals. So far the record stands at 2-2. The Korottama won the Eating Contest and the 'Let's Do Acrobatics' championship.
korohelmets: KoroHelmets hurt each other with their spikes but that's how they really get to trust each other. They rush forward in perfect formation and then it's...touchdown!
korokoroller: Just like its name, the KoroKoroller just rolls along, and it always drives safely. Its red nose warns it when it starts going too fast.
koroncho: A monster shrouded in mystery, nobody knows what it really is. They say it often appears on beautiful, starry nights. Maybe it came from outer space?
lafreshitan: The Lafreshitan loves sunshine. It's always happiest when it's sunbathing, lapping up the nectar from the flower on its head.
kungFuPixie: An unusual one in the Pixie species that is trying to master the martial arts, but it's having trouble mastering the techniques.
lacoon: Lacoon is the manager of the forest. It uses the pincers on its head to cut back useless branches.
korodango: If you poke this monster, it curls up to protect itself. Although it could probably move faster in that shape, it never does. Maybe it hurts to roll?
koronit: When the weather becomes cold, its fur becomes thicker. You can tell which region this monster is from by looking at the thickness of its fur.
kungFuDragon: 'I have never seen Kung-Fu get hit by an enemy,' says a Breeder that trained one. (and she's not lying!)
kujata: This mysterious Dragon is said to have come from the other side of the moon, though that is not really true. It has a bad temper and is hard to train.
kuma: He's a monster who loves the old-fashioned way of life.
kyuza: This is the most common type of Henger that was manufactured. Different color versions and custom types can also be seen.
warriorZ: This name means that no one can equal it.
krsnik: A monster whose soul has taken up residence within the armor of a divine knight. Its sacred power repels all attacks.
kungFuHare: It trains daily to master the ancient art of kung fu.
kuro: He has the classic dream of becoming a superhero.
kuririn: When you see Kuririn in the woods, put out your fires. If Kuririn catches fire, it will explode.
kurincho: This monster was found under a huge chestnut tree. Initially, the monster still had burrs and many Breeders were hurt.
kueruno: A monster that inhabits cold regions, it possesses skin hardened into an armor-like, keratinized hide. It is highly resistant to cold but does not tolerate heat well. Compared with Korunu, it is much more curious and becomes accustomed to people more easily. However, because it is also more active, it is more prone to aggressive behavior.
koloro: Koloro has lived in Kalaragi for a long, long time. Every year at the famous [[Koloro Festival]], you can see the Koloro Dance. It's fun.
konta: Konta thinks it can do anything with just a piece of a leaf. It often tries to use the leaf as money and gets in trouble for it.
lapislatel: Called the 'Desert Castle,' this Golem has high [[defense]]. When traveling in the desert, Breeders sometimes bring one instead of a tent.
kusazumo: A monster that came from the [[Refirn Islands|southern islands]] to compete in a foreign sport. Its cheerful personality has made it quite popular, but some say its fighting style is too straightforward and predictable to be exciting.
lancelot: A monster that carries the dignity of a knight. On the battlefield, it stands tall and proud. It will show you in the way that it fights.
larock: Though it looks like a light and fluffy mass of cotton, it in fact has considerable weight and hardness. This monster is a top-class fighter with lots of [[power]] despite its gentle personality.
mikmew: Always full of energy, it's constantly running. Its dream is to someday be the star of the battle world! It plans to eat, sleep and fight a lot to get strong.
lidee: Hold on tightly when you get on this fella. He's very fast.
lilim: It can be best described as a little witch.
lionkoro: The LionKoro has all the strength of a lion but comes in a compact size. Act now and get all three at a bargain price! What a deal! Wanna buy a set?
lavaLessie: Inside a body that can stand up to lava, it keeps a cool, level head. A monster you can rely on, it can always make a calm decision no matter how tough things get!
lepus: Her long ears don't mean that she'll listen well.
lobearta: Maid by day, skilled fighter by night. This creature was planning to quit its day job, but grew to love it so much that it hasn't been easy.
loveSeeker: It is a Metalner combined with a Pixie to understand 'love.'
clayMonolSub: Though native to volcanic lands, he does not like the heat.
lionel: Its fangs, polished every day without fail, are strong enough to crush even rock! Showing them is usually enough to make most foes turn tail and run.
liorosa: Its bright red mane gives it the aura of a king. With unmatched strength and courage, it is a reliable leader who never loses to anyone!
liquidCube: It is almost impossible to recognize it in the water.
lindwurm: It lives in the sky and soars freely through the air. Compared to other Dragons, its movements are especially swift and agile.
lekken: It has an honest, obedient personality and listens well to its Breeder. However, it only listens — it doesn’t actually follow through with anything.
leoken: A Ducken that has acquired an innocent heart. Its curiosity is so strong that it sometimes ends up dismantling its own body.
locomotive: It imitated a 'locomotive' which it saw in a foreign country. Its performance is the same as a normal Henger.
leziena: It proves that women also participated in ancient battles.
lorica: This armor, made out of the shell of Arrow Heads, is light and easy to handle.
tropicalDog: He is covered in leaves to help him grow. Unpopular.
lunasos: Appearing on a moonlit night, it attacks with a blade like the crescent moon. Its eyes are filled with madness.
lessieorca: An intelligent and affectionate one among the Lesione species. But it has sharp fangs, and caution is needed when it's in a playful mood.
lesioneIsh: The youngest of 5 Lesione siblings is often born with unusual coloring. This is called the Lesione-ish, and is usually quite dependent.
licorice: With a lovely coat of velvety fur, this one is beautiful!
looker: Perhaps the best looking monster of them all.
lexus: This monster is best known for his great [[Speed]].
ripperNaga: Has an array of attacks, but he doesn't trust many people.
lovina: This blissed-out monster loves bright colors. It is said that anyone who sees it will become happy, but the happiest of all has to be the monster itself.
lemlaria: This golden Golem has been blessed by the mysterious powers of the deep forest. It looks golden because of this magical blessing.
lordJizo: Lord Jizo seems as though it has finally reached true enlightenment in this world, but it continues to sit still today, seeking even greater heights. I wonder what today's offering will be?
manna: It believes that it is the most beautiful monster of all.
mumMew: Another monster who's quite a mixed breed of creatures.
machuPicchu: Looks pretty high-tech but it's only a wind-up toy. It has a hard time getting its gears to line up right. It once tried out for a movie but was rejected.
magmax: It is active, but it becomes lazy when it is kept by humans.
mahjongkoro: This monster is covered with writing, but not even the most renowned scholars can decipher it. Its name comes from the three words
mandrakeMonsterRancher: When the Mandragora gets mad its flower petals give off an extreme heat. If you're careless and touch it when it's in a bad mood, you'll get an awful burn.
malincarin: The Malincarin just loves summer! It carries a swim cap and tube with it the whole year through. But it can't swim. It never even lets go of the tube!
magicBajarl: It is considered to be a descendant from [[Magic]] in [[FIMBA]] area.
marshmallow: They are great hunters. The white Jell body blends in perfectly with the snow as they sneak silently up and fire their Jell Cannons.
marbel: Its purple body armor is said to actually have been remodeled. It seems to want to fight for justice.
marimba: Easily mistaken for a tree, people often try to cut them down. But every time, the three bind tightly together and they are saved.
magmaHeart: It will immediately attack whoever invades its territory.
magamocken: A baby monster with a cool green body that crawls on fours. The big ears look like a decoration, but it can hear things clearly. Although whether they are really ears or not is unknown.
luvco: An old legend speaks of a young heartbroken woman who jumped into the sea, and her love came back in the form of this monster. The heart on its forehead is the symbol of love.
madGaboo: A tool to make it obey is buried in its forehead.
mage: This monster's might is beyond description.
magnet: A side-to-side mover who can slide out of danger.
lycanthroid: Even compared to other Hengars, this one is especially modified to suite air combat. It is said that thousands and thousands of Sky Hengars filled the sky during the ancient war.
mariomax: It always cares how it looks. It is a little bit self conceited.
maestan: Because it's busy listening to all the music in the world, it is always sleep-deprived. It may look unpleasant, but it's really a kind musician at heart.
magi: No one knows where it is from. If it proposes a bet using its cards, don't accept; if you lose the bet, you'll lose your life. Watch out!
marm: There is a mysterious attractiveness that lingers with its flexible and agile body. The mysteriousness of it is rather charming, making it popular among breeders.
maririn: I heard Maririn used to work for a sea god named [[Ogyo]]. They say that Ogyo was a tyrant, and Maririn was always suffering.
maharajan: This monster does mystic moves called 'Yogar.' They say that even if it is hurt, using 'Yogar' it can heal quickly. Can this be true?
maneplum: It blossoms its flowers beautifully  like a lion's mane. It is very ambitious and will show its aggressive side during combat.
marincho: A monster with great fondness for playing with balls so much, that it eventually mad it its house. If you ask nicely to come out and play, it will do so happily.
makyu: Makyu mesmerizes its fans with its exciting battles. It is always trying to improve itself, looking for a bigger battlefield.
maidchi: A Mocchi that has been trained to help out in household affairs. But, there seems to be a limit to train monsters to help you out in the house. Its cooking is especially awful.
marimocchi: A Mocchi covered in green fuzz. It gets really depressed when people say it's grown mold, but don't shouldn't let it bother you!
moaigon: Defined by his sad and longing blue eyes, he eyes the past.
magna: Immortalized on ancient wall paintings as a great warrior.
marbleGuy: With his fatal [[Power]], he has killed many. Highly feared.
magmaFrog: A Kawazumo species that possesses the soul of a Dragon. It is incredibly resilient and highly resistant to heat. It's even said that, for short periods of time, it can swim through molten lava.
metalJell: It is very rare. Even if you find it, it will run away quickly.
melcarba: A mechanical monster who was made before Henger.
maturidragon: The dashing Edokkodon can't seem to hold onto its money. It often uses rough language although it doesn't know what it means. (Don't ask, because it can't explain.)
mermagaru: If you've noticed the MermaGaru's gross yet cute appearance, then you have a discerning eye. But this monster is even odder than it looks. Watch over it, OK?
metazorl: It is a Metalner combined with an expressive monster: Suezo.
metanix: A cold-weather type Henger equipped with skis. It must have patrolled the mountainous regions frequently.
maverick: The Maverick is said to be the soul from an ancient researcher who sealed himself inside in order to obtain immortality.
metalGlory: There is no record showing that this armor has been used in the past.
masala: It used to be a warrior of light, but after it found a demon sword, its mind was lost, and its body color became dark.
metalShell: Its body is made out of a strange substance.
maskWorm: Don't let this hard-head get hit in his body or else.
matalyn: A nocturnal monster that causes mischief to people throughout the night. Its fickle, and does some farm work at times, earning some affection.
shishitan: A monster said to live deep in the forest, always traveling in a wild pack. Its name comes from how energetic and lively it is.
massacrer: It is said to have inherited the soul of a cruel nobleman who wore a mask. Rather than a monster, it is closer to an evil spirit.
mechHare: It is said to possess dormant electrical power, though there is no visible change in its appearance. In fact, it is more [[Intelligence|intelligent]] than other Hares.
metalHead: It usually saves energy for upcoming fights by doing nothing. A very clever monster...
merlion: Whistle and it will appear for you in a second. It's a very affectionate monster, although whether you can use its agility as well in battles is entirely up to the breeder.
metalGlay: This is popular among little kids and tends to be their toy.
melonSuezo: To no surprise, this melon-looking guy loves fruit.
merman: With the gills on its breast, it can breathe underwater. This monster sees itself as a mermaid, but others have trouble with that idea.
melonGaboo: A monster that looks just like a [[Watermelon|certain fruit]]. This appearance is designed to lure opponents into a false sense of security, and if you approach carelessly, you'll be met with a powerful attack.
mechael: It was apparently developed to win competitions in a foreign land, but mechanical entrants ended up being banned, so it was reduced to serving as a coin bank.
mercury: Many monsters with Undine blood are known to be kind-hearted, but Mercury is quite tomboyish. Its transparent wings and tail add to its charm.
merrowMonsterRancher: The 'Singer of the Sea' who lulls people to sleep with its songs. It seems to be popular with men and women, which is perhaps why there are many sad stories of people falling in love with it.
mewbat: Mew types are cute, mysterious creatures, and the Mewbat is the strangest of all. Some say the soul of an [[Abyss]] resides within it, and others just think it's odd by nature.
mimizo: Its big ears are able to hear distant sounds. Makes a fine watchdog, with such good hearing and the sight of the Suezo species, and stands out among it's kind.
mochiMonk: The tropically-grown Peachie releases a sweet fragrance from its body. Despite its large size, it has an equally big heart and a laid-back personality.
moch: Although it seems very friendly on the surface, this monster is always thinking of new pranks in the back of its mind. Watch your back!
mimiuo: Despite the elegant characteristics of most Ogyos, this breed gives a comical impression which divides the opinions of Ogyo lovers. Very popular with children.
mewsneak: A thief who disturbs the city every night, stealing instead of working. If she doesn't watch her figure, she soon won't be able to fit into that fur coat.
mewJ: A Mew that loves basketball but has no real skills. When it decides to dunk, it always end up going through the hoop rather than the ball.
mewseijin: Its body is covered with a special skin, and its large eyes are always shining. There are rumors that it's from another planet, or that is really a machine.
skullMew: A white skeleton that loves to scare people in dark rooms. Its body pattern was burned there by lightning, but it still likes to take walks on stormy days.
psymew: It's stuffed with beads, so it has no problem in the water. And it's so light it can't help but bound around. Its ambition is to become a bigshot monster someday.
mochiMew: It looks fabulous in its big pink check pattern. It's trimmer than the [[Mocchi]], so it has plenty of confidence in its looks. The shell on its head is extremely hard.
miku: When the Miku goes out, it always brings its camera. It takes pictures of flowers and the scenery. But why is there always a bluish-white shadow in every picture?
miniogrekoro: When two of them bang their horns together, they're having a conversation like, 'How you doing?' 'Not bad, you?' But their horns are so small it isn't easy to do.
mochiPlant: The Rice-cake Cherry sports pretty blossoms every spring. These blossoms go by quickly, and the best time to view them is a little different each year.
mocchisaurus: It's been long-treasured as a messenger of fortune that brings happiness wherever it goes. (This rumor isn't even true, and the poor monster feels pretty pressured...)
mia: It draws many people's support with its cute charm.
mewbyss: This creature may look laid back, but is actually very sensitive. Rumor has it that the Mewbyss loves to sing and dance with its mic when no one else is around.
mewco: Falco disguised itself to hide its large body, but its muscles are about to burst from this stuffed animal shell.
mewmew: Mewmew has something resembling a zipper on its back. Therefore, the 'Mewmew is only a costume' theory is even considered plausible in academic circles.
miragePlant: A monster who looks very beautiful and mysterious.
mewcho: Mewcho loves its 'house' so much that it never comes out. Maybe that's why it hasn't noticed someone took a nice big bite. Ignorance is bliss...
mocchini: It always wears black tights in order to protect its legs. It is a fast runner.
mocchiIsh: Mocchi-ish has a strong hatred for Mocchi because of its cute demeanor and popularity. But no matter how often it says it hates Mocchi, the feeling's actually closer to envy.
mewIsh: This monster was sitting with a lot of stuffed animals but nobody bought it. Next thing it knew, its entire body was covered in tears, hence the color.
mewnda: Mewnda was looking for some oh-so-crunchy magic bamboo once, but forgot what it was doing, and decided to give up.
mewkiri: Mewkiri thinks it is a giraffe, so they don't like being called a monster. Nonetheless, it continues to eat fish rather than grass.
milim: Curious and tomboyish, it is theorized that she holds the power of a Demon King from another world. Don't let her cute appearance fool you, or you'll be in for a surprise!
monzo: Monzo loves listening to gossip, but what it doesn't realize is that its big ears are often the subject of gossip themselves!
mumm: Mumm always wakes up early to put on its dress and apron. It is a hard worker, always preparing meals.
mochilips: Pease’s dance, born from its love of nature, soothes the heart and brings love and peace!
moztan: It somehow got the idea it could be a [[Raiden]] when it grew up, so it trains hard every day. What it doesn't know is that it's been an adult for a long time now.
munitan: A kind little monster that always smells good. In spite of the way he looks, he's a boy. People always mistake him for a girl, though, and he doesn't like it.
pinkJam: Named after a famous and tasty fruit product.
mose: Because of its huge shoulders and horn that can act as a straw to suck [[Honey (Item)|honey]] directly from a beehive, it has come to love sweet things.
mrFujiyama: Clad in its manly red loincloth, it runs all around town every day.
mooMonsterRancher: This dreadful-looking dragon hardly appears even in legends.
mochiken: Mochiken’s body parts are soft and sticky like rice cakes. But that doesn’t mean you should eat it!
muimaya: It can draw power from sunlight, so it loves taking naps in the sun. As a result it sleeps all day, but this can put it in a bad mood, so Breeders should be careful.
mocky: Mention of its cheap-looking makes this monster mad.
morlock: It is thought of as a stone monster, but it is said that the jewel held in the eyes are the core of what controls its life formulating stony body.
monoEyed: This one-eyed wonder is very friendly. Kids love him.
monolIsh: A genius scientist was said to have created this monster as a Monol imitation, but had no idea what to use it for when finished. But he was pretty proud of getting the levitation right.
momotero: A subspecies of Antero distinguished by markings that resemble the 'Sakura Blizzard' technique used by the [[Mocchi]] species. Unlike the ordinary Anteros, it is less wary of people and is said to become attached to humans more easily.
mustardy: It is playful, and tends to carry its jokes too far.
nightfang: One touch of its sleek, dark body and you'll get a glimpse into its cold and unforgiving heart. But in battle, its graceful moves will impress you.
nedel: This ecological Golem likes places with lots of wind from which it can generate energy. Kids love it because it looks like a toy.
ormeka: This ancient and mysterious Golem was just recently discovered. Its body was covered with moss, so it must have been there awhile.
nightSickle: A slightly odd monster that likes suspenseful horror movies. Quite intelligent, it sees through the traps laid by its opponents with a cool, clear head.
niezheg: Its dazzling purple skin is said to be an advertisement of its own aggressiveness.
mustachios: This monster is always clustered with companions.
mushtan: The MushTan likes damp, humid places but its personality is unexpectedly bright and cheerful. If you breathe in its spores, you won’t be able to stop laughing.
naskaova: The strange and ancient Henger robot evolved into this monster, with a body particularly suited for battle. Present-day science can't explain its mysteries.
nagisa: Warm-blooded like humans, she has a soft jelly body.
nightFlyer: Her radar-like antennas help her to dodge opponents.
ninja: Due to its tendency to remain hidden in the darkness, it is rarely found. It use to be raised as a spy in the past.
nasupen: Though it looks like it can fly, it in fact spends its time swimming. It demonstrates characteristics that fit surprisingly well in any environment.
mustard: Acts like a brat though it appears innocent.
naguaco: Naguaco has a solid balance of power and magic, and is always training for the sake of keeping others safe.
nis: It lives in a cold region. Though looks aggressive at first glance, it's not a bad monster. In fact, if you're nice to it, it'll help you out with work.
ninjaKato: It originated from a Kato with master ninja skills.
nagaSaurian: Since it is a descendant from Naga, it is rather violent.
newLeaf: This guy has a striking resemblance to a local tree.
nagaIsh: Naga-ish no longer has use for its eyes due to living in the dark depths of a cave for so long. Its other senses were sharpened as a result, which means its prey never gets away.
munlee: This sweet monster performs under the solitude of the desert moon. Dancers often use it in their designs.
neon: This monster is absolutely bursting with [[geonyte|energy]].
narikirog: A Kawazumo species recognized by its trademark silk hat and cane. Although it considers itself a fellow gentleman, it apparently harbors a secret rivalry with the [[Gentle Mocchi]].
nightFlight: A nocturnal Piroro that moves under the cover of darkness. Because of its striking appearance, it is often referred to as a mysterious creature. It is known by the nickname 'Luminous Moth' and is a beautiful clown-like monster.
nekobo: Nekobō loves to play and get into mischief. If you don't keep it strictly disciplined, it may do things you never expected. It's very popular with grandpas and grandmas.
nycta: The Nycta's large, wide beak snaps up every last bit of food in sight. If you don't watch out, it just might snap you up, too!
nutcho: A big walnut that ripens once 100 year on the big tree that has lived for 1000 years. Inside it lies a secret jewel. There was such a legend past, but it was actually just Nutcho.
nyankoro: Since it is a descendent from [[Kato]], it looks like an old cat.
oh: Even among Golems, which pride themselves on their strength, this flamboyant egotist is noticeably strong. Is it for real?
plauna: This calm character loves to stand in the green grass and breathe deeply. It might not do well in a place too cold or too hot.
serenity: A very kind and gentle being who isn't good at fighting.
octoban: When the soft-spoken Octoban enters into a dull tournament it's sure get more exciting!
nussie: It is the type of monster that won't risk anything.
octgon: A cruel monster that attacks ships crossing the sea. It is feared by sailors.
octon: The Ducken’s movements combined with Octopee's softness, it has evolved into an even stranger monster called Octon.
octKnight: The armor of a knight who once defeated a sea monster has been cursed by the creature and now moves on its own.
nobleSaurian: It is considered to be a status symbol among noble people.
odium: It is said that its spell causes its enemy to be unable to move.
normaya: The most ancient type out of the Maya species. Its temperament is somewhat rough, and shows little affection for attachment. But once it gets used to you, it quickly forgets its wild instincts.
purpleSuezo: Although he may fail your expectations, he's strong.
octomee: An ancient race attempted to give eternal life to this monster. Judging by all those bandages, the experiment must have failed...
obelisk: This monster looks a little ordinary. He has high [[Defense|Def]]..
ogyoIsh: Ogyo-ish lives deeper beneath the sea than any other Ogyo monster. It continues to save up its energy far beneath the sea where no sunshine has ever reached.
offshore: This one likes to sit underwater, moving along with the current. Unfortunately, sometimes fish lay eggs in its hair.
ogreMonsterRancher: It doesn't need a reason to fight - it's a fighter through and through. However, battles that require strategy and careful thinking may be a little difficult for it, perhaps?
odin: It is revered as the 'God of the Spear,' and its ability to wield its weapon as if it were an extension of its own body is the admired by all other Centaurs.
oceanus: Also known as the 'Angel of the Seashore' because of its transparent appearance, there are many who say her tears have saved them from trouble, so it apparently has a large fan club.
nobleWitch: Amongst the [[Witch]]es, the most outstanding are called the Noble Witches. It seems that its enemies are overwhelmed by its noble aura.
nyaruda: Exceptionally good at singing and dancing, she's everyone's cheerful, energetic idol. Nyaruda actually loves sleeping, and when nobody can see her, she's always fast asleep - but she's scary when she first wakes up.
opmocchi: Why is OPMocchi the most stylish Mocchi on his block? Easy! He gets his lifestyle tips from the greatest magazine around: Official U.S. PlayStation Magazine!
paperDragon: 1000 pieces of Origami made by a ill boy, combined into one and turned into a dragon. According to the legend, the boy's illness has since cured.
panthy: Wearing today's most stylin' outfit, Panthy is known among young Breeders for its charisma.
pansy: A fairy with a sad past in which it lost everything. It stopped smiling, and its eyes became red from crying for so long.
owlbeard: The Owlbeard, with eyes full of sorrow and a heart that shuns fighting. Its cry is even sometimes called the 'Symbol of Peace.'
pandibaku: A legendary monster that lives deep in the mountains. Despite its big body, it's pretty gentle. It likes to eat a plant called 'sasa.'
peachTreeBug: It is cute, but you should know that it is a bit too noisy.
panquiche: Its thick eyebrows prove it has a strong sense of justice. It hates wrong-doing. Come on and give it your best shot! It'll greet you with its spiky drill.
owlden: This monster is rumored to be a transformed magic-school teacher from a magic country. If anybody finds out, it'll have to go back, so don't ask it about it.
tanmarin: I've no idea what it is thinking, but it does have cute eyes. Careful, if you let your guard down near it, you're liable to get poked!
osakaKnight: Since the day it awoke to the ways of chivalry, it's devoted itself to being the best knight ever. Its only worry is that it sinks in water because of its armor.
omega: From an ancient race, he can change like a shapeshifter.
purpleJell: He has a very short memory. Can't remember a thing.
pantheon: A mysterious monster believed to have perished in ancient times. It has recently been confirmed to exist again, but what happened during its period of absence is unknown to anyone.
orchestron: A possessed trumpet used by a famous trumpeter is said to have turned into a monster. By combining with various musical instruments, it is able to perform as an orchestra.
peachdillo: Its yellow beak is a sign of how much it can talk. Unlike most taciturn Madillos, it's a real chatterbox. The shell on its back is actually soft and sticky, they say.
oscerot: This monster keeps a collection of oil pot in his house.
paradocken: Its poisonous-looking colors made people think it was a toy-like assassination weapon, but it was simply just made in poor taste.
suezoMask: Once his mask is on, he's cursed for life. Careful!
ombren: The Gali cast away its evil heart through intense training, but when only its dark aspects take physical form, it becomes the Garinokage.
ornamenger: A Henger who often only appears at the beginning of the year, making it a very auspicious monster. Its body is decorated in various places with designs that are said to bring good fortune.
pain: A Hare that fell into [[Joker]]'s trap and was consumed by the power of [[Element|darkness]]! The cheerful Hare it once was is gone, and now it exists only to bring destruction.
palasaulo: What looks like a long horn is actually a nose, which allows it to breathe underwater. It is the champion of the swimming contest each year.
pashminer: Pashminer is so proud of its gorgeous muffler. It fancies itself to be quite stylish, but no one else really thinks so.
parasaur: Because it swims at high speed through the water and catches all the fish, fishermen fear it. It's nicknamed 'Sea Storm.'
orionMonsterRancher: Look into his eye and you can see the whole universe.
ootan: This monster was raised in the forest as a wolf. It howls at the full moon with its big mouth. Isn't that a little annoying?
panchoIsh: Pancho was fused together with a giant monster pumpkin, but that pumpkin rotted and turned blue, which really isn't all that bad.
osiris: Among the types of Gali, this one gives off a particularly quiet and serene aura. In desert regions, it is highly respected by people and considered a god who presides over death and rebirth.
pipoApe: An odd monkey that wandered here from a distant land. Will a monster like this really take its training seriously...?
pinkEye: Used to be able to fly with his wings, but he can't anymore.
pinkHopper: It is a combined monster from two other popular monsters, but it is not popular.
pirateApe: An odd monkey that wandered here from a distant land. It has confidence in its ability to run away. It dresses like a pirate, but some say it's just for show.
pinkPrincess: After a long sleep on the ocean bottom, the Pink Princess is now enraptured by everything she sees.
rhinocerous: A monster clad in armor extravagantly adorned with jewels. It is said to have once been a flamboyant nobleman’s treasured possession.
pirahnikoro: The Pirahnikoro looks like the legendary Tsuchinoko creature. It was once really popular, but not so much anymore. If you really look at it, it's kind of cute...
peachrin: The PeachRin smells so good you just want to grab it. It's a really good singer, too. Lavishing smiles on everyone is its greatest pleasure.
peacocken: Priding itself on its beautiful feathers and its aesthetic sense, it's a monster fashion leader. Too many people hunted it for its feathers and few remain.
pedrolino: It's said that there resides a soul of a performer inside this flexible body. But whether it can actually do this or not depends on whether it feels like it or not.
phantomMonsterRancher: It never shows itself on the forefront, always protecting the peace from behind the scenes. The lonely hero, its true form is still a mystery.
pict: With its red mane and large feet, it is very cute. Among the Garu, it is especially hardworking, and can even build a large house in just one night!
pillard: Pillard is a legendary monster admired by carpenters the world over for its leadership skills. Every day there are many people requesting to be its apprentice.
pitan: There are no surprises here, a scheming character that keeps its intentions in the dark. Its sharp-edged wings are weapons to be wary of.
piekan: It is believed to be a toy for girls from an ancient civilization, but whether it was actually popular is uncertain.
piroco: Monster battles aren't the only things that make people happy. Falco's peace-loving heart changed into an interesting monster shape and appeared as this.
pierry: This monster is used to gather lumps of ice in high mountains.
pithecan: There is a scholar who says that humans are descended from this monster.
pitbocor: A sinister monster that revives the dead and freely controls them. It is said that it uses the monsters it has revived to attack people.
pinkKato: This monster likes its own cherry blossom-colored body.
pinkZilla: It has a beautiful white body, and strong confidence.
petitKnight: It is the most popular doll and is often out of stock.
pebbly: This Golem doll is made of stone and is too heavy for children.
pieripper: A thug of the sea, a pirate monster that worked under [[Captain Zakk]]. It's very good at combat in unstable places. If it successfully becomes attached to you, it will soon listen to your orders.
piroroIsh: Piroro often performs comedy acts to entertain guests, putting on various silly outfits to make them laugh. What do you think of today's costume?
phoenixIsh: This Phoenix lost its life-giving flames, resulting in this oddly colored skin. Even without flames, it is still quite wise.
persim: As its name suggests, Persim absolutely loves dried [[persimmon]]s. When asked whether it would choose dried persimmons or [[Walnut|walnuts]], it spent an entire day agonizing over the decision.
peligoon: This cool Pelican is proud of how its beak can hold anything. Will it come to hold your heart, too?
phowou: This monster will one day be legendary. It has a strong sense of fairness, and in that red body a heart burns with the flame of justice.
petraden: If you want to know this monster's history, just ask. It isn't called a living fossil just for show it really has lived through an eternity.
pixel: Perhaps best known as one of the smartest monsters.
player: He is a regular sports fanatic who especially likes baseball.
pooch: Pooch looks like your average dog at first glance, but is said to be very smart, and can even talk. It's actually a very sensitive dog that loves to travel on its own.
poseidon: Like the mythical Greek god, he rules the water.
platinum: A monster who can sing and dance well. Great rhythm.
psirow: This strong, patterned monster carries the pride of all past generations on his shoulders. That's why the Psirow feels he just has to win!
poddog: A battle machine created ages ago. To be compatible with humans, it was loaded with a prototype emotions AI, but apparently it doesn't work very well.
planekken: This mystery monster is said to have been bathed in starlight for 1,000 years. Its secrets have yet to be revealed.
princesskoro: The PrincessKoro and Koroball are rivals. So far the record stands at 2-2. The PrincessKoro won the
protoant: A rare, Antlan-type robot weapon created by long-ago scientists. Thanks to the huge radar on its forehead, it has amazing control over its attacks.
silhouette: Covered with a unique, highly-protective shield.
poison: They say it is hysterical. But the truth is unknown.
pixieIsh: Pixie-ish pretends to be a Pixie, does bad things, and blames them all on Pixie. It's really just for attention.
piyoken: Though Piyoken looks like a chick, its strength is that of an adult, or even beyond. However, it still waddles around like a baby, no matter how much time passes.
psiken: Psiken is said to have been given the ability to operate underwater as well, but it seems to dislike water.
pongPong: This one is a meat lover and a glutton.
proto: An example of how monsters are not merely 'robots.'
protoZero: This prototype was the original design for the Hengar. Its destructive power and intelligence are quite amazing for a Hengar type, but it wasn't mass produced due to violent streaks.
prius: A state-of-the-art Henger made using all of the ancient technology. It is kind to children and to the environment; A dream Henger.
plagueJoker: Its scythe looks like a big claw and actually has a very sharp point. If you are intrigued by its unbalanced look, you will get in trouble.
princeHare: He's a monster who is most popular among noble people.
poleMock: It stands in dark places and eats bugs that were lured.
planet: This is a very rare type of monster. He's celestial.
piyopi: This Octopee was born from a hard-shelled egg. It continues to switch shells as it grows, much like a hermit crab.
prepee: Its dignified bearing and refined features make it look well-bred. When it strolls through town with its magnificent ears flowing in the breeze, everyone turns to look!
plantIsh: Plant-ish was born in the far north, where ice, snow, and blizzards are plentiful. People say this monster reminds them of [[diamond]] dust.
pressure: It cannot float on the water like Zilla. It is too heavy.
priest: During the [[The Final War|ancient war]], it was this Priest who stood against the rampaging [[Gobi]]s. It placed itself in harm’s way, becoming a shield to protect the people.
pumpkimochi: Some people say PumpkiMochi is just a regular Mocchi wearing a costume. There's definitely something suspicious about how hard it denies it... (Just kidding.)
punisher: It is said that it was actually raised by another monster.
rabicho: Its soft and springy afro smells like sweet chocolate. Some people train it as a guard dog because of its ability to quickly sense odd situations and hear things thanks to its Hare ancestry.
pumpkiduck: All Duckens love pumpkins. They say this monster looks like this because it ate so many of them. Lately it's been worried about getting eaten by other Duckens...
puppykoro: When you feed the PuppyKoro, you'd better bring them extra food, because all three of them are real gluttons. Don't let them get hungry!
pumpkiplant: It has a scary face, but it only looks scary. Actually, it's just a big coward. If you surprise it, it cries and runs away, so you've got to sneak up on it.
rabbirin: A very popular monster, with its soft hat and squishy body. It takes to people easily so [[Breeder|breeders]] love it. Now all it has to do is put up some effort in the arena.
queenroller: The 'Queen of the Highway,' many a breeder has been captivated by its elegance and smooth ride. It even has quite a few fan clubs!
putaranoden: It used to have big wings but its constant training made them shrink. Repeated punching made its hands big, too. But it still has sharp talons at its elbows...
ragerock: It holds amazing [[Power|strength]] within its shockingly small body. Lifting anything is a piece of cake.
quintie: The feelings Quintie has for its horns are intense; if the angles don't look just right, it doesn’t have the will to do anything all day.
puck: It is a little closer to the gods than other Garu breeds, but it remains just as mischievous as ever. If it keeps playing pranks, it’s going to get scolded!
radial: A difficult monster to breed. Has high [[Speed]].
quellepre: It is said to be a prehistoric monster that survived deep in the [[Tapota Jungle]]. Whether it is true or not remains a mystery to this day.
quailken: It was given this name because it looks just like an egg, but it is rumored to be a messenger from the gods. However, there is absolutely no sign of that.
purpleMask: He has a mouth with tusks on his mask that never opens.
purpleHare: He's supposed to be low in [[Intelligence]] and high in [[Power]].
purpleWormMonsterRancher: All the kids seem to be afraid of this guy.
pururu: A flexible body with wavy moves. As well as a fondness to please spectators with its performances. Its popularity among breeders is understandable. A monster to be raised at least once.
radialNiton: It is said that there was a play titled '<nowiki/>''Cars''' in the ancient era.
rabbiroller: One day, a snow rabbit found a roller, sat on it, and found it could not let go. This is how the Rabbiroller was born.
raggaePlant: This monster loves a certain kind of music very much.
pulcinella: It will do anything for the sake of performance, and so decided to possess the tools used in the performance. But is it righteous to use the tools as its weapons and shields during combat?
ra: Because the blood of opposing elemental monsters was mixed together, it has come to possess a dual nature of kindness and cruelty. A type of god, believed to travel the [[Land of Chaos|world of the dead]].
redShortsApe: An odd monkey that wandered here from a distant land. It has a frightening glare, but we hope it's really a good monster deep down...
rayZan: The Ray lives in a land of ice. It has a gentle spirit, but once the battle begins, it gets an expression on its face that sends chills down its opponent's spine.
rinkaZan: The Rinka's slender body is made with a special kind of glass. The wind makes a noise as it passes over this body so this monster is also often called 'Rinkabell.'
raiducken: Extremely popular with kids, the Raiducken is a slightly surreal superstar. Not only does it have a brightly-colored body, but it's also a true martial artist!
ramuna: With a single jump, the Ramuna sets off a whirlwind that tears everything around it to pieces. Be careful when you go near it!
rhinorhine: Despite the way it looks, this monster is the fastest Antlan, but it's not very good at using its brakes and crashes into things to stop. That's why it's banged up.
reaper: It was created by Joker, but it even hates him.
rhinotank: Living on the prairie, it rolls along and can cover over 600 miles a day. Every summer, it has a speed race with the Rhinoroller. Which will win this year?
razwel: It was created to protect the [[Paradise of Monsters|Garden of Angels]]. Its fragrance is said to bring about death...
rearEyed: It has the third eye in the back of its head.
reflector: Its technique reflects back any attack; the secret is to evade and then counter! Even if you know it’s coming, it cannot be stopped.
redWorm: Although his wings don't let him fly, he can jump.
redcapMonsterRancher: A monster that lives in abandoned or crumbling houses and plays pranks on people. It is said to always appear and roam around wherever battles or conflicts occur.
rhigitan: Though small, it carries itself with confidence and dignity, and is said to have the potential to become something great in the future. It’s hoped that it won’t turn into a [[:Category:Baddies|baddie]].
requiem: A messenger from hell, dressed in a black cloak. But once, he was a radiant, shining angel. His white wings are proof of that.
retsu: Impressed by the lifestyle of a crayfish, it tries every day to live like one. This is why it is so good at fighting underwater.
remus: This monster was recently discovered in the jungle. Its fur acts as camouflage, which is why no one could find it before.
rayrin: A fairy from the land of [[Chuka]]. Despite the pale face, it's very healthy. It loves to take naps, but don't spoil it too much.
redEye: This guy likes to stay out late instead of sleeping.
raipenpenn: It has a rather indistinct face, but this monster can't. be tricked. Called
rapper: Its best quality is that it always looks on the bright side. No matter how tough the battle, it says, 'I can do it!' and somehow manages to overcome it. What an amazing little guy!
rhinogigas: It hides itself deep within the jungle. Despite its large size, it is surprisingly skilled at hiding, making it quite difficult to find!
redshell: It is difficult to move its joints because of its shell.
rimuru: Because it has a round, wobbly body, it is affectionately known as 'Slime' in the [[IMa]] Region. Its original good, such as [[manju]] (sweet buns) are extremely popular.
rygaroller: Searching for a certain princess in a faraway land, it somehow found itself in this world. Sometimes it stands looking out to sea, remembering that princess...
ryulon: The two beautiful horns tell us this is the King of Tigers. Unlike the others, they live in packs and take care of their families.
rockyFur: A close friend of [[Scaler]] that has good [[defense]] and poor [[speed]].
rollbeat: A monster that loves being in the sea, it moves quickly through the water. Its pink body color washes off the minute it touches water. It looks happiest when eating.
tecnoDragon: A robot monster and one of the hardest to obtain.
roseocobra: The Roseo Cobra usually has soft, velvety skin, but the dry area it lives in makes it rough. That's why this monster spends the whole day just caring for its skin.
ryoku: This nice monster traded in some of its battle power for its soft, velvety skin. The biggest drawback is that now it sometimes can't tear itself away from the mirror.
rocknroller: Despite its hefty-looking appearance, it's got a lightning-fast spin. With its rhythm and impressive running speed, they call it the 'Speed Race King.'
rugaru: Also known as the cursed Garu. Those who wear its fur lose their sanity and go on a rampage!
rockApe: Won't move for hours at a time, just like a stone statue.
rubyKnight: It is said that it was the armor for the ancient royal guard.
ruinSector: The armor of Ruin Sector, also known as 'Neck Slicer,' was possessed by the soul of a monster. We still don't know what happened to Ruin.
roborabi: A monster that looks like a combat type robot, although it is actually a robot type pet. It is understood why it behaves rather cute despite its looks.
rockWorm: This one dwells between the rocks. He can't see well.
rockSaurian: It can move quicker than its looks, but it is not very smart.
rockHound: One his heavy body lies on you, you'll be pinned.
rockyMonsterRancher: Named because he disguises himself to look like a rock.
roro: The thing Roro carries that looks like a walnut is actually the seed of a giant [[plum]]! Did Roro eat the whole plum by itself?
romperWall: This monster has high [[Intelligence|Int]]. and is a kind soul to breed.
ryozan: Sometimes, this monster starts hibernating before the winter comes, which is why many Breeders have given up on this monster.
rockPlant: You need a good cleanser for scrubbing this guy down.
saboran: A famous story describes how a Plant fell in love with a desert Chickchick and had a [[CobraLord|Lord]] change it into a Cactaran. If it sees a Chickchick, the flowers turn red.
rudolphus: A Dino species from colder regions that has undergone a unique evolution to give it thick, fluffy fur. It eats food found in the snow, and has acquired large antlers.
scalie: Some ornaments are made out of its green scales.
santa: His small body allows him to fit down your chimney.
scribble: The markings all over hia body were in fact a punishment.
saga: It appears out of the darkness and vanishes again without a sound. Many die before they even realize its presence. The Saga, a silent assassin.
scarabio: The Scarapio's favorite food is the sweet nectar of flowers. Because it readily follows anybody that'll give it nectar, it often goes missing. Breeders beware!
samurairin: Some people think it left its hometown just so it could come back in triumph. It really should stop saying, 'Don't wanna!' to everything...
scales: Despite his appearance, he's vulnerable to attacks.
scaledJell: Its gelled sections are harder than its scaled sections.
sam: Resembling the American flag, this patriotic guy is tough.
samson: Samson, a [[power]]-loving fighter, enters battle today with its proud super strength. If only it were just a little bit smarter...
scissors: The scissor-shaped horns on its head cut anything. If it abuses the horns, they fall off, but that is okay because they'll grow back quickly.
scorpi: This savage monster has poison at the tip of its horn. However, about 10 of them die each year due to their own poison, which is kind of silly...
scaledMask: Its mask is covered with scales like [[Dino]] and [[Zuum]].
scaledHare: Its ability to jump is better than that of other Hares.
seaBishop: A priest who vanished into the sea during a storm is said to have become a Sea Bishop, but no longer retains a human heart.
sandLessie: This monster was thought of as royal and noble since it used to carry the King on its back. You can see this in the insignia on its forehead.
scaledWorm: It hides its legs and uses them only for quick movement.
satanClause: A festival doll became possessed and then became this monster.
sandSaurian: Most monsters dislike the desert, but this one does not.
scarClaw: When it hides among the grass, its appearance becomes a perfect camouflage, making it nearly impossible to notice. Patiently lying in wait for prey, it bursts out with breathtaking speed to capture its target.
salome: The red eyes that dance in the dark forests are scary indeed. It slowly creeps up on its enemies, and its attacking capabilities are known for their deadliness.
seaguile: Born in a region surrounded by sea, it has evolved to survive in both air and water. Its evolutionary effort is something of an amazement to scientists.
sandy: An abrasive skin makes him unsuitable for petting.
scaler: A close friend of [[Stoner]] that has good [[Speed]] and poor [[Defense]].
scaledPlant: Its green body is luminous at night, so many people have it.
sandGolem: It will not forgive anyone who breaks its quiet living.
santy: This doll might be based on either the designer or the [[IMa]] president.
sakuraFrog: Despite its appearance, it's surprisingly agile, dancing like a shower of cherry blossoms to defeat its foes. In foreign competitions, it is known as 'The Marketplace of [[:Category:Techniques|Techniques]]' because of its vast repertoire of moves.
shin: The side of its arms is shaped like a huge blade. It probably uses this to push the tall jungle grass aside as it walks.
sharly: The Sharlie, the gentlest of all Lesiones. It loves to take afternoon naps more than anything else. (The thing it loves second best is eating.)
shellincho: It lives in the sea where the currents are calm. It is said that this monster was born from the teardrops of a [[mermaid]]. How poetic!
shidao: The Shidao can read the wind and predict the weather and earthquakes, but it never shares its knowledge. Try touching its nose. If it's wet, it'll rain tomorrow!
shadowMage: The Shadow Mage is a model of righteous thought, and highly-skilled at the magic arts, but its severe techniques strike fear in the hearts of others.
shades: He's thought to be born of human ancestry.
shishi: It is said that anyone bitten by it will be lucky for a year.
shel: His shell keeps people off his back. His belly is vulnerable.
shimurug: This Dragon is said to be the guardian god of this region. It is strong against the cold with its thick fur, and its breath is a special flame called 'Ice Breath.'
searcher: A tracking machine made to discover any intruders. Once it sets it’s sights on something, there’s no point in running.
selvan: It is said that the soul of a legendary swordsman resides within it, and its swordsmanship is truly exceptional!
shogunMonsterRancher: This armor was discovered in an [[Eastern Continent|eastern]] country.
shearsman: It is said to lurk within a cursed castle and slash everything to pieces. Where the lord of that castle disappeared to remains a mystery to this day.
shiisa: It's considered to be a Protector in some parts of the Southern countries. But it is too easily attached, hates to be on its own, and is a little fidgety.
seapea: Very gentle and kind, it's an ideal playmate for children. When it is in a good mood, it will show you some tricks.
setsuna: Its golden body is a symbol of royalty. With a single swift move, it can deliver a fatal blow to its enemies.
shellSaurian: Various Knights rode on its back and fight in the ancient era.
seniorin: If you are ever lost in the desert, try calling for Seniorin! Though it can't help you, it will make you forget about everything with its funky dance.
shironcho: Don't speak too loud when you see a Shironcho. It will go inside its shell and never come out.
shalltear: Characterized by her long silver hair and dark dress, she is a beautiful member of the Illumine species. She excels at both hand-to-hand combat and magic, and is deadly with a spear. Contrary to her lovely appearance, she has a cruel personality.
shiranui: Pixies who evolved uniquely on the [[Eastern Continent]]. They are talented monsters that wield first-class magic and martial arts skills.
ayaZan: She was created as a female version of the original Zan, but the process didn't go very well. (Her looks were the problem.) They finally settled on this version.
shyanne: The strongest of its tribe, Shyanne travels the world in search of its lost partner. The word 'strongest' really applies to entertainment but it can hold its own in battle.
skipper: It will move seductively when someone touches its horn.
skeleplant: The Corpse Weed grows by sucking negative emotions out of people. Its pollen is a powerful poison. Not even a [[Dragon]] can breathe in this pollen and live.
skunkroller: This monster is the one that keeps the group together. If an argument crops up, it solves things right away. A dependable, leader type with lots of followers.
shogunMogi: Depend on it to guard the peace of the [[House of Treasure|capital]]. It plans on taking classes on the ancient art of {{wk|wikipedia|Onmyodo}} soon. It just might be able to use it someday.
skeletant: An Antlan that was revived after its power ran out before achieving its goal. Even dead, it won’t stop. A sad hero...
sieger: If the Sieger dives into the ocean, it’ll catch a fish bigger than it’s own body!
sniper: This monster is feared as the dominator of the Mandy Desert.
slothBeetle: It resides in a high mountain region, that is covered in snow.
sketch: An enemy of Doodle who is constantly at odds with him.
slash: This lizard has soft skin and razor-like claws.
smiley: Appears lazy, but that is an act. It really has ability.
skullCapped: It is scheming but not enough smart to deceive someone.
sneakHopper: It is very self centered and it has a cunning character.
snowHopper: Snowboarding was created by copying the way this monster skis.
skeletonMonsterRancher: Its design is a reminder that death is always with us.
skullwave: This monster is said to bear the soul of the legendary pirate Edgar. However, no one knows anything about this Edgar, so....
sirenMonsterRancher: It has the ability to not only manipulate water but also wind.
smartie: It cracks nuts passed to it from [[Momo]] and makes very delicious cakes, which it shares with everyone. However, its true goal is to give everyone tooth decay!
skullGold: The strongest of all Jokers who wields a golden scythe. Its brilliance increases every time it drinks blood.
sleeves: Another one who is very fashion-aware. Keep him thin.
silverPiroro: It is said that the Silver Piroro has once been defeated by the Gold Piroro, even though it is well-known for being a monster genius in the art of performance.
silverSuezo: This is also rare, for its body is the color silver.
sky: His striking body pattern keeps him from going unseen.
shrub: His body glows a green light at night. He loves insects.
sleepyhead: It spends most of its time in one place and hardly moves.
snegurochka: A monster nicknamed the 'Granddaughter of Ice.' It possesses strong [[loyalty]] and high [[intelligence]]. Its skillful manipulation of trees and its bravery in overpowering enemies are a testament to its power.
sodacchi: Some say it has Rhinoroller blood so it can move really fast, but few people have actually witnessed this. Apparently it doesn't expend energy unless it has to.
suekiSuezo: It is a man made monster, and its form is based on Suezo.
whiteHound: This monster has pure white hair and much is made of it.
suecho: Due to its upbringing, it is kind of spoiled. If it doesn't get its way, it throws a fit. Its butler always looks dumbfounded.
spyHare: Nobody has ever been able to find out much about it. It's usually looking around like it's nervous. Maybe it's backed by some kind of shady organization?
sorcero: Unusual for the Chuparo breed, it's a nihilistic outlaw wearing a cloak. Since it's dressed all in black, it's weaker in strong sunlight.
sueko: This monster cares only for the way she looks.
stripe: Because of his stripe pattern, he's considered fashionable.
stitch: It has a black-and-white striped body. If you stare at it for too long, your vision starts to spin as if you've been hypnotized.
spot: A keen sense of hearing enables him to dodge attacks.
sraosha: A monster with beautiful wings on its flexible body. It is called
springer: Its body shows a soft luster because of its Metalner blood.
spiritKnight: Spirit Knight is the knight of all knights. The shining helmet is a symbol of this. It cleans it every day.
soulReaperMonsterRancher: He is a terrifying guy who believes that taking his opponent’s life is his mission, and carries it out properly.
spearmint: The twisty thing on its head is not hair, but a shell. It is so fashionable that it goes underwater to put on these stylish things.
strawberry: Strawberry is a friendly and spoiled baby. Popular as a pet, its favorite food is the [[Strawberry (Item)|strawberry]], as you might have guessed.
suealien: There are rumors that SueAlien is not a creature of this planet. It is an agent of justice, although it lacks stamina.
stripeShell: This monster is very patient when fighting.
soboros: His bulging eyes can search well, but they are weak.
striker: His sharp white claws make him dangerous. Easy to breed.
stoneface: A cute monster that lives inside a scary-looking rock. But it too is covered in rock, so no underestimations.
strongHorn: Though it has a large horn, it hardly uses it in battle.
spooky: When a ghostly soul possessed a scarecrow, it is said that Spooky was born. It has a cheerful personality, and apparently has recently gotten into roulette.
tanklon2: A fearsome monster with a bomb onboard. Dreamed up by a mad scientist who pressed the button for detonation just before he died, but it still hasn't blown up yet.
tatoonJ: A billionaire spent lots of money to create this battle monster. Its flame tattoo symbolizes its furious fighting style.
tetra: Long-ago people admired the Koropendora's teamwork and created the Tetra. We didn't know the Koropendora had been around so long until this Tetra was rediscovered.
suzuricho: Always fascinated by bells, this monster finally turned into a bell itself. Often happy, sometimes sad, the beautiful sound washes away the heart's impurities.
surfana: The Surfana just loves the ocean. You can often see it surfing in {{wk|wikipedia|California}} or {{wk|wikipedia|Hawaii}}. It says its goal this year is to visit {{wk|wikipedia|Australia}}.
sumopion: It is strange looking, but it does practice hard every day.
switch: This monster looks like a witch, though it has a large spoon instead of a cane. More dedicated to sweets research than magic, it's sometimes called a 'Sweets Witch.'
sun: Its golden body is inhabited by the power of the sun. Its brightness is so intense that it even dazzles itself.
sunsetGali: This Gali, captivated by the sinking sunset, had its heart stolen by the moment. In order never to forget that feeling, it had it engraved into its very body.
tender: A Henger created with the hopes that it wouldn't fight. As if that wish was understood, it started to love the forest and nature instead.
suntham: Suntham loves to swim. Its body isn't red because of Octopee's bloodline — instead, it's because it spends all day at the beach and gets sunburned.
teemaya: A hunter monster who is said to have eagle eyes with a night vision of a cat. Prey once targeted by it is ensure a slim chance of survival.
taintedCat: It rejects everything in this world and lives alone.
tank: His fancy clothes have long been a fashion trend.
tasman: This monster believes only in brute strength.
suezoIsh: Unlike other Suezo types, it's hard to to figure out where the eyeball is actually located on this one. Don't ask about that, or it'll get mad.
tanuzo: It loves nuts and berries, and can run away quickly. Unlike other Suezos, this one is well-behaved.
swimmer: Training in the water will make the entire body toned up.
talos: Talos is said to faithfully obey its master’s commands and protect a [[Shidira Rama|certain island]]. It is incredibly strong, but strangely enough, its only weakness is its heel.
technoDino: Despite having a mechanical body, this species of Dino loves to remain active. But apparently, they sometimes get so engrossed that parts of their bodies pop out.
therian: Therian is mischievous and cub-like, and perhaps because it is mixed with [[Tiger]], it is very loyal to its master. Those two monsters don't get along at all, so be careful when raising them together.
sweetPiroro: To think I'd meet a monster like this...how unfortunate I am, that no matter how many [[Mystery Disc|Disc Stone]]s I revive from now on, I'll never encounter a monster better than this one!...So sweet!
titan: This mammoth monster loves to eat anything and everything.
tihon: This icy Lamour is unsurpassed in pride. Characterized by napping as soon as it gets tired, it's one of the best healing monsters.
traffikoro: Usually, Color Pandora are just green. But if you put ketchup and mustard on its [[Saucer Stone]] and bake it, you get this monster. Nobody knew about this nifty trick!
triGai: Combining DNA, the PSM staff hoped to form a super-being to produce an entire issue unaided, as they played mini golf and drove go-carts. The experiment went really bad.
trickster: It likes to play with its opponents, and eventually they realize they are moving at the Trickster’s pace. The birth of an unusual but cool hero!
tomcat: It closes in with super speed and knocks out its opponent with a storm of punches! It holds the name 'Shootout King.'
tropicalApe: He will emit a potent and intoxicating scent to foes.
trojan: It has stone-like, hard skin and a stubborn character.
tram: This monster is covered by a house-like pattern.
ticken: It is said that it contains the secret of the lost technology.
tokunbokun: It used to have beautiful skin until it got a tan. Now it is so sad it just looks at itself in the water and cries.
torridon: It was sunbathing at the beach in summer, but before it knew it, it had turned completely black. It got a bit too roasted and was pretty shocked about it.
toryo: He is very precise and does not like making mistakes. It attacks disruptive youths with its hammer at first sight.
tombstone: This is a Joker monster with the strength of the Golem species.
tricker: Contrary to its humorous appearance, its nature is rather evil.
tigerIsh: Tiger's blue mane now covers its entire body! Actually, this is the genuine fur color of the Tiger-ish, and many Tiger-type monsters are even said to admire it.
tinkleBell: Little and energetic Tinkle Bell loves cute clothes. If they get even a little dirty, it starts crying.
trident: This monster pulls out all the punches to K.O. opponents.
timeNoise: The secret goal that this one has is to obtain immortality.
tigre: This monster is wild, as its look suggests. Many breeders fear this monster. But you seldom meet these, so don't worry.
tortboy: This is the most relaxed of all Mews, and because of this many want it as a pet. It can move surprisingly fast sometimes, though.
tidalle: When Tidalle swims, it causes tsunamis, so swimming is prohibited wherever it goes!
thorhummer: Its Golden Arm attack splits the earth open and always defeats its enemies. Its one-hit knockout strategy is so tremendous that it needs no explanation!
thrump: The soul of a hardworking person has possessed a clay doll. It gives a harsh punishment to those who don’t take their work seriously!
trickin: This ghostly spirit is influenced by Joker. Skilled at scheming, it seems to enjoy deceiving monsters and humans using various methods.
torozo: A monster rumored to imitate the cute inhabitants of a faraway world. It is said that people have even witnessed it removing its ears and taking a short break, but Torozo refuses to comment on the matter.
vega: Vega is said to have been born when a dragon bathed in the holy light of a galaxy. As it flies across the sky like a shooting star to defeat its foes, people can't help but stare in awe.
valkyrie: This fairy was born to fight. It's friendly, unless you make it upset. The blue eye can see the future while the red eye can see the past.
vesuvius: Its helmet has a curved Dragon figure on it.
versailline: A beautiful female knight, beloved by all, that stands up for those who suffer. She proves that women, too, can fight courageously on the side of justice.
uroboros: The wings of the Uroboros are extremely sharp and have excellent cutting power. Anything nearby won’t get away unscathed!
unico: It is the most earnest monster in the [[Pixie]] species.
truenos: Truenos is extremely jealous. If you pay too much attention to someone else, she’ll grow horns and attack you with her ray!
ultrarl: It is said that this monster is a kind of hero of justice.
vermillion: A fast-moving ninja monster. It’ll start a fight with its burning fist!
trotter: It has an excellent reputation as an excellent runner.
tumudillo: The TumuDillo has the Ripper's speed. If it takes off its shell, it's almost as fast! But moving fast gets it hungry, so it doesn't like to do it much.
valentino: This lovable beast has wings but cannot fly.
vievle: The Vouivre is usually very calm in nature, but once angered, no one can stop it.
ultimate: This monster once ruled over the [[Land of Chaos|dark world]]. It's not in complete form now, as its body has been sealed, but it still has a firm command of the dark arts.
venomous: It loves deceiving people above all else. Its skills are so refined that even those who are tricked can’t help but be impressed.
undertaker: Appearing with a roaring sound, it wipes out everything it can see. To let you sleep peacefully, it'll finish you off in a single strike.
uminaibi: A monster whose mysteries have just been revealed to be the sea god in ancient times. This so-called
urara: A monster covered in smooth fur. Not only is it affectionate, it is very quick at learning tricks. But it is rather a spoilt baby, and tends to ignore people who it does not know.
usazo: A timid prankster, Suezo likes to hide in the snow and scare people. Once, it even accidentally scared itself!
valencie: Its pleasant scent is actually meant to keep enemies away. However, humans love the smell and adore it as a pet.
twoTone: Watch out for this monster and his dual personalities.
tsuboncho: Since they say that a Tsuboncho will grant three wishes to the Breeder that has been nice to it, many Breeders tend spoil their Tsubonchos rotten.
tropimochi: A monster born in the southern lands. With a bright and positive attitude, it is constantly dancing, twisting its jelly like body. But it breaks down in tears sometimes thinking about father.
typhon: It can proudly split any kind of fruit with the powerful flick of its finger. However, it breaks them into such tiny pieces that they aren't even worth eating any more.
tyrant: The wings on its back are too small for it to fly.
veldora: Despite its resemblance to another type of dragon known as the
whiteMocchi: It has changed the color of its skin in order to be conspicuous.
whiteSuezo: It was raised very carefully because of its pure white body.
whiteBirch: It is more resistant to cold than other Mock monsters.
winducken: This creature has no sense of direction, which led to the proverb
undinePixie: A Fairy of water, this is where Windine came from. There are rumors it is going out with [[Jell]]. Kind of a careless monster.
viperMonsterRancher: It always holds its tongue out to cool its body temperature.
wildWestNaga: It wandered in aimlessly from the west. It's really popular with kids, but adults are puzzled by its looks and the odd way it's always saying, 'Oh dear...'
wizring: The Wizring is a really hard worker, so it's always worn out and its clothes are all ragged. But it thinks it doesn't matter what it wears as long as it does its best.
wolfie: The Wolfkin, who hides both wildness and kindness within. Its sharp, dignified expression is said to be irresistible, and its female fanbase is steadily growing!
warBaku: It functioned well as a shield in the ancient battle.
vritraMonsterRancher: It is said to have been born from vengeance and possesses power that can even surpass gods. However, it is deeply loyal, and once it acknowledges someone it will never betray them.
watermelony: On the beach, it is often mistaken for a watermelon.
wakken: Wakkungs knows the rings is fashionable. Although they say it change their patterns itself, no one has seen it in person.
vulcanMonsterRancher: They say this was the champion machine in the Henger fights long ago that made the Ancients go crazy.
whimfly: A model that was created by a machine-lover, into which a monster's soul will occasionally enter. Even though it’s just a toy, this feat is impressive.
wabbit: Wabbit is full of charm and extremely sociable. It even appears regularly as a mascot in children’s programs on [[Age]]!
winglord: Winglord may look frightening at first glance, but is actually a talented warrior, fighting for peace and justice.
wildSaurian: It is an active Zuum-type monster that has become wild.
vivaroller: The sharp fangs are not used to fight, but to clean its rollers. This monster likes to keep things clean and tidy. It lives underwater.
warabi: Its skin is actually covered with sand. Because it carefully keeps itself covered, no one knows the real color of its skin.
wickerman: The Wickerman is devoted to its master and will agree to any command. However, please don’t ask it to do anything too unreasonable.
volcano: A Golem created while burning deep within molten lava. It unleashes devastating eruptions, making it nearly impossible to withstand its assaults.
witch: To brighten up the lively night, they wear special costumes. They invite anyone and everyone, and ask for sweets.
wedding: An Undine dressed in a beautiful dress. Apparently, it longs for a human companion, and it can often be seen studying about housework and manners...
woodie: Woodie was sent here by a super weapon from the distant planet of [[Celfoan]]. It's a fairly timid monster, always worrying about burning itself when breathing fire.
zanzo: The Zanzo travels so fast you can't even see it. All you can see is a big blur! Could that blur that just passed be a Zanzo, perhaps?
yuma: This Lesione-type Henger was built by long-ago people for use on land as well as in the water. Because it was made for searching for things, it rarely gets lost.
zabel: The first person that saw the Zabel was so shocked he locked it away. While the Garu is called the
xtalDragon: It has a beautiful body that sparkles brilliantly. It is said that all of its scales are made of crystal, making their value beyond measure.
zaratan: This creature can swim in the water as if it were flying, and its blue skin is rough like a [[shark]]'s. Don't touch it - you'll hurt your fingers.
yuzuken: The most gentlemanly Ducken of them all. Afternoon tea, complete with a manly 'Self-destruct Attack' are simply the refined tastes of a true gentleman.
zanken: Its wings are actually very sharp blades. However, they don’t seem to be very useful. How unfortunate.
zorjil: It has a high IQ and it often gets lost in its thoughts.
wondar: It always forgets what it is supposed to do.
woodyHopper: It is covered with body hair that looks like bark at glance.
yabbic: A type of Henger designed to work in a factory and not in battle. Its hands were made into scissors for that very purpose.
woodKnight: Poor knights made this armor out of trees in the ancient era.
yamimaya: Also known as a transporter of death who is said to possess seven lives. One glare at the enemies with its glowing eyes could in an instance cripple their lives.
zombieMonsterRancher: A real wiseguy who loves to play dead and scare people.
zillaKing: It was awakened from an ancient sleep by a major earthquake.
xenonIsh: Xenon-ish broke the seal with its own power before the curse was lifted. Due to this, it has emerged as an incomplete Xenon, with bits of the curse still in place.
zanIsh: This monster is said to have been born from an afterimage of Zan moving at a super high speed. Many aspects of its existence are a mystery, and it is highly sought after by breeders.
zebraSaurian: Its striped body is the least conspicuous in [[Papas|savanna region]].
woodSaurian: It is cowardly and runs into the forest when it sees humans.
zeburo: It lives in the wild to entertain the wild monsters. But it used to suffer sudden attacks at times which prompted its body to develop camouflaging capabilities.
yuppee: Yuppees are usually energetic, jumping, running, and rolling. But when they're tired and just standing still, they look just like snowmen.
zaza: While you can often see Zaza having fun, rolling down the sand dunes, no one has ever seen Zaza climbing back up the dunes...
woodGolem: Unlike Mock, it rarely changes the expression on its face.
yokozuna: Only those who have conquered the highest level of the foreign sport earn the title of Yokozuna. Once at the peak of both body and mind, it now appears to have reached the limits of its physical endurance.
yashagami: This fiery and fierce Tiger breed with shining eyes has a strong fighting spirit that allows him to face any opponent.
yabusame: It is said that monsters struck by the demon-repelling arrows wielded by the Yabusame are left with a strange sense of solemnity.
slimeDragonQuest: Gorgeous globs of goo that are loathed as monsters almost as much as they are loved as mascots. Honestly, just look at that cheeky smile...
dracky: Bat-like blighters who grin like nobody's business to hide the fact that they're afraid of pretty much everything.
bossTroll: Grotesque giants that lord their power over all trollkind. Anyone unlucky enough to get knocked down by their clubs is unlikely to ever get back up again.
metalSlime: Mercurial monsters that flee at a moment's notice. Their appearance delights, but their inevitable escape leaves you dreaming of the experience you could've had.
ghostDragonQuest: Spectral so-and-sos who vanish as soon as they're done scaring their victims-usually unsuspecting travellers.
golemDragonQuest: A statue built by human hand, and brought to life in order to stand guard over Cantlin. Tragically, it was tainted with evil, and turned into a monster.
bewarewolf: Although they're strong and like to come out swinging, they're far from stupid. In fact, they're the intellectual pride of the werewolf world.
scarewolf: Werewolves who've figured out how to cast Fizzle, which they use to muffle their enemies' magic before flinging themselves into the fray, fists flying.
tearwolf: Well-respected in the werewolf community, these lupine leaders are said to have been elevated to their position of power by dint of their ability to cast spells-a rare skill among their kind.
prestidigitator: Once earnest students of spell-craft, these weak-willed sorcerers were seduced by the illicit allure of black magic, and are now no longer men.
lunatick: These curious monsters' enormous eyeballs afford them excellent vision, even in absolute darkness. Once they set their sights on their prey, they will not give up until they wrap their tentacles around it.
ravingLunatick: Ticks who've taken on board dangerous levels of darkness. As leaders among their kind, they're also curiously considerate, and as such, are handy with healing spells.
scorpionDragonQuest: The unhappy outcome of spontaneous mutation, these overgrown arachnids use their giant stingers to subjugate their prey.
cosmicChimaera: A chimaera whose form was forever changed by the light of a meteor shower, which also pumped its powers through the roof.
greenDragonDragonQuest: A truly terrifying creature whose claws alone have cut short the careers of countless adventurers. Add fiery breath and a tree trunk of a tail, and you can see why the Dragonlord set one to guard Princess Gwaelin.
blueDragonDragonQuest: Ice-breathing dragons of pre-eminent power. Though rarely forced to fight in earnest, when they do, a single snap of their enormous jaws is usually enough to end the argument.
dreadDragon: The latest in a legendary line of superior serpents. Even the Dragonlord recognizes them as a force to be reckoned with, and counts many of their number among his closest coterie.
skeletonDragonQuest: They spend their days scouring the land for whoever it was that gave them the bonk on the head that cracked their skull and killed them.
armyAntDragonQuest: Army ants are absolutely obsessed with order. If any member of the insectoid infantry should slip out of step with its allies, it will send itself straight to bed without supper
ratscal: Rodent-like monsters who call mountainous regions home. They've survived in the wild for years upon years thanks to their top-class survival instincts.}}
terrordactyl: Flying dragons whose deep blue hue enables them to pursue their prey across sea and sky all but undetected.
