I changed my appearance to impress the girl I like, and it made me even more cheerful. The power of love is amazing!
zebraMantis: A mechanized praying mantis with dazzling vivid black and white patterns. Watch out for the cannon and the flash grenades he fires from it. The black and white paint has a dazzling effect in group battles, but it has not been mass-produced because it is difficult to repaint by hand.
blackMantis: A praying mantis killer that sprays an unpleasant liquid that lowers attack power and poisons you. Under the cover of darkness, it targets travelers. The sharp eyesight that has been acquired through training does not miss the procession of ants that stretches across the pitch-black ground at night. She boasts ultra-high night vision.
greenScissors: An insect that hides in plants and protects itself with armor. With a hidden cannon, it deals great damage. The doctor who developed the cannon was said to have had a great influence on the later Demon weapons industry, and apparently received some sort of award.
hellboundHunter: A blood-stained assassin possessed by the power of darkness. He specializes in putting his opponents to sleep and finishing them off with a Rain of Pain. For some reason, he likes jumping off high places, so on his day offs he travels far away to enjoy bungee jumping.
dirtyDoll: He uses the spell Kafuddle to confuse his enemies and try to make them fight each other. His dirty nature is true to his name. He says that whenever he goes to the beach, people mistake him for a sea urchin because of his appearance and color, which is a problem for him.
phantomFencer: A ragged cape enchanted by powerful magic. Invulnerable to air-based spells.
phantomSwordsman: Acolytes of the Lord of Darkness that gave their own lives in sacrifice. Their flesh is gone, but their faith remains to fuel their hunger for battle.
royalReptile: The Emperor of the Dragon World rules with his overwhelming charisma. The flames he exhales shine like a jewel, captivating others. The first emperor had the ability to nullify attacks just by opening one eye. The Eye of the Dragon is a jewel that reproduces the glow of that eye.
liegeLizard: The majestic king of lizards, with powers rivaling those of a dragon. A magnificent flame spews from his mouth, befitting his royal name. The majestic figure of the Liege Lizard inspires the dreams of lizards. A world for lizards, by lizards!
zaptile: A scary electric frog that stores electricity inside its body. It discharges the stored electricity to create lightning. When the Zaptile is happily bathing in the water, electrocuted fish float up to the surface, so there is no shortage of food.
spikeHead: This is a very dangerous monster that increases its attack power with Oomph and then aims to inflict great damage by lashing out with the spikes on its head. The handles are covered in spikes so at first glance it may look inconvenient, but in fact it can be used like chopsticks, making it surprisingly useful.
faceInvader: A colorful horned monster shaman. He stirs up sand, creates flames and fights like a ritual. Apparently, they perform rituals every night in a secluded cave, summoning spirits with evil hearts...
visorKaiser: A mechanical soldier with a camouflage that melts into the darkness and attacks silently. The edge of darkness summons deep darkness, dazzling travelers and weakening them. A monster that has been magically modified by evil scientists. He vows revenge on the scientists and wanders through the wilderness today as well.
miteyOak: A cute, round-bodied tree spirit that lives in the grasslands. It treasures the red leaf that grows on its head. Everyone is competing to see who can grow the biggest, but it's really like comparing acorns. There's not much difference.
tuftyTot: They perform a cute, fluffy dance and chant Zing. It is said that meeting her brings happiness. The healing plant, Tufty Tot. There is much mystery surrounding its ecology, and one theory is that it is the fluff of a flower that blooms on Yggdrasil.
fluffyFur: A fluffy spirit. Despite its appearance, it is aggressive and casts the explosive spell Bang. It is aggressive and attacks. Judging from his name, one might assume he has some connection to the fluffy creatures, but he was actually born from a Feralbeast's furball. He has a devious personality.
hamShamwitch: A pig monster who wanders the world wearing his favorite hat. He stores flames in his small body and explodes them whenever he gets the chance. A pig that doesn't travel is just a pig. With that, he left the herd. His sombrero, his travel companion, was a symbol of his freedom.
amodeus: A great demon who likes to pretend to be an artist and loves blood and music. He uses various techniques to beautifully color tragedies. Apparently, he composed the heroic "Troll March" in just one night to inspire the Troll army. He has a natural talent for music.
dankBubbleSlime: A negative slime that likes damp places. It places mushroom bombs and makes happy people explode. There was a time when the humid bubble was booming. It has since shriveled up, but it was called the King back then.
evilGanesha: This elephant god was exposed to a large amount of demonic miasma and transformed into a demon. He holds weapons on his six arms and violently slashes at you. He has perfected his skills with each of the weapons he wields in his six arms, and it seems he plans to branch out to include boomerangs and whips in the future.
elephantKing: Originally an elephant monster worshipped as a sacred beast, its ability to use Multiheal is a remnant of its time as a sacred beast. His anger towards the hunters who were targeting the tusks of his fellow elephants built up and turned into a grudge, transforming the sacred beast into a demonic beast.
hellboundHeretic: A dreaded underworld worker colored by darkness and death. In addition to powerful spells, he is also adept at using charm and roars. He once served the Netherlord, but left due to differences in their views on life and death. Now he lives a carefree life as a freelance guardian.
darkPlanet: An unidentified dark star lurks in the darkness of the night. Chants Kazammle to summon even deeper darkness. Dark Planet is feared by adventurers, but for some reason, it is revered by some gamblers as a good luck charm.
marsFace: A burning meteorite fell from the night sky and was given a will of its own. Its facial expression changes rapidly, increasing its attack power and excitement! Even though their strengths and living places are completely different, for some reason they seem to feel an attachment to Octopot.
redBaron: An archdemon of noble blood who pledges absolute loyalty to the Demon King. He weakens his enemies with mysterious light and casts vicious spells. The Red Baron is a noble demon with a long history spanning thousands of years. He turns the death throes of humans into music and revels in the sweet wine of chaos.
polkaDotDragon: A polka-dot frog dragon said to live in thunderclouds. It displays its majesty to travelers by wearing a Blessed Breath. Grandma said that if the Water Ball Dragon clicks its earrings three times, it will rain.
tundragster: A pure white dragon sprints across the snowy plains in search of prey. Its glittering breath freezes everything in its path. Because no one has ever seen it, when a disaster occurs in the snowy plains, people shout that the dragon has appeared and fear it.
yellowSickle: A ferocious praying mantis that was transformed into a killing machine by a monster. Suddenly, it fires off a flashbang, blinding you. It has a protective color that makes it easy to get confused on sandy beaches and deserts, but the sound of its body rattling makes it easy to find.
rainbowScissor: An insect with a colorful body equipped with flash grenades and cannons. It is also equipped with an anger radar and locks on to enemies that react. Due to his brightly colored appearance and proud behavior, he is feared and known as the Rainbow Emperor.
blueMink: A small, supple magical beast covered in blue fur. It uses Deceleratle to lower its enemy's speed and attack cautiously. He has a heroic tale of once crossing the ocean, landing on Cat Island in the Wena Islands, plucking out the whiskers of a giant cat tribe, and surviving.
snailyTail: A demonic beast with a gigantic tail that curls up like a snail. If you get lured in by its Sultry Dance, it'll bite you with a painful blow! When startled, it hides inside its tail, resembling a snail, hence the name Snaily.
needleman: A spiky doll that wanders around in search of prey. It is said that its small size will stalk anyone who lets their guard down. At first it had no thorns, but in order to survive, it grew cactus thorns onto its body and uses them for attack and defense.
needleRabbit: This troublesome rabbit has a thorny constitution that shoots out when startled. If you approach it carelessly, you will be stung, but this does not necessarily mean that it is hostile. He is so timid and shy that he runs away if you make eye contact with him. He also quickly hides in the shadows, so it is apparently quite difficult to encounter him.
hellboundHairRaiser: Although he appears to be an attention seeker, dyed all yellow, he is actually a skilled practitioner of both flashy techniques and understated tactics. I'm the lead vocalist for the legendary monster band "Lightning Death." You'll be blown away by my voice!
lumberingLizard: An ancient dragon with a tree growing on its back. If it is injured during a battle, it eats the leaves to recover. A long time ago, a nut dropped by a bird among the scales on its back sprouted and eventually grew into a magnificent tree. It is truly a miracle of nature!
masqueraider: A deformed soldier wearing shell-like armor. It can defend against physical attacks to a certain extent using special guard techniques. The two giant horns he holds belong to a dragon that lives in a distant valley, and retrieving them is a rite of passage for the clan.
metalTruffleSlime: A mysterious mushroom has sprouted from the body of that Metal Slime! It quickly escapes, scattering spores. The mushrooms growing on its body are said to be one of Astoltia's three great delicacies, but apparently they're just rare and don't taste that great.
mouldySlime: A grudge has taken up residence in the discarded rice bran and begun to move. It chants Kafuddle to soak your thoughts in rice bran. Long ago, my grandmother used to make this wonderful rice bran. Even now that it has rotted, I still remember her.
frighteningConductor: An unfortunate musician who died without being recognized by society has turned into a Demon who tries to control those who listen to his mysterious music. In reaction to his unfortunate life, he turned to death metal after his death. With his new song "Dormageddon" in hand, he is aiming for his major debut!
hellSSteward: A demon who is loyal to the Demon King and takes care of him. He is skilled at Zing and shows great consideration. A capable butler who manages the Demon King's schedule and health. Recently, he's also been working part-time as a waiter at a cafe.
hippoGuard: A dynamic hippo knight who constantly uses Feel the Burn to boost his strength, he is highly regarded by his comrades. He is a knight of the Hippo tribe and is highly regarded, but he feels self-conscious about his short legs. He is considering getting secret boots.
hippoSoldier: A brave hippopotamus warrior who is skilled at splitting helmets. When he gets angry, he uses Feel the Burn, which can be quite troublesome. It seems that a Rhinoceraxe is trying to challenge us, Hippo. Hippoppo. I'll show him that he's not on the same level as me, Tamas!
naumannborg: A monster with six arms that brings about many disasters. It also has a stoic side, able to heal itself through Meditation. He is a handsome, domesticated elephant whose hobby is cooking. He can make delicious dishes three times faster than normal.
evilSorcerer: An elite demon who has mastered sorcery. A formidable foe who can cause Kazam to go berserk and revive allies with Kazing. He has a personality that makes him like to act in everything he does, and is bound by countless rules, like the order in which he puts on his shoes in the morning, or where he starts washing in the bath.
priestKnight: A dark knight who serves the evil god has come from the Netherworld. He uses healing spells with the protection of the evil god. Due to his serious personality, it is rumored that he is struggling with his identity, whether he is a priest or a knight.
jadeFlare: By just hesitating, the enemy will let their guard down and then use Time Bomb and Kaboomle to deal massive damage. He is particular about the sharpness of the flickering flares, and becomes upset when the flare is not set properly.
zamtasm: An evil wraith born from Kazammle. Naturally, his favorite spell is Kazammle. Unlike the failed Firespirit, this is an elite spirit born from the highest level dark spells cast by the finest magicians in the Netherworld!
shamHatwitch: A rookie boar monster wearing a large hat pulled down low on his body. When fighting, he gets scared and wraps himself in his hat to protect himself. Until recently, the monsters kept him as a pet, but he is now seen as a valuable asset and fights as one of their own.
shamHamwitch: A hideous pig monster who has mastered forbidden alchemy. He brings disaster to the world with his Black Breath and Cursed Mist. The hat I always wear is the first one I made through alchemy. I really like the shiny color.
hatHamwitch: The soul of a dead wizard resides in his favorite hat and controls wild boars. Beware of his special spell, Bang. You might think that the poor boar has had his body taken over by the hat, but it seems that he doesn't mind it at all as it makes him feel like a wizard.
kaleidocat: A very rare cat demon boasting colorful stripes. It whimsically casts Frizz and licks around. Seven cats from Cat Island played a prank on Jailcat and painted him with magic paint, which is how he was created!
remote: A cool desert ghost with a tropical vibe. Although it looks slow, it is light on its feet. When I applied Dowachaka Oil to my tanned, frizzy hair, my whole body turned a deep tan! Since then, my life as a popular guy has begun.
trikaceratops: A crimson demonic beast that has lived on earth since ancient times. Its body is as heavy as a rock and unfazed by anything. When it's cold, they sleep huddled together in groups, but if they get too close, they are faced with the dilemma of getting pricked by the thorns and being unable to sleep.
fromageFray: Despite his goofy appearance, he is a smart man who can't let his guard down and has the ability to cast explosive spells and heal himself. An unknown new face that looks both Slime-like and Ghost-like. Is there a secret under the hat?
fromageGrey: A dark warrior born when Fromage fray fell to the dark side of black mold. He masters the power of darkness. Why did he fall to the dark side of black mold? It is said that there is a story about Hakko that brings tears to his ears and tears to tell.
fromageFlay: As a result of fondue's longevity, it has developed a unique taste. A true name mawashist who is devoted to researching food. He is confident in his own delicious taste, and says that it goes particularly well with basil and tomatoes mixed with olive oil.
lanternSoldier: A foot soldier commander who lights up the battlefield with his lights. He rushes towards the enemy and suddenly blows himself up. A Bambooligan who's a hard worker became an ashigaru captain after many hardships. In fact, he seems to be an ambitious man who is not satisfied with his current position and is aiming for a higher rank.
bambooligan: A mysterious soldier holding a bamboo spear. His friends hang out with each other and desperately try to stop those who want to destroy the bamboo forest. The bamboo forest is my hometown and the place where my soul returns... It expresses Aritake's feelings in the bamboo forest.
bamboozler: A trickster of the Bambooligan tribe who carries a high-collared banner on his back. He likes flashy techniques such as Multithrust and self-destruction. Ikusaba is the stage of Han Dynasty. That's why I want to stand out and strongly assert myself. Look at my way of life!
generalMech: The golden armor is proof of Bambooligan leadership, to inspire his subordinates to wage a big battle. He is a general who rules over the entire Bamboo Forest, but there is no shortage of people aiming for his position and he is busy putting down rebellions. The day when he can sleep in peace is far away.
bamboogieman: The leader of a large force that leads the Bambooligan army and maintains a base in the Bamboo Forest. He protects himself by using the many friends he has summoned as a wall. The turbulent Sengoku era has begun, where the strong rule everything. Everyone is plotting strategies to unify the bamboo forest.
shellieSMother: A laid-back and generous slime-weaving mother. However, if you startle her, she'll strike you with lightning! The reason why Shellie's Mother's shell has no thorns is because she is kind enough to not hurt her baby snails.
slimecicle: A pure white slime with a giant icicle on its back that can only be found in snowy regions. It puts travelers to sleep and attacks them. It silently sneaks up on travelers stranded in the snowy mountains. Locally, it is feared as the White Grim Reaper.
hauntedTomato: A monster that has been possessed by a demon inside a bright red tomato, giving it limbs. It absorbs your MP and attacks with its Zammle. It seems that it is her secret dream to one day go to the Netherworld and be eaten at the Great Demon King's table.
hollyOliver: A multi-talented fairy who can not only use powerful ice spells, but also dance a Weird Dance and cast Zing. Born from a 100-year-old holly tree that had an evil spirit dwelling within it. Because it was originally a holly tree, it has an extremely prickly personality.
pumpkinKid: He fights by toying with his opponents with skillful steps such as a Weird Dance and the Fuddle Dance. The Pump Kids were too shy to dance in front of other people, but one day they discovered that they could dance if they hid their faces behind pumpkins.
sacredSilverHaardvark: A very rare Haardvark with a holy silver metal body, excellent escape speed and luxurious EXP. It's the talk of adventurers. There is a mysterious legend that if you wash a skull for 100 years without ever letting go of it, your body will turn into sacred silver.
pinkBonbon: A rather troublesome idol of the Netherworld who supports her friends with hustle dancing and encouragement. Her fans don't yet know that she is an idol with such tenacity that she continues to practice dancing until she gets blood blisters on the soles of her feet...
prisonLeader: The boss of the prisoners has been resurrected as a monster, trying to drive travelers to their deaths and increase the number of his minions. The large bone he holds in his left hand is an ancient bone that has been passed down from generation to generation to generation of prison lords.
lunarChimaera: A vicious bird monster that launches breath attacks by increasing and decreasing the magical power of light and darkness like the phases of the moon. The new moon day is the only day off a month for the Lunar Chimaera. Since they are constantly flapping their wings, they can finally stretch their wings on this day.
metalChimaera: These composite creatures are too metallic to be considered true Chimaeras. They are constantly chased by adventurers, leaving little time for them to search for new metal mates.
snootySlimeKnight: A short, flimsy man who straddles a pink slime and shows off his brilliant sword skills, capturing the hearts of the girls. He's a severe narcissist who never misses combing his mane every day, much to the amazement of his slime partner.
crimsonGlaive: It roars and makes enemies cower, then goes on a rampage swinging a giant sickle. Be careful of Kafrizzle, too. Its hideous crimson skin is said to be either stained with blood or discolored by rage.
slimeSisters: An idol unit from the Netherworld formed by three pink slime girls. Their signature performance, Momoiro Shower, will move fans to tears! Her dream is to reach the pinnacle of the Monster Idol Warring States period and retire while at the height of her popularity, saying, "I'm going to turn back into a normal Slime!"
poisonTrill: It attacks by spewing poison stored in its purple body. Its appearance may be cute, but its insides are a poisonous evil spirit. Donguri Manako and Ochoboguchi have dopey looks on their faces as they make nasty, sarcastic remarks that shock the other monsters.
redPudding: A monster accidentally created by a witch who loves sweets. It sometimes breathes fire, but it has no ill intentions and acts only on instinct. The pudding, which was supposed to be sweet, ended up being extremely spicy for some reason. It seems the witch who loved sweets was bad at cooking.
softServeSpook: A cute ghost with a fluffy bubble body. Although it looks docile, it has surprisingly strong attack power. This is a work by a witch who loves sweets. She looks a little unhappy because she mixed up the sugar and salt in the whipped cream.
armouredAnt: Armoured monsters that go to battle by sucking the blood of their enemies. Fearless soldier ants that hide bombs in their tails. When walking in a queue with friends, they may step on a tail bomb and cause a major disaster.
iceBomber: A bug-like monster that drops blocks of ice. A terrifying creature that absorbs the magical power of anyone it bites. The cool Ice Bomber loves shaved ice so much that he even shaves the ice himself to eat it. His favorite flavor is Blue Hawaii.
mosquitoGnat: A beetle-type monster with a time-honored name. A combat weapon that charges forward while protecting itself with a barrier. For some reason, I keep getting robbed by travelers. Even though I don't have anything worthwhile...
scarabKing: The emperor who reigns over the beetle monster world. He possesses incredible strength and attacks by dropping giant boulders. With his striking body, he stands out wherever he goes, and is the fashion king of the beetle world. He used to be a model.
piousDogra: An evil nightmare demon who came from the world of dreams and controls the darkness. If you are hit by a pillow that he throws, you will be cursed. He seems to really like his brightly colored nightgown and pillow. Where on earth did he buy such tasteless things?
napir: A demonic beast with a nasty look in its eyes that appears holding a pillow. It is said to put travelers to sleep and eat their dreams. It's good at putting people to sleep, but lately he has been worried about a lot of things and suffers from insomnia.
incubusDragonQuest: A shady monster from the world of dreams that throws pillows at travelers, forcing them to sleep. He's a nosy guy who enters people's dreams, interprets their contents, and forces the results on them.
nightmare: A terrifying incarnation of nightmares wielding a crimson pillow, he stirs up chaos with his Charm-Cha-Cha and hypnosis. If you rest your head on the blood-stained, bright red pillow and fall asleep, you'll never wake up from a dream about drowning in a sea of ​​blood...
scratcher: A blue killer with a well-trained body and sharp claws. A formidable opponent who can slash twice and breathe flames. He is proud of his impressive claws and fins. His blue skin resembles Wetling's a bit, but he hates being told that.
foebergine: An annoying fruit monster that approaches with a seductive dance and occasionally calls its allies. Be careful of its blown kisses. It is said that eating blueberries is good for your eyes, but apparently eating blueberries makes your eyes watery.
largeWoebergine: The Jumbo Woebergine has undergone repeated breeding and improvement. Although it has grown significantly in size, its personality and fighting style remain the same. Unfortunately, I missed out on winning the jumbo vegetable contest held at Hell's Farm. I'm hoping for the next one.
snotbonce: A fearsome red-eyed monster that poses as a sacred beast that brings good luck and ambushes travelers. If you get caught in its claws, you will die. When Snotbonce saw the image of a holy beast that brings good luck depicted in a certain grimoire, he realized that it didn't look like him at all!
spaceDevil: A space lifeform specialized in combat that was born from a meteorite. It considers anything that moves to be an enemy and attacks. After destroying a planet, they curl up their limbs, camouflage themselves as meteorites, and travel across space in a swarm, heading for the next planet.
spaceDemon: A space lifeform specialized in combat that was born from a meteorite. It slowly tortures its prey with toxins produced from its respiratory organs. Without words or letters, they express all their emotions through attack. They will even kill someone to convey the love they harbor.

blueGiraffe: A demonic monk who has undergone rigorous training and whose head has grown long, earning him great respect. He swings his explosive stick with graceful, dancing movements. Opinion is divided in the academic community as to its origin as being a dragon or a giraffe, and one theory is that it was originally a combined monster created through alchemy.
deadBowdy: A mummy, not so much petrified as prettified, with a large pink ribbon and bow. But would anyone want to receive such a present?
morrimp: An imp being impish by dressing up as Morrie. But it's not just the imp-osing outfit. Oh no, this cheeky devil is an imp-rovement on its brethren, with more GUSTO and more PASSION! So beware!
goldNugcat: A candy cat coated in gold! In fact, it's so shiny, you shouldn't look straight cat it, for fear of clawsing damage to your eyes!
cherreevilBlossom: Everyone's favourite treevil when it's time to sit under the cherry blossoms in spring. But best observed from afar, since it will attack if it twigs you're there.
santaclops: A spontaneous Xmas transformation of a hell hopper in a festive mood. Add a dead bowdy into the mix, and you've got a truly magical crimbo combo!
boxOfTricks: A chestful of trouble inside which chaos reins.
cofferOfDeath: A fabled chest that promises to deliver all who encounter it to the hereafter.
hippocamper: A sea horse that runs freely across the ocean floor, defying the currents of the water. It uses its Air Pollution to weaken its opponents and deliver a devastating blow. I would love to compete in a gallop with a horse, a creature that lives on land, but sadly the living world is too far away.
oriColumn: A fearsome dance master who lures enemies into the world of death with mystical and mysterious movements that exude the scent of the orient. Originally, he was just a Prancing Pillar. When he was young, he traveled to an eastern country and was fascinated by the local dances, becoming a master after training.
shadowNoble: A noble black knight born in the depths of darkness, wearing a shadow. His signature Multithrust instantly transforms the world around him into a world of death. He comes and knocks on your door in the middle of the night, when even the plants and trees are asleep. It is said that anyone who accidentally opens the door will disappear, leaving behind only a shadow.
pickyMole: Release all the tension you've been building up in one go and get into a super high-tension state. In one go, it'll come at you! A legendary pickaxe user and tunnel construction expert, he is well known among the Shigura Demons. He has dug countless caves.
darkNebulus: The evil legacy of the ancient Al-Agun. It was created using technology that cannot be replicated in modern times, and it vaporizes the target without a trace. It was created as an ultimate weapon to protect the ancient kingdom, but now only one remains roaming beneath the Pyramid.
icicleDragon: The bones of many different animals that were frozen to death in a blizzard gathered together and began to move, imitating the shape of a dragon. Its breath freezes everything. I can at least breathe. Just like you guys! Like this, inhale and exhale... That's it. This is breathing!
eagleDevil: A noble demon with black wings who commands the Gargoyles. He uses his powerful sword technique to perform dive techniques. Hawk man calls himself a noble devil, but he has actually lived a long life. Now that he has gained fame and fortune, he has become even more selfish.
rainbowRock: A rock monster that has the glow of an aurora floating in the icy sky. Be careful, as it will unleash a Kamikazee if you stare at it carelessly. The best way to relax is to lie down and look up at the sky with the Aurora dancing. Apparently, this is called aurora bathing.
mandrakeMilitant: He is confident in his Oomph and Leaping Cleaver, but his cautious nature and the fact that he never forgets to call for his allies makes him even more formidable. Don't be fooled at first glance. His dull body color is said to be cool, but he is still a very popular handsome man in the Mandrake Major world.
nightCardinal: A noble dark paladin who wields the power of death and annihilates all enemies that stand in his way with powerful spells and swordsmanship. He has a nasty habit of going by majority vote when making important decisions, which often results in him making unfavorable choices.
treeSage: A Monolog that has become powerful after being parasitized by a Carnivine. Not only does it bite, it can also use healing spells. So does the heart of the Tree Sage belong to the Carnivine or the Monolog? The truth is shrouded in mystery.
motherwood: The grudge of the murdered mother bird resides in the stump and turns it into a monster. It uses Kabuff and healing spells to protect the chicks in the nest. If you secretly observe it, you can see the heartwarming sight of a mother and child feeding the chirping chicks.
snowball: A fairy that sometimes appears when it snows. She hops around happily, but she is always on guard against Mages who cast fire spells, as she hates them. It's a popular rumor among kids that if you leave Snowball's rain boots at home on Christmas, you'll definitely find a present inside the boots the next morning.
rosePrincess: A spirit princess from a land of flowers that is said to exist somewhere. A mischievous princess who likes to turn people into roses. She transforms into roses using the magic of the walking stick she holds in her hand. She has brought back the treasures of her hometown to fill the world with flowers.
devilMaru: In life, he was a fiendish, wild samurai who committed every kind of cruelty possible. Even now, he continues to curse people and live his life in wickedness and cruelty. They say that Bushido is the way of death, but this guy boasts that the way of immortality is to find not dying.
lingeringOgre: A combat professional with an excellent balance of both offense and defense, he stands before people as a test of their abilities. The left and right shields have names, the one on the left is Furious Blackus and the one on the right is Greedy Orenzel. Both have very bad personalities.
angoraFaun: A demon feared by the people as a messenger of the Great King of Terror. The tremendous power of Kafrizz is the very definition of fear. According to the prophet Puctradamus, on the last day, a horn will be blown to announce the end of the world to everyone.
belfggor: A cold-hearted and excellent commander of a terrifying demon army. He scorches the surface of the earth with his Scorch breath attack. He's a sports-oriented corps commander who will punish monsters that he finds slacking by making them run around the Netherworld 30 times. He's strict, but he's also good at taking care of them.
blackBatboon: A demon with great magical powers that can even control Kasizz. He has also mastered the death spell Thwack, so he is an opponent you cannot let your guard down against. The famous great demon Pazuzu is said to be from the Gusion tribe. They are very proud that such a famous demon came from their tribe.
angolaLizard: The reason he can live with Yuki in the flames is thanks to the heat of his Blessed Breath. He's a vicious guy who uses Oomph to increase his attack power and swings his tail around. Ever since he found out about the existence of a monster called Angora faun, he has secretly been burning with a competitive spirit. Will they ever become rivals?
grandYellowBelly: A giant yellow dragon that has evolved differently from Frou-Frou. It can now use Blessed Breath and the spell Remoreheal. There is also a rumor that the whole body being yellow is actually a warning sign of health problems caused by being overweight.
silverine: A beautiful warrior demon with a silver-white body and golden hair. He cuts down anyone who opposes him with a single stroke of his dazzling golden axe. They take great care of their bodies to maintain their pride and joy of whiteness, but it seems that the undersides of both wings are difficult to brush and have darkened slightly.
fromageFey: A tactician who lowers your resistance to magic and uses spells. The surface of his body is like oil that burns well. Seems to be slimy with burning oil. I also remember Frizz-type spells, but I'm determined not to use them because it would be terrible if my body accidentally caught fire.
spiritFlame: An evil will-o'-the-wisp that uses its breath to inflict pain on enemies and cast deadly spells. Beware of the Spinning Wheel skill. It is said to lure lost travelers into the forest, disguised as a bonfire, then take their life and make them its ally.
oldFlame: It is said that the flames surrounding this monster shine so beautifully that they imbue the torches used in rituals with the power of fire. The Dancing Flame that has been burning for 1000 years without being extinguished has evolved to become stronger and purer, approaching the primordial flame.
lickitySpit: A perverse lower-level demon who loves to harass others and is good at attacks to achieve that end. Despite his small body, he is quite a big eater. Although Ukobak is a big eater, he is surprisingly picky about what he likes and dislikes. He loves fried food, and his favorite food is fried lizards.
rapscallion: It is larger than the demon beast Eagle and is more cruel and cunning. It roams the frost-covered drift ice fields, violently slicing its prey to pieces. His stubborn father is actually searching for his runaway son, but is getting frustrated when he can't find him.
blueHorn: A wind-controlling, bull-shaped demonic beast that corners its opponent with kicks and critical hits, then finishes them off with a Wind Sickles attack. Due to his red and blue coloring, he is often paired with the inferior Red Horn, which secretly scars him.
redFang: When the beastman is angry, his flaws become more apparent and his body appears bright red. He becomes highly excited and attacks ferociously. It was named after the cry it makes, "hunger". It is said that there are many different kinds of "hunger" sounds, as they use different pitches depending on their emotions.
darkSabrecub: These baby dark sabrecats are vicious hunters who move as swiftly and silently as shadows, and put even the adults of some other species to shame.
nessicure: The king of ferocious sea dragons, feared as the ruler of the deep seas. With a frozen spirit of ice, he specializes in cold attacks. The king thinks of the oarfish as his subordinate, but in reality, they have no relationship. In fact, he is a sad man with no new clothes.
soulMoleInMemoriam: Don Mole's revival tour backing singers, joining him in the fourth challenge you encounter down Memories Lane. They're stouter and more soulful than ever, but can still be Dazzled.
captainCrowInMemoriam: The sixth challenge that awaits on a trip down Memories Lane. Even in memoriam Crow is buckling swash, and enjoys giving a daring display of tension-building almost as much as receiving a puff-puff.
goregonzolla: A cheese monster that spreads a unique odor around it. Its scent is so strong that you can tell where it is even if you can't see it. I often feel frustrated when I'm told that my name is inferior. He trains every day in hopes of becoming the ferocious boss he lives up to his name.
needler: Easily recognised by the bundles of abundant fluff spilling from their masks, these furry fellows will make pincushions of pretty much anything they can poke their enormous needles into.
haystackNeedler: These dapper dancers are said to have the deftest steps in the business, and spend their days sashaying across the sands with friends and family.
lampling: A fire demon that has taken up residence in an abandoned lantern. Disguised as a lantern, it showers unsuspecting adventurers with sparks. People often ask me if the flames I'm holding close to my body aren't hot, but in fact they are extremely hot. I endure them in order to hide my true identity.
grublin: Grisly little green grumps who won't stop swinging their swords once they get upset with someone.
horknight: Elite grublin warriors who ride astride great big wasps. Beware their two-pronged spear and stinger strikes.
rottenEggsoskeleton: Mechanical monsters made of a mysterious pearlescent metal as yet unknown to science, and given to emitting a paralysing gas.
slayerOfTheSands: The citizens of Gallopolis have lived in fear of this giant scorpion for centuries, and its unquenchable appetite for carnage has earned it a truly intimidating nickname: the Slayer of the Sands.
frightBulb: Nobody knows where they started sprouting, but it's said that the first farmer to find one of these tuberous terrors was so shocked by its scream that he never picked up a spade again.
fruitySuccubat: With her alluring appearance, which is unlike that of a monster, she lures adventurers into letting their guard down, showering them with affection and making them fall head over heels in love with her. She is a cunning monster. She finds great pleasure in captivating adventurers with her captivating gaze and slicing their throats.
succubat: A beautiful and splendid monster that flies through the dark night with its large wings. Its charm makes its opponent weak in the knees, slicing them to pieces with its sharp claws. The fluffy feathers give you a Puff-Puff, which feels like heaven. But be careful, you might actually be sent to heaven if you're not careful.
coralossus: Enormous creatures crafted from coral to fight in an ancient undersea war. Legend has it that they were designed to weapons of mindless destruction, with no free will of their own.
evangelizard: These wise teachers of the dragon world are always in high demand, with their lectures often being booked up months ahead of time.
bongoDrongo: Their thundering drums are decorated with funny faces, and draw monsters from miles around with their rousing rhythms.
brollyminator: Puckish parasols whose party trick is pretending to be ordinary umbrellas, then pranging the hands of those who grab the claws they have for handles.
spitzfire: Hellish hounds endowed with dragon wings. They are unwaveringly loyal, and as such, are highly prized as guard dogs in the underworld.
pennyPincher: When people wish to make a killing on the slots, fate plays a cruel trick on them by turning them into these murderous machines.
jerkules: Monstrously muscled four-armed fiends who love nothing more than flexing in front of the mirror. They've got a pose for every possible occasion.
clangoustine: They may be the same colour as metal slimes, but they're nowhere near as nimble, owing to the weight of their all-but-impervious outer layer.
otterShambles: Costumed creatures who have adapted to life at sea. Well, up to a point--they still can't get used to the taste of clams. Bleurgh!
polarPolly: A bird monster with fluffy feathers that has adapted to the frigid world. During battle, it shows no signs of being warm by unleashing its Kazammle. For a long time, they have lived comfortably without any natural predators, but with the appearance of the Rapscallion, they are becoming increasingly nervous.
tundracky: Dracky is a fearsome, ruthless and heartless man who has acquired an icy spirit. However, being a Dracky, there is only so much he can do. He is concerned that his pale body colour means he cannot blend into the darkness, and becomes extremely angry when touched there.
darkCandle: It creates powerful spells from the flames above its head, which is the source of its magical power. A hybrid candle that combines the magical powers of darkness and fire. It is said that the countless candles used by ancient sorcerers in rituals to summon powerful spirits transformed into these monsters over time.
pineNeedler: Fuzzy green fellows from the First Forest who've found so many World Tree leaves lying around that they've absorbed their life-giving powers.
eggsoskeleton: Curious mechanical conveyances that can jump eggstremely high. Their drivers disappear when defeated, making it impossible to identify them.
professaurus: Exceptionally well-educated dragons who other monsters studiously avoid for fear of being bored stiff with titbits of trivia.
brollygagger: Umbrellas once owned by skilled assassins that carefully observed, and can now perfectly imitate, their former masters' moves.
slickSlime: Strange slimes made of an oily sludge with a truly unique texture. Touch one, and you won't forget it.
gloomyGrublin: Innocent, impish little things that run around the place bursting into tears at the slightest provocation.
biteBulb: They're as red as ripe tomatoes, but no one's ever got close enough to take a bite and see if they taste like them. They spray out clouds of soporific spores so carelessly that they sometimes put themselves to sleep.
leafyLampling: Though they began life as demonically possessed flames, long years living in the forest have seen these little fellows evolve to resemble acorns.
midnightHorknight: Gloomy grublins that have somehow learned to ride great big wasps. Despite their distinctly unchivalrous nature, groups of them often come together to play at being knights.
shadowMinister: Sent to hell for murdering their masters, these putrid politicians roam the underworld looking for new sovereigns to serve.
krillerKiller: Cruel crustaceans built solely for battle whose scythe-like claws are so sharp they can slice straight through their enemies' swords.
jockilles: These massive mountains of muscle make an easy living as bodyguards for monsters smaller than themselves.
silverSabrecat: Its pure white fur is beautiful, but it is an incredibly ferocious beast. It has killed countless prey with a single, devastating blow. They are extremely clean animals. After hunting, they always wash in rivers or lakes to remove any dirt or blood.
kleptoreptile: Charismatic characters of the dragon world with many faithful followers and fans among their fellow wyrms.
foulerJowler: Giants among jowlers gifted with god-like strength. It's said they're destined to save their kind in a time of great crisis.
vampireSuccubat: A beautiful demon with dripping blood-red wings. It creates a pink storm and leaves opponents weak. A heart mark on the forehead is a charm that will make your love come true. She also has an innocent and pure side that makes it difficult for her to approach the person she likes.
rantingenRaven: The sight of these blood-red birds and the dragon skulls they carry can strike fear into even the most experienced soldiers' hearts.
supremeSuccubat: Beautiful beasts whose winsome ways and plentiful puff-puffs have lured countless starry-eyed souls to an untimely end.
snowgre: The failed experiments of wizards who imbue icy masses with the spark of life. The resulting creatures are completely uncontrollable, causing them to be abandoned by their creators.
mosstodon: Golems who've been left out in the woods until moss and muck grew all over them. The earth shakes with every single step they take.
leviathing: Snowgres reincarnated as even more atrocious foes. Their eyes glow red with animosity toward the masters who abandoned them.
brollygarch: The devilish crimson of these cursed umbrellas makes them a must-have accessory among fashion-conscious fiends.
brollympian: Utterly unhinged umbrellas with a worrying fixation on insta-death spells, which they supposedly learned from a king among demons.
goldenGirl: The masterworks of the monster world's most accomplished demonic dollmaker. If ordered, they will rain down destruction indiscriminately.
platinumPoppet: Mechanical dolls animated by unseen forces. They keep humans as pets, and punish them painfully when they don't do exactly what they want.
steelSiren: When mermaids meet with truly tragic ends, the crushing weight of their bitterness causes them to be reborn as steel sirens.
ironMaiden: A doll that charms humans with its beautiful appearance and manipulates them at will. When it gets tired of manipulating them, it starts showering them with freezing snow. I'm a beautiful doll. Would you like to play with me? If you don't want to play with me, I'll play with you.
grimGryphon: Their massive wings and cruel claws make them appear impressive, but they're mid-level monsters at best, and often get bossed around by others.
goldDrohl: Glitzy little snail-like so-and-sos whose shells get their shimmering sheen thanks to a diet of almost exclusively precious metals.
stumpChamp: Demons made when the souls of men who've meet with unjust ends meld with tree trunks. They blaze bright red with rage at their wrongful deaths.
megatonChamp: The Netherworld arena champion who gets excited with his fighting dance and goes wild with his hip impact. Of course, he's in the open weight class! He is constantly trying to gain weight to improve his hip impact, and repeats the cycle of eating, sleeping, and training three times a day.
abyssalOctopot: A demon guarding the Gate of Trials, feared for its devil's tentacles. It heals its sea friends by dancing the Hustle Dance. He claimed that the octopus was once a gigantic monster capable of sinking ocean-going ships, but that the water pressure of the deep sea has caused it to shrink.
octoDermon: Rather than wielding a weapon, she finds meaning in life in supporting her comrades by cheering and dancing. Its name and appearance lead people to believe it is highly poisonous, but it is actually non-poisonous. The octopus soldier is suffering from negative publicity.
inferno: The flame used in a ritual by a group worshipping an evil god came to life. It became an evil entity that emitted a Cursed Mist and cursed all living beings to death. Her body temperature is surprisingly low, and she is good at dark techniques, which is actually a secret complex of hers. She wants to burn even hotter!
desertGalba: An outlaw whose sole purpose in life is to attack caravans in the desert. His specialty is gathering a large group of allies to surround his prey. Surprisingly, he's very popular and most of the bad guys in the desert are his friends, so no matter what the situation, his allies will come to his aid right away.
desertGorba: His life's work is to discover desert oases and then dry them up with scorching winds, thus causing trouble for travelers. He became angry because his reflection in the water of the oasis was hard to see, and began to hate the oasis. What a nuisance.
pinkSabrecat: Despite its adorable appearance with heart patterns scattered all over its body, its ferocity and high physical abilities are no match for that of a Great Sabrecat. It is said that the more happy romantic relationships she has, the more heart patterns she will have, but for some reason, she seems to be single.
honeyheadHorknight: They're supposed to share their steeds' sweet honey with everyone else in the monster world, but they love it so much that they can't quite bear to.
grumpyGrublin: Legendary sourpusses said to be born when a grublin's gruffness boils over into outright rage. Suffice it to say, they're famously foul-tempered.
gleefulGrublin: These rakish rogues of the grublin world like to grin their way into the hearts of grublin girls, then toy with them mercilessly.
jarvisSShadow: Jarvis is always berating his bumbling umbral underlings, but all of them are utterly unwavering in their loyalty to him.
silverSabrecub: Cute little sabrecat cubs that are left out in the cruel cold of the snowfields, with the parents returning to raise only the survivors.
spriteBulb: Having been raised in running water, these soothing blue relatives of the Fright bulb are said to bring peace and tranquillity to all who behold them.
wightBulb: They suck the happiness from humans and store it up in tiny seeds, which when planted can grow into wish-granting flowers.
luridLampling: Jazzy little lights used as decorations for all the major monster festivals. Their contrasting colours can't fail to put one in the mood for fun.
lavaLampling: The fire in their bellies can reach tremendous temperatures, and losing focus for even a second could see them consumed in flames, making them understandably anxious.
luminousLampling: They'll stay alive as long as the blue flames in their bellies keep on burning, and as such, are seen as symbols of life's evanescence.
bongoFandango: Passionate percussionists who pound away enthusiastically despite the nippy northern winds. What better than a jam session to warm you up?
bongoBango: Their thundering beats bring lurid lamplings from miles around to boogie, making death by drummer a very real risk for unwary adventurers.
bingoBangoBongo: Inspired by the Dark One, these demonic drummers composed a blistering beat with which to welcome the end of the world.
lobsterMobster: Fierce, fire-breathing beasts from the deepest depths of the ocean. The heat from their flames boils the water around them, which is what gives them their brilliant crimson hue.
mothertoad: The emboldening battle ballads of this queen of amphibians can send swarms of froggy soldiers surging into the fray, filled with new-found fury.
crushtacean: Unrivalled in both ferocity and greed by any other creatures of the deep, they empty the ocean wherever they go of all creatures great and small.
gnawchid: Free and easy flowers that spend their days sunning themselves in oder to mantain the magnifecent marigold hue of their prodigious petals.
runnyEggsoskeleton: Horrifying murder machines made by madmen. They often leap up to attack from above using their powerful piston-like legs.
clockwyrm: It looks colorful and pop, but it is a weapon with extraordinary lethality. It makes enemies who are deceived by its appearance and let their guard down, and plays with them. No one knows who made it, but one theory is that it was a toy made by a heaven-spanning giant to soothe babies.
hardBoiledEggsoskeleton: Ultra-advanced mechanical contraptions with unmatched military might. Their spotted pattern signifies the severe danger they present.
tokenTaker: Maniacal slot machines that convince punters to pump them full of tokens, then take their lives into the bargain.
goldGrabber: Malevolent machines whose idea of an ideal day is one spent supping on the souls of those who foolishly trade them in for one last spin on the reels.
fortuneFilcher: Spits out great torrents of tokens, but these are just a trick to attract the unwary, who it swallows whole when they come close.
a3g15: A mechanical soldier that a certain battle-loving great demon had created to use as his training partner. His fighting ability is outstanding. It is said that the great demon who created him was satisfied with its performance and gave his name to this mechanical soldier.
mechidroid: A combat machine for use in high-heat areas, specializing in beam attacks and designed to be heat-resistant, even capable of withstanding the heat of magma. It is equipped with artificial intelligence through advanced programming, and it would apparently be quite hurtful if it was found to be a fake Type G0.
shadeshifter: A fighting tribe that parted ways with the Flamethrowers long ago. They are the children of darkness, wielding Kazammle and Black Breath. He had wanted to live in the realm of darkness, but was frightened by the smiling, axe-wielding Headhunters and so moved away.
redMist: Unsettling entities that look like nothing more than the great gouts of gore that fly up around them everywhere they goon the battlefield.
garishGarlic: Loathsome Leek mutated after eating a lot of garlic for health reasons. His abnormal body odor now stands in the way of adventurers. Apparently after just one fight, the smell will be unbearable for a week, so it's probably best to avoid fighting before a date if possible.
hooperTrooper: Bizarre beasts that use huge spiked hoops as weapons, with which they lay waste to all around them.
hooperDuper: Cunning creatures who jiggle their hypnotic hips in order to distract foes before slamming them with some serious spellcraft.
hooperman: Superstar dancers of the monster world who take the lead in every show going, much to the grey gordons' chagrin.
badonis: Muscle-bound monsters so tough, it's said they could tear the stars from the sky and punch holes through space itself.
brodysseus: The leaders of elite three-hundred-man units in the underworld army who have led their men through hell and back, only to emerge smiling.
goldenGoliath: Sizeable statues gifted with golden bodies by their creator, whose dying words they continue to hold dear to this day.
masterCommander: The twin sword attacks of these glory-hunting tyrants of the deep are feared even by the gods themselves.
headlessHorseman: These nasty knights gave up all pretense of chivalry long ago, and now aid the strong and prey on the weak.
headlessHunter: Silent as shadows, these ghostly knights fall upon their foes without warning, raining down brutal blows with unerring accuracy.
headlessNorseman: Worshipped as gods of war in the monster world, with their chargers foaming at the mouth and their morning stars making mincemeat of enemies left and right, they're truly a terrifying sight.
hellrider: Their crimson clothes mark them out as elite soldiers of the underworld. Utterly without mercy, they would pursue a foe to the depths of hell.
calasmonaut: Skeletal soldiers brought to life by Calamos's malign magic. They have no will of their own, and exist purely to do their master's black bidding.
horknightWatchman: These ruthless rulers of the grublin kingdom are fiercely territorial, sending trespassers on their turf to an early grave with Thwack.
tubbyDracky: A mutant Dracky. She casts Deceleratle to hold back her enemies, then uses her voluptuous body to press them down and take them all down. When you lean against his belly, it fits your body perfectly and you don't want to get up. Dracky is a person who ruins people.
pantomine: A clown who prioritizes his own safety while using the Bomboulder to bounce around on a ball. He uses various tricks to defeat his opponents and create a nightmarish stage. Apparently the Kerplunk act he performs at the Demon Circus is a surefire hit. His noble act of self-sacrifice moves people to tears and the applause never stops.
erdrickSRestlessArmour: A suit of restless armour decked out in Erdrick's signature kit who set out to engulf the world in unending terror.
goldPlatedPuppet: With his golden, sparkling body, he is the star of the doll demon world, but he never neglects his basic Weird Dance. The shining golden body that everyone longs for is proof that he once won a gold medal at a Netherworld entertainment competition.
ursaPanda: A giant, hot-blooded panda that sees anyone it meets as an enemy and tears everything to shreds with a single blow from its powerful claws. A certain ruffian challenged the other to a fight to determine who the real ruffian was, but was completely defeated, and the matter was clearly decided.
chihuawyrm: The sumptuous, snow-white fur of these sizeable serpents is warm enough to ward off even the most biting of blizzards.
labradrake: Fabulously ferocious creatures that carved their name into legend with their own razor-sharp fangs. The mystical light they breathe can obliterate any and all that stand before it.
tatsunaga: A ferocious red dragon feared for its penchant for eating people. It was originally attracted to Mount Huji by the heat and the smell of humans.
cactolotl: They attract prey with their sweet-smelling cacti, then swallow it whole with their massive maws - like whales eating krill, only without any water.
coralotl: Gargantuan sea reptiles who slept on the ocean bed for centuries, and were woken from their slumber when the Dark One returned.
crystalotl: Curious creatures that eat ore, and refine it in their enormous insides into amethysts which are said to possess wondrous properties.
dreadDragooner: A warrior sent from the underworld who rides a dragon with grace. It is said that he wraps the living in a darkness and leads them to the other world. She is very sensitive to heat, so she doesn't wear tights under her armor. Her sweat gets on her body, which seems to annoy her partner dragon.
electricNeedler: Ferocious furballs with an uncanny mastery of all things electric. Their dream is to bring all of Erdrea alive with thunder and lightning.
spawnyDevil: These frustrating little fellows have learned how to confuse their foes, but are also in the habit of annoying their friends by doing it to them too.
redGiant: Only the Lord of Shadows himself need not fear these utterly unforgiving fiends. Their armour is awarded to them by the Dark One when they destroy their first kingdom single-handed.
greyGordon: Committed cavorters who dedicate their lives to dance, and can be heard to say 'C'mon everybody, let's hustle!' about a hundred times a day.
colossalCannibox: Titanic treasure chests whose grotesque gluttony is so unstoppable that they'll even swallow a Gigantes whole.
megaMimic: Enormous mimics that are far too large to pass for treasure chests. That doesn't stop some greedy travelers from trying their luck, though.
pandoraSBigBadBox: Titanic treasure chests in which are contained all the calamities of the universe. If they were ever to escape, that would be the end of everything.
deadManSSoul: A very evil ghost who is particular about death spells. According to him, Thwack tastes refreshing, but Kathwack has a rich taste. I was the one who taught Thwack to the Frostburn! However, they seem to be good at deceiving people.
cursedCrooner: An unidentified, sinister entity exuding an extraordinary grudge. It attacks while singing a horrifying cursed song. There are many theories about its true identity, such as it being the vengeful spirit of someone who was offered as a sacrifice, or that it is searching for the man who betrayed it, but none of them have enough evidence.
caliconjurer: With the power of the meat stick, the cat maker transforms into a calico cat! With love and courage, he stands out among the others and will sweep away all his enemies. Only Meowgician girls who have the sparkle of dreams in their hearts are supposed to be able to transform into calico cats, but it seems that there are rare cases of boys as well.
deadlyBlade: A sword monster bathed in numbing medicine. It summons its allies with a horrifying screech and tears through travelers from all sides. He was performing a Sword Dance at a dance hall in the Netherworld, but other guests complained that he was constantly getting scratches, so he was banned from entering.
grigoryBaby: He is the child of a fallen angel who rebelled against God and descended to earth. Despite being fallen from heaven, he has a habit of gathering in groups with his friends and acting in groups. Other monsters keep messing with my head. No one listens to me even though I tell them that the name doesn't mean that.
shakoDemon: A doll that harbors a wicked evil spirit. He is an expert at inflicting abnormal conditions, disabling enemies with confusion and sleep while shining a Lullab-Eye. Originally, it was a ritual tool used to pray for the fulfillment of love, but instead of fulfillment, it brought about a breakup and was called a terrifying breakup charm.
conquistadorGhoul: The remains of an adventurer who set out on a journey to rule a distant golden land. Even after death and reduced to nothing but bones, he continues to seek out targets to conquer. He was extremely greedy and had an unrivaled love of gambling during his lifetime, but it seems he lost his final big gamble, which put his life on the line.
agehafly: A sinister fairy with white butterfly wings that brings death. Increases the speed of its friends and use Kaboom to knock enemies down. It is said that when countless Agehaflies dance around a person who is on the brink of life or death, a beautiful field of flowers can be seen. That's why it's called the Fairy of Death.
whiteImp: A small devil said to have been born from the snow. He licks it and ends up being buried in the cold snow of Kaboomle and the Death Dance. In fact, the white part of its body is made of shaved ice. Apparently it tastes like sweet milk, but no one other than myself has ever tasted it.
asuraKing: An evil spirit has possessed the statue of an ancient king who loved justice. The distorted justice has become an incarnation of slaughter, seeking only conflict. The Zombie Gladiators, who have witnessed countless brutal massacres, worship him as a god of war. Today, the King continues to walk the path of hell.
pumpkabinet: A festival-loving Chest Mimic dressed up for Halloween. When he gets high and violent, he's impossible to control. I'm told it's trick or treat, but no matter what you choose, you're faced with a hellish choice: they'll eat you whole.
crankiid: A mysterious baby squid appears quietly in the shadows of scary monsters all over the world. It drops the Holy Crest of Zelmea. The Zelmea Crest that awaits them was stolen during an attack on a ship belonging to the World Innkeepers Association. The purpose of this attack remains unclear.
phalarisBull: A beastman who is feared as the executioner of the wilderness. In addition to the devastating blows fired from his strong arms, he also uses lightning spells. Actually, I'm not good at handling iron balls. It would be more efficient for him to hit with his bare hands, but his pride as an iron ball boy makes him continue his daily routine.
darkBuzzard: A jet-black bird that spreads death and is said to have been born in ancient times. It spreads death to all living things with its Air Pollution and Kazammle. It is said to be the ancestor of the Hawk Moth, Snowbird, and many other bird monsters, but the truth remains unknown.
coralDimos: A synthetic beast that has been given the ability to move underwater thanks to dark magic. Even in the ocean, it can rain down meteors and scatter scorching flames. They are excellent hunters who use their vivid body coloring to camouflage themselves as coral and attack prey. They have the patience to remain motionless for long periods of time.
basiliscale: A monster with a wealth of combat experience that excels at mid-range combat using double claws and breath attacks from its long arms. It loves poisonous air, so when it is feeling down it licks the poison that has seeped into its sharp claws and feels better.
paintbrushHermit: A mysterious demonic hermit who is the only one who drops materials for summoning charms. He hides behind a powerful bodyguard and rarely shows himself. Since he possesses special materials and is protected by bodyguards, he must be a VIP. Monsters can be deceptive.
paladinsaurus: Its own scales harden and emit a unique glow, making it appear as if it is wearing
guardianAngel: A rare Harmor in the world, where the evil grudge was canceled out while being attacked by a holy attack, and in its place was imbued with holy power. Just because it's an angel doesn't mean it's kind; it's not at all gentle and will use super powerful attacks, so be careful.
venompede: A caterpillar that breathes sticky threads that restrict movement and poisonous breath. Rotates its rounded body at high speed and approaches enemies slowly. It is said that a Killerpillar that fails to become a pupa becomes a Venompede when it swells and releases poison.
diablada: A legendary dancer who is spoken of as a miracle in the world of devil dancing. It is said that the sharpness of his Sword Dance can even cut large rocks in half. Anyone who can tell the difference can clearly see the difference in the level of perfection between this and the dance of a weak devil, but unfortunately there is not much difference in the effect of the speech.
prettyCatFly: A self-proclaimed healing cat demon who recovers with her Hustle Dance and shows off her dependability with the attack power of Sword Dance. She has known her partner, Sexy cat fly, for many years, but deep down she thinks she is cuter.
sexyCatFly: A self-proclaimed devilish cat demon who charms you with her Charm-Cha-Cha and never forgets to create surprises with his cat tricks. She has known her partner Pretty cat fly for many years, but deep down she thinks she is the better woman.
writhingRoot: Roots of the man-eating Malign Vine which seem to have a mind of their own. In truth more akin to tentacles, they can snatch a human and drag them underground in seconds flat.
jurassicLloyd: A combat machine modeled after a dragon. Its main weapons are its steel claws and extendable tail, but it can also spew high-temperature flames using an internal combustion engine. They are made with technology that is clearly different from the Empire's Demon Soldiers, and are said to be a secret weapon from the Gateria Empire that has gone wild.
hangelabra: A cruel demon who enjoys watching his prey suffer by blinding them with blinding lights and spraying deadly breath. His arms, which constantly support his entire body weight, are extremely powerful when used to attack, but they are literally his last resort as they inevitably result in him falling to the ground.
platinasaurus: It is equipped with an advanced cooling system to cool the internal combustion engine, and it makes the most of it to emit a radiant breath. It's not actually made of platinum, but the name means that it is as strong as platinum, but there's no end to adventurers stealing its parts.
gyldenaut: Glittering golden warriors who go around grabbing people's valuables, but always fail to find anything they like quite so much as their own twenty-four carat bones.
gyldenbritches: Guv'nor of the Gyldenauts, and a great lover of booty. Enjoys draining his enemies' defences so his boys can step in and batter them.
canaryano: A rainbow-colored monster bird that is one with its cage. It summons storms and unleashes heat to relentlessly pursue enemies that invade its territory until they die. The part that looks like a birdcage is apparently an exposed part of the skeleton. During breeding season, females lay eggs inside the cage and protect their chicks from predators.
stoneCrablet: A monster that couldn't be crabbed if a stone tablet had been dropped in the past. The hardness of its shell is just as high as the stone tablet it carries on its back. It looks like a crab carrying a stone slab on its back, but in fact it is said that the grudge that resides in the discarded stone slab has given birth to the body of a demon that attacks.
trickyDevil: This little monster likes nothing more than hiding in treasure chests and playing pranks on people, but they tend to go off with a whimper rather than a bang. It might be time to change its name...
tweedledoomAndTweedledeath: This lumbering trailmaster lurks in the depths of the Kingsbarrow, patiently awaiting any knights who wish to prove the depth of their camaraderie.
geyzerInMemoriam: The first challenge you meet when you take a walk down Memories Lane. Not the sharpest tool in the box, but he'll wipe you out if you lake might of him.
torturedSoulInMemoriam: Part of the second challenge that awaits down Memories Lane. Largely a healer for his cronies, for which he may employ Kazing, he may also injure the entire party with a single strike.
trapBoxInMemoriam: The third challenge down Memories Lane - another monster once slain by the party in the past, now back 'in memoriam' to deal a deadly concoction of critical hits and Whack wizardry
donMoleInMemoriam: The fourth challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. Don Mole's dead, but he still feels good. You knew that he would now. Oh yeah, he's duggone dangerous
argonLizardInMemoriam: The fifth challenge that a trip down Memories Lane leads you to. This great beast loves to scare the party stiff with it's terrifying war cries.
gemonInMemoriam: The seventh challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. For some reason - perhaps cowardice - he doesn't like to fight alone, and often summons his Dark Turkey and Darkbird lackeys.
sirLeopoldInMemoriam: The eighth challenge awaiting those who take a trip down Memories Lane. He uses a muttley assortment of breath attacks that hit the whole party. His weakness appears to be poison.
darkServantInMemoriam: The ninth challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. Together with it's dancing flame flankers, it unleashes a deadly squall of Scorch and other attacks against the party.
ruinInMemoriam: The tenth challenge that awaits those that take a trip down Memories Lane, Most attacks are futile against this impenetrable fortress of a foe, leaving only critical hits and defence dodging strikes to play with.
jessicaInMemoriam: The eleventh challenge to present itself on a trip down Memories Lane. Sepia seems to suit her, and this Jessica can captivate men with complete consistency. The more women in the party, the better.
marcelloInMemoriam: The twelfth knight - or rather, the twelfth challenge to be faced down Memories Lane, in the form of the Templar Marcello. In memoriam, his battle devices of choice are Fizzle and sweeping attacks against the whole party.
dhoulmagusInMemoriam: Unlucky for some, the thirteenth challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane consists of Dhoulmagus in triplicate - one who attacks, one who heals and one who revives.
skeletonInMemoriam: Part of the second challenge that awaits down Memories Lane. This rattling bag of bones likes to attack with his Walking Corpse companion.
walkingCorpseInMemoriam: Part of the second challenge that awaits down Memories Lane. This stinky stiff likes to attack with his skeleton sidekick.
darkbirdInMemoriam: A member of the seventh challenge you encounter down Memories Lane, who quietly bolsters his feathered friends in battle with Multiheal and Kasap.
darkTurkeyInMemoriam: A cocky member of the seventh challenge you encounter on a trip down Memories Lane. He likes to stun the party into inaction with loud squawks.
dancingFlameInMemoriam: A member of the ninth challenge you encounter down Memories Lane. Appearing with a Servant of Darkness, together they unleash a deadly squall of Scorch and other attacks against the party.
shadowInMemoriam: An extra in the eleventh challenge you encounter down Memories Lane, this shadow is never far behind Evil Jessica, but only manages physical attacks in the main.
wrongoBongo: The black sheep of the Bongo drongo family due to a lack of any discernible rhythm. Its tunes are said to be so bad that they cause those who hear them to go deaf for days.
booga: A Spectral Sentinel and casino magnate whose monstrous dedication to his own desires caused him to corrupt Jade.
pilferpithecus: If this sticky-fingered simian hadn't stolen Rodolfo Briscoletti's breaktime banana way back when, he wouldn't have had to be sealed away until his descendant Rodrigo's day.
headlessHoncho: Headless commanders in the army of a certain Spectral Sentinel who keep their underlings in line with judicious use of their massive morning stars.
gloomnivore: This cruel creature spent a lifetime gorging itself on the suffering of men, and found a particularly repast in the form of King Irwin's tragic fate.
grampogriff: The old man who was absorbed into the statue of Pegasus after years of praying to get a glimpse of that noble being. They're right when they say you should be careful what you wish for!
nagasus: Though a gentle gee-gee by nature, this creature combined with the statue of Pegasus to become a seething steed of petrifying proportions.
kirinjiGiraffe: He was a genius child of the Giruffian clan who had great expectations for his future from an early age, but as he grew older, he became attracted to darkness and went astray. The stress of the expectations placed on him and the arrogance that came with being a genius had a negative effect on him, and he developed a completely cruel and exclusive personality.
doomsdayDragon: When some slimes found a fygg and feasted on it, they transformed into this deadly dragon-the most abominable creature they could imagine. Unfortunately, none of them remembers any of it.
revivalist: A mean-spirited maritime menace who couldn't stand the sight of others being reborn, so took steps to put a stop to it.
dudDude: A bad-tempered brute without an iota of appeal who tried to get into Tania's good books by disguising himself as her brother.
jiangshiGhost: A Ghost with no redeeming features is transformed by a strange magic spell into a cool Ghost who is good at casting spells. The truth is, the banknote in front of me is really bothering me, but I'm worried it'll be dangerous if I take it without permission, so I'll endure the stress today as well.
dazey: A fleur fatale found in the Neverglade, where it puffs out stupendously soporific pollen in order to send enemies to sleep.
blindHatred: The Luminary's most unpleasant animosities made flesh. Its swords, forged from pure loathing, cut cruel wounds not just into the body, but the very soul as well.
unfathomableAnger: The Luminary's untrammeled rage made flesh. A deep sea beast that seethes and roils with boiling fury, its mere presence can call forth devastating storms, even from hundreds of fathoms beneath the surface.
sheerDecadence: The Luminary's worst excesses made flesh. Those who cave in to temptation and give themselves up to debauchery will themselves paying a weighty price in the afterlife.
allConsumingGreed: The Luminary's most grotesque gluttonies made flesh. Its fangs can tear straight through steel, and its roar can make even the most fearless fighter's hair stand on end.
abjectTerror: The Luminary's deepest fears made flesh. Appears alongside Darkest Despair in order to drag those who have lost faith in life down into the depths of hell.
darkestDespair: The Luminary's fear of failure made flesh. Appears alongside Abject Terror in order to drag those who have lost faith in life down into the depths of hell.
crimsonKillingMachine: A unique, ultra-high performance machine roaming the Realm of Fire. It wipes out swarms of enemies with its ruthless Fissure Fists. It was created as a successor to the Mechidroid, but was never mass-produced because its performance exceeded expectations and its creators feared it.
brightCrystalBeastZolzom: An evil spirit-type demonic beast that can generate a substance called a crystal nucleus. Driven by a strong grudge, it escaped from the Netherworld's Great Training Grounds. They were created by giving spiritual elements to ancient crystals that have existed in the Netherworld since ancient times. According to Gabra, despite their appearance, they are friendly.
racoonPlatypunk: He's the drunkard of the Platypunk world. He shows up at parties all over the country singing, dancing, throwing around Kaswooshles and causing mayhem. Originally, he was just a normal Platypunk. He was made to look like this as punishment for causing a terrible disturbance, but he doesn't seem to mind at all.
superDarkism: The painting is displayed in the Magic Garden, but it also serves as the museum's security. The ideas behind this painting were sublimated into Dark Realism. An artistic concept that seeks to explore the dark beauty that represents the chaos of all things. The famous artist who advocated it was Maldragora.
deathRomanism: This is a painting that hangs in the Madesses Museum, but it also serves as a guard for the museum. The idea behind this painting is sublimated into Wild Fobism. They found beauty in the concept of death, which was often overlooked in the Netherworld, and created an era in the history of demon art. The center of the movement was Maldragora.
phantomGeneralFuzzma: A sorcerer who serves as one of the four demon generals under Demon Marshal Zerudorado. He can manipulate illusions and send his enemies to their deaths within virtual images. He considers himself to be the most intelligent of the Four Demon Generals, but the other three don't think so at all.
boodifulHocusPoker: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Harnesses its inhuman mastery of magic to inflict pain on prisoners, and has a huge laugh doing so.}}
boodifulHoodlum: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Loves to hear victims beg for their lives before brutally butchering them.
boodifulWizard: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Incorporates all kinds of evil incantations into its efforts to drive prisoners to the depths of despair.
boodifulSmogbonnet: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Its marvelous memory means it's able to fondly recall its favourite shrieks for years after eliciting them.
boodifulSootbonce: A leading light of Limboo's human-hurting community. Specialises in claw-based cruelty aimed at petrified prisoners.
graveDigger: A monster used by Captain Morva of the Desert Mole Thieves. Be careful of its fierce attacks using its four arms. The name was given to him by Captain Morva and apparently means "gravedigger." He doesn't like it, but he can't speak the language so he can't say it.
halberdsaurus: A monster that drifted into the Gharial Cave in the False world from somewhere. It swings a giant axe and cuts down everything. Halbredsauruses have used the same axe for generations, and cannot tolerate losing it, even when they sleep.
sambaBeakon: She is the fashion leader of the Netherworld, adorned with gorgeous feather ornaments... but only she thinks of it, and those around her are put off by her flashiness. The feather he wears on his back is made from pieces that were collected one by one from the fallen birds of the Lotus Sutra. It is the fruit of his blood, sweat and tears.
emeraldDragonDragonQuest: A giant dragon with scales of deepest forest-green. Fought Hero and the party to draw out their fullest potential.
amethystCrab: A celebrity in the crab monster world, carrying an amethyst on his back. He doesn't mind scattering it around in a big way during Gorgeous Rain. He has a close friendship with Stone Crablet and often gives advice to his friend who is often at the mercy of fate. He is a compassionate and caring person.
guardianOfTheDarkTree: A mysterious group of monsters appearing around the Great Dark Tree. They will mercilessly attack anyone who approaches the tree. The guardians of the Great Dark Tree have no names or genders, and apart from having a single leader, there seems to be no distinction between them.
fuginmunin: He is an information master in the Netherworld who has excellent thinking and memory skills and uses his minion, the Stark Raven, to gather gossip from all over the place. He can use the information he gathers however he likes. Sometimes he sells it to those in power, other times he uses it to trick his enemies. He's a man of cunning and tactical wit.
