monogette: Cruelcumber, a plant-type creature, has somehow been reincarnated into a material-type creature. Apparently, he's been hired as a bodyguard because of his green origins. He once served the Kamaboko Shogunate, but during the turbulent times, his family line was wiped out. Now he lives as a ronin and aims to restore the Shogunate.
buntzenberner: An evil incarnation of fire that exploits the lusts of the Dwarves. It will not disappear unless its central core is removed. Buntzenberner Hearts are extremely small and require considerable skill to steal. Despite all the big talk, it's actually just the size of a flea's heart.
heavenloon: A bright red balloon-shaped monster floating in the air. Contrary to its round appearance, it performs a sharp dance. It is said that the name "Heaven Balloon" comes from the fact that when people encounter it, they are greeted by a dance of death and taken to heaven.
blackseedKid: When the black sesame seeds that had fallen to the ground gathered together and formed a small mountain over time, they began to move with a will of their own. A fairy made from 100% sesame seeds. Basically, it's a lump of sesame seeds, which fall apart as you walk, creating a fragrant sesame road in your wake.
apostandle: A monster that lights up a high-temperature blue flame. It looks cool but has a strong fighting spirit and uses Kafrizz, which has enhanced magical power, to burn down the enemy until it turns to ashes. He catches a candle demon and tricks him into buying a starter light at a high price by telling him that the blue flame is cool. Is this a real flame marketing tactic?
mossyGhoul: A small demon that grew up eating poisonous plants. It drips bodily fluids from the tips of its claws and paralyzes or poisons any enemies it scratches, rendering them immobile before eating them. The green parts of its body are covered with moss, and when it gets wet in the rain, it releases spores, making a strong appeal to moss girls.
carapoppo: Although it is often looked down upon due to its appearance and name, it is a fire demon bird that is considered to be as high-ranking as the Prism peacock among bird monsters. There is debate in academic circles about the origin of the name Carapoppo; one theory is that it comes from the fact that the bird has an empty stomach, and the other is that it comes from the sound of the flames spewing out.
torchgan: A variant of the Wax Murderer that contains the explosive power of lava. It burns the enemy with the hellish flames stored in its strong body. Her fellow Wax Murderers will melt if you get too close. As a result, he is always kept at a distance and, ironically, his heart is cold.
whiteyClubber: He wanders around in search of a worthy opponent and challenges anyone he comes across. If he deems them unworthy, he sentences them to death. Although they are called judges, they decide who to pass judgment on based on their own selfish likes and dislikes, so it is hard to say they are fair or impartial.
jungleye: A fearsome assassin of the sky, aiming at its prey from above and casting cursed blades, drawing the victim into its own pace with dazzling light. They love to sing, and in their free time they sway their bodies and make a unique sound that is neither a song nor a growl, called the Jungleye Melody.
sinistletoe: A winged tree monster that flies around searching for criminals. Its giant eye will not miss any crime. It is said that anyone gazed upon by the Sinistletoe will be unable to bear the power of her gaze and will confess their sins.
angerope: It was used as a shimenawa. A mass was placed in the rope and it started to move. The abundant techniques using the soft arms are not to be underestimated. He risked his life to seal a place believed to be harmful to humans, only to have it torn apart by a heartless person. His heart trembles with rage.
gangrem: A Demon that casts advanced spells. Use Moreheal to turn the tide and attack with powerful spells. Be careful especially towards the end of the battle. Although he is a powerful spellcaster, his special skill as a Demon is serving. He flies around with agility and never empties the drinking cups of his master or guests.
jadoai: A giant monster with a carved face made of jade. Its brilliance is overwhelming and so solemn that it freezes everything. Because it is made of jade, its surface is smooth and is looked upon with envy by the rough-surfaced Mad Moai.
tengale: A yokai with speed like the wind. It specializes in powerful wind-related attacks such as the gale attack and Kaswoosh. Although he calls himself Tengu, he has a complex about his low nose. Dreaming of having a beautiful, high nose, he secretly wears a nose clip.
harvestDragon: A dragon with a large golden tree growing on its back. It uses Oomph to increase its attack power and crushes opponents with its massive body. Be careful of its Burning Breath. The mighty and arrogant dragon spoke. "I'm not one to be harvested. I was given this name because I harvest adventurers."
platinumimic: A monster that disguises itself as a luxurious-looking treasure chest. It will deliver a fatal attack to any traveler who is driven by greed and tries to open the chest. She seeks a luxurious, clean, and stylish place to live that suits her looks, but the conditions are strict and she can't find a place where she feels at ease.
skycat: A cat demon dancing magnificently in the sky. He calls Bounce with the magical power he stole from Drain Magic. Do you like magic or hate it? I love blue skies on sunny days and am sensitive to changes in the weather. Skycats washing their face seems to be a sign of rain.
pinkmushslime: A deceptively evil slime that dazzles travelers with suspicious spores and further inflicts suffering with paralysis and poison. Surprisingly, he hates mushrooms and throws away any mushrooms that grow on his body without thinking about where they go, which makes him disliked for being selfish.
akumaKnight: A masked knight with a secret mission. He appears in the darkness before dawn accompanied by a bat. Be careful of his desperate attack. He hides snacks such as nuts and insects on the inside of his cloak for the bats he summons. The slits in the snacks mark the slits in the border.
mashouu: A Killer Gila that underwent a terrifying evolution after gaining demonic powers. It stores miasma in its body. It's said that it grows inside a giant crevice and cannot get out. What was it thinking?!
mouldfish: A fish monster that swims in the ocean of the underworld. It attacks with its dark breath and powerful lightning bolts, sending its enemies to the brink of death. When it was alive and swimming in the ocean, it was a rare and monstrous fish that was sought after. It is said to have bitten the fingers of many anglers.
killseeker: An elite overkilling machine that will kill any prey it targets. It will knock its opponents down with the force of the ground, immobilizing them. It is equipped with sensors for heat, sound, vibration, etc. to track down targets for elimination. If it were to be pursued by a Prisma Run pursuer in the middle of the night, it would surely be a crushing victory.
shamanju: She boasts a vibrant crimson body like a manjushage flower. She also has a horrifying side, using her mysterious Death Dance to lure people to their deaths. They gather their friends and compete in a contest to see who has the most beautiful Kurenai. In order to win, they make an effort to suck the living blood of others.
slimachineZ: A slime that has been remodeled by a mad scientist. Watch out for Kazapstrophe, which it emits at maximum output voltage. Until the completion of Sura Machine Z, it seems that a total of 25 prototype slimes were made from Cyber Slime A to Y.
yellowjackwasp: A selected Waspion raised on a special nutritional diet. It is not only physically strong, but also has a clear mind and is mentally strong. The pollen balls it wears are rumored to be a complete nutritional food. It seems to improve beauty and health, causing them to be worried about being targeted by adventurers.
marbguar: A ferocious beast that is consumed with rage and attacks anything that moves. It uses its sharp claws to unleash its powers and eradicate all living things around it. They have the ability to sense emotions directed towards them through their smell, and in fact they only attack in response to fear or hostility.
ayashiitake: It is a popular mushroom in the Funghoul world, rich in umami ingredients. Even mushrooms that are thrown at you taste delicious. Its popularity does not make it arrogant, and its down-to-earth nature is also one of its charms. It has topped the ranking of mushrooms people want to become for three consecutive years.
jiatick: Lunatick has adapted to the crystallizing light emitted by the Jia Kut Clan, and attacks with abilities and ferocity far surpassing those of the original monster. After transforming into a mineral lifeform, his prized eyes have become even more powerful and shining. It's said that just being exposed to his gaze can send tingling sensations through one's body.
jiademon: A Demon steward that has adapted to the crystallizing light emitted by the Jia Kut Clan, it attacks with abilities and ferocity far surpassing those of its original monster. Apparently, he came to pay his respects to Belfggor, who was his superior when he was a regular Demon Steward. He is grateful to the Jia Kut Clan.
rayFinnedSahuagin: A cool, sharp-edged merman with striped patterns. He is proud of his jagged dorsal fin, which scratches anyone who touches it. Why stripes? Stripes are cool! Are you complaining? Come outside, damn it!
duneStalker: A destructive weapon with enhanced dust-proofing functions intended for carrying out operations in the desert. His green mono-eye shining on the horizon signifies death. In order to protect the internal structure from sandstorms, the gaps between parts are so perfectly aligned that it is said to be a pain to disassemble for maintenance.
woolmaulus: The shorn wool was blown away by the wind and gathered together, and the grudge of the naked sheep took hold of it, turning it into a monster. Its fluffy fur is connected, and if it were all untangled, it would be long enough to easily circle Astoltia three times.
dragnoir: A juvenile jet-black dragon that bears the resemblance of a mighty dragon. The whole party suffers with his shimmering breath. When an old Dragnoir is crowned with a golden crest, it will be feared as a dragon with power that is equal to that of a god.
twisticider: A child of the clouds whose body contains a special gas that crackles and pops. Its breath is freezing and stimulating. They often invite their friends over and dance together, twisting their bodies. Apparently it's fun to hear the gas in their bodies popping.
jadewarrior: A troublesome demonic flame warrior who seeks to burn the world to ashes. He attacks using a combination of Acid Breath and flame bullets. When the sacred tree was cut down by scoundrels and put on fire, an evil flame sparkling like a jewel flared up and gave birth to demons.
cottoncloud: A delicious-looking monster with a sweet fragrance emanating from its fluffy body. However, underestimating it could pose a nasty surprise. Because of its sweet scent and appearance, it was often tried by adventurers, which was a source of trouble for it, so it learned the technique of disappearing.
leghornEmperor: A user of scorching flames worthy of his bright red tail feathers, he has laid many adventurers to rest with Kasizzle. Because its body color is similar to that of certain livestock, the protrusion on its head is often mistaken for a crest. However, if you look closely, you will see that it is actually a horn, so don't make that mistake.
silhoubaron: A noble shadow monster with a noble title. His features are magnificent and handsome, and his gaze is filled with compassion for his subjects...or so it seems. In fact, he was a low-ranking noble. Due to his excellence, he was well-liked by the king and was the object of jealousy from the higher-ranking nobles, which made him haggard from the stress...or so it seems.
deadorian: A shield-wielding specialist who can perform a variety of techniques with the spiked shields he holds in both hands. His motto is "offense is the best defense." It's called that because it looks like that, but I'm careful about the smell. It's okay. It doesn't smell bad.
bloodape: A giant monkey with wings reminiscent of a flying dragon. With its powerful arms, it can easily throw boulders taller than itself. His scary name can easily lead to misunderstandings, but he was born with red fur. He's sick and tired of people worrying that its blood spurting out of his body.
bloodcorn: A sinister crimson incarnation of corn. It uses its Hurt Converter to suck out the adventurer's vitality and weaken them. He is particularly particular about the dyed black beard on his head, and apparently spends half a day styling it to look just like that.
kuroganeGiant: A giant with a body of steel forged by first-class craftsmen, a blow from his lustrous black fists can shatter even a stone wall. Kurogane means iron. In short, it is an iron giant, but it is hollow inside because it would be too heavy if it was made entirely of iron.
vividoai: A gigantic stone head painted in brilliant colors. The overwhelming sense of color dazzles and confuses the viewer. When he was young, he was just a stone, but he wanted to change his plain self, so he transformed into something flashy, and he is a hard worker who successfully changed his image by honing his skills.
fluzula: A mysterious monster that appears suddenly without a sound and eats humans. It is said that attacks other than the black spear are ineffective against it... The sturdy castle is a miraculous haven for the people of Zenias, but to the Fluzula, it is nothing more than a farm for prey.
wightRuler: After a painful and painful life, this monarch wanders forever in order to inflict the drudgery of death on all living things. "We're cursing the world with the slogan "no curse, no life," but we're not even living in the first place!" she says, waiting to be teased.
purplanary: A bird fascinated by darkness, who has only mastered techniques and spells related to darkness. He believes in being cool and stylish. I have directed characters who live in the darkness, but I am worried that their comical appearance is making it difficult to get the role I want. I am now considering changing my approach.
jellyfishKid: A completely different species of jellyfish monster from the Man o' war. It is called a boy, but it seems to be already an adult. It is surprisingly firm for a jellyfish, but when you press it, it has just the right amount of elasticity, and it is said that using it as a pillow makes for a very good night's sleep.
whitecorn: She is a woman of beauty and dignity who is highly regarded even among the madam community. Even her attack methods are sweet and gorgeous, making her the ultimate madam. She is also famous as a gem collector, and the gems scattered by Gorgeous Rain are only a small part of them. Is her rival Sage Marine?
bourgeoisHand: Rings with expensive jewels and I wore a famous brand bracelet to see this. A nasty rich monster. I'm dissatisfied with not being able to wear ornaments such as earrings and pendants, so I'm spending money today to relieve the stress.
scarabelina: With a shell that has a poisonous color scheme, it is the ominous creature of the beetle world. It also has the same attack methods as other beetles, sucking blood and poisoning it. Due to her naturally flashy appearance, she plays the role of a scoundrel, but deep down, she is a coward and an earnest person, which causes her to accumulate stress on a daily basis.
darktor: He entered the path of faith, but was unable to endure the training, and was taken over by the darkness and turned into a monster. His purpose in life is to cause failure in the training of Priests. As a person, he was a former Priest, but it seems he became accustomed to the waters of the dark world, and as a monster he was reborn as a high-ranking priest.
macely: The remains of a corrupted soul who wields Funereal Force and seeks to pass judgment on his enemies with Kaswoosh, granting them the peace of death. From the moment he was born, he knew no love, hated people, cursed the world, and rebelled against God's grace, devoting himself to evil deeds, but he lost his life as a result of divine punishment.
kylla: A protector of the pyramid and one of Baramos's underlings. When a certain coworker slacks off, the glare it gives would cause other monsters to cower in fear.
phantasm: Despicable spirits that turned Theddon into a village of death. They grow stronger each day by gorging on the anguish of any wandering souls they can catch.
ashdemon: A demon of some distinction with a body of purest silver. Bombards its enemies with a wide array of abilities enabled by its elevated intellect.}}
lightmour: A trial monster that stands in front of the brave and the Great Demon King who visit Grand Zenus's Trial Grounds. It has the power of God. I designed the shield myself. When I look at the ephemeral maiden's profile, my heart, which should not exist, is pounding.
shadowmour: A trial monster that stands in front of the brave and the Great Demon King who visit Grand Zenus's Trial Grounds. It has the power of the devil. I designed the weapon myself. The heart, which should not exist in a large and cool weapon, is hot and hot.
monochromour: A trial monster that stands in front of the brave and the Great Demon King who visit Grand Zenus's Trial Grounds. It has the power of God and Devil. I'm curious about the left half of the Lightmour that should have been left over when I created myself and the right half of the Shadowmour.
gentledevil: The Gentledevil is also in the Monster Gentleman's Record. The dance is colorful, gorgeous, and teaches us what it means to be a gentleman. Silhoubaron, the same Rarefied monster, is a best friend, but the meeting was a duel for each other's honor.
mummycanth: It is an ancient fish that has become a zombie, but it is unclear whether it is a fish that became a zombie long ago or whether it is a living ancient fish that has recently become a zombie. They call themselves "dead fossils", not "living fossils", which would technically make them plain fossils, but do not point this out to them, they get upset.
hikuinadon: A ferocious and colorful monster bird that can follow a group of Apeckalypses running. The most violent food, the three violent extremes, it has a reputation as the twilight of the world. There are also rumors that it is a mixed species of Firebird and Forest peckerel. When it appears with Apeckalypse, it is Mayutsuba.
giraffgoon: It is said that a chosen giraffe, born with a probability of once every 100 years, will gain the power of the dragon when it survives to be 1000 years old. When he lived as a giraffe, he was not ashamed to be naked, but as soon as he transformed into a dragon and gained intelligence, he quickly put on clothes.
tricerathon: As Drag Racer continues to run, the body temperature continues to rise. A rare species with flushed skin, it's burning hot when you touch it. It's a habit to practice bumping. When their eyes meet, they rush forward. I'm being avoided by my friends. No one can stop him anymore.
icieye: Born in a cave in the snowy mountains, he prefers dark and cold places. He's a nasty creature who finds travelers, puts them to sleep, and freezes them. When they lived in the snowy mountains, they moved around by crossing icicles, but when spring came, the icicles melted and they would slip and fall.
madderMerman: A monster met on the rocks where the Mermaids like to sun themselves. It's particularly proud of its bright red body
octopest: Underlings of Mariella's met in the Mermaids' Sanctuary. Having spent their whole lives in the sea, they had never seen humans before, and judged them to be extremely funny-looking creatures indeed.
midnightManguini: An underling of Belial's met at the Dragonlord's Castle. While it judges all non-monsters to be beneath it, little does it know that it's looked down upon itself by the higher-ups in the monster hierarchy.
boatBorer: Among the creepiest of creepy-crawlies, they keep the sea free of flotsam by boring their way through the bottoms of boats, then eating everyone and everything inside
goyling: An underling of Belial's met at the Dragonlord's Castle. Smaller than most of its associates, but actually more important-although still but a lowly pawn in its masters' game.
coldBoulder: Lumps of ice that slowly became sentient over the centuries. So incredibly cold that if you threw one into a lake, the water would freeze almost instantaneously.
neanderdrohl: Precursors of the land-bound drohls we know today. Also known as 'olden drohls'.
shiningArmour: An underling of Mariella's met in her mysterious seabed base. It was sick of its mistress's selfishness, and looking to be posted elsewhere.
hornipillar: Mixed in with the Killerpillar, although it is a larva of Dread admiral. By putting out horns, I can't help but appeal to the difference. Horn, which I'm going to drink, seems to smell good. It seems that it only led to the result of being targeted by Yokei.
towerFlyingDragon: Sad monsters born within the Tower of Lost Creation are destined to prey on each other. Their grudges become the food for the gigantic Loss Waves. The dragons in the tower are in a very tense situation. Don't be jealous just because you can't fly! Even if you had wings, you still can't get out of the tower.
whiteGeneral: General Kacrack, who leads the army of the dead, freezes the enemy who stands up with a fast slash and leads them to death. Apparently, in order to be able to handle four weapons at once, he trained using a knife, fork, spoon, and even chopsticks.
hellboundPendulum: An ominous monster with a purchase that makes those who see it unhappy. There was nothing that was safe when I saw the contents of the suspiciously glowing hood. It is said that his hobby is to shake his body by dowsing, and his ability to find veins and things he is also said to be out of a hundred.
kaiserSlime: A huge slime who surpassed the king and gained the title of emperor. The dignified voice turns into a loud breath and attacks the opponent. As expected, even King Slime is afraid to miss in front of Kaiville. I think it's a little easy to be afraid of everyone.
saltDragonia: A human-shaped monster with a dragon factor. He has absolute confidence in swordsmanship and defeats enemies with three-dimensional movements that make use of his jumping power. I don't know if it's because of the name, but I like salty things. I always hold a small bottle of salt and sprinkle it on sweet fruits.
seventhKingdomRemnantSoldier: A humanoid weapon of the Galiante Kingdom that once existed. Starting to move again with the power of the Atma Stone, we are now fighting to protect the dead kingdom. I am very heartbroken because all the large humanoid weapons I relied on as a force have been broken.
blazingSkelegon: The dragon, resurrected by vengeful spirit despite being consumed by scorching flames, still has bones that are glowing red and boiling at high temperatures. The thirst that attacks me all the time, no matter how much water I drink, can ever quench. Is there no salvation for this cursed soul?
orcGuard: An elite warrior with a sense of mission who has improved his combat skills with the guardian of the orc tribe. I don't like being told that I'm conscious. By acquiring a spell from ordinary orcs as an existence on Kumono, the distance has been placed.
zomfish: He turned into a zombie because he accidentally ate another zombie that fell into the water. Be careful about eating things you find on the ground. Since I was already dead, eating poison wouldn't be a problem. And as I consumed poison, I learned poison spells.
thanksalotBarroth: It has green eyes and covers itself in treasure along with mud on a gold-colored shell. In addition it has treasure chests, a pile of gold, and a flag with the respective Monster Hunter Explore anniversary number on the top of its head.
bOWUragaan: B.O.W. Uragaan looks exactly like Pumpkin Uragaan, but with red eyes and a dark purple aura similar to Frenzy Apex monsters.
yianKutKu: The Yian Kut-Ku is characterized by its large, fan-like ear frills that unfurl when excited and enlarged lower bill. They have a large, yellow beak with a pink stripe running central down the length of the upper beak. The lower jaw of its beak is significantly larger and bulkier than the top jaw. Yian Kut-Ku's body is covered in orange-pink plating and beige scales. Its wing membranes are deep blue and its eyes are bright yellow. These wyverns are small and relatively light, making them quick and agile. They have an extremely powerful sense of hearing, thanks to the large frills circling their ears.
gypceros: Gypceros is among the largest and heaviest known Bird Wyverns. Its most notable features are the lamp-like crest on top of its head and a rubbery, shock-resistant hide. It has a long pink tail with a bulbous tip, and is a uniform blue-grey across most of its body. It possesses a poison sac which allows it to produce toxic fluids for use against attackers.
blueYianKutKu: Although they are usually smaller than their pink counterparts, they are stronger and more aggressive. They are covered in an indigo carapace, and blue streaks can be found on its beak and ears.
cephalos: Cephalos' body shapes are streamlined and flat, to help them swim through the sand. They have a vaguely hammer-shaped head, with eyes that face upwards. Their brown and beige coloration helps them camouflage themselves among the desert sands.
bullfango: Bullfango are large boar-like quadrupeds. Mainly covered in brown fur, they have whitish underbellies along with darker grayish tufts on their heads and backs. Jutting out from their backs are two rows of boney spikes. Their heads have a pair of small pointy ears, a long pointed snout, and a pair of large tusks that stretch out forward and curve upwards at the tip.
rathian: Rathian is a medium-sized true flying wyvern similar in looks to her male counterpart, Rathalos. Her hide is a dull, muted green in contrast to the Rathalos's deep red, and her lower mandible features a long, protruding chin spike. Her upper back and wingtips are covered in a moss-like fur not seen on the Rathalos, and while her clubbed tail lacks bony spikes, it makes up for this with the presence of sharp and highly poisonous needles, which she can use to poison foes upon contact.
velociprey: These monsters resemble dromaeosaurid dinosaurs .They have blue scales with black stripes, a dull red crest on their heads, yellow eyes, and a white belly. These carnivorous monsters travel in packs and inhabit many different environments.
velocidrome: The large, bright red crest over its blue hide signifies to other Velociprey that it is fit to be their leader.
khezu: Khezu are large, pale Wyverns with a flabby, rubbery hide which they constantly keep damp, similar to that of an amphibian. Many of their blood vessels and veins can be seen through their pale skin. Their tail features a specialized orifice which bonds to the ground during electrical attacks and helps them cling onto cave ceilings. Their mouth features rows of sharp teeth similar to that of leeches. Khezu feet lack claws, and instead have suction pad-like toes to assist them in climbing and hanging from cave walls and ceilings. Spending most of their lives in the dark, their eyes have regressed greatly, though they make up for this with a superb sense of smell. A layer of fat helps to keep them warm and prolong the time they can spend hunting for food. Khezu have an extendable neck which allows them to grasp and ambush prey from afar, such as from a cave ceiling. Khezu are hermaphrodites, which means an individual is both male and female. To reproduce they paralyze a creature and inject their young, known as Whelps. The Whelps grow inside their victim until it dies, or when they are strong enough to leave.
kelbi: Kelbi are small deer-like creatures that pose very little threat, although they have longer tails. They are usually either green (male) or blue (female or juvenile). Males have large, prominent horns, with some individuals having massive, curved horns. These large specimens are often referred to as a Kelbidrome. Females are smaller and have stunted horns. Interestingly, their horns are used in medicine and are said to cure many diseases.
redKhezu: The Red Khezu is covered in a fatty, blood-red hide. It has greater control over its extendable neck than the common species and possesses a more potent thunder sac.
bulldrome: Bulldromes have larger tusks than Bullfango, and a layer of white fur, as opposed to Bullfango's black fur. Bulldromes are more agile when running and proficient at finding and locking onto their victims.
pinkRathian: Pink Rathian has a more heavily-armored body and has greater health and attack power than her green relative. She can often be found in various quests alongside her gender counterpart, the Azure Rathalos.
genprey: Their bodies are covered in a colorful yellow and green hide, with a pair of yellow crests over their eyes.
gendrome: Hunters can easily identify a Gendrome by their big crest and slightly larger size compared to a Genprey. The crest signifies leadership over the pack.
aptonoth: Aptonoth are cow-like creatures with leathery gray skin. They have black stripes along their backs and a head reminiscent of a Hadrosaur. They have a large crest protruding from their heads and a flat, spiked tail. The males are larger in size and have four horns upon their crest, while the females are smaller and only have two horns on their crest.
felyne: Felynes resemble bipedal cats and are capable of human language. They typically have light fur, but can come in a variety of colors and patterns.
daimyoHermitaur: Daimyo Hermitaur has a large, crab-like body. It is covered in a red and white carapace and wears the skull of a Monoblos as a protective shell. It has broad, shield-like claws and long antennae.
apceros: Apceros are herbivorous reptiles that frequent desert and volcanic areas. They have a body structure similar to Aptonoth, their evolutionary cousins. They have many characteristics of tortoises, such as head shape and a protective shell. Their tails have a developed mace-like structure on the end that is covered with sharp spikes.
vespoid: Vespoids are yellow-and-purple wasp-like insects roughly the size of a housecat. They have barbed stingers at the end of their abdomens, and fly using two pairs of wings.
hermitaur: Hermaitaur are hermit crab-like monsters with red carapaces and a thick white shell. The shell is grown by the crab itself; only when they grow much larger, into a Daimyo Hermitaur, will they replace it with a Monoblos skull, or into a Black Diablos skull if they grow into the Plum Daimyo Hermitaur. Hermitaurs are related to the Ceanataur, a blue Carapaceon that lives in Volcanic regions.
popo: Popo is a type of large muskox-like Herbivore that resembles a woolly Toxodon or a yak in its body structure. They are covered in long and fluffy fur to protect them from the cold. The fur is a dark brown in color with a lighter cream color along the top of their body. This fur also covers their eyes, preventing them from ever been seen and they have long droopy ears. Both male and female Popo have two large tusks that protrude from their faces and curl up slightly at the end. Male Popo are larger than the females in size and they have larger tusks.
qurupeco: The Qurupeco resembles a large bird with Pterosaur-like features, such as a fanged beak and leathery wings. It is mainly lime green with some scales being tinted yellow, it also has a clump of iridescent purple feathers on its back between its shoulders. The Qurupeco has a short, stubby brown crest extending from the back of its head. The Qurupeco's soft crest stretches over the top of its head and when calling opens out into the shape of a megaphone, amplifying its calls. Its most notable feature however is its bright red vocal sac which inflates when calling, similar to a frigatebird.
altaroth: An interesting note about the Altaroth is that they can absorb mushrooms, berries, and other resources into the sacs on their backs. When hunters kill an Altaroth in this state, they will drop a shiny item depending on what they have absorbed. This can be taken to an advantage; if a hunter were to intercept and collect the resource the Altaroth was heading for, before the Altaroth reaches their target, the Altaroth will move on, and can be forced to consume one specific type of plant or mushroom. The hunter can then kill the Altaroth to gain the item dropped. The swelling of their sacs is indicated by different colors depending on what they have eaten.
royalLudroth: It has a crown-like crest composed of several finger-like appendages tipped with black spikes as well as a large, spongey yellow mane. The Royal Ludroth has a long, serpentine body with four squat limbs. Its hind pair of legs are shaped like paddles for swimming, and its foremost pair are more muscular, tipped with developed digits ending in long black claws. Its jaws are lined with shear-like plates in the place of teeth.
ludroth: Ludroth are mostly yellow-green in coloration, with long, sinewy bodies that enable swift and sweeping underwater movements to confuse their prey. Their claws are stubby, but effective, their strong tails end in reinforced bony segments, and their powerful jaws grant then moderately strong bites.
bnahabra: Bnahabra are similar to the Vespoid from previous generations. Bnahabra fly in a similar fashion and can also cause paralysis with their stingers. There are various subspecies of the Bnahabra which vary between the regions, each with distinctly colored wings. Bnahabra are often seen attached to the sides of the walls seemingly lifeless, until a hunter is close enough - then they fly away or attack.
arzuros: Arzuros is noted for its turquoise colored fur and ursine body structure. It has a ridge of erect hair aligned with its nose. Its back is made of a tough hide, somewhat characteristic of a carapace. Hair runs from its cheeks, connecting to its back, where it forms a trim along the sides of the back. The claws of an Arzuros have elongated, red nails. Each claw has a tough brace encasing and protecting the wrist and forearm. Arzuros has large, bulky legs connected to much smaller feet and a short, wide tail.
lagombi: Lagombi resembles a mix between a wombat, a bear, and a rabbit. Its ears are long and highly sensitive, and its face features a beak-like mouth along with small red eyes. Lagombi's belly is made of a low-friction material and is shaped so that it can slide upon the ice like a sled. It is covered in a thick fur coat to keep it warm in its sub-zero homeland.
slagtoth: Slagtoth (resembling the real-world Pachyrhinosaurus) have a green, saggy hide covering most of their body, most notably drooping near the sides of the head and along their flanks. They have a pale yellow underbelly and a black nasal boss and nose.
nerscylla: Nerscylla physically resembles a real life arachnid, but is much larger in size. Its body is mainly white, with dark blue and gray markings around its joints and orange hairs on its appendages and abdomen. Its front claws are a bright orange, whereas its other claws are a dark brown.
konchu: Konchu have hard shells and can roll into a ball and attack in groups for protection, although they are still frequently preyed upon by Yian Kut-Ku and Yian Garuga.
zamite: Zamite are small, shark-like creatures with relatively large mouths that house many rows of sharp teeth. They have been observed in various stages of development. Some have fully developed legs, while others slide on their bellies.
zamtrios: Zamtrios is a large, quadrupedal monster with grey-blue skin and yellow fins. It is superficially shark-like in appearance, with a long, pointed snout and a mouth filled with multiple rows of sharp teeth. Zamtrios is sometimes seen encased in an ice-like armor, which forms many spines and horns all over its body. As the adult form of Zamite, its limbs are powerful and fully-developed. Its skin is extremely elastic in order to accommodate its inflation abilities.
shroudedNerscylla: It is very similar to its common counterpart; however, its body is a dark gray with white stripes and purple markings, its underside and spikes are a bright yellow, its hairs are a light turquoise, and its front claws are pink. Instead of a Gypceros hide, Shrouded Nerscylla wears a Khezu hide.
yianGaruga: Yian Garuga has is largely grey and purple in colour, possessing large defensive spikes, and an extremely tough shell. Its beak is sharp and jagged, and it possesses a silver mane around the edge of its face. Aside from all of that, its morphology is very similar to its close relative, Yian Kut-Ku, with a similar beak and ear frills, albeit different in many ways. Its beak is longer. Its ears are more skinny and wicked. It has three large, poisonous spikes on its tail.
cephadrome: The Cephadrome has yellow eyes, yellow or pink fins and blue or purple scale covered skin. This skin appears brownish black due to sand covering their body. They and their minions have a flat, diamond-shaped head (much like a hammerhead shark or a Diplocaulus, an extinct prehistoric amphibian), fins, and tail, which helps propel them through the sand.
rathalos: Rathalos are large, bipedal wyverns with a spiny, armored hide covering their body. Their outer shell features much brighter and more vibrant colors than that of their female counterpart, the Rathian. It is primarily bright red, with black markings throughout. Like the Rathian, Rathalos possess a flame sac which is used to produce deadly flaming projectiles from the mouth. The talons upon their feet are highly poisonous and are known to inflict toxic mortal wounds on larger prey. In addition, their long, thick tail features a heavy spiked club at the end. Rathalos' wing membranes feature ornate patterns which are likely used to attract potential mates.
azureRathalos: Azure Rathalos is a Subspecies of Rathalos, and thus, it shares almost all of the same characteristics. However, its shell that is usually fiery red is now an azure color, hence the Azure title. Its wing webbing is lime green, and its tail has one single red spike on the end. It has higher stamina, higher health and higher attack power, and is considerably more aggressive.
diablos: Diablos are large, bipedal wyverns with powerful armor plating covering much of their body. Their most noteworthy feature is a pair of massive, solid bull-like horns above their red eyes. Diablos also possess a pair of tusk-like fangs and a large, spiny neck frill. Their tail ends with a heavy, studded club that can be used to ward off attackers. Diablos stand on a pair of stocky, wide-set legs and possess a broad upper body complete with thick, muscular wings.
tigrex: Tigrex is a large, quadrupedal wyvern characterized by its massive T-rex head and jaws, powerful limbs with large wings, and striking yellow/blue striped coloration. The top of its head is tipped with a pair of horn-like ears, and its segmented tail ends with a spiny protrusion.
ioprey: Ioprey have lithe, raptor-esque bodies. They have vivid red skin, with some black markings and purplish lavender colouration by the limbs.
iodrome: It is significantly larger than normal Ioprey and possesses a larger crest. Unlike other pack leaders, Iodrome has a more amphibian look, with salamander-like skin that seems to glisten with moisture, and a frog-like throat sac. It also lacks the sharp claws of its relatives, relying more on poison to bring down prey like Aptonoth and enemies.
purpleGypceros: As the name suggests, rather than gray and pink as seen on a common Gypceros, the Purple Gypceros has a vivid purple hide and green tail.
blackDiablos: The designation as a subspecies is somewhat of a misnomer, as Black Diablos are simply female Diablos in heat. Their shell turns black during mating season to warn other monsters of their heightened aggression and hostility. It is not possible for a Black Diablos to be male.
congalala: It resembles a giant, tailed gorilla with pink fur, a hippo-like head, and long front claws. The spike on its head is actually hair that the Congalala has smoothed into shape to signify that they are the pack leader. Congalalas are surprisingly intelligent beasts. Its long tail can curl at the end when holding mushrooms.
blackGravios: Although considered a subspecies, Black Gravios is actually a common Gravios whose shell has undergone a chemical change due to an abnormally high body temperature, making it closer to a Variant classification. As the name suggests, Black Gravios is covered in a black hide with red spines. They are also larger and heavier than the common Gravios.
conga: They resemble pink gorillas with a face of a hippopotamus, black underbellies and have a blonde patch of hair on top of their head.
greatThunderbug: Despite their name, each Great Thunderbug is actually a colony of Thunderbugs, and their electricity causes them to appear as spheres of blue light.
shakalaka: Shakalaka are small, humanoid creatures with green skin. They wear a mask over their heads at all times, so their true faces are unknown.
nargacuga: It is a panther-like Flying Wyvern with a quadruped built. It has black scales, black fur and nightmarish red eyes, giving it the look and style of a predatory black panther. Its dark, feral appearance suggests that it may mainly be a nocturnal predator. This wyvern has been sighted within the Great Forest at both night and daytime, the Jungle, and also the Old Swamp. When it's in Rage Mode, its eyes glow bright red and leave a trail of reddish lines when Nargacuga moves. Also, its tail erects large spikes which can be flung and linked up with its attacks for devastating hits. Their vertebrae and tail muscles are extremely flexible, making the tail of Nargacuga also prehensile. Its tail is also its most powerful weapon. The scales at the end of the tail can also be shaken to produce rattling sounds similar to that of a rattlesnake.
emeraldCongalala: In addition to its green and white colouration, it has a large beard and a taller hair spike than the normal Congalala. It can also produce greater amounts of gas, and farts even more often than the normal Congalala.
jaggi: At this stage of their lives, Jaggi are mostly pink, with purple foreclaws, back-stripe, and head-frills, and with cream-colored underbellies. Their tails are barbed along the length of the appendage, and they sport sizable frills like the frilled lizard sprouting from behind their jaws, possibly for making themselves look bigger to other monsters.
jaggia: Jaggia are the females of the Jaggi species. They are noticeably larger and bulkier than the immature males, and are mostly a blue-purple in hue, the exceptions being orange areas along their limbs and the sides of their necks and cream-colored underbellies. Their tails, unlike males of the species, have no barbs, and instead have a soft feather-like hanging accent near their ends. Their frills, located behind their jaws, are also more subdued than in other Jaggi variations, and hang limply.
barroth: Barroth is a large, bipedal monster characteristic of the Brute Wyvern class. It is noted for the large crown structure atop its skull, which houses its nostrils. Its body is covered in rigid plates that help protect it from the harsh desert environment. Barroth possesses a pair of small red eyes and a mouthful with numerous long, peg-shaped teeth.
uragaan: Uragaan is covered in a lustrous gold-colored hide. Its back is lined with hard crystals and its chin is plated with a rock-like shell, suggesting the Uragaan has evolved a tough exterior due to life in volcanic regions. Its underbelly is covered in a sticky, tar-like substance which it uses to affix explosive rocks to itself.
agnaktor: Agnaktor is in many ways similar to Lagiacrus; both are quadrupedal Leviathans of similar size and body shape.
plumDaimyoHermitaur: Unlike the common Daimyo Hermitaur, this subspecies sports a purple and white carapace, and wears a Diablos skullshell instead of a Monoblos skullshell. Unlike its red counterpart, the Plum Daimyo Hermitaur is weak against Ice, rather than Thunder. The horns on its shell can be broken, just like those of a Diablos.
deviljho: Deviljho is a very large, bipedal Brute Wyvern characterized by its uniform forest green coloration and muscular upper body. Its thick hide is littered with short, jagged spines that reach a maximum height along the back and tail. Deviljho has a narrow snout with a large lower jaw, covered in multiple rows of teeth spreading outwards from the mouth. It has massive, powerful hind legs, but tiny, poorly developed forelegs that it rarely utilizes. When enraged, Deviljho's back and shoulder muscles swell considerably revealing scars. During this period, areas of its skin will take on a bright red coloration.
uroktor: Just like their adult form, the Agnaktor, they have the remarkable ability to tunnel through solid volcanic rock. Uroktor are distinguished by their reddish-purple skin, which protects them from both the sweltering heat and volcanic predators.
baggi: Baggi resemble small theropod dinosaurs called dromaeosaurs. Their hide is primarily blue, with a grayish underbelly and a streak of yellow between. Patches of black fur can be found on the back of the head, above the shoulders, and especially the tail.
greatJaggi: Great Jaggi's distinctive feature is its frill and the lavender scales with the crimson and tangerine overrides on the frills and the abdomen part, but also the furs that grow on its neck and along the back down to the middle tip of the tail.
gargwa: Gargwa are flightless birds that closely resemble the extinct Dodo bird, cause they both have very small, likely vestigial wings. Like most species of Herbivore, they're normally docile creatures, but will attack and flee when they're threatened and when they flee will usually leave an egg or guano. They coexist with the people of Yukumo village as livestock, but they have been known to attack Hunters from time to time.
zinogre: Zinogre is a quadrupedal monster with superficially lupine features. It has highly developed limbs, sharp fangs and claws. Its body is covered in turquoise scales, whitish fur, and tan bony spikes, and it has two prominent horns. Closer observation of its horns and the spikes on its back reveal that they are porous, presumably for hosting Thunderbugs when the monster charges itself.
bruteTigrex: Brute Tigrex features a darker, more muted color palette of various shades of grey, brown, and beige. It apparently possesses a more robust set of lungs than the common species, as evidenced by its increased roaring capacity. It has a more powerful set of forelimbs, and has adapted to live in harsher environments than any other variety of Tigrex.
crimsonQurupeco: Unlike the normal variety, this subspecies is red and blue in color. The electric flints are unique to this subspecies.
jadeBarroth: Known as Ice Crushing Wyverns, they cover themselves in snow for protection, in much the same way Barroth cover themselves in mud. The Jade Barroth's crown is also somewhat larger than its desert cousin.
purpleLudroth: The purple coloring is due to the large amounts of toxins stored in its body. It has pale, grey skin and bright orange claws and spikes.
greenNargacuga: This subspecies is covered in mossy green fur. Its long, prehensile tail ends in a bright red spike, and its eyes are a bright yellow.
ivoryLagiacrus: It sports a briny white body, unlike the usual blue of Lagiacrus. In addition, the various knobs, spines and horns on its body are a deep blue, compared to the common Lagiacrus's brown and orange.
kechaWacha: Kecha Wacha is a lemur-like monster with long arms and hook-like fingers and claws. It has bright yellow fur and blue skin. It can fold its spiked ears over its face, forming a "mask" that is likely used to intimidate would-be attackers. It also sports a tube-like trunk and large, forward-facing eyes.
rubyBasarios: The most notable feature of this species of Basarios is the assortment of pink crystals protruding from all over its back, suggesting a considerable variation in its diet compared to its rocky cousin. Its body is also heavily covered in moss, due to it living in a vegetation-rich environment.
ashKechaWacha: In contrast to the bright orange pelt of the normal species, it has a washed blueish fur with black coloration on the hands, feet and head. The mask on its ears has a yellow-orange pattern on a dark background.
greatDracophageBug: Great Dracophage Bugs, similar to their Great Thunderbug relatives, are charged with Dragon energy. While clouds of the bugs exist by themselves, they tend to follow around Stygian Zinogres, aiding them during combat in symbiotic exchange for living safely in its fur like regular Dracophage Bugs.
kirin: Kirin resembles a unicorn, though a closer look reveals that it has a lion-like face and is covered in scales, rather than a coat. It has a mane of fur as well as a bushy tail tip. Tufts of fur run down its shoulders and above its hoofs. It has crimson eyes and black stripe-like markings along its sides and legs. Its majestic white mane and hair stand on end, as if charged with static. The monster often crackles with stray electricity.
monoblos: Monoblos are large wyverns with a brown, rock-hard texture to their carapace, and very closely resemble Diablos. Unlike Diablos however, a Monoblos' head is akin to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ceratopsia Ceratopsian] dinosaurs, mainly a Styracosaurus, featuring a beaked mouth, a long, spiral, and pointed nasal horn, giving it a drill-esque look, and a large frill on the back its head, which, when enraged, gains several red markings. Additionally, it is adorned with spikes of various sizes. Monoblos has a pair of small yellow eyes with vertically slit pupils. Its back also features a frill-like carapace. The tail club is more like a mace compared to a Diablos', lined with four spikes on each side, and a single one at the end.
fatalis: Fatalis closely resembles a traditional European dragon, with a long, serpentine neck and tail, a pair of large bat-like wings, and a body covered in fine, jet-black scales.
whiteMonoblos: White Monoblos features a bright white carapace covering most of its body. As a result, the flushes of blood to its frill when enraged are significantly more striking. Beyond coloration however, it is identical in body structure to the common species.
kushalaDaora: Kushala Daora is a dragon with metallic skin. Its large wings connect at the base of its tail, making them seem even larger in proportion to its body. Two backward curving horns lie on either side of its head, blending in with the spikes that line its back. It has visible wind streaming around its body. Kushala has a slightly reddish nose, possibly a sign of rusting.
teostra: Teostra is a large dragon with leonine features and a fiery red coloration. He has a grand mane, large fangs, and a pair of horns that curve backward. His wings are covered in fur, and its tail ends in a clump of such fur. He is the male counterpart to Lunastra.
rajang: Rajang strongly resembles the Blangonga, a large ape-like beast in appearance and movement. It even borrows some attacks from the Blangonga. However, notable differences include Rajang's broader muscles, large horns, hairy tail tip and its ability to use electricity-based attacks. The Rajang is black in color, while it's eyes are a crimson color, and it's horns are gold. When enraged, much of the fur on their front body rises and becomes gold.
silverRathalos: As a Rathalos rare species, he retains the standard characteristics of the species, although he has some differences. This Rare Species features a shining silver carapace from head to tail with black markings along the spine. He is notably slightly larger than the average Rathalos. After activating its “Incandescent” state, his head, chest, and the area between the neck and wings are lit with blue flames.
goldRathian: As a Rathian rare species, she retains the standard characteristics of the species, although she has some notable differences. Her body is covered in an exceptionally strong golden shell from head to tail; this also makes it difficult to attack without the Hunter's weapon bouncing off. It is notably slightly larger than the average Rathian. After activating her “Incandescent” state, her head, chest, and the area between the neck and wings are covered in blue flames.
barioth: Barioth is a quadrupedal Flying Wyvern, with a head that resembles a saber-toothed cat. Its body is mostly covered with icy white plates and spikes along its neck, spine, and tail. Its face features two massive, curved tusks of an amber coloration. Its forelegs are longer and more powerful than its back legs, with deadly spikes along its wings, as well as three large claws. Barioth's tail is forked and ridged with spikes
sandBarioth: This Subspecies of Barioth has an orange-yellow color scheme with a blood red colored head with deep indigo tusks the tips of which are also blood red.
glacialAgnaktor: Its body is covered in an icy armor covering that works in reverse to the normal Agnaktor, it hardens when it burrows and softens over time. It also appears to have a longer, harder and sharper beak, useful for digging through the ice of the Tundra.
stygianZinogre: Overall, they share the same body structure as a regular Zinogre, albeit with some notable differences. They now sport color schemes of grey, white and red and are typically larger than normal individuals, and in addition are perpetually covered in red bolts made of dragon energy thanks to it bonding with Dracophage Bugs; Fulgar Bugs that feed on dragonfell berries.
oroshiKirin: Unlike the ordinary Kirin, this subspecies's body is mainly a dark navy blue, with violet stripes throughout. Its mane is black with light purple tips and its eyes are a luminous red. In addition, its horn is larger, has pink-ish color and features a spiraling ridge from base to tip.
moltenTigrex: Molten Tigrex features a striking blood red coloration interspersed with bright blue spines and claws. It is slightly larger than the other two varieties of Tigrex.
seregios: Seregios is a medium-sized bipedal wyvern covered in lustrous gold scales. Its face features red markings around the eyes which continue along its body, its head being topped with a single, backwards-curving horn. Its feet are zygodactyl in nature, with two toes facing forward and two toes facing backward. Each of Seregios's scales can swivel individually as it will use them to perform a rattling display when agitated.
kumashira: Kumashira has a bear-like appearance and closely resembles the Arzuros. Its fur is black. Two red spots on its cheeks give it a jovial appearance. Its muzzle is white, and its tongue is constantly hanging out. Like the Arzuros, it has splints with spikes on its front legs.
plesioth: Plesioth are bipedal monsters with a wyvern-esque body structure. They have webbed feet and a paddle-like tail, and are covered in shiny, fish-like scales. Their mouth is filled with shark-like teeth, and their eyes glow a bright yellow. Their head and back feature large fins which can fold in and out at will.
greenPlesioth: Green Plesioth is identical in body structure to the common species. It differs greatly in coloration however, featuring deep green scales along with white and purple striped spines and fins.
duramboros: Duramboros is a bulky, heavyset, bovine monster with stocky, muscular legs and a thick upper body. It features a very thick outer hide that is riddled with heavy folds, with a row of armored plates running along its back and tail. Duramboros' most distinctive features include its massive tail club, twin brow horns, and a pair of energy-rich dorsal humps. Duramboros' slow lifestyle often results in a layer of moss and algae growing upon its hide, most noticeably along the back.
tetsucabra: Tetsucabra is a large Amphibian with a striking orange and indigo coloration. Its lower jaw harbors large tusks along with a large set of molars that are capable of crushing prey with ease. Tetsucabra also has a spiky stubby tail that swells up when angered.
seltas: Seltas is a large, mantis like insectoid with a brightly-colored, highly resistant exoskeleton, which is covered in spines and knobs. He has six legs, the foremost pair are armored and weaponized for combat, and a pair of collapsible wings. His head is hidden beneath a large, armored canopy that extends far beyond the rest of his upper body. He has a large bee-like stinger. He has a pair of compound eyes and powerful slicing mandibles. Seltas is the male counterpart to the Seltas Queen.
seltasQueen: The Seltas Queen is a very large, beetle-like Neopteron with an armor-like exoskeleton covering its body. She is primarily a lustrous green color, but also features beige stripes and orange spines. She has six limbs, four of which make contact with the ground, the other two being used for digging and grasping prey. In addition, she has a long, segmented tail with a large pincer-like structure at the end. Seltas Queen is the female counterpart to Seltas, although she is physically very different.
desertSeltasQueen: She has a brownish olive-green shell and a narrower tail pincer than that of the common species. Her eyes are bright green like those of the Desert Seltas.
larinoth: Larinoth is a distinctively big monster, compared to other Herbivores and even many large monsters. It possesses a great height, which is mostly attributed to its extremely lengthy neck. The tail is rounded and club-like, with spiked plating that runs along the back and up to the crest on its head. Said plating is nearly entirely green, and the underbelly is a creamy color.
gammoth: Gammoth resembles a real-life woolly mammoth. She is by far the largest Fanged Beast known to date. The fur covering her huge body is mostly bluish, although it's also white and red on her trunk, legs, back and underside. The fur on each side of her shape up to resemble an eye. She has brown plating covering most of her head and feet, as well as two tusks seemingly made of the same material. This plating is said to be extremely resistant to damage. The underside of her trunk seems to be covered in a scaly hide, and is lined with numerous spikes. Her eyes are small and on the sides of the head. Interestingly, Gammoth is sometimes seen with its legs encased in snow clumps.
mizutsune: Like most other Leviathans, Mizutsune has a long, slender body. However, it is one of the few Leviathans to actually have fur on its body. This dark purple fur covers its chest, underbelly, legs and tail. Its scales are light colored and resemble those of a fish. Its fox-like head has a long snout and is beautifully adorned by many fin-like appendages. These fins are pink with yellow markings, and they can also be seen on its back and tail. Its feet are said to be quite different from other Leviathans, being curved, allowing Mizutsune to move swiftly on land and gaining traction when need to. The females are said to be dull in color with shorter fins and dark black fur.
dreadkingRathalos: Bearing a strong resemblance to normal Rathalos, the Dreadking Rathalos doesn't have many qualities to differentiate itself from them. Despite looking alike, Dreadking Rathalos are overall larger wyverns, with relatively thicker features such as their talons and tail spines. They are also more of a crimson color where the normal Rathalos is red, and their black plating has a noticable iridescent sheen. The patterns on their wings are identical, but in contrast to normal Rathalos, a Dreadking's wings are a darker brown with cream colored markings.
thunderlordZinogre: In its default state, the Thunderlord Zinogre resembles a fully-charged Zinogre. One of its horns is much larger than the other and its scales are green instead of the normal blue. Its fur and claws are a golden colour. The Thunderlord Zinogre crackles with green electricity, which turns to a golden color when it enters its "Ultracharged" state.
silverwindNargacuga: Silverwind Nargacuga appears similar to normal Nargacuga, however similarly to Lucent Nargacuga it has bits of white fur and scales on parts of its body, though in this case the fur is aligned in bright striped patterns. It also has more spikes on its tail which protrude at all times and Silverwind Nargacuga's are often larger than normal ones.
dreadqueenRathian: A Dreadqueen Rathian tends to be bigger than normal Rathian, while also having a purple tint on her scales, as if poison had been seeping through all parts of her body. Poison can be seen secreting from a Dreadqueen's tail whenever she attacks with it.
grimclawTigrex: The Grimclaw Tigrex's forelimbs and head have a blue coloration with visible pulsating veins. When enraged, these veins pulsate red instead of blue, and are also visible on the Tigrex's chest.
hellbladeGlavenus: All Hellblade Glavenus are male as the female are not seen. Hellblade Glavenus resemble a large, enraged Glavenus. In comparison, they have a deep red coloration; their horns and dorsal spines are larger, and blood red in color, and their throat-situated flame sacs and bladelike tails either glow with heat or have a magma-like texture.
bloodbathDiablos: After one of its horns were broken off, a new but severely warped horn grew in its place, while its other horn grew to a massive size. Bloodbath Diablos also has bluish blood covering parts of its body, including its face, wings, and tail.
soulseerMizutsune: All Soulseer Mizutsune are male as the female counterpart are not seen. Soulseer Mizutsune is similar in appearance to the more common Mizutsune, although often noticeably larger in size. The fur across his body and tail is paler. While in combat, it will coat his front claws and tail in a substance that colors them with a deeper reddish hue. His claws are longer as well.
boltreaverAstalos: Boltreaver Astalos has a slight turquoise tint on its scales and shell. Its wing claws, tail pincers, and head crest are all much larger than that of a regular Astalos. In its default state, it has the appearance of a fully charged regular Astalos, although it can charge itself even further and change the color of its electricity from green to blue.
tobiKadachi: Tobi-Kadachi's face resembles a colubrid in appearance with grayish blue scales covering its slim squirrel-like shape. On its back are patches of white fur as well as a bushy tail covered in rows of spikes. Its front limbs also have a few spikes. Tobi-Kadachi's head, claws, back and tail can be wounded. When the monster is fully charged the fur on its back will stand up.
paolumu: Paolumu is a bat-like wyvern that slightly resembles the Honduran white bat. Like said bat species, Paolumu is covered in white fur and has a pink face. Though it is covered in fur, Paolumu also has some brown scales covering its back, underbelly, and tail. The Paolumu has rodent-like buck teeth. This is because its diet consists of the eggs that come from the coral which Paolumu sucks in using its incredible breathing power. Paolumu's head, wings, and tail can be wounded.
legiana: Legiana is a slim, primarily beige and navy-blue colored Flying Wyvern characterized by its leaf-like wingtips and striped skin patterns. Legiana's head is topped with a pair of antenna-like fins which are attached via a thin membrane to the back of its neck. Legiana's membrane enables it to move at extreme speeds and emit chilling winds. It has bright yellow eyes and powerful legs ending in piercing talons. Its face, tail, feet, and wingtips are a dark navy blue, and its body is covered in striped patterns of the same color. The ends of its wings are separated into four distinct flaps which overlap each other when folded, and its tail has three retractable fins on the left, right, and dorsal. Legiana has star-like shapes on the back of its wings. Its back is also dark blue.
nergigante: Nergigante is a dragon with a bristly appearance. It is covered in spikes that constantly regrow as they're broken off. It has two massive horns similar to a bull. The monster's hide is primarily black with purple and orange accents. Nergigante is constantly regenerating its skin as it attacks and is struck by hunters. It will slowly grow white spikes on certain body parts, which harden over time. Hunters must try to break the white spikes before they harden. Once they have hardened, its attacks deal more damage. These spikes are white in color when they regrow, but will turn black if left to harden. Once these spikes have hardened, they will deal more damage to foes and repel attacks.
kulveTaroth: Kulve Taroth is a very large, lizard-like dragon covered in a beautiful golden mantle. This mantle covers its entire body, with an appearance of large blocky scales on its back and a long trailing section down the length of its massive tail. Kulve Taroth's main feature is its massive spiral horns. These horns resemble lapis lazuli when the gold plating is removed. Without the mantle, its scales are gold and black with emerald-like patches. It has ram or frog-like eyes.
velkhana: Velkhana is a traditional dragon with the slim, upright body structure of Elder Dragons like Kushala Daora. Its scales and shell are a unique crystalline blue. Its head has a tiara-like crown of small horns. It summons ice to cover its wings, limbs, and tail. Its thin, lance-like tail is highly flexible and can jab at enemies.
moofah: Moofah is a docile alpaca-like creature known for its long shaggy fur. Males have longer horns than females. Domesticated Moofahs have lighter-colored fur than their wild counterparts, and wear colored bows and bells.
elderfrostGammoth: All Elderfrost Gammoth are females and the male counterpart are not seen. Elderfrost Gammoth appears to have a more bluish fur than regular Gammoth. The portions of red fur on her back have also turned silvery-white, although the reason for this is unknown. The bony plate on her scalp is also slightly different in shape: the plating on the sides of her head are now asymmetrical, and there is a large crack in the center of her scalp. Elderfrost Gammoth also appears to have larger, sharper tusks than a regular Gammoth.
yamaTsukami: Yama Tsukami is an unusual Elder Dragon with an octopus-like body. It is covered in moss, algae, and other plant life, and boasts a set of four thick tentacles. In addition, it possesses two large whiskers and an oddly human-like set of teeth and gums. It produces gas within its body in order to keep itself afloat.
shogunCeanataur: Shogun Ceanataur's body is covered in a blue carapace. Its head is long and knife-shaped, and features a pair of lengthy antennae. Its folding claws act as sickles, and in rage mode extend to double their length, adding a significant amount of range to its reach. Shogun Ceanataur is known to inhabit a variety of shells, among them: A Gravios skull, a snail-like shell, and a skull belonging to an unknown wyvern.
blangonga: As the alpha-male of the pack, the Blangonga is twice as large as the average Blango with a much more aggressive temperament. Its strong, muscled limbs allow it to run and leap at a startling speed, and its powerful roar can catch hunters unaware without adequate hearing protection. It has larger fangs and a bald forehead appearing as a bump. It has two large whiskers and two large protrusions on the side of its nose.
espinas: Espinas is physically similar to a Rathian, but alongside scales its body is covered in hot pink spikes full of venom and rough green armor plating. A long, pink, venom-filled horn protrudes from the front of its head, in a similar fashion to Monoblos. Venomous thorns also protrude from its body, wings, tail, feet, and head. Its body, tail, and feet are bigger and more muscular than those of other Flying Wyverns. It has four pink claws upon its feet. Red-orange veins will appear when it is in its enraged state, similar to Tigrex.
ceanataur: Similar in appearance to the Hermitaur with sharper claws, leg stubs and a higher-edge shell. The shell on its back was actually grown by the Ceanataur itself. Only when it grows much larger into a Shogun Ceanataur will it replace its shell with a larger monster skull, like a Gravios skull, or a giant snail shell. The Terra Shogun Ceanataur will use a Black Gravios skull.
blango: Blango is a white-furred, ape-like creature, resembling a white Dinopithecus with a bright red face. The skin beneath its coat is a dull purple color. It appears to be a mix of a Mandrill and a Japanese macaque.
anteka: Anteka is commonly perceived as the snowy region's counterpart to the Kelbi of the forest and jungle regions. Anteka have a similar build to caribou. They have fluffy bodies, along with a fluffy tail. This fur starts white around the hoofs, before turning to a light brown, and back to white along the back and head. They have gold eyes with pupils that are slitted horizontally like a goat. They walk on four hoofed feet and sports a large, impressive pair of antlers upon their heads. Curiously, Anteka have little tufts of fur around their maw that create what looks like white fluffy mustaches.
nibelsnarf: They are capable of burrowing into the sand and of disguising themselves as sand dunes to ambush prey. You can see if a sand dune is a disguised Nibelsnarf if it blows out 2 small patches of sand from the ground every 2 seconds.
deadeyeYianGaruga: True to its name, this Yian Garuga only possesses one eye, yet this remaining eye glows and leaves a red contrail in its wake, similar to an enraged Nargacuga. One of the Yian Garuga's ears have also been clipped. Its wing membranes and tail tip are covered in a green moss.
apypos: Apypos resemble Wroggi, but with a black and grey body. They are covered in yellow markings, with blue tips on their tails, red eyes, and small Jackal like ears on their head.
odogaron: Odogaron is quadrupedal, capable of moving at fast speeds. It is covered in red scales and bony protrusions that resemble muscle tissue and bone. The tail is particularly bony and can be used as a club. The small blue eyes lack both pupils and eyelids. Odogaron's most distinctive feature is its double row of claws, which it uses to inflict deep wounds in its prey. After eating, red veins will glow on its back.
ebonyOdogaron: Much like its standard counterpart, the Ebony Odogaron sports scales and bone like protrusions which resemble muscle tissues that cover its entire body. However, these scales and protrusions have a dark blue and jet black coloration to them, hence its Ebony name. Its claws also have a more blood red coloration in comparison to the standard Odogaron's claws and are serrated.
namielle: Namielle is an Elder Dragon that has aspects of manta rays, deep sea fish, and jellyfish. Its massive wings are colored black on top and a light blue on the underside, with stripes of rainbow luminescence that pulses constantly. Its head is red and blue with the same pulsing luminescence but when drained of its water and dried out, it has a milky tan coloring that covers both its body and the underside of its wings. It also has multiple long whiskers on the lower jaw. When Namielle is sufficiently charged up, the blue parts of its body will start glowing and pulsating.
magnamalo: Magnamalo is a hulking Fanged Wyvern that bears some resemblance to a tiger. It is primarily clad in purple and yellow plates of armor, with a red underbelly. The head has a short, tigrine snout, holds two foldable tusks under its cheeks, and sports a large pair of jagged yellow horns, just underneath which are its long, thin ears. Both the forelegs and hindlegs end in four-clawed digits, and each foreleg is armed with a single large serrated blade, which is kept folded back, parallel with the leg. Magnamalo's tail ends in a spear-like tip composed of three spikes that can flex outwards to form a trident shape. Hidden within its back are a series of bone blades/spikes that spring out from its hide whenever it becomes enraged.
tetranadon: Tetranadon is an Amphibian with an inflatable belly and a turtle-like shell on its back. Its belly is capable of inflating to the point of doubling their original body size. It also has algae-like fur on its head, front legs, shell, and tail. It has a toothless, platypus-like beak and webbed feet. Its eyes are orange and have the horizontal pupil common to amphibians. It also has a crest on their head that looks very similar to the head dish of the mythological Kappa. When its belly is not inflated, it walks on all fours; once enough debris is swallowed, however, its belly inflates to an incredible size, and it starts standing on its hindlegs.
raknaKadaki: Rakna-Kadaki are Temnocerans bristling with sharp curving spikes. Their bodies are covered in a purple carapace with several large spikes on the legs and the abdomen, which are usually draped in pale webs. Unlike Nerscylla, Rakna-Kadaki have eight limbs; the two middle pairs are walking legs, the hind pair is held above the ground carrying the abdomen, and a pair of burgundy, blunt pedipalps that can extend to over three times their length make up the front pair. The most peculiar trait of Rakna-Kadaki however are their "necks". Similar to pelican spiders, they have a long, extendable neck that can be "retracted" back on top of the thorax. Their heads sport eight yellow eyes, as well as two pairs of chelicerae on their jaw.
somnacanth: Somnacanth has a very unique physiology. Covering its body are large yellowish scales, transitioning to white on the underside. Its front feet have three digits, each one ending in a long, curved black claw. Its back feet have four digits that end in shorter claws. It has fins on each front leg. It has a short face with a disturbingly humanoid appearance. Above its eyes are a pair of large purple horns, with a pair of smaller knob-like protrusions in front of them. Adorning the side of its head are three pairs of small purple fins, with a massive crest-like fin on the top. These purple fins also appear along the top of its tail and form a crescent shape at the tip. It has a hard pad on its belly with a taiko drum-like pattern that it uses to crack open shells. It also features several bioluminescent patches on its body, which can be seen around its eyes, in the mouth, the seams on the throat, and the underside of the tail base.
rachnoid: Rachnoid are Temnocerans that resemble a mix between jumping spiders and ticks. They have large web-spun orbs covering their backs that closely resemble the egg sack found on adult Rakna Kadaki.
malzeno: Malzeno has a body shape reminiscent of a European dragon, similar to Velkhana, with dark scales covering its body along with swarms of small, flying leech-like creatures called Qurio on its neck, chest, and front legs. Its wings, while being dull grey when looked at from above, have a red underside. The wing membrane connects "separately" to the wing fingers, and each wing possesses a single, giant talon. There is also a pair of smaller fins, similar in coloration to the wings at the base of its tail. Three of the fingers on its front legs end in a curved, giant claw. It has two large, golden horns, as well as frills extending from both sides of its neck that resemble a cowl. Its tail ends in three large, movable prongs that can be used to grab small prey. It can cover its body with its wings like a cape.
lunagaron: Lunagaron is a large, wolf-like Fanged Wyvern similar in appearance to New World Fanged Wyverns such as Odogaron and Tobi-Kadachi. Its body is covered in cobalt scales with white edges, with several ridges running down its back. When enraged, Lunagaron's body and claws will become covered in spikes of ice.
bloodOrangeBishaten: Blood Orange Bishaten is similar in appearance to a standard Bishaten; however, the primary colors of its feathers are orange and black instead of the standard Bishaten's blue and white. The tips of its wings are yellow, and various parts of its body (namely its face, legs, and tail) are white.
chatacabra: Chatacabra is an Amphibian with incredibly strong forelimbs. Its ape-like posture and way of locomotion are akin to a simian Fanged Beast, most notably a Rajang. Its body is covered in rigid turquoise scales, with black patterns all over. It has a spiky lower jaw reminiscent of a Deviljho, and in its maw hides a long massive tongue.
reyDau: Rey Dau is a large bipedal wyvern covered in bony golden scales, as well as smaller black scales on its underbelly, joints, and wings. Unlike most other bipedal Flying Wyverns, its wings are not comprised of extended digits, instead being a single membrane similar to that of pterosaurs. Its wings additionally have bladed protrusions which are used as weapons. It has a short and vaguely serpentine head with a facial structure similar to Nergigante, with two rows of teeth and a pair of mandible-like protrusions on either side of its jaw, while its neck has two slits that extrude glowing blue, fin-like structures whenever it is focusing electricity. Its defining features are the large horns spread out on each side of its head; the horns on its head can be folded inwards and used to channel electricity akin to a rail gun. After harnessing electricity, its wing blades and back spikes glow bright blue with fulgurite.
arkveld: Arkveld is a large quadruped monster covered in grayish white scales, white fur, and armor plating. It has ram-like horns on each side of its head curving downward in a manner of tusks, a thick armored tail, a large plated lower jaw, and a mouth full of sharp teeth. Its head has plating that gives the impression of a helmet. Its feet are zygodactyl, with two toes facing forward and another two backwards. Similar to Berukyurosu, Arkveld's main feature are its clawed wings which have huge armored chain-like tendrils attached to them that can extend and retract at will. Unlike in Berukyurosu, where its "chains" are made out of elongated wing fingers, Arkveld's tendrils are made of two strands of tendon lined with arrays of bony structures attached to its wrists. Its wing membranes are relatively small and are also covered in white fur. Despite this, it is still capable of flight. Overall, its body structure is similar to that of Seregios.
ajarakan: Ajarakan is a large Fanged Beast that resembles a Mandrill monkey and a baboon/gorilla hybrid in stance and appearance. Its body is covered in jagged, golden-green scales, with streaks of bright blue and red running across its face, chest, back and arms. Its forelimbs are larger and more muscular than its hindlimbs, much like most primate-like Fanged Beasts. However, Ajarakan's fingers do not have claws like the other primate Fanged Beasts, instead possessing flat fingernails, as well as thick gripping pads on the fingers and toes.
aenshin: Aenshin resembles a colossal flying baleen whale with two pairs of flippers. Its upper body is covered in a thick shell of blue-gray crystalline crust, with numerous teal, blue, and purple crystal spines along its back, upper flippers, tail fin, and head.
