The undersides of its upper flippers, its tail fins, and its horn are entirely crystal. It has a single large crystal atop its back that is normally protected by a thick shell. Its hide is dark grey with beige stripes on the underbelly. It has a row of small gills along its neck and a large brown "beard." Its eyes glow red. In its battle-bound state its hide pulses with dark blue stripes and its crystals become purple in color.
akantor: The Akantor is a massive, vaguely snapping turtle-like wyvern that dwells in magma. Akantors are covered with massive reddish black spikes and durable shells, and have both large sharp claws on their legs but also a similar structure on its tail. The Akantor's most distinctive feature aside from its fearsome spikes are the pair of dreadful tusks on its head. These tusks are both nearly as long as the entirety of the head. The underside of the Akantor is a much tanner color than the rest of its body, and is comparatively lacking in dangerous protrusions.
melynx: Melynx are noted for their black fur and the ability to talk in human language, as well as do human activities like their fellow Lynian subspecies called the Felynes.
gobul: Gobul is a uniquely-evolved Leviathan reminiscent of anglerfish, stingray, and puffer fish, along with traits which are calling cards of Catfish (the tentacles below its mouth). Its body is covered in purple scales, and a bright, bio-luminescent lure dangles from its forehead. It possesses a gargantuan mouth filled with equally formidable teeth. Its back features an array of retractable spines, and its tail is tipped with quills which are capable of inflicting paralysis if touched.
giggi: Spawning from large organic globules called "Giggi Sacs" whithin in dark caves, Giggi are relatively featureless. They have grey bodies with purple markings, small stubby arms, and round mouths with small though sharp teeth used to drain their victims bodily fluids.
gigginox: Gigginox is similar to Khezu, in that they are blind, cave-dwelling wyverns. However, Gigginox does not sense prey by smell; instead, it has a special organ that can detect the body heat of its prey.
rhenoplos: Rhenoplos is a small, quadrupedal, ceratopsian-like monster with an armored body, resembling the real-world Protoceratops or the square-frilled, short brow-horned Chasmosaurus. Its face features a small nasal horn and the back of its head is surrounded by a bony frill.
greatWroggi: The Great Wroggi has a slick salamander-like skin similar to the Iodrome, and, like its close relatives the Great Jaggi and Great Baggi, Great Wroggi are usually accompanied by a group of their smaller kin - in this case, Wroggi.
wroggi: Wroggi are similar in body structure to Jaggi and Baggi, and are covered in a slick, water-resistant hide of an orange colouration. They have a pair of poison sacs on either side of their heads.
balefulGigginox: Baleful Gigginox has a golden color on the top and a dark bruise-black color on its underside. Its heat-sensing organs glow green as oppossed to the normal Gigginox's purple.
rustDuramboros: The environment in which it lives has left its body covered in sand and grit, giving its hide a copper-pink tone, on top of the natively brown hide. Although similar to ordinary Duramboros in many ways, the Rust Duramboros has developed a wider, more axe-like tail club rather than the spherical, hammer-like club of a common Duramboros.
lucentNargacuga: It has metallic, azure scales, patches of white fur, and a golden-colored chest.
abyssalLagiacrus: Abyssal Lagiacrus is significantly larger than its more common relatives, towering over even some Elder Dragons. Its shell is a lustrous black, and, unlike its cousins, it is bio-luminescent. As such, its body is covered in vivid blue points of light, a color matched by its electricity-producing dorsal spikes and hood spines. Its eyes are a striking red that appear to glow among the murky depths, and the inside of its mouth is a vivid electric blue. The horns and spines on its head and upper neck are longer and more prominent than the other species of Lagiacrus.
savageDeviljho: Its standard appearance and abilities are the same reddened-state as that of a normal Deviljho in rage mode. When enraged, it has a dark red haze of Dragon Element surrounding its face, as its eyes turn into a blood-red hue and its skin changes to a light brownish color. The Savage Deviljho's scales appear slightly darker than their regular counterparts', but their tailfangs are also blood-red in colour.
furiousRajang: Furious Rajang is a standard Rajang that has grown extremely powerful, and has lost its tail either by it falling off naturally or by tearing it off itself, allowing it to fully harness its abilities. It still has a tail in older games, but without a tip.
flameRathalos: Flame Rathalos resembles a standard Rathalos, but with bright orange scales, black parts changed to gold, a different wing color and a constant aura of fire around it.
frozenBarioth: Frozen Barioth have the same appearance as normal Barioth, with differences in coloration. Its underside is purple and its fangs are sky blue in color, with a constant frosty aura surrounding the monster.
aberrantDeviljho: Aberrant Deviljho is a special individual of Deviljho with an appearance inspired by the Colossal Titan. Unlike its relatives, it has no skin and its muscle tissue is exposed. Like the Colossal Titan, Aberrant Deviljho has a lot of steam which it still emits upon being slain.
virulentGigginox: Virulent Gigginox heavily resemble the normal ones but their bodies sport blue and green patterns which changes to purple and red when enraged, they also have an aura of poison around them which disappears upon death.
gildedDiablos: Gilded Diablos are crossover themed special individuals of Diablos with the appearance that are inspired by Gilgamesh's Noble Phantasm, Ea. Unlike their relatives, Gilded Diablos have red eyes and golden shells with red stripes throughout their body. Gilded Diablos left horns are broken while the right horns aren't which they have a similar look to Gilgamesh's Noble Phantasm.
unit01Brachydios: Unit-01 Brachydios is a crossover-themed special individual of Brachydios with an appearance inspired by Evangelion Unit-01. Unlike its relatives, it has numerous green markings throughout the body, two green tipped square plates on their backs, robotic looking forelimbs, a green chin spike, a thin robotic looking horn, and a severed by default tail.
greatApypos: Great Apypos bares a huge resemblance to Great Wroggi but shares features with the lesser Apypos. It also has a large yellow patch on its back, a yellow tip at the tail, a glowing blue throat sac, larger ears, and a small curved protrusion on the lower jaw, representing a pharaoh's "beard".
demonicSeregios: Demonic Seregios resembles a typical Seregios but sporting a color scheme of purple for the wings and upper body and dark grey for the waist and tail. The other notable differences are a patch of white hair on its head with a pair of horns with black markings accompanying it. Lastly a smoky black aura radiates of it which dissipates upon death.
fiercewaterNargacuga: They have primarily deep blue fur with a small gray tuft on their backs with orange underbellies and mostly dark gray limbs, they also have white tipped ears and dark grey beaks. Their arms have a few sandy beige spikes on them and their wing blades are larger and segmented into sharp vent like structures with sandy beige spikes and blades of the same color on the ends, they also have light blue membranes with white edges connecting them. Their tails also split apart near the end with sandy beige sword-like blades with a few nozzle-like openings on the ends between where it splits.
iceblastBrachydios: Unlike the normal Brachydios, Iceblast Brachydios has ice covering its body. The forelimbs and the back of its head have four flaming ice spikes that contain red slime mold inside them. This red slime seems to be found near the monster's eyes as well.
scorchingHeatRathian: Scorching Heat Rathian is a variation of Rathian characterized by its dark reddish brown shells and scales with orange patterns in between. It has 3 Scorching Parts that can heat up with burning flames. While it is active, it has a fiery glow and dark flame aura.
explosivePeakDuramboros: Given its tail shape, Explosive Peak Duramboros appears closer to the rust-colored subspecies rather than the common species. It has a reddish brown hide and dark brown horns and shells. Its humps are broken by default, with some magma flowing on its back.
destructionWyvernRathalos: Destruction Wyvern somewhat resembles a standard Rathalos, but with neon blue, black, and white scales. They have a different wing structure similar to a bird or fairy and a tail resembling an earwig tail pincer to some degree. The tail has axe like blades on the sides before the end of the tail. Destruction Wyverns have glowing neon blue eyes and white chest scales.
thunderbubbleMizutsune: All Thunderbubble Mizutsune are male and the females are not seen. Thunderbubble Mizutsune are special individuals of Mizutsune with different unique coloration. Instead of having pink fin appendages with yellow markings throughout their bodies, Thunderbubble Mizutsune have instead have neon blue fin appendages with the same yellow markings. Their scales are pale white while most of them are tainted neon blue. Thunderbubble Mizutsune fur on their bodies are a neon blue color as well. Their yellow long claws have a blue tip on them. Also, Thunderbubble Mizutsune's back fins are constantly glowing.
landconquestLagiacrus: Landconquest Lagiacrus has dark brown scales and shells. It has red horns, red shockers, red claws, red spikes and yellow eyes. It has constant orange sparks around its body while it is active.
steelArmorDiablos: Steel Armor Diablos are crossover themed special individuals of Diablos with the appearance that are inspired by Alphonse Elric. Unlike their relatives, Steel Armor Diablos have grey shells and faces that look similar to Alphonse Elric's with one large conical horn on their middle foreheads.
whitewaterPlesioth: Like other kinds of Plesioth, the Whitewater Plesioth is a wyvern-like bipedal monster with some resemblance to a fish. However, unlike your typical Plesioth, the Whitewater is often found with pale scales all around its body and red eyes, suggesting some form of albinism. They also have pale fins and foot webbing, all are light gray and orange. It also has a mist surrounding the monster.
sweetToothTigrex: Sweet Tooth Tigrex is very much identical to a normal Tigrex, the only notable difference being the stuffed toys of the characters, My Melody and Kuromi, stuck onto its tail.
chameleos: Chameleos' body is covered by a purple and white hide, and its head ends with a protruding horn at the tip of its nose. Its eyes are similar to a real life chameleon's; large and orb-like, with the ability to control eye movement individually. The long and elastic tongue can extend to grasp and steal items from a distance. Its wings are a purple color with a grayish white membrane, and are used for flight and controlling the direction of its poison fog. Chameleos's large tail is reminiscent of a leaf and has a curled, spiraling tip.
giaprey: They have crystal blue scales with sky blue stripes. Although they are of a different species, White Velociprey have been seen in packs of Velociprey. Like all of the '-prey' family, this sub-species also fights in a pack.
mosswine: Mosswine are small, moss-covered pigs. They have a gray, spiky head plate. Mosswine are known to have a great appetite for mushrooms. Hunters and marketers commonly observe them to identify an area of Special Mushrooms.
kingShakalaka: King Shakalaka is slightly larger than its subjects, but generally looks identical. It wears a BBQ spit upon its head, and weilds a thighbone as a club.
akuraVashimu: Akura Vashimu is a scorpion-like Carapaceon. The Akura Vashimu has blue-purple crystals growing on its claws, back, and tail tip. It has a huge geode mineral on its tail tip. The Akura rests and hides underground, protruding its large mineral tail tip on the surface. If it is aware of nearby enemies, its tail breaks out of the sand and swings around violently, hurting anything nearby. It is possible to temporarily break the tail crystal, but the geode will quickly grow back. Its attack pattern depends on the color of its blood (grey, red, green, blue).
akuraJebia: Whereas Akura Vashimu features purple crystals, Akura Jebia is mostly covered in white and blue crystals. It has a characteristic horn on its face that the Akura Vashimu lacks.
berukyurosu: They are green in color with a large grey horn, yellow manes, several blunt peg like spines on their backs and tails, and most notably long whip like fingers ending in small hooks with two similar hookless tendrils hanging from its waist.
doragyurosu: The fur on its head turns orange when enraged and it harnesses an even more advanced moveset than Berukyurosu.
volvidon: Volvidon is a medium-sized monster, slightly larger than an Aptonoth. It is covered in a series of red armor plates, which are segmented around the midsection and allow the Volvidon to curl into a ball. It possesses an extremely long, chameleon-like tongue which is covered in sticky saliva. Its overall appearance is similar to armadillos.
amatsu: Amatsu has a unique body structure similar to that of a Leviathan. Its head itself is quite small, though it is adorned with massive golden horns, flanked by tendrils of flesh. Amatsu's body is largely pale white in color, and covered entirely in fins that stretch along all four limbs. From its back rise more pointed fins, whereas its underside is grey and scaled.
steelUragaan: This variant appears to have a hide of a deep metallic blue, rather than the golden hide of the common species. It is speculated that this altered coloration is due to the monster feeding on different types of ores.
abiorugu: Abiorugu is a large Brute Wyvern that closely resembles a real-world theropod, the Allosaurus. Its skull protrudes from the top of its head, forming bony plates. Its tail is thick, and ends in a knife-shaped protrusion, which is used both offensively and defensively. It uses the plates on its back to regulate its temperature, making it able to thrive in a diverse range of climate zones.
caeserber: Caeserber are large beaver like monsters mostly covered in light brown fur with four yellow streaks two running down their backs, two on the sides of their heads which contain crests. The parts that are not covered beit hide or the spines running down its back are prussian blue with some beige highlights in places and throughout its body are beige protrusions of varying shape and size, such as the spike like ones on its arms, the ones on its crest, and the four spikes on its flat tail.
shagaruMagala: Overall, Shagaru Magala's body structure is similar to its juvenile form, Gore Magala. However, following the skin-shedding, its body is now covered in glittering golden scales, as well as its horns, claws and other spiky protrusions, which changed colors from crimson red / purple to dark brown. The once hidden eyes underneath the horns are also now fully opened. Its ragged-tattered wings also became golden scaly sheets that when fully expanded, resembles a star shape (more specifically, when both wings are expanded.)
baelidae: Baelidae are Carapaceon with a spider-like appearance that is terrifying. They have two pair of legs and a pair of pincer-like claws that has four pairs of brown claws. Its back seems to be either a pattern that looks like a monster's head, or a skull of an unknown monster. The eye sockets on its back turns red when enraged.
yellowCaeserber: Yellow Caeserber has light yellow fur while everything else is brown of varying shades (including the teeth), besides the stomach highlights which are also yellow, and a small yellow patch behind its nose. It also lacks the streaks on its face that the standard Caeserber has.
goldCongalala: It is the first monster to be neither a Subspecies nor a Rare Species of Congalala, but a new Species that made its debut in Monster Hunter Online called a "Lone Species" (独行种).
chramine: Chramine is a Bird Wyvern that is highly similar to Gypceros but also has differences. Some of these differences are crimson red hair standing on its head instead of the crest of Gypceros, a different coloration, and a hard shell much like Yian Kut-Ku.
dreadBaelidae: The body of a Dread Baelidae is somewhat more yellowish than the common Baelidae; its spikes and claws are tipped in dark purple rather than reddish brown.
iceChramine: Rather than the sandy coloration and red hair seen on the common Chramine, this subspecies has browner skin and blue hair. Many parts of its body – such as the horn, back, wings and tail tip – seem to be encrusted with ice.
ghostCaeserber: Ghost Caeserber heavily resemble normal individuals, the differences lie in the blood soaked tail, claws, and spikes. And the red eyes one of which has a scar.
pumpkinUragaan: Pumpkin Uragaan resembles a standard Uragaan, but with red eyes, orange skin, purple crystals on its back and underbelly, and a chin resembling a pumpkin.
immortalZinogre: Immortal Zinogre has the same appearance as regular Zinogre.
flameBlangonga: Unlike the other types of Blangonga, Flame Blangongas have red fur with some small yellow present on the back, and grey skin. A patch of yellow fur is present on the "dome" on the head, resembling the spikey looking come on a Congalala. The eyes are purple, the head has a few pale yellow stripe marks, and the whiskers are half red and half yellow. Lastly, notably thick layers of skin with a rocky texture are present on the forearms and hands, with only a few "cracks" of red fur present.
nefGarmat: Nef-Garmat has the standard structure for Elder Dragons. It is covered mostly in golden and dark grey plates and scales. The wings are rather peculiar, the last finger on the wings has a backwards curve at all times, making it look like the other half of the wings are always curved in the opposite direction compared to nearly any other monster. Their heads resemble that of a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackal Jackal], with red eyes, dark blue tongue, dark hair, large blue ears, and a protrusion on the lower jaw resembling a Pharaoh's false beard. Running along the back of the neck are black tuffs of some sort, on the sides are large gold plates forming a sort of "hood". And running all the way along the back and tail are two blue stripes, the tail itself is long, wide, and rather flat.
ffbeZinogre: A purple body with berry red fur, green claws, markings, and horns which also have numerous small spikes poking out from between them, several small spikes on the end of the tail, and a large green fin on its back.
thunderEmperorKirin: Its body structure and overall look is similar to the one of a normal Kirin. Thunder Emperor Kirin is bigger than its counterpart. Its body is colored with gradients of gold, its horn has a copper/red color and its mane has a pale grey and yellow gradient with a thunder pattern. Its surrounding aura is also golden.
jieLung: Jie Lung is an unique Brute Wyvern with a similar body structure like Brachydios. Unlike the latter, its arms have blade-like shape with visible claws and it has a sharp looking face with a front horn and a long red one on the back of its head. The long tail is covered with red tipped lime green fin-like spikes and red tipped lime green fins at the end of Jie Lung's tail. Jie Lung's unique legs have three red claws on them with red spikes behind its legs. Most of its scales are lime green and its underbelly is grey with a line of downward spikes.
morudomunto: Morudomunto has a body structure similar to Gore Magala. Some of its white scales have peeled off, revealing its steel blue skin. Its feet are dark grey with four claws. Tufts of fur can be found on its legs and the "hands" of its large muscular "wing-arms", which have partially torn membranes and can unfold to reveal odd, mouth-like structures. Large spear-like spines run along its back and tail, which ends in a club shape that somewhat resembles a large clawed hand. Its neck has a large throat sac with glowing blue vent-like openings, and similar blue cracks are visible on its spikes, horns, and tail; all of these will turn red when Morudomunto is sufficiently angered. Its mouth features a barbed tongue as well as a pair of sharp tusks; the rest of its teeth are flat. Last but not least is its most distinct characteristic: a large, black, crown-like set of horns, which the monster is titled from.
eoGarudia: Eo Garudia have the standard bodily structure for Elder Dragons, and are mainly avian in appearance. Most of their bodies are covered in a mix of white feathers and golden scales. They have black feet, red chests alongside the underside of their necks, avian-esque faces featuring piercing blue eyes, red markings, hooked down beaks, red tuffs on the back of their heads and a bit along their necks, and large red ears. Their last finger on their wings have a noticeable curve to them at all times, giving the last section of the wing an opposing circular curve, the wings also have some reddish-orange crystalline spikes of varying size on them. They also have ridged feather like structures on their backs where their necks start, forming a rounded structure. Running along their backs and tails are two red stripes, the ends of their long wide and rather flat tails also have large white feathers lining the sides. On the underside of the tail, as well as on the wings, are red structures with dark markings that form eye like patterns. In total there are five of these structures.
shiningrockUragaan: The Shiningrock Uragaan's body is an icy blue, the scutes on its back and the top of its tail are purple, while the belly, the underside of its tail, and the underside of its neck are red.
watermelonUragaan: Watermelon Uragaan resembles a standard Uragaan, but with a pink underbelly, green crystals on its back, and a chin resembling a watermelon.
elementalBulldrome: Nearly visually identical to their more typical cousins, while not enraged, Elemental Bulldromes appear as slightly darker Bulldromes with red eyes. However, after becoming enraged, Elemental Bulldromes gain a orange, dark-blue, yellow, pale-blue, or red aura corresponding to the Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice, and Dragon elements respectively. Furthermore, after having their tusks broken, Elemental Bulldromes gain an aura consisting of all of the aforementioned colors.
rottenUragaan: Rotten Uragaan looks exactly like Watermelon Uragaan, but with red eyes and a dark purple aura similar to Frenzy Apex monsters.
hypnocatrice: Hypnocatrice is a medium-sized Bird Wyvern covered in bright, colorful feathers. It has extremely powerful legs with large feet, and a hard, sharp beak. Despite its feathered appearance, Hypnocatrice flies using pterosaur or bat-like membraned wings, leaving its feather arrangements strictly for display purposes. It possesses a sleep sac, which allows it to produce a colorless mist that can cause attackers to fall unconscious.
laoShanLung: Lao-Shan Lung is a colossal hind-limbed Elder Dragon with a hulking copper red body with a cream-colored underbelly. It has numerous dark grey spikes on its neck, back, and tail. Its limbs are comparatively small with dark grey hands and feet. Its head features eight large horns that curve backwards and a smaller horn on the front that points upwards and curves back slightly. Its mouth has small teeth with several larger teeth on the outside.
lunastra: Lunastra is a dragon with leonine features and a cool coloration. She has a prominent mane, large fangs, and a distinct crest that resembles a sort of crown. Her wings are covered in fur. She is the female counterpart to Teostra.
shenGaoren: Identifiable by its grey exoskeleton, towering legs and the gigantic green-yellow balls of acid that it generates and hurls from the rear of its body. Shen Gaoren uses a Lao-Shan Lung skull for protection. Its colossal size helps it to defeat most creatures. The diet of Shen Gaoren is unknown; however, it is likely to be omnivorous, like most real-life crabs.
lavasioth: Lavasioth resembles a bipedal coelacanth fish covered in hardened lava, which forms a tough outer shell. It has two dorsal fins, two pectoral fins, two pelvic fins, and a long, thick tail to help swim through the thick lava it resides in. Its head is fish-like in nature, with rounded features and large, circular eyes. Its mouth is filled with sharp, needle-like fangs. Its powerful hind-legs end in fins rather than claws, but are capable of supporting it on land.
giadrome: It is physically very similar to the Velocidrome, the only key difference being the pale blue colouration and the presence of a frost sac.
rustedKushalaDaora: Rusted Kushala Daora is an Elder Dragon whose characteristic metallic skin is, as its name implies, is wholly rusted. Aside from this, the Rusted Kushala Daora resembles a regular Kushala Daora.
flamingEspinas: Flaming Espinas features a brown carapace with red spines, claws, and horns. When enraged, its body is covered in glowing orange veins. It is otherwise identical to the common Espinas.
silverHypnocatrice: Silver Hypnocatrice is covered in cobalt and silver plumage. It has extremely powerful legs and a highly potent sleep sac. Its eyes are a deep red.
pariapuria: Pariapuria is a quadrupedal, amphibious Flying Wyvern. It is big, gluttonous, and disgusting in its behavior. Its head is flat with six red fins, with a long blue tongue inside a big mouth. Its body is mostly colored dark brown, with a milk white hide on its belly. Its back is shaped similarly to a Tigrex, only with two fins protruding out. Its front legs have three claws and a phalanx, which feature three spikes that are orange at the tip. It has colorful wing membranes, in a sort of gradient consisting of black, blue, orange, and yellow. It has four claws on its hind feet. Its tail is long and thick, with a white membrane stemming from the side of its tail. Although it is a Flying Wyvern, Pariapuria shares some physical resemblance to a Leviathan, due to its habitat and fins.
kamuOrugaron: Kamu and Nono Orugaron are canine-like Fanged Beasts with two sharp tusks and numerous quills running along their backs and tails, they also have fur tufts on their legs, backs and tails. What separates Kamu Orugaron are his longer tusks and quills, a larger fur tuff on its head, giving the impression of a "fur Mohawk", dark grey fur, and higher physical strength.
dyuragaua: Dyuragaua has the typical body structure of primarily-quadrupedal Flying Wyverns. Its hide is covered with cyan and turquoise scales, with deep orange ridges, spikes, claws and horns, its wing membranes are green. The head somewhat resembles that of a fox, with a mouth full of sharp teeth permanently bared, with a "mane" of sorts of red fur sprouting from the back of the head, with more fur of the same color on its underbelly. The tail culminates in a "club" covered in small spines, normally lowered.
gurenzeburu: Gurenzeburu is a primarily blue and cream-colored monster. Though it sports a navy blue for most of the scales on its upper body it has a lighter baby blue coloration on its horn, the spikes on the end of its tail, a ridge of its back, and the index fingers of its wings. It also has some red on it, such as lines on its sides, most of the claws and talons, and some spines lining its tail.
nonoOrugaron: Nono and Kamu Orugaron are canine-like Fanged Beasts with two sharp tusks and numerous quills running along their backs and tails, they also have fur tufts on their legs, backs, and tails. What separates Nono Orugaron is her smaller tusks and quills, white and yellow fur, no "fur Mohawk", and greater agility.
taikunZamuza: Taikun Zamuza are Carapaceons covered in multiple layers of armor. Typically they are seen covered completely in an layer of dirt, rock, barnacles, mushrooms, and some plant life.
farunokku: Farunokku are easily identifiable monsters, due to their vivid yellow and teal colors, as well as their signature "manes" — puffy balls of feathers that grow on the Farunokku's necks. They have light brown beaks and dark brown, three-toed feet. Small stripes of yellow can be seen on the frames of their wings, and lines of erect feathers can be found on the back of their legs. Their tails are long and curve upward towards the end, with yellow underneath and blue on the top.
giaorugu: Giaorugu has blue, yellow-tipped dorsal plates, a light blue scaly hide, and a blueish white underbelly. The two head crests of Abiorugu have fused together to form one larger, stronger crest ringed with spines; it also has a long snout, spikes that grow on its jaw, and two long fangs protruding from its jaw. Its legs are muscular and powerful, like all Brute Wyverns, and reinforced with spines. Giaorugu's tail is large, slim, and resembles a blade. It is also unique; when slammed into the ground, it will become encrusted with ice, which makes all attacks with the tail more far reaching and powerful. Its head-plate spikes, jaw spikes, claws, toes, diamond-shaped spikes, and tail blade are light yellow in colour.
tartaronis: Tartaronis is a rather large Elder Dragon that resembles a sea turtle. Its facial structure is odd, with the top of its head having a distinctive pointed look to it. Its lower jaw is similar looking, bearing a resemblance to Ukanlos. On its back are several moving spikes that shift in and out whenever it moves or takes to the skies. It has a very long tail fin which holds greater length than its main body.
gurenShenGaoren: Guren Shen Gaoren has a more brown hue to it than its more common counterpart, and has fiery looking legs that expel smoke. It uses a Akantor skull for protection.
teppekiShenGaoren: Teppeki Shen Gaoren has a more brown hue to it than Shen Gaoren. It uses a Akantor skull for protection.
slicemargl: Similar to Blangonga and Rajang in build, Slicemargl are large quadrupeds with canine-esque faces. Their bodies are covered in a black and white striped pelt, and blade-like bones protrude from their arms and back. Much like the aforementioned Fanged Beast species, Slicemargl are often seen traversing on their fists.
merphistophelin: Merphistophelin is a pale white Elder Dragon whose physical appearance is very similar to that of Fatalis. Running along from it's head to it's tail rests a line of dark grey spines, trailing off from being shortest on the tail to larger barbs along the back of its neck. Its head is rather unusual, being somewhat avian and serpentine in appearance, while also sporting a prominent spike on its chin. This dragon's wings are also abnormal in their appearance, being almost devoid of any sort of membrane in between, yet this beast somehow retains the ability to fly. Its wing membrane appears when it enters one of its elemental states. On its chest is an assortment of rib-cage like barbs that normally stay closed around its purple chest cavity. These barbs will spring open during either of its states with the "core" in it changing to various colors depending on the state its in.
lightenna: Lightenna resembles a rhinoceros beetle, with a mostly blue body with yellow accents, bright teal eyes, and jagged wings that go from a blue base to a purple fade. Most strikingly, its head sports one large upward-facing horn at the front and two smaller forward-facing horns at the back. This exact arragement of horns make it particularly similar to the Atlas beetle. The aforementioned horns are highlighted in a brighter shade of blue than the rest of Lightenna's body, making them stand out even more.
goldHypnocatrice: The Gold Hypnocatrice resemles a regular Hypnocatrice in build and appearance. However, the Gold Hypnocatrice are covered in bright gold colored plumage unlike their common kin. They have the same dark purple eyes that the common Hypnocatrice have. Like the Silver Hypnocatrice, a Gold Hypnocatrice has a potent sleep sac.
purpleSlicemargl: Being a subspecies of Slicemargl, Purple Slicemargl share many of their physical features with them. However, unlike their arctic cousins, Purple Slicemargl have purple-tinted fur, red; venomous bone spikes, and blue eyes that will glow red when the monster is enraged.
onimusha: Onimusha differs from the typical Shogun Ceanataur with its pale turquoise exoskeleton, as well as a left claw that appears broader than the right.
flameTigrex: Flame Tigrex are nearly-identical to standard Tigrex, but with red stripes and eyes, along with cooled lava covering their face and claws. Flame Tigrex are also significantly larger then regular Tigrex.
elementalMerphistophelin: In its typical state, Fire state, and Dragon state, Elemental Merphistophelins appears identical to standard Merphistophelins except for their significantly larger size.
hornetaur: Hornetaur resemble crickets of the real world. Like the related Vespoid, they are highly susceptible to poison. Due to their small size, many find them difficult to hit directly.
jagras: Jagras are small and slim compared to Great Jagras. Their body shape is very wolf-like in nature, allowing them to move quickly and stand up right for short periods of time. Jagras have light green scales with blue and reddish stripes covering their body, as well as a blue-colored underbelly.
kestodon: Kestodon heavily resembles the Pachycephalosaurus, a dinosaur famous for its unique-looking skull. Male Kestodon are bright orange in color and have a large head crest for headbutting rivals, whereas females are bronze in color and lack the head crest found in males.
zorahMagdaros: Zorah Magdaros is a colossal semi-aquatic Elder Dragon covered in a rocky hide. It has turtle-like characteristics, bearing a mountainous shell on its back that it can retreat under while walking on all fours, as well as a beaked mouth. Fire, smoke, and lava constantly radiate from Zorah's shell, making it more akin to a walking volcano than a typical creature. Zorah has three magmacore organs located on its back and a fourth on its head that act as weak points.
gajau: Gajau have greenish scales with orange dorsal fins. They resemble catfish in appearance. In their original appearance in the third generation, they were classified as Fish. In World, Gajau were initially classified as Piscine Wyverns prior to being changed back into Fish with the April 19, 2018 patch.
tzitziYaKu: Tzitzi-Ya-Ku is a medium-sized Deinonychus-like Bird Wyvern of navy blue coloration. It has long, powerful back legs, and muscular forelegs complete with three claws for grasping prey. Perhaps its most unique feature is the pair of retractable frills that line either side of its head, which are bright and vividly colorful in appearance. Its back is lined with a row of short spines, and it has wide sturdy feet.
grimalkyne: Grimalkyne resemble bipedal lynxes. They have tufted ears, and come in a variety of colors depending on the tribe:
shamos: Shamos has a wolf-like body shape with huge orange cat-like eyes. Though its body shape is akin to a wolf, Shamos' appearance is very similar to fish. Its cat-like face is covered in red scales while the rest of its body is covered in grayish-white splotches. Its limbs are navy blue in color. Shamos also has a small fin on its back like a fish.
radobaan: Radobaan is very closely related to Uragaan. As such, it is very similar in appearance, with the same stocky frame, enormous chin, and brow horns as its cousin. Radobaan's most distinctive feature is the covering of bones it adorns itself in, affixed in place via a sticky, tar-like substance secreted through the monster's skin. It is typically seen with a spiny row of vertebrae wrapped around its massive chin, along with a pair of massive Diablos horns upon its haunches. The bones on Radobaan can easily be knocked off if enough damage is applied to certain parts of its body..
girros: Girros are snake-like Fanged Wyverns with a head and hood similar to a cobra. They have black onyx scales with yellow stripes on their neck. Girros also have red gill-like organs on the side of their neck.
vaalHazak: Vaal Hazak is a long, slender Elder Dragon with several unique physical features. Its body is covered in silver scales, which are obscured by the fleshy red veil that covers most of its body. It possesses a striking double lower jaw, each with a row of extremely long, sharp fangs similar to those of a deep sea fish. It has two bright yellow spots at the sides of its head and two small red eyes. Its toes and wingtips are adorned with sickle-shaped claws. It is similar in size to other Elder Dragons such as Teostra and Kushala Daora. Vaal Hazak's head, body and arms can be wounded. Its Tail can also be severed.
gajalaka: Like many Lynians, Gajalaka are short humanoids. They resemble Shakalaka more than Felynes or Grimalkynes, lacking any fur and wearing large tribal masks which leave only their bright yellow eyes visible, similar to Jawas. These red masks have different color accents, ranging from blue to yellow to purple, to represent what status ailment their weapons afflict. The Gajalaka in the Caverns of El Dorado have golden masks.
gastodon: Gastodon resembles a cross between a Hypsilophodon dinosaur and a bison. They are covered in scales but have large furry manes and horns reminiscent of a bison. When angered, they will glow red.
xenojiiva: Xeno'jiiva is a large dragon with an otherworldly appearance. It has two eyes and six orange sensory organs running up the length of its horns. Parts of its body glow ethereal blue, making its skin appear crystalline and translucent. Its wings are frayed at the edge of the membrane and are grayish-blue in color. When enraged, its torso glows a hot red and orange. Upon maturing, and molting its skin countless times, Xeno'jiiva will undergo a change that will turn it into a Safi'jiiva.
behemothMonsterHunter: The Behemoth is a creature from another world. It is a colossal quadruped with purple skin and little hair over its body except a mane of black spiked hair on its back. Its body and front legs are absurdly muscular, though its hind legs are less so. The Behemoth's head is vaguely canine with a pair of sharp horns and piercing blue eyes that do not close. Behemoth's thick tail ends in long barb-like hairs. When Behemoth has gained enmity its eyes and body glow red.
leshenMonsterHunter: The Leshen's body structure or biology is completely alien to the known world. The creature stands upright on two limbs that support an eerily humanoid body made of what appears to be wood, which it covers with ragged clothing; branches grow out of its shoulders, which may have the remains of its most recent victims hanging upon them. The Leshen's head is an animal's skull, topped by a pair of antlers unlike anything seen in the Old or New World. The Leshen seemingly lacks any functioning eyes, mouth or any features expected from the head of a living monster. Indeed, in its own world it is thought to be a nature spirit rather than any kind of living creature.
ancientLeshen: The Ancient Leshen looks very similar to its younger counterpart, with the main difference being in its much larger antlers. Parts of its wood-like body have also become covered with moss and small mushrooms, like an old tree.
alatreon: Alatreon is a large quadrupedal Elder Dragon whose overall body shape strongly resembles that of a stylised [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_dragon European dragon].
ragingBrachydios: Raging Brachydios sports a green shell with yellow-orange slime mold on its forelimbs, head, back, and tail that turns red when it becomes enraged. It is noticeably larger than normal Brachydios and moves slower as a result.
shriekingLegiana: Shrieking Legiana are structurally similar to their regular counterparts, with more extensive ice vents along the underside of their wings. They have black coloration instead of blue and their chest, tail, and wing patterns are encrusted with spiky ice.
wulg: Wulgs greatly resemble a cross between a wolf and a badger with their body shape resembling a mustelid like a weasel. Possessing a thick black and white striped pelt, a lithe frame and a long bushy tail. Their faces are long and tapering, and covered in black fur. Wulgs also posses long, blue, and slightly curved claws on their shins, which most of the time are buried in their fur.
boaboa: The Boaboa have the basic shape of a Grimalkyne, but exhibit much thicker, white fur and a bulkier frame. They wear crude imitations of Popo heads as masks, with the tusk's tips painted in colours that correspond to the status ailment each individual Boaboa uses in combat.
ruinerNergigante: At first glance, Ruiner Nergigante is built similarly to Nergigante, albeit with darker scales and carapace. The variant's defining feature are the black metallic spikes that grow in between their regular bone spikes.
viperTobiKadachi: Much like its standard counterpart, the Viper Tobi-Kadachi's face resembles that of a colubrid with its body retaining several of the standard Tobi-Kadachi's characteristics such as the slim, squirrel-like body, the fur patches which trail across its back as well as the large, bushy tail armed with spikes.
coralPukeiPukei: Coral Pukei-Pukei retains most of its characteristics from Pukei-Pukei. However, Coral Pukei-Pukei sports bright orange coloring on its face, feet, and front wing claws. These turn red when it becomes enraged. The rest of its body has a pinkish-red tint to it while its underbelly and tail tip are violet.
nightshadePaolumu: Like the standard Paolumu, Nightshade Paolumu is a large Flying Wyvern resembling a bat. Its body is covered in soft fur that is primarily black or dark purple, contrasting with its standard counterpart's white-and-pink coloration. Its tail is also darkly colored, matching the color of its fur. Its face is pale white, while on its neck are two brightly colored patches resembling the patterns on the tail feathers of a peacock. When it is deflated, these patches are more difficult to see. Its wings contain faint hints of green on the webbing.
sharaIshvalda: Shara Ishvalda is a large dragon that has two different forms. It will initially take on an appearance covered in rocks, sand, and other minerals. This gives it a very bulky shape, and its head's appearance is mostly impossible to make out. Most distinctively, instead of wings, it has adapted its appendages into a four-fingered hand-like structure.
blackveilVaalHazak: Blackveil Vaal Hazak is similar to its counterpart in terms of general appearance. The main difference is that it's covered in strange moss-like pustules that emit Effluvium constantly. These pustules even go as far to cover its head, rendering it blind. Should they be removed/broken however, it is able to see again. Contrasting regular Vaal Hazak's dark red and silver coloring, Blackveil is a green and milky-white coloring.
scarredYianGaruga: In terms of appearance, Scarred Yian Garuga is virtually identical to Yian Garuga. The main difference between the two is that one of this monster's ears is missing and Scarred Yian Garuga received a scar across its face. It also can only be found in a tempered state in Monster Hunter World: Iceborne.
safijiiva: Safi'jiiva is a large red dragon that in contrast to its juvenile form, Xeno'jiiva, no longer has an otherworldly appearance. Its scales are now rigid, very resistant to damage unless tenderized, and red in colour with some dark accents on many parts, such as the horns, feet, spikes, and wing edges. Its wing webbing and underside, however, is a tan colour. Its body parts no longer glow except when absorbing energy or when in its "Supercritical" state. Many spikes run from its neck along its back to the tail tip.
bombadgy: Bombadgy has an appearance of an obese badger or raccoon with gray flabby skins and long tendril-like eyebrows. Along its back are three jagged rows, with another row on each side of its body. Its legs are scaled and end in five digits with long claws.
apexRathalos: Apex Rathalos are similar in appearance to the Dreadking Rathalos, though with more elements of a normal Rathalos than a Frenzied one, with a normal-ish skin tone and equal size. It has multiple red scars covering its body, like the other apexes do. the most notable feature is its neck which will glow a bright orange when it breathes fire or roars, signalling a massive burning flame deep within its throat.
apexMizutsune: All Apex Mizutsune are male and the females are not seen. He is similar to a frenzied Mizutsune, with a darker tone and wounds all over his body. However, he has multiple differences, including his arm fur being purple and his torso and tail being a deep blue. When enraged, the crests on his head and back get redder.
apexArzuros: Unlike normal Arzuros, Apex Arzuros are very dark colored, having multiple red scars across the body, mainly their arms, and having red eyes. Similarly to their Redhelm Deviants, they have large forelimbs. When enraged, the red scars start glowing.
apexDiablos: It bears an exceptionally striking resemblance to a Bloodbath Diablos all while still keeping some similarity to a Frenzied Diablos, having red eyes and scars on his body, but keeping a darker and bloodier color scheme of the original. Its horns are much larger and more developed. When fully enraged or attacking, Apex Diablos's scars brightens up.
apexRathian: Apex Rathian is extremely similar to a Dreadqueen Rathian, having multiple red scars on her body and red eyes. The eyes and scars glow bright red when enraged. Her teeth are a lot sharper than a normal Rathian, and her wings and legs have either new or bigger spikes. Furthermore, similar to the Dreadqueen, her tail has much bigger spines than normal.
crimsonGlowValstrax: Due to the rampant dragon energy flowing through its body, Crimson Glow Valstrax has permanent glowing red marks connecting from the chest to the wings, showing up on the sides and wing-arms. The wings have a different design than a normal Valstrax's wings, looking more like exhaust vents, and are covered in glowing red color similar to a normal enraged Valstrax. When inhaling air, the wings will glow a bright red and start spewing out dragon energy. When enraged, dragon energy starts to spew out from the nostrils on the back of its head as exhaust, while its torso glows red in color, with large amounts of dragon energy coming out from the vents in its chest and shoulders.
apexZinogre: Appearing very similar to the standard Zinogre the Apex variation is quite different in coloration, having yellow fur, red eyes, dark greenish blue scales, or straight up grey in some areas, and the presence of a few small, glowing red marks present on the underbelly, with larger orange ones appearing when charged up on the fore legs
boggi: A Boggi has a body structure similar to like of Wroggi or Baggi, as it resembles a small theropod dinosaur, with a scaly yellow hide and brown markings. Its head quite resembles a hyena's head, with large ears, oversized lower canines, and a patch of dark hair on its shoulders, back, and along the tail. Its tongue is normally seen hanging out of its mouth. The eyes of Boggi are gold in color.
pyrantula: These small Temnocerans, the young of Pyre Rakna-Kadaki, are identical in appearance to Rachnoids except in their color; they have light gray bodies and yellow eyes, and the webbing on their backs is a glowing orange.
pyreRaknaKadaki: Pyre Rakna-Kadaki is similar in appearance to a standard Rakna-Kadaki, but with several key differences; her body is now light gray with glowing orange hooks, and her webbing is now black. Her horns are now much longer, giving her a demonic appearance.
scornedMagnamalo: Scorned Magnamalo mostly resembles a normal Magnamalo, but has elongated, oddly serrated arm-blades, larger fangs, and more jagged back shells that will unfold when sufficiently enraged in place of the normal variant's spikes. It is missing its right horn and eye, and its body is shrouded in volatile pink Hellfire at all times. Its body is now a darker purple color with glowing red scars all over its body, similar to the appearance of the Apex Monsters found in Kamura.
gaismagorm: Gaismagorm is a massive Elder Dragon similar in size and structure to Gogmazios, though seemingly with a more pseudowyvern-like gait. Its back legs appear to be vestigial, as they drag along as it crawls along using its front legs and massive forearms, which appear to have been adapted from its wings like those of Gore Magala and Shagaru Magala. These forearms are incredibly dexterous, allowing it to easily climb vertical surfaces and even grip and toss objects at opponents. Its tail is large and thick, with five spikes at the end.
risenChameleos: Risen Chameleos' appearance is noticeably different from a standard Chameleos, now being mostly gray and black with some areas (such as its head, feet, wingarms, and tail) still being slightly purple. Its body is covered in wounds resembling burns, which have a bright orange glow upon entering its Risen state.
risenKushalaDaora: Risen Kushala Daora's appearance is noticeably different from a standard Kushala Daora, with most of its body darkened with certain parts (their heads, wings, and torsos) retaining their metallic grey coloring. Its body is covered in wounds resembling burns, which have a bright orange glow upon entering its Risen state.
risenTeostra: Risen Teostra's appearance is noticeably different from a standard Teostra, with most of its body darkened with the hair on its mane and tail appearing more orange and yellow, or even white. Its body is covered in wounds resembling burns, which have a bright orange glow upon entering its Risen state.
risenCrimsonGlowValstrax: Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax' appearance is noticeably different from a standard Valstrax and Variant counterpart, with most of its body darkened with certain parts (their heads and torsos) retaining their metallic grey coloring. At the tip of the spikes and wing exhaust are wounds resembling burns, which have a bright orange glow upon entering its Risen state.
risenShagaruMagala: Risen Shagaru Magala's appearance is noticeably different from a standard Shagaru Magala, with most of its body darkened with certain parts (their wings and head) retaining their tannish white coloring. At the tip of the wings, the tip of the tail, and their horns are wounds resembling burns, which have a bright orange glow upon entering its Risen state.
primordialMalzeno: Primordial Malzeno greatly resembles a normal Malzeno, but has a more sturdy appearance, with most of its body, wings, and head crest being covered in silver and gold plates and blades resembling armor, and the parts of its body that were already gold becoming a darker, richer color. The Qurio are no longer present on its body, with the patch on its chest being replaced by a thicker section of armor plates, and its red wing membranes are now dark bluish-purple instead, with its horns also being less twisted.
ceratonoth: The Ceratonoth is a quadrupedal, reptillian herbivore. They have yellowish-brown, overlapping scales across their back, similar to those of a pangolin and a long snout. Their tail hangs low and is covered in wide plates, with the shape of the tail resembles that of Gowngoats. The males possess three large spikes on their back and are darker in color.
dalthydon: Dalthydon is a bipedal dinosaur-like herbivore, somewhat resembling the Olorotitan. They have grey skin covered by white and dark brown fur. Similar to Kestodon, they have an armored head to presumably protect from and charge at threats. Connected to the head are small ram-like horns. Their eye pupils are horizontal like a goat's eyes are.
bulaqchi: Bulaqchi resemble a giant, flightless mosquito with a yellow or yellow-green color. Their abdomen is covered in long thick, black netting-like hairs.
gajios: The Gajios is a small crocodilian-like creature closely resembling a real-world crocodile. Its most striking feature is the row of horn-like scales on each side of its snout, making its head resemble a double-sided saw.
gelidron: The Gelidron is a relatively small Amphibian that is no larger than a human is tall. Overall, the creature closely resembles a giant salamander, with a portly body, rounded head with small, almost useless eyes, and a fat tail. Its head is a dark black, while the rest of the animal is a mix of blues and pinks, resembling the image of oil on water. When observed up-close, one can notice the entire body of the Gelidron is covered in a thick layer of translucent mucus that darkens as they submerge into the oil and tar of their native habitat. On their limbs (with 4 toes on the front pair, and 5 on the back) are gecko-like pads and sharp claws for climbing. Inside their mouth is a sticky pink tongue used to consume decent sized prey at high speed.
comaqchi: Comaqchi are giant carnivorous insects similar to the Bulaqchi. Their bulky forelegs are well adapted for punching and their tail is armed with a stinger. Their exoskeleton is mostly pink, save for their blue stinger, and is covered in small hairs. It is described as smooth and lustrous.
gogmazios: Gogmazios is a massive Elder Dragon with a body structure similar in nature to that of Gore Magala and Shagaru Magala, albeit with proportionally-larger wingarms. It has a large, heavy head with red eyes and rows of sharp teeth. When its chest and throat begin to heat, a glowing pattern, reminiscent of a scowl, is present beneath its chin, giving it the semblance of a second face. Its wingarms feature membranes that almost completely retract when not in use, and its body is covered in thick, powerful scales, carapaces, and spines of an indigo colouration. Perhaps the most notable features of Gogmazios's body are the ever-present covering of a sticky, tar-like substance which it uses to incapacitate prey, and the presence of ancient siege weaponry lodged in its back.
doshaguma: Doshaguma is a large monster with a bear-like gait. It is covered in thick golden-brown fur, with the area surrounding the back of its skull and the peak of its spine being noticeably shaggier and similar in appearance to a lion's mane. Similar to Arzuros, Doshaguma has armored forelegs and bear-like paws and claws, though not as heavily armored as the former's with only several small scutes and bumps being present. Its face is wrinkled, slightly reddish in hue and completely devoid of fur, with two large oval-shaped bony pads on the top of its cranium. Its eyes are noticeably smaller than any other monsters. It also possesses distinctive tusk-like canines on both jaws, with the tusks on the lower jaw protruding upwards being slightly larger in comparison. Its tail is long and covered in flowing brown fur as well. It seems to be similar in size and appearance to another Fanged Beast, Goss Harag.
balahara: Balahara is a supple, serpentine Leviathan with a body shape similar to Agnaktor and Lagiacrus. Its body is covered in small, brownish-gray scales that grow larger and sharper on its sides. It has four short legs and a long drill-like tail. The Balahara's most distinguishing feature is the unique shape of its head. Its tripartite jaws bear three tongues, and both its upper and lower jaws are covered in large amounts of sawblade-like teeth. The inside of its mouth emits a faint blue glow, and it has multiple pairs of tiny, scallop-like eyes lining its jaws. Also lining both sides at the base of the neck are shark-like gills.
lalaBarina: Lala Barina is a large temnoceran with a unique appearance. Its six legs are jointed and are covered in sharp-looking spikes. Its thorax and abdomen are instead coated in fluffy hairs. Its abdomen culminates in a retractable stinger, which it can use to sting enemies. The frontmost pair of legs is normally tucked within its body, but can also open up to reveal appendages that resemble clawed hands. Its head is small, with two large, orange eyes, two slightly smaller pairs of eyes above, a cluster of three small eyes in the center of the forehead and a pair of chelicerae. Its most distinguishing feature, however, is the fact that, when enraged, part of its abdomen opens to reveal a tuft of red hairs shaped like a rose bloom.
quematrice: Quematrice is a Brute Wyvern covered in mainly green scales with red and blue stripes, like most brute wyverns it has short arms and large hind legs used for locomotion. It has reddish orange crests around its eyes that gives the appearance of a mask, a large comb atop its head, and a wattle on its throat, giving it the appearance of a cockatrice. It has an unsually large tail draped in layers of loose skin, from which it emits a highly flammable oil that can ignite with friction.
uthDuna: Uth Duna is a massive reptilian Leviathan with a hefty quadrupedal body. It has a narrow, arapaima fish-like face equipped with powerful jaws and small sharp teeth. Its body is covered in colorful red and lustrous scales in a striped pattern that looks similar to the ones of an Arapaima. Uth Duna's most recognizable features are the massive translucent and watery "fins" on its head, back, forelimbs, and tail formed from a mix of water and mucous secretions along several long tentacles on the leviathans head, limbs, and back, and on these tentacles are lined with long cilia which act as the skeletal structure of Uth Duna's watery fins. When these fins are devoid of water and damaged, Uth Duna will retract these tentacles and its body appears more noticeably seal-like; visibly heavy, yet streamlined and graceful in water.
rompopolo: Rompopolo is a brute wyvern with an unusual and bizarre appearance; it has the basic brute wyvern body plan with small arms, large hind legs and a powerful tail, but it also has a long sharp beak similar to that of a hummingbird or a mosquito proboscis, equipped with a long tongue capable of forking at the end, its short arms have long sharp front claws like a mantis, and it has gecko-like toe pads on its feet and beady, close-set reddish violet eyes that seemingly lack eyelids.
hirabami: Hirabami is a leviathan with a peculiar body shape, similar to that of Somnacanth. Its body is mainly colored a dark purple, with shades of cyan all throughout. Its head is pointy and covered in segmented plates, while its lower jaw can split in two. The inside of its mouth is brightly-colored, and it has two small white eyes that lack pupils. A large membrane begins from the sides of its head, running down the entirety of its long neck and ending at its shoulders. Each of its arms has a fin running from the elbow to the hand, and is tipped with a single, sickle-shaped claw. Its back legs are small and thin, ending in flat pads. Its tail is thin at the base but thicker at the end, and culminates in eleven pairs of clamping claws.
jinDahaad: Jin Dahaad is an enormous monster with a long, serpentine body and four limbs. Its head is small, with small green eyes mostly obscured beneath metallic facial plates, and a bottom jaw capable of splitting in two. In addition, it possesses several sets of metallic, jagged horns, forming a "hood" near where the head meets the neck. Its neck is long, surrounded on either side by metallic plates akin to ribs and vertebrae. A row of upward-pointing, rod-shaped plates grow on top of the monster's shoulders, while another row grows horizontally across them. A similar arrangement is also present on its hips. Its chest has several large spikes protruding outwards, and the outline of its ribcage is seemingly visible. Its limbs continue the pattern of plates seen on the neck, with the forelimbs specifically having an extra row of spikes above the wrists, and ending in angular claws. Its tail is long and sinuous, featuring rod-like plates like on the shoulders and neck across its length, and ending in an arrangement of spines pointing in various directions.
nerscyllaHatchling: Nerscylla Hatchlings are small white temnocerans that resemble adult Nerscylla, but lack the poison spikes and Gypceros hides of the adults.
zohShia: Zoh Shia's initial appearance takes the form of an "angelic" dragon superficially resembling that of a six-limbed Elder Dragon. Its body covered in a sleek, paste-white shell of pure Wylk ("Wyvern Milk") crystal with a smooth, featureless face and numerous crystal formations all over its body and wing arms that curve upwards like feathers. Its mouth, which is normally not visible when closed, has unnatural blue flesh and small teeth. The Wylk crystals on its limbs give all its claws a feathery covering. Aside from the Wylk coating, the flesh itself is smooth and black with glowing veins of blue light similar to other Constructs.
guardianDoshaguma: Compared to regular Doshaguma, Guardian Doshaguma have white fur with prominent glowing veins covering their head and forearms.
guardianRathalos: Guardian Rathalos have distinctive glowing veins over their head, body, wings, and legs in addition to white patterns on their wings and pale red scales. They have solid black eyes.
guardianEbonyOdogaron: Guardian Ebony Odogaron have distinctive glowing veins over their body in addition to white patterns on their body and forelegs. They have solid black eyes.
piragill: The Piragill is a small, slender leviathan with a long neck. They are primarily blue in color, with a darker blue stripe running from the top of their head, down the length of the body, and fading into the navy-blue tail. Their heads are small, with a short, sharply hooked snout superficially resembling that of a parrot. Piragill have a row of jagged red spikes down their backs, starting at the tip of the nose and ending roughly three quarters of the way down the tail, with blue webbing between. They have a small verticle fluke at the end of their tail. Their legs are short and navy blue, with flat, paddle-like webbed feet.
guardianArkveld: Guardian Arkveld is nearly identical to its standard counterpart, with glowing veins covering its head, body, forelimbs, and chainblades. It appears more white in comparison to normal Arkveld. Like other Guardians, it has solid black eyes.
guardianFulgurAnjanath: Guardian Fulgur Anjanath have white patterns on their head and body, glowing veins covering their head and body, and entirely black eyes.
kranodath: The Kranodath has roughly the body plan of a dromaeosaurid dinosaur, except with flexible arms with pronated wrists and a long, stiff tail. The creature's entire body is colored ash-gray, transitioning into a light purple on the neck and head. Its head has tiny pinprick eyes, a mouth filled with sharp teeth, and a red casque above the snout. The most characteristic feature of the entire species are the four thick plates that emerge in pairs from its head and neck, which it can expand and contract at will.
rafma: Rafma are small quadrupedal caprine-like creatures, with two horns and brown fur all around its body. They have a stout body, hooved feet and a short tai. The Rafma has a flat snout, a forehead covered in black scales and two flat horns on its head. Alpha Rafmas have larger, anvil-shaped horns and are slightly taller than their herd members.
porkeplume: The Porkeplume has a bipedal body similar to that of theropod dinosaurs. It is covered in fluffy white feathers, with brown on the feet and tail and orange on the underside and head. It has bristles on its head which can be puffed out for protection. Its head is similar to that of dryosaurs, with a beak.
wudwud: Wudwuds resemble anthropomorphic badgers mixed with otters. They have bear-like hands for manipulating tools and two distinctive canine teeth protruding from their upper jaw. WudWuds are often seen wearing clothes made of various natural materials found in their native habitat, most commonly large, hollowed-out mushroom caps worn as helmets.
crimsonFatalis: Crimson Fatalis is a Fatalis whose shells and scales have become a reddish-crimson color after generations of exposure to the Volcano. The majority of its body is still black in color, but these red scales take up its chest, neck, undertail, and the tips of its wings. One of its four horns is extremely overgrown in comparison to the rest.
whiteFatalis: Old Fatalis is strikingly different in appearance from its relatives. It is covered in luminous white scales, and a line of fur runs down its back and tail. Its horns are antler-like in nature, and the structure of its head is significantly less reptilian than that of its counterparts. Like Kirin, the coat of a Old Fatalis produces a bright white aura. When enraged, the throat and chest of the Old Fatalis glow a menacing red and becomes surrounded with red lightning sparks.
ukanlos: Ukanlos closely resembles Akantor and Odibatorasu in body structure and possesses the same quadrupedal gait. It has a silvery-white carapace which features a row of large, jagged fins along its back. It has a small, compact face which features glowing yellow eyes, sharp teeth, and a massive, shovel-like chin.
najarala: Najarala is a large Snake Wyvern with bright green skin adorned with large orange-yellow plates on its back and tail. It has a long serpentine body with small though fully functional fore- and hindlimbs that aid it in moving around on uneven ground. Najarala also has a large beak-like mouth similar to that of a parrot, along with a small pair of tusks.
dahrenMohran: Dah'ren Mohran is a large, whale-like dragon that is covered in armor plating. Unlike its relative, Jhen Mohran, its body is jagged and sharp, with spine-like protrusions on the forelegs and back. In addition, Dah'ren Mohran's face features a single gigantic, knife-like horn that extends several meters from its head rather than the pair of horn-like tusks found on Jhen Mohran.
dalamadur: Dalamadur is a massive serpentine Elder Dragon similar in appearance to Najarala. It has a snake-like face, with bright red eyes, numerous fangs, and many hook-like spikes along its body which start out clustered around its head and neck, and becoming more spread out along its long body, with a small cluster near the tip of its tail, which is topped with a pair of red barbs that it can rattle in a manner similar to rattlesnakes. The back has 2 massive spikes with medium-size ones behind them. It has a pair of large clawed forearms like Najarala, but the only remnant of hind legs it has are small spurs, similar to pythons, boas, and anacondas. Its chest has glowing vents, which huff steam when it is enraged. Its face and tail will also glow red when in its raged state.
tidalNajarala: Tidal Najarala features a blue, yellow and grey hide lined with rows of purple and green spines.
desertSeltas: This subspecies features a green, orange and brown shell, and seems to have reduced flight capacity. Its canopy features a double-pronged structure, rather than the single barbed spine of the common species, and its eyes shine a bright green.
shahDalamadur: Compared to regular Dalamadur's more monochrome coloring, this Subspecies possesses a paler body and differently colored spikes, having changed from a blueish-grey to red and gold. Though many say the spikes on its head appear bigger than usual, it is hard to confirm this due to the sheer size of the monster. Apart from those previously mentioned changes, as with most subspecies, Shah Dalamadur appear otherwise identical to their original counterparts.
maccao: Maccao has a body shape similar to the dromaeosaurid dinosaurs. Its body is covered in green feathers with red underbelly. The legs and hands are covered in hard brown shells, which can also be found on its thick tail.
greatMaccao: The Great Maccao's feathered crest sets them apart from its Maccao pack. Although superficially similar to its younger brethren, a Great Maccao is bigger and bulkier, with more brightly-colored plumage. It also has powerful legs it uses to kick threats and to move with great speed, and its spiked tail allows it to propel itself forward and jump with tremendous force.
malfestio: Malfestio superficially resembles an owl. Its body is covered in blue plumage with a grayish belly, a yellow collar, and a white face with a small beak and red eyes. On its head are long tufts that point back and are tipped with yellow. There are hints of yellow on its legs that end in scaly feet that have two talons and one small vestigial toe. Its wings have bright blue membranes. Along its wings are long blade-like claws. Its flattened tail ends in a three-pointed shape. Like a real owl, it can turn its head around to see directly behind itself.
redhelmArzuros: Redhelm Arzuros are among the largest of their species. Their forearms, feet, eyes, and upper body-fur are blood-red in color. Aside from those sections, their bodies are primarily blue, with their carapace and lower body-fur being a greenish blue. A pronounced strip of fur atop their head gives the impression of a mohawk.
stonefistHermitaur: Stonefist Hermitaur sports blue-purple coloration throughout its body. Its left claw has grown larger in size and has larger spikes on the edges.
drilltuskTetsucabra: Drilltusk Tetsucabra are very close to normal Tetsucabra in appearance, but bear a few distinctions from them. A Drilltusk's horns are longer and more pointed, similar to how its tusks are much longer than a normal Tetsucabra's. It also possesses longer fangs, and one tusk is always longer than the other. Unlike normal ones, Drilltusk Tetsucabra have more blue markings and scales toward their anterior. Drilltusk Tetsucabra loves to go on rampages as well.
nakarkos: Nakarkos is a massive cephalopod-like monster. It has glowing yellow eyes and a massive, sharp beak. It has blue skin with spots of turquoise bioluminescence. The most unique feature of a Nakarkos's body is its self-made covering of bones which it uses to protect and camouflage itself. Under normal circumstances, the Nakarkos's face cannot be seen. Its two primary tentacles are covered in vertebrae and tipped with skulls, creating the appearance of a two-headed skeletal dragon.
snowbaronLagombi: Snowbaron Lagombi have darker colored fur on the lower half of their bodies and along their backs, becoming a brown color. Their plastron bellies are purple in color. The armored sections on their forearms are no longer visible due to their fur growing longer there. Their ears have oval tips as opposed to the trapezoidal tips of regular Lagombi.
crystalbeardUragaan: Crystalbeard Uragaan possesses a near identical body shape to the normal Uragaan, yet has a different coloration. With an orange-red body, it blends in well with its fiery, volcanic habitats. In contrast to its overall orange hue, this gem-clad Deviant has shiny, blue-ish purple minerals protruding from certain areas on its body. These gemstones can be found jutting out of its tail and chin.
valstrax: Valstrax is a slender Elder Dragon covered in gleaming silver scales. Its most notable feature is its wings, which have fused into a trident-like structure, each segment ending in an opening designed to expel dragon energy in the form of reddish flames. Its back is lined with fin-like projections. Its head is avian in shape and has a small crest, and its eyes have red irises and blue sclera. Its chest has three horizontal gaps that are used to take in and pressurize air like a jet engine.
nightcloakMalfestio: Nightcloak Malfestio has golden scales on its chest and the edges of its wings and bright red wing webbing and tail feathers. Its tail feathers are dark purple in color and resemble a four-pointed claw.
rustrazorCeanataur: Rustrazor Ceanataur's look nearly identical to a normal Shogun Ceanataur, except for the claws, with the blades at the very end having a different shape, alongside there being an additional couple curved back spikes on top. These claws are usually brown in color, though they turn an iridescent blue color once sharpened. These Ceanataur's have exclusively been seen wearing either a Glavenus and Gravios skull on their backs.
jhenMohran: Jhen Mohran is an extremely large monster, with a long, almost serpentine body shape. On each side of its head are sturdy, sharp-ended tusks which can be broken by hunters. Due to its back legs being vestigial, it moves either by dragging its enormous body along with its arms on the ground or by swimming in the sand. A rocky spine runs along its back, where valuable minerals can be found.
terraShogunCeanataur: While considered a Subspecies by the Guild, Terra Shogun Ceanataur is actually the same species as Shogun Ceanataur. Terra Shogun Ceanataurs are particularly aggressive Shogun Ceanataurs that have moved to harsher environments, such as volcanoes and swamps, to live in solitude. These environments provide unique sources of nutrition, giving Terra Shogun Ceanataurs a reddish-brown coloration. Living in these harsh environments has also toughened the shells of Terra Shogun Ceanataurs, making them much harder than the average Shogun Ceanataur. Their habitat also gives them access to the notably tougher skulls of Black Gravios, giving them even more defense against intruders.
ceadeus: Ceadeus resembles a giant whale with a face similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dunkleosteus Dunkleosteus]. It has a prominent beard of fur and two massive horns, which constantly grow and eventually overtake the creature’s eyes, leaving it blind. Luminous organs line the monster's underside aswell as the top of its mouth, which turn from blue to red when it is enraged.
direMiralis: Dire Miralis is a very large, semi-aquatic Elder Dragon. Its body structure is reminiscent of Fatalis, with relatively short limbs and a long tail and neck. Its body is filled with a magma-like substance which pools at the base of the tail, the chest, and at each shoulder. Each of these pools directs magma flow to certain parts of the body. On its back are a pair of wing-like appendages. Seemingly useless in terms of flight, these "wings" feature cannon-like chutes which can extrude globules of magma, both as a means of defense and as a way to jettison excess magma. Dire Miralis's head features a frill-like structure and an upturned snout.
berserkTetsucabra: Berserk Tetsucabra has a dark green body with a grey tail and brown tusks due to the soot and gas from the explosions caused by explosive rocks. The monster's face will also become orange from each explosion as well.
tigerstripeZamtrios: It has an orange-brown body color with some red shades mixed in it while fins and belly are more blueish.
agumon2006AnimeVersion: A unique Agumon which has bound red leather belts around its arms, its maturation is presumed to differ from its traditional evolutions. As it's still growing, its power is weak, but it has grown hard, sharp claws on its hands and feet, and demonstrates its power in battle. Its Special Move is spewing flaming breath from its mouth, striking the opponent (Baby Flame).
falcomon2006AnimeVersion: A subspecies of Falcomon whose wings have developed to allow it to fly freely in the air, in contrast to normal Falcomon, who possess powerful leg strength. Despite its ability to fly, it seems to be obsessed with making its appearance from above by flying in on a kite, like a ninja. Its Special Moves are scratching the opponent with the claws on its wings (Scratch Smash), and repeatedly throwing 4-point shuriken made out of hardened feathers (Shuririnken).
yatagaramon2006AnimeVersion: Possessing three legs, it is a bizarre Bewitching Bird Digimon and a subspecies of Yatagaramon. Although its jet-black body presents an evil image to those who see it, it is told that it is the Digimon who guides the chosen to the "Golden Land" in the eastern Digital World. The eastern Digital World is a region where there are still many mysteries, and it is said that the "Golden Land" is protected by multiple sacred barriers.
kudamon2006AnimeVersion: A Holy Beast Digimon that wears a holy cartridge case. It is said that day after day, it accumulates holy power within the earring on its left ear, and that the stored power is great enough to have influence on its next evolution. It has a calm, cool, and collected personality, conducting a precise assessment of the situation even in combat, and attaining the advantage in battle.
beelzebumon2010AnimeVersion: An aloof demon warrior possessing terrifying destructive power. Although it is seen as having a calm personality as a result of its indifference to strangers due to its taciturnity, in actuality, it loves conflict more than anyone else. It is considered one of the strongest Digimon, and anyone who sees Beelzebumon's figure and still challenges it to a fight is nothing but a fool.
cyberdramon2010AnimeVersion: An otherworldly Digimon rumored to have turned up from another world. Since both its language and thinking patterns are completely different, it is regarded as fundamentally impossible to communicate with Cyberdramon. It is dangerous, with extreme combativeness befitting its otherworldly appearance.
metalgreymon2010AnimeVersion: The "Tactical-enhancement Mode", which possesses Mail Birdramon's armor on top of Greymon's power, is a form that was strengthened without hindering the fighting strength of Greymon, who specialized in close-combat fighting.    As its "Trident Arm" is a technique that was enhanced exceptionally in offensive ability by adding extreme high-temperature claws on top of Greymon's already mighty power, and its "Giga Destroyer" is an annihilation technique in which it irradiates extremely high-energy, homing laser beams at all opponents in its surroundings, it has been strengthened from a Greymon that excelled in one-to-one battles to one that could fight one-to-many.
greymon2010AnimeVersion: A Tyrannosaurus-type Dinosaur Digimon. As a Digimon specializing in offensive power, its combat instinct is extremely high, and its cruel, brutal nature is such that it will not stop battling until it annihilates the opponent, so ordinary Digimon cannot even approach it as they are repelled by the abnormal fighting spirit it exerts on its surroundings. Its "Mega Flame" is a jet of flames that incinerates its surroundings, and its "Blaster Tail" allows it to strike enemies from any direction within 360° of itself.
n1ShuunenUsapyon: USApyon is handing out balloons for Yo-kai Watch World's 1st Anniversary party. He even modified his ray gun for the occasion and is helping with the lighting.
n1ShuunenWhisper: Whisper is brainstorming ideas for the first anniversary party. It seems he plans to make a surprise entrance by popping out of a special, oversized kusudama prepared for the occasion.
ageagehaShouEn: A butterfly Yo-kai with wings so beautiful they seem otherworldly. Anyone who inhales his wing powder will make them feel incredibly uplifted.
akaOniRyoFu: Gargaros, the symbol of terror who descended from the Terror Time. His power is so immense that he obliterates weak Yo-kai.
amanojakuKanGen: If you are inspirited by Contrarioni, you'll turn into a stubborn person who can't accept anything honestly.
amaokami: The ocean's beauty caught Alpina's attention, reincarnating as an ama. After diving into the ocean, growing coral, and heading back to shore, she picks up flotsam and protects the life of the ocean.
amefurashiSaiBou: He keeps puffing out rain clouds and making it rain here and there, thoroughly drenching everything until it's completely soggy.
anikiGiEn: A legendary Yo-kai said to have single-handedly annihilated an entire gang of delinquent Yo-kai. He is revered by many underlings as their big brother.
