aoOniRyoFu: He continues to wander through the Terror Time, mercilessly swinging his iron club. He will only befriend someone that possesses the true strength of heart needed to overcome the Terror Time.
apelicanBaTou: A cheerful pelican Yo-kai who studied in Texas and became infatuated with American culture. He knows a lot about America, but can't speak English at all.
armsman: Even headless he gives 110 percent. He dreams of reuniting with his head someday... Not sure how he dreams-- he just does.
atsugaruruKouhoSuu: A Yo-kai with a hot heart and body. Just having Swelterrier nearby makes it so hot that you won't even need a heater.
ayamaridaoshiTokuYuu: A Yo-kai that resembles a giant domino. No matter how small the mistake, he keeps blowing it out of proportion and piling on the blame until he crushes both his victim's body and spirit.
babangKouGetsuei: She blasts embarrassing secrets all over town through her giant speakers. Anyone whose secrets are exposed won't be able to live it down.
bakeArareSaiBou: A Yo-kai with powerful ice powers even when it's alone. If you are hit by his freezing air or ice crystals, the part they hit will freeze solid.
bakuRiShi: A Yo-kai that makes the「dreams」people are seeing her food. She puts the person she inspirits to sleep and slowly enjoys feasting on the dream they are having.
bakuonNarashiKanChuu: In pursuit of the ultimate deafening roar, he ended up riding off on a stolen motorcycle. Those annoying people who make a racket on the streets might be inspirited by Rawry.
bakusokuTaishiJi: He clings to your feet and runs around town. He races at incredible speed and can't stop even at dead ends. If he clings to you before a race, victory is practically guaranteed.
benkeiTenI: He hides 999 swords, stolen from his defeated opponents, in his stomach. When necessary, the swords shoot out and impale his enemies.
bikyakuShinKenei: A swift messenger Yo-kai with beautifully shaped legs that gives anyone it inspirits incredibly gorgeous legs. If it inspirits a man, he ends up with needlessly beautiful legs, making for a rather pitiful sight.
boobouTouKen: He's usually spaced out, but when he's spotted, he runs away at an astonishing speed. He can run 100 meters in under 8 seconds.
budounyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai made from 100% grape juice. He bewitches girls with the sweet aroma he gives off from his body. He even claims to be the most popular guy in the entire fruit industry.
bukakkouChouHan: If you become possessed by this guy, even the most proper and well-mannered person will end up looking awkward and unfashionable. He's worried about it and is feeling down about it.
bunbundoriJoEi: He uses his perfect lassoing skills to snatch things from others. He has a legendary story of using a rope to retrieve his ex-girlfriend from a wedding.
bunnyChocomint: Agent Spect-hare hands out Valentine's chocolate for her mission. She is like a cool chocolate mint, tricking the target with sweet differences and smartly obtains information from them.
bushinyanFuture: ”Bushinyan conformed to modern high-technology and reincarnated. Belonging to special forces called SNYAT, he protects everyone's safety with his armor-style bulletproof vest and proud sword.
bushouHiNoShin: A godlike Yo-kai with unparalleled creativity who can instantly materialize any thing that comes to mind. He has so many things he wants to do that his two arms aren't enough, so he grown six arms to keep up with his activities.
chikuchikuUniRyouKa: Coughkoff looks almost exactly like him. Since they are often mistaken for each other, he regards Coughkoff as his sworn enemy. If he were by the water, he’d be Hurchin.
daJi: A female fox Yo-kai who has lived for over a thousand years. Long ago, it is said that with her beauty and sweet, melting voice she bewitched the king of a nation called Yin, leading it to ruin. In fact, she likes cute things, and she can't help being kind to small animals.
daiHaouKomasanSonSaku: Komasan, who became stronger with the help of "Little Overlord" Sun Ce, trained further to protect his friends and reached the peak of his "Great Overlord" power. I'm trying my best to let the hem of my fine cloak flutter so as not to step on it and fall.
daiMaouShibu: A Great Demon King who creates new and interesting things, captivating people with them. He loves the heroes who challenge him and always smiles even during battles. Incidentally, the floating games around him are some of the masterpieces he created himself such as「Romance of the Three Kingdoms.」
daiTotokuNurarihyon: Zazel has navigated through many battlefields and wields the right command as the governor. His military administration gives all Yo-kai a place to play an active role, leads the battle to victory, and brings more prosperity.
daidarabotchiSekiHeki: A legendary giant Yo-kai that even appears in fairy tales. Some even say that, rather than being a Yo-kai, he is actually a god that created mountains and ponds.
daijaNoTsuboHouKi: It looks like an ordinary pot, but inside is a huge, snake. It is said that the jack-in-the-box was invented by someone who happened to see a pot with a snake inside.
daikudanKanRo: After overcoming harsh training, he awakened her ability to see the future. He can foresee anything, but he will never use it for anything bad.
darudarumaBunShuu: At first glance, it looks like a daruma that seems to bring good luck, but inside is a Yo-kai with a weary-looking face. When someone is inspirited by this Yo-kai, their body becomes sluggish and lethargic.
darumatchoBunShuu: Through training in the mountains, he overcame his laziness and became muscular. The scar on his forehead is actually body paint meant to show off his training.
denjinBaKin: A Yo-kai that governs radio waves, sometimes revered almost like a god. Thanks to the widespread use of smartphones, the value and appreciation of Signiton have apparently increased tremendously.
denpakuKozouBaKin: A mischievous Yo-kai that happily gobbles up the radio waves drifting through the air. Whenever it's around, cell phones stop getting a signal.
devibiranKakuShi: Timidevil having shed his cowardly heart, has become the most powerful demon. However, he can still occasionally revert to his old self.
devibiruKakuShi: An extremely timid demon. Always on edge and unable to unleash his true power. Some say he is invincible when he can relax.
dokechingKaKu: A greedy Yo-kai who schemes to make all the wealth in the world his own. He will stop at nothing to obtain money.
dorobokkunSakuYuu: Having developed a taste for never returning borrowed items, Yoink has now become an active thief. He snatches up what he steals and stores it in the furoshiki on his head.
doukakuDoujakudai: Anyone inspirited by Castelius III will end up in third place no matter what they do. Those who are satisfied with Castelius III will never see a truly bright tomorrow.
dummkap: This hat Yo-kai can make geniuses into dreamy fools. A foolish life can be more fun...but would you even realize if it were?!
ema: Neighfarious was accidentally enshrined because his name sounds similar to "ema". He was already a rare creature, but now that he's been deemed sacred, the mystery surrounding him only deepens.
enraenraShinShi: A smoke Yo-kai that wanders the air, constantly changing shape. Being made of smog, she can take on any form, but her current form, which has received the most positive feedback, is her favorite.
fujiNoYamaChouKou: A Yo-kai from a snowy region who loves sumo wrestling. With legs and hips honed on the ice, he displays astonishing tenacity in any situation.
fujimiGozenSuuShi: A Yo-kai who has achieved immortality. She can no longer die and does not age. Her power seems to lie in her staff, so if the staff is taken away, she ages instantly.
fukaiKoHou: One of the Wicked Executives. She loves unpleasant emotions and try to share that unpleasantness with others. She is the most beautiful among all the Wicked.
fukuroJijiiHiI: A Yo-kai that delivers and distributes presents to souls. Since all of the gifts come through Santa Claus and are nothing but wonderful presents, you can accept them without worry.
fukuryuuRyuuZen: A dragon that brings happiness, with a flower of happiness blooming on his head. His power to bring good fortune is famous and there are apparently shrines dedicated to Bloominoko.
fusafusanHouTou: A Yo-kai that makes everything grow thick and fluffy. If something is furry in a place where it shouldn't be, it's probably this Yo-kai's doing.
fuumazaruBaChou: A monkey Yo-kai possessing the power of the Fuma clan. Before becoming a Yo-kai, he was apparently a legendary ninja. Even now, he steals treasures silently, like the wind.
fuuminChouSen: The power of Diao-Cicada, one of the four most beautiful women in China, resides in Insomni, a Yo-kai who does not let you sleep. Insomni seems to be satisfied with her gorgeous outfits and decorations.
gabunyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai that became Dracula-like taking in the blood of a Western Yo-kai. His ability to suck blood is not very strong, and even if you get bitten, at most you'll only become anemic.
gakiKanGen: A Yo-kai that throws childish fits and bothers everyone around him, even though he's already grown up. Be careful not to end up acting like Tantroni.
gamanmosuKouGai: As a result of continuing to hold in his pee, he developed the ultimate endurance, allowing him to endure just about anything. Why he kept holding it in for that long, however, remains a mystery.
garioujiKouhoSuu: An ice wolf believed to be the guardian deity of the snowy mountains. Many legends tell of people who became lost in the mountains and were rescued by him.
gekiDragonSouShin: A Yo-kai that explodes with such furious rage that it can shake the earth. When inspirited by a Firewig, one loses control of oneself in rage, to the point where all the dishes in the house break.
gikkuriOtokoGakuShin: A fearsome Yo-kai that wreaks havoc on people's lower backs, leaving them with a sudden, crippling back strain. Older people are more susceptible to being inspirited by him.
ginkakuDoujakudai: Anyone possessed by Castelius II will end up in second place no matter what they do. It might not seem so bad, but it's not good to be satisfied with this, you'll never become the very best
gishinankiKanGen: An oni who can't be satisfied unless he questions everything. He always travels together with his fellow oni, but he doesn't trust them in the slightest.
gokuOrochiShuuYu: Goku Orochi imbued with the power of Zhou Yu, a handsome military commander with wisdom and bravery. Goku Orochi's ruthless assassination techniques have been honed to their limits by Zhou Yu's talent.
gokudouGiEn: Wielding his trusty「nail bat,」this assault squad captain Yo-kai charges headlong into battle. Despite appearances, he takes good care of his juniors.
goridarumaBunShuu: As a result of striving for even greater heights, Darumacho gained the physique and strength of a gorilla. He can crush cars like marshmallows.
goukaiToYo: One of the Wicked Executives. A Yo-kai who insists that everything be done in an extravagant manner. He possesses the greatest raw power among the Wicked.
guraguraionChouHi: With his strong legs stomping alternately, he shake the earth violently. It is said that the vibrations caused by Quaken have the power to move even the most stubborn hearts.
gurerurinGiEn: A troublesome Yo-kai whose reason for living is to act like a rebellious tough guy. He possesses serious people and drags them into the world of evil.
gyakujouoRiKaku: This is a nasty Yo-kai that, no matter how wrong it is, will lash out and rampage when scolded. Those who lash out when scolded might be inspirited?
hakaiBunOu: One of the Wicked Executives. He is the leader of the Wicked and lives by the motto of destroying everything. His combat power is the number one among the Wicked.
hakujaKaira: Ananta jumps into the world of the Three Kingdoms as a military commander. He races through the battlefield as a military commander and fights bravely at the vanguard. On various battlefields, he continues to hone his martial prowess.
hanahojinChinKyuu: Snottle doesn't need a reason to pick his nose. He has two nostrils. Whatever's in them, he just wants to dig it out. That's all there is to it.
hanakoSanSaiEn: Hanako-san, who researches how to scare people in the times. She has the power of Ei, who has excellent literary talent, is enthusiastic about research, and has left many works.
happiUsapyonChuutatsu: USApyon enlivens the festival by wearing a happi coat imbued with the power of Zhongda. With the dream of traveling through space someday in mind, the festival drums sound towards the sky.
haraoDoriJoEi: A somewhat strange Yo-kai with a pattern on his stomach that looks just like an old man’s face, he is particularly skilled at belly dancing, using the pattern as part of his performance.
harawashellChouSeihei: If you get inspirited by him, you'll start paying for everything without hesitation. Before you know it, your wallet will be completely empty.
hareOtokoShibaShou: Wherever Ray O'Light is, it never rains. He's always cheerful and energetic. He's currently making an strong effort to brighten the heart of Drizzelda.
hatsudenshinBaKin: He is usually lazy, but it is said that if he were to get serious, he could solve every energy-related problem imaginable. A god of the world of energy.
hekokijinYouHou: A Yo-kai that farts incredibly badly. If you ever find trapped in an enclosed space with Cuttincheez, you'd better prepare for the worst.
higurashimaruUKin: A practitioner of the Cicada Ninjutsu who fights while singing in a beautiful voice. Yo-kai who use this ninjutsu are extremely rare, to the point that their battles attract spectators.
hikikoumoriSoJu: If you're possessed by Hidabat, you'll become afraid to go outside and end up reclusing. People nowadays are especially prone to being inspirited by Hidabat, so be careful.
hiraishinRaiDou: A Yo-kai that gathers lightning and controls it at will. No matter how troublesome the problem, he takes it on like a lightning rod. Lately, it seems to be taking on too much and is starting to get stiff shoulders.
hitomakasenninSaJi: A Yo-kai who leaves absolutely everything to other people. He employs dozens of disciples and leaves everything up to them. He even leaves fighting to someone else.
hitotsumeKozouOuRou: A mostly harmless Yo-kai with no special powers, so much so that people would be surprised if he appeared. The only thing he enjoys is that he only needs half as many contact lenses as everyone else.
homuraTenguBaShoku: Tengu with fiery red hair. It is said that when the world is in turmoil, he causes droughts and withers the land, warning people against their actions.
honebijinBiShi: She boasts that no one can match the beauty of her bones. So confident is she in her skeleton that she decided to live with her bones completely exposed for all to see.
horyuuRyuuHyou: A dragon Yo-kai that can't make decisions right away and always puts things on hold. When you get inspirited by him,「Let's put it on hold for now!」will become your catchphrase.
houroushiTeiIku: He travels from place to place on a wandering journey. It is said to be a miracle when the three elder brothers, Illoo, Elloo, and Alloo, gather together.
huXimei: She is a pheasant Yo-kai and the younger companion of Da Ji. She is a bright and energetic girl, but she has a selfish personality that wants to do whatever she wants. Because Wang Guiren, who is always with her, doesn’t listen to what she says, they often end up arguing.
hyouhennaSonKen: At first glance, she looks like a Reversa, but it's actually a rare Yo-kai whose pattern colors are slightly different. It seems to stay depressed longer than a Reversa.
hyouhennuSonKen: One moment he's all smiles, the next he's suddenly depressed over something trivial, causing trouble for everyone. In a way, he's even more troublesome than Dismarelda.
ichigonyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai made of 100% strawberry juice. His greatest pride is being able to sit atop a shortcake, the highest honor in the strawberry industry.
ikemenkenKakuKyohei: By some mistake, the legendary human-faced dog has become incredibly handsome. His handsome smile will bring you comfort.
ikkakuSouHi: A sacred Yo-kai distinguished by his single beautiful horn. It is said that various powerful figures throughout history have used every means possible to acquire that horn.
inugamiJunIku: A nine-tailed dog spirit said to be even rarer than the nine-tailed fox. He has beautiful, silver fur, and it is said that if you have even a single strand of that fur, you will be guaranteed good fortune for generations to come.
isshougomen: He's been apologizing for a while, but he finally couldn't take it anymore, and decided to reincarnate. He apologizes for his very sincere apologies, but he, strangely, doesn't really feel that bad about it.
izanamiSonShoukou: A god-like Yo-kai who serves as the source of all life. As proof of this, she herself claims that most of the nearby gods were born from her.
jakouKenshinJyoka: The arrogant evil god, Nüwa, whose anger has reached its peak, unleashes her power. Wielding a sword imbued with the divine power said to have created humanity, she annihilates anyone who stands in her way. She will not stop until the world is plunged into terror.
janegabuunSouHyou: An evil Yo-kai that plunges the hearts of those he possesses into the depths of despair. Unless he disappear, it's impossible to recover on your own. Such a dangerous Yo-kai.
jetnyanChouUn: Jibanyan dreams of racing through the vast sky. However, even if he puts a model airplane on his head, there's no way he can fly, and it seems he's recently hit a dead end.
jibanyanSRyuuBi: Jibanyan has finally made his S-Rank debut. He seems brimming with confidence, believing the time has come to triumph over the truck, now reborn and stronger than ever...
jibanyanSenchou: Captain Jibanyan traverses the vast ocean in search of the elusive, Mythical Chocobar. He knows everything there is about the sea! But he's prone to seasickness. 「Let's set sail beyond the horizon, nyan!」
jigajiiSanGenHakuko: A Yo-kai that boasts「I'm great!」no matter what he does. It's best to just ignore him because dealing with him will only cause trouble.
jikochuuRiShuku: A mouse that spent so much time hiding in a ditch that he came to believe he was the center of the world. Those inspirited by him become incredibly selfish.
jimmyKouSo: When Dimmy inspirits someone, their presence becomes faint, and they become unnoticed by everyone. Dimmy uses this power for his work as a ninja.
jinmenkenRoShoku: A modern breed of a dog with a human face. He often surprises people who are drawn in by his cute back view. His dream is to be very popular with the ladies.
jinraiNoruka: Noruka has obtained the power of thunder that never ceases to resound. In a fight with his twin brother Soruka, who doesn't get along well, a tremendous lightning bolt roars. His appearance is exactly like the god of thunder.
jorogumoEnShou: A rain specialist. He likes highly feminine tactics such as poisoning cakes or using a kiss with deadly lipstick, but he is a real man.
joushouFuyunyanSouSou: Hovernyan, imbued with Cao Cao's power, became the highest ranking official, the chancellor. Even though he becomes great, he never forgets his guts and coolness, and aims for politics that is close to the people.
kabutoMusoTouGai: Only a Rhinoggin who has survived every battle and attained the power of the peerless is permitted to bear the name Rhinormous.
kageOrochiShuuYu: Acting as Venoct's shadow, he has carried out dark assignments such as assassinations. Almost no one knows of his existence, as he disappears if anyone sees him.
kagemaruUKin: Cadin, who has become a fine warrior after mastering the Cicada Ninjutsu. He is working hard to prove that even the Cicada Ninjutsu can make someone strong if they master them.
kagerooKouSo: A specialist in stealth who goes completely unnoticed by everyone due to his overwhelmingly faint presence. But, being unnoticed is actually a little lonely for him.
kageroushiTeiIku: An elder Yo-kai who specializes in disappearing like a mirage. He hides his presence and watches humans with a warm, amused smile. He is the brother of Illoo.
kaimuKouSo: His presence is so incredibly faint that even you wouldn't even notice him standing right next to you. Because of that, he became exceptionally good at entertaining himself alone.
kantetsuChouShuu: A Yo-kai that keeps playing video games without sleeping a wink. The dark circles under his eyes are so intense they go beyond mere ill health and make anyone who sees him feel uneasy.
kaoberosRoShoku: Since he has two creepy faces lined up side by side, nobody comes near him. He is an excellent guard dog and is even serving as a guard dog in Hell.
kappaKaiKakouTon: The wicked form of Faux Kappa. He drags people who approach the river into it, drowns them, and then eats the souls he pulls out through their buttocks.
karakaraSanBiShi: A skeleton Yo-kai dressed in Gothic Lolita fashion. She normally acts quiet and refined, but if you insult her clothes, she flies into a rage and reveals her true nature.
karakasaMajinChouKou: A Yo-kai who uses a Pallysol as a weapon. When the umbrella is open, it offers impenetrable defense. Closing the umbrella unleashes a desperate, all-out attack. A powerful Yo-kai that combines offense and defense.
karakasaObakeKaiRiTen: The wicked form of Pallysol. The resentment of a discarded umbrella has come back to life, and he has ended up attacking every person reflected in his eye.
karakasaObakeRiTen: A Yo-kai born from an umbrella that was used for many years. Remembering his owner's smiling face,he happily hops around on his single leg.
karamizonTouHaku: If Snaggly inspirits you, you'll become the kind of person who only causes trouble whenever they get involved. If a conversation just won't go smoothly, it might be because she is lurking nearby.
karipakkunSakuYuu: A Yo-kai that swallows up anything he wants to borrow and claims it as his own. If you become inspirited by him, you will never return anything you borrowed from someone.
kashiwasheru: This is Sakurasheru's evolved form for Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. With his plump, mochi-like appearance, he tempts people into buying kashiwa mochi. He's already planning what kind of 『mochi』 to get them to buy next.
katanoriKozouGakuShin: He has a short temper and is always kicking people’s shoulders. Getting kicked doesn’t cause any injuries, but it leaves you with terrible shoulder stiffness.
kayukayuSouHyou: If Scritchy is nearby, your whole body starts to itch. No matter how much you scratch, the itching won't stop, and your skin ends up all torn up.
kazekamoRyuuKi: Anyone inspirited by this Yo-kai ends up feeling like they have a cold, but it's not a cold, they become stuck wondering whether they should take cold medicine or not.
kemamonAkaiNan: A local mascot Yo-kai working hard to revitalize Harrisville. He continues his activities while grappling with the daily dilemmas of balancing his roles as a「character」and a「Yo-kai.」
keukegenHouTou: A hairy Yo-kai that appears in damp, shady places. He doesn't possess much power, but he can sometimes make the person he inspirits a little hairier.
keukegenKaiHouTou: The wicked form of Furgus. He awakened as a god of pestilence and began attracting dangerous evil energy. It is said that any illness summoned by Feargus can never be cured.
kinkakuDoujakudai: Gold medals, gold prizes, first place. If you're inspirited by Castelius I, you're sure to become number one at whatever you do. This is definitely what you should aim for.
kiraigyoRiKaku: A Yo-kai who looks for people's bad qualities and quickly comes to dislike anything and everything. His hobby is hitting the things he dislikes with the harisen on his tail.
kirakiraion: Blazion reincarnated as a cold Yo-kai with a shining, below-freezing mane and a cool personality. He analyzes battles calmly and instantly freezes enemies glisteningly.
kirakomaSonSaku: Koma Star, the superstar Yo-kai loved throughout the Yo-kai World, has been imbued with the power of Sun Ce, the brave superstar of Wu. With the combined charms of both, Kirakoma Son Saku shines so brilliantly that it's almost impossible to look at him directly.
kirinSouHi: A sacred Yo-kai that protects all life. The voice of Kyryn has the effect of purifying away evil energy, and in the Yo-kai World, it is distributed as a download on music sites.
kiwinyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai made from 100% kiwi juice. His unique charm point is the fine hairs growing on the surface of his body. Thanks to this fuzz, he feels soft but is surprisingly well-protected.
kizunamekoBenShi: The tongue of Tongus has antiseptic properties, allowing her to heal any wound simply by licking it. It is said that she can mend not only physical injuries but also the bonds between people.
kizunurseBenShi: Tongus became a nurse by making use of her talent for healing. She is like the idol of the hospital, and many people eagerly await Nurse Tongus’s licking treatment.
kodomonohiJibanyan: Clad in armor and a helmet, with a war fan in hand, Jibanyan looks a little brave as he celebrates Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. 「This war fan is so cool, nyan! Everyone! To battle, nyan!」
kodomonohiKomasan: Komasan crafted adorable carp streamers to celebrate Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. 「These carp streamers are higher than the roof, zura! I... I can't reach them, zura!」
kodomonohiShishimaru: Lie-in dressed up in a heroic costume to celebrate Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. Even today, he's taking a nap so he can grow up to be a fine samurai.
koenraShinShi: A Yo-kai that can appear anywhere there's smoke, such as from incense. When a Smogling grows, she becomes an Smogmella, but more often than not, she disappears before she ever gets the chance.
komamiSonShoukou: Komami, who travels the fields of the Three Kingdoms, has been imbued with the power of Sun Shangxiang, known as the 「Bow-Waisted Princess」and a lover of martial arts. Borrowing Sun Shangxiang's strength to bring peace to battles, she dreams of creating a world filled with 「Likes.」
komasanA: Having soldiered on steadily, Komasan's finally reached Rank A, much to the delight of his little brother Komajiro.
komejiiKouChuu: A very rare Hungramps whose body is made of rice. He is kind enough to let hungry people eat parts of his own body. Its flavor is said to be worthy of praise even among the finest premium rice.
konbuSanKanKou: One of Wiglin's dance companions. He takes pride in believing that kombu is the finest seaweed of all, and he also sees Wiglin as a rival.
kongaragalTouHaku: A troublesome girl who complicates conversations with her annoying tone. Apparently, many friendships have fallen apart when she gets involved with people.
koutenShishiEnma: Serving as a strategist, Enma overturned countless unfavorable situations and gained unmatched martial prowess and tactical brilliance. His command, capable of bending even unstable battle conditions to his will, shines with overwhelming brilliance on the Three Kingdoms battlefield.
kuchidakeOnnaSonRohan: If you become inspirited by Chatalie, you will only talk without taking action. As a result, you will lose everyone's trust.
kudanKanRo: A half-human, half-cow fortune-telling Yo-kai. He should have amazing powers of prophecy, but while he's still training, all he can currently predict are tomorrow's weather and pop quizzes.
kuiijiiKouChuu: A Yo-kai with such an insatiable appetite that he devours anything and everything in front of him. His mouth is practically like a black hole.
kuroganeSenbonShuuSou: He has a heavy, solid body made of iron. When a Ledballoon stands in your way, even a dump truck cannot move it.
kusaKuiOtokoKakouHa: A Yo-kai with no ambitions and simply wants to live alongside the grass. Anyone inspirited by him becomes a weak, effeminate, herbivorous person.
kusanagiShuuTai: A radiant holy swordsman wielding a divine sword bestowed upon him by the gods of heaven. Its sharp blade is said to cut down all evil and bring peace to the world.
kuwagaTaishouShouKai: Only a Beetler who has overcome countless battles can become a Beetall. If you're struck by his massive body, you won't stand a chance.
kuwanoBushiShouKai: A Yo-kai who fights with giant scissors and well-trained fists. He is still young and rough around the edges, but he is steadily building his strength by competing with Rhinoggin.
kyuntarouHanShou: An unbelievably cute dog Yo-kai that makes everyone around it swoon. He is aware of his own cuteness and cleverly uses those around him to his advantage. In reality, he is a little bit devious.
maboroushiTeiIku: A Yo-kai skilled at manipulating illusions. With a caring personality, he uses illusions to explain even the most difficult things in a way that's easy to understand.
magasusKousonSan: When inspired by him, you get an irresistible urge to do things that will get you in trouble. If you have a friend who is always playing pranks, maybe this guy has inspirited them?
maisonDowasureRyuuShou: Wazzat, has grown from a hat to the size of a single room. The amount he can eat has increased, allowing him to devour all of a person's memories.
mamemameinu: Although she has a gentle appearance, she is a "Bean Onryo" that can reduce the size of her opponents with beams emitted from her eyes. If you pamper her with her sparkling eyes, everyone will fall in love with her cuteness.
masamuneShuuTai: A Yo-kai swordsman who returned to the path of the sword after encountering a famous blade that stirred his samurai spirit. He uses his once-honed swordsmanship to punish villains.
masshirocake: Whenever someone asks Petty-Cake about her Christmas plans, she puts on a tough act and says, 「Leave me alone!」, so her calendar ended up completely blank. She even did her makeup perfectly...
matenSoranakiBoy: When Maten Soranaki grabbed the Satsuki doll's sword, for some reason his mind and body changed into that of a child! A super dynamic dark boy who mows down his enemies with full power!
matenSoranakiTouTaku: The power of Dong Zhuo, who was feared as a villainous tyrant, dwelled in Maten Soranaki, a knight of darkness born from feelings of resentment and hatred. With his mighty power of darkness, he plunges the turbulent world into further despair.
mekabuChanHouSanjou: Mekabu-chan, who is Sekisaku's lover and possesses the power of Abalone's three daughters, who excelled in martial arts. What about the love triangle between Wakame-Kun Kanojo and Konbu-san?
merameraionChouHi: The king of beasts with a fiery mane. He is a passionate man who pours out his burning passion on those he possesses.
michibikiChouShou: A cat Yo-kai made of 100% mandarin orange juice. He is more orange than cat in nature, and unlike ordinary cats, he seems to prefer resting on top of a kotatsu instead of snuggling underneath it.
mikannyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai made of 100% mandarin orange juice. He is more orange than cat in nature, and unlike ordinary cats, he seems to prefer resting on top of a kotatsu instead of snuggling underneath it.
mitomenEnKyoudai: A trio of foreign-looking Yo-kai. Even when something inconvenient happens, they all agree on their stories, saying「Nuh-uh-uuhh!」and refuse to acknowledge the facts.
mitsumataMizuchi: A demon beast-like Yo-kai who runs wild in the Yo-kai World and uses his three heads as weapons. It seems that he used to go out to drink and loiter around every night, alongside his former buddy, Slimamander.
mitsumataNozuchiRyuuYou: A snake-like Yo-kai with three heads and large mouths. When faced with its body, protected by thick skin like an elephant's, even a famous sword tempered through a hundred battles is no better than a dull blade. The large eyeball inside one of his mouths is Slimamander's weakness.
modakaAgeha: A first-year student at Youma Idol Academy, proud of being the most dazzling in her class. No matter how down someone may feel, she can lift their spirits to the highest level. She aims to become the ultimate idol.
monomannequinOuSan: It was once just an ordinary mannequin, but after imitating humans, it eventually became able to move. Anyone inspirited by him can't help but imitate other people all the time.
morezouKouGai: Something always seems to be about to leak out of his trunk, leaving him constantly fidgeting in embarrassment. When he reaches his limit, he attacks by spraying a tremendous amount of water.
motenusuKakuKa: Unlike Casanuva, this pitiful Yo-kai simply can't become popular no matter what he does. Anyone possessed by him will end up becoming just as unpopular.
mudazukaiChouSeihei: If you are inspirited by Spenp, you'll end up buying things you don't even want, and before long, all of your savings will be gone.
mukamukadeSouShin: A centipede Yo-kai that's always fuming. If you get inspirited by him, you'll feel incredibly irritated. Asking「Are you angry?」will only make things worse.
muramasaShuuTai: A ghostly swordsman, possessed by an evil cursed sword, wanders in search of someone's blood. He sneaks up from behind and slashes silently.
muridajouJoSei: He soars high into the sky, rejecting everything. What lies beyond Impass after overcoming it. That, no one knows yet.
mushaKabutoTouGai: A rough and tumble rhinoceros beetle Yo-kai. He is constantly battling Beetler for the title of King of the Bug Yo-kai.
mushibaHakushakuKakuShi: A terrifying Yo-kai that dissolves and ruins the teeth of anyone he inspirits. He loves the faces of children crying out in pain from toothaches.
nagabananaISeki: This Yo-kai looks exactly like Babblong, but is made entirely of bananas and has absolutely no relation to Babblong. His problem is that insects are attracted to him.
namahageChouRyou: A Yo-kai from the northern regions who goes from house to house asking, 'Any brats here?', frightening children. Lately, he’s been punishing kids who don’t follow traffic rules.
namigappaKyouI: Kappa normally live in rivers, but this one is a rare surfing Kappa that rides the waves out at sea. He's also a bit of a flirt, trying to pick up girls while surfing.
nankaiKaJuu: One of the Wicked Executives. He attempts to confuse others by using complex language. He possesses the most knowledge among all the Wicked
necrosnartle: Necrosnartle a terrifying Yo-kai that continually exhales a damp breath. If you’re cleanly cut down by the swords in his hands, regardless of whether you’re a good kid or a bad kid, you’ll become a zombie in the blink of an eye…
nekuramaTenguHouSei: A gloomy tengu who is always quietly reading books. However, there are many Yo-kai who find this atmosphere pleasant, and he has a hidden popularity.
nikuKuiOtokoKakouHa: His masculine instincts have exploded, transforming him into a true carnivorous guy. With his tanned body and smooth talk, he constantly hits on women.
ningyoSonShoukou: A Yo-kai with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a fish. She sings with a beautiful voice. Since she usually lives in the sea, she’s full of curiosity about people on land.
nitetesu: 「72 hours of gaming a day!」 That seems to be his motto; he's been playing non-stop for two full days without sleep. The coffee he drinks to stay awake has 10 times the usual caffeine!
nogappaKyouI: I'm a kappa living by the water, and I love taking walks. When I get tired, I refresh myself by pouring water from the river onto a plate!
norarikurariOuIn: He has a soft body and can smoothly dodge any amount of complaining thrown his way. If you become inspirited by Ben Tover, you become exceptionally good at making excuses.
noroinoHanakoSaiEn: Toiletta after growing up and becoming a high school girl. She has become a dangerous girl who doesn't even listen seriously in class and thinks about curses all the time.
obakuSamaRiShi: She possesses the power to enter dreams. With the help of Bakulia's power, she can even enter the dreams of someone she is interested and learn how that person truly feels.
odenjinBaKin: The Oden Master of the Yo-kai Food Stall. He serves up flavorful oden while telling interesting stories, and it's said that if you grow up eating it, you'll become a fine, flavorful adult.
oiranSuuShi: She maintains her youth and beauty by draining the life force of her victims. She particularly prefers young and beautiful women and is always searching for her prey.
okaneniderYouShou: A brave hero who rose up to help the poor people of the world. However, his biggest obstacle is the cost of transportation, as he has no money to get there.
omatsuriRabby: A Snow Spect-hare who changed in a heart-shaped way at the arrival of the summer festival. This year, she seems to be deciding the best shaved ice flavor by eating various flavors of shaved ice.
omatsuriShishimaru: Lie-in continues training hard even in the summer. After getting tired and taking a quick nap, he was jolted awake by fireworks exploding and festival music. Today is a fun summer festival!
omatsuriHime: The fascinating Blizzaria experienced the enthusiasm of a festival and reincarnated as a festival Yo-kai. Inspirited humans will always be in a festive mood and will want to shout at any time and anywhere.
omoidashinJunYuu: A deity who governs memories. By using a mysterious vacuum cleaner to suck out a person's memories, he can even bring back memories from their previous life.
omoidasupponJunYuu: If you put the softshell turtle you've been carrying on your back onto your head and pulls it off with a「Flush!」even things you have forgotten will come back to him. It'll clear away the mental fog, too.
onarazumonoYouHou: A Yo-kai that spreads farts whenever the opportunity arises. If you become inspirited by this guy, you won't be able to stop farting, so dash to a place where there are no people!
onemuNoSeiChouSen: If you are inspirited by her, you can play with Sandi in your dreams. It's so much fun that you become unable to wake up and continue sleeping forever.
oniKuiJoSho: A terrifying Yo-kai said to feed on onis. He has a mouth large enough to swallow an oni whole, though it’s said to sometimes get a stomachache from it.
onitaiji: Prohibited from eating oni for a diet, Demuncher reincarnated into a slim, handsome man. The spiral on his head changed to long hair and can be freely manipulated to eliminate oni.
ookuwanokamiShouKai: A stag beetle Yo-kai that has mastered the martial arts to the point of being worshipped as a god. Anyone inspirited by him gains strength comparable to that of a god of war.
ootsunonokamiTouGai: When the Yo-kai Rhinoggin attains even greater power and reaches the realm of the gods, it becomes the one and only being known as Hornaplenty.
ooyamaSunaoKanYou: Sandmeh, with his honest and straightforward personality, grew into a diligent office worker. His perfect, sincere bows make others instinctively bow down to him.
oshisshouKakuTo: A professional at creating awkward situations, even more so than Compunzer. His jokes are so old-fashioned that they only elicit awkward laughter. He himself thinks he's receiving high praise.
osuberiSamaKakuTo: A Yo-kai who always creates an awkward atmosphere when trying to get a laugh. He has a strong heart and doesn't care even when his jokes fall flat, but everyone around him suffers.
otomorashiKanChuu: He inspirits people who are listening to music through earphones and makes the music leak out loud for everyone around them to hear. It seems to be particularly prevalent on trains.
otsuboneSamaSonRohan: If you become inspirited by Nagatha, you'll become a nagging, overly critical person who won't overlook even the slightest mistake.
pintocool: Suddenly, a Cornfused had a flash of inspiration, and turned into an ice cream Cornfused. When this guy is around, your head becomes clear and everything gets a bit cooler. I don't know if it's my imagination or not, but it seems to beat the heat...?
poppoJibanyan: Jibanyan has become a train station master. He stands at attention on the platform, but in reality, he's just sleeping while standing up. Ironically, this habit became a talking point, and he gained fame as the "Sleeping Station Master."
positibun: Influenced by a positive aura, Negatibuzz inadvertently reincarnated. Since then, he thinks very positively about everything, and his life has become brighter!
pridonShuZen: A super-luxurious tempura rice bowl Yo-kai with both an exceptionally high price and an equally high sense of pride. Be careful, because if you get inspirited by Pride Shrimp, your pride will increase and you will incur the resentment of everyone.
purachinaKakuDoujakudai: He is also known as「Hakkin-kaku.」A very rare yokai, if you are possessed by him, you will become a special being that transcends the concepts of winning and losing.
puruphantKouGai: This Yo-kai will endure even the most painful situations, trembling all the while. If you are inspirited by him, you will become incredibly patient.
putasockinit: Those inspirited by Putasockinit will always push things too far, upsetting all their friends.
raiOtonMouKaku: No matter how lazy a kid is, they work briskly in front of Papa Bolt. He's terrifying when he unleashes his thunder.
raizouRaiDou: The furoshiki on his back, which stores tremendous lightning power, was a gift from his mother. He channels that power into his spear to unleash a devastating strike.
rakutendouYouShou: He is incredibly optimistic about everything and don't worry about anything that happens. He is the kind of Yo-kai you'd like to be, but if he inspirits you, it's still a problem.
redJRyuubi: A devilish Yo-kai feared as the strongest of all Yo-kai, leaving behind various blood-soaked legends. Accompanied by his vicious minions, the「Army of Hell,」he goes from town to town, committing every imaginable atrocity. It is said that not even a single blade of grass remains where Rubeus J has passed.
reisenjaKaira: Having traveled across countless battlefields, Ananta's talents as a military commander have fully blossomed. Leading the charge at the front of all Yo-kai, his figure, repeatedly victorious in peerless battles, resembles that of a mythical serpent who brings wars to an end.
reitouOnigiri: Flamurice finally reincarnated after being refrigerated for a long time! If he wants to return to his original form, heat him up in the range for some time at home! Can you easily reincarnate?
rifujinOuI: A Yo-kai that constantly says unreasonable things and causes trouble for those around her Her selfish behavior toward her husband is especially outrageous, yet strangely enough, their marriage is still going well.
rimokonKakushiChouEn: A Yo-kai that enjoys hiding the TV remote just to watch people panic. It's this guy that's responsible for finding remotes in unexpected places.
roboRyuuKunRyuuGu: This is Draggie's robot, who came from the future. He lost the path to evolving into Dragon Lord by gaining a body of steel, but he gained power that was comparable to him.
roboGKouChuu: A robot version of Hungramps that came from the future. Even after becoming a robot, he is constantly short on energy and always feels hungry.
robogappaKyouI: A robot version of Walkappa that came from the future. The plate on his head is now made of titanium, so it will never crack or break again.
robokomaSonSaku: A robot version of Komasan that came from the future. He's still not good with cities. His batteries often run out while he's wandering around.
robomenkenRoShoku: A robot version of Manjimutt that came from the future. At this point, it's doubtful whether he can even be called a Yo-kai anymore, and there's absolutely no trace left of his original human-faced appearance.
robonyanSea: A summer type Robonyan who has undergone extensive modifications to operate underwater. By rotating the propeller on his back, he swims at the same speed as a jet ski.
rokurokubiChouShunka: A Yo-kai with the ability to stretch her neck to great lengths. As long as she doesn't stretch her neck, no one realizes she is a Yo-kai, but she simply can't resist doing it anyway.
rokurokubiKaiChouShunka: The wicked form of Lady Longnek. She uses her long, outstretched neck as a weapon, wrapping it around defenseless people and squeezing them, causing them to suffer.
rubynyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai whose entire body is made of rubies. He defeats his enemies with a body that shines like flickering flames.
saikouchouShouEn: People possessed by him can bring out a level of peak performance unlike anything they have ever experienced before. A butterfly Yo-kai that everyone desires.
sailornyanChouUn: A marine-loving, girly cat Yo-kai who works on a ship. Her feminine charm is exceptionally high, making her the most popular among the crew.
sakigakenosukeKinSen: A Yo-kai whose motto is to be the first to charge into any battlefield, living for reckless attacks. He fights naked, so he's always tanned.
sakuraNoJimaChouKou: A sumo Yo-kai with explosive power on the level of a volcano. Mad Mountain is his eternal rival, and their head-to-head record stands at 99 wins and 99 losses.
sakuranyan: Powered by a miraculous force, the fluttering cherry blossoms and Jibanyan have combined! With his mysterious, cherry-blossom-shaped paws, any cherry blossom, whether 20% bloom, 50% bloom, or 80% bloom, will be in full bloom, nyan!
sakurasheru: It's spring time and Almi has transformed into a sakura mochi. His body emits a wonderful scent that makes people buy sakura mochi. However, this phenomenon only occurs during cherry blossom season.
sanshokudangomasan: Komasan went to see the cherry blossoms and became captivated by the three-colored dumplings. Carrying the giant, chewy, three-colored dumplings, he tore off bite-sized pieces to share with the other viewers.
santakuRoushiHiI: He gives you one of the best present, the ordinary present, or the worst present. If you ask for all of them, though, he simply leaves.
sanzuNoInuRoShoku: An elite watchdog of Hell, born and raised there. He won't allow a single soul to escape from hell to the surface.
sebastianShokatsuKin: A genuine Yo-kai butler dispatched by the Yokai Butler Association. His techniques are top-notch, but his pursuit of perfection sometimes leaves everyone stunned.
seiOkanShuKuyuu: Sometimes strict, sometimes gentle, she embraces and cares for all Yo-kai. No matter what Yo-kai it is, they cannot raise their head before Mama Aura.
seiryuuRyuuGu: A legendary divine beast. He governs the power of water and protects beautiful waterfalls and rivers. His power is said to surpass even that of Dragon Lord.
semimaruUKin: He's apparently a practitioner of a ninjutsu technique called Cicada Ninjutsu, which nobody has ever heard of. His actual abilities are nothing special, and his only real strength is his ability to run away.
sharekofujinBiShi: A fashion-obsessed Yo-kai with an outrageously flashy style. She inspirits people she likes and makes them adopt the same fashion sense.
shidoromodoroTouKen: If this Yo-kai possesses you, you'll have trouble getting your words out, and even you won't understand what you're saying. He's especially dangerous when reading aloud.
shikirunjaTeiGen: An elder snake Yo-kai who always wants to be in charge of everything. When he gives orders with his tail, which bears a commander's war fan, for some reason no one can bring themselves to disobey him.
shinObaaShuKuyuu: Her boundless kindness heals everything. No matter how evil a Yo-kai may be, when embraced by Auntie Heart, it regains they beautiful heart.
shinigamiKamaitachi: Whirlweasel dresses up as a shinigami and participates in the Halloween festivities. His prized scythe, decorated extravagantly, can slice through anything at high speed. Even hard pumpkins are no problem for him.
shinigamidoriChouHan: If you see a Skreek, you should run away immediately. They plunges the person they inspirits into the depths of despair and never returns.
shippuuSoruka: Soruka has gained the power of a fierce wind that never stops blowing. During a fight with his twin brother, Noruka, who doesn't get along well with him, he creates a tremendous windstorm. His appearance is exactly like a wind god.
shippuujinraiNorukasoruka: Noruka, who has gained the power of thunder, and Soruka, who has gained the power of wind, combined to create Shippuujinrai Norukasoruka. A roar of thunder and a violent storm rages, devastating everything around him.
shirokabeJoSei: Long ago, he served as the wall of a magnificent castle, but after the family that defended it for a long time perished, he has now become a Yo-kai.
shishiEnma: Lord Enma jumped into the world of the Three Kingdoms as a warrior. He soon learned the ability to watch the game calmly, but he never stopped growing stronger as he learned more on the battlefield.
shishikomaSonSaku: Having wandered countless times, Komasan has become incredibly strong. Not only has his strength grown, but his heart has also matured, and he's no longer easily intimidated. A truly reliable Yo-kai.
shiwakuChanSuuShi: She was beautiful in her youth, but now she's a wrinkled old woman. Resenting smooth, beautiful things, she gained the terrifying power to make anything become wrinkled.
shouseiFuyunyanSSouSou: With love, guts and moxie as his watchwords, he underwent further intense training and became a super shōsei S rank. It is said that his overflowing guts and spirit have become even hotter, but he himself doesn't really care.
shouseiJibanyanRyuubi: In a mysterious world, Jibanyan, who has become armored, has the power of Liu Bei, a hero who was active in ancient China. As a result of accumulating his virtues, he became a shōsei, and his motivation to unify the world seems to have increased.
shouseiKomasanSonSaku: The will of the courageous "Little Overlord" Sun Ce gave the kind-hearted Komasan more confidence and strength, powering him up as a shōsei star. With his inherent curiosity, he runs around the vast battlefield to the west and east.
shurakomaDenTan: Before the era of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Tian Dan was a military commander who saved the Qi nation from crisis with his ingenuity. That power dwells in Komashura, which is said to have the heart of Shura.
shuugenOrochi: Venoct wears a blue kamishimo. He arrived dressed in formal attire befitting a celebratory party. 「What a joyous occasion. A bit of festive revelry isn't so bad once in a while...」
snowRabbyBenShi: Snow Spect-hare was born when a snow rabbit possessed the mind of a child, has been imbued with the power of Lady Bian, the modest wife of Cao Cao. With a gentle heart that cherishes things dearly, she continues to wear her favorite costumes and hair accessories.
soureisenjaKaira: Ananta, who has overcome countless deadly battles as a military commander, has gained authority and wisdom that overwhelms others. With his freely manipulable Blue Flame and his powerful Snake King Sword, he has an absolute presence on any battlefield.
sternyan: The normally lazy Jibanyan has had a change of heart. Now everything is SERIOUS! Even his hair roots are serious!
summerRabby: In love with the summer sea, Snow Spect-hare reincarnated. If you luckily meet her on the beach during the summer of the year, it seems something wonderful and memorable will happen.
summerShakurero: A rising star of the Yo-kai pro wrestling world is taking on the beach volleyball tournament, representing his team! His brutal spikes bursts the ball with a single hit.
summerTheShark: The Jawsome Kid, a popular wrestler making waves in the Yo-kai World, is entering the summer beach volleyball tournament! He overwhelms his rivals one after another with spectacular high-impact moves honed from pro wrestling!
sunaoKanYou: This Yo-kai has a very honest personality. Even the notorious「Roughraff」apparently became obedient, turning into a refined young gentleman with silky-smooth hair.
sunesnakeTeiGen: A snake Yo-kai that's always sulking. If you get inspirited by him, you'll become a petty person who sulks over even the slightest unpleasantness.
tabigappaKyouI: A kappa who travels from place to place, honing his swordsmanship. With his prized blade made of water, he slices through anything with effortless, clean cuts.
taigongWang: A long time ago, he was a Taoist from Mount Kunlun who led the nation of Zhou. Cheerful and easygoing, he seems inscrutable at first glance, but he possesses a strong will to fulfill his mission. He’s a passionate fishing enthusiast, though apparently not very skilled at it.
taishiGensuiNata: This is the powered-up version of Nezha, who can freely control the Hermit's weapon known as Pao Pei. He can now use more Pao Pei at a time, making him even stronger, but his childlike nature has also increased, and he innocently swings them around.
tararinSaiBou: A nosebleed Yo-kai, just as his appearance suggests. When inspirited by him, not only nosebleeds but also paint, ink, udon broth, and all sorts of other things will start to drip.
tenguBaShoku: A great Tengu who controls an extraordinary power over the wind. It seems that the power of the sacred treasure fan he holds in his hand is greater than his own abilities.
tetsuyaChouShuu: A true night-owl Yo-kai that keeps playing all night, no matter how tired he gets. If you have a friend who brags about staying up all night, they might be inspirited by Wydeawake.
todomekiKakouEn: An oni with many eyes all over his body. Apparently, only one of those eyes is connected to his heart, and he can only be defeated by shooting that particular eye with an arrow.
togenyanChouUn: Jibanyan's attack power has increased thanks to his signature spiky body. After Thornyan finishes fighting, the surrounding area becomes covered in spikes, making it far too dangerous to go barefoot.
tohohogisuChouHan: A bird Yo-kai with a gloomy complexion. Those inspirited by her can't help but say,「Boohoo,」and end up making a series of embarrassing mistakes.
tojikoumoriSoJu: Hidabat stayed inside his house for so long that he eventually fused with it. Having become so completely one with his home, it's now impossible for him to leave.
tomnyanS: Tomnyan continues to challenge BBQ crosswalk convoys. His heart gave in, and steeled itself, it resulted in him turning into an S rank.
tooMuchToTake: Mishearing is no longer a problem for this Yo-kai, but now it can't stop hearing unsolicited rumors about itself.
toosenbonShuuSou: A strange Yo-kai who is passionately devoted to blocking the path of anyone who walks by. What motivates him is a mystery.
topanyanChouUn: A cat Yo-kai whose entire body is made of topaz. Anyone who can become friends with Topanyan is extremely lucky.
torajirouSonKen: While continuing his journey in search of Komasan, he grew stronger and more resilient. The power of the fierce tiger awakens, and the tiger's fighting spirit surges forth.
toushirozameKoShaji: Anyone possessed by Shrook will become hopelessly bad at things they're normally good at. Even someone regarded as a master craftsman becomes as incompetent as an amateur.
toushouDouketsu: In order to help his master, Voidera became a Bushou full of fighting spirit. At times, he uses his ingenuity to disturb the world of war. Seeing his back, countless soldiers aspire to become a Bushou commander like him.
tsuragawariToShi: When she inspirits someone, their face changes, causing everyone to think「Have you always looked like that?」every time they meet someone. She often inspirits women.
tsuraretarouMaruKanNei: The guardian of Catfish Pond, he is the master of the pond. He gets extremely angry at people who disturb the pond, he can lose all sense of restraint, but the fish hold him in high regard because of his manly personality. At a single call from SV Snaggerjag, the big fish of the pond immediately come gathering.
umaGinnan: A cheerful Neighfarious that sports large ginkgo leaves on his back. Where have his wings gone? The mystery of this enigmatic Neighfarious only deepens as autumn arrives.
umaKousonSan: A horse Yo-kai that glows mysteriously in the night sky. Neighfarious himself is so incredibly rare that no one knows what kind of Yo-kai he is, or even what the「farious」part refers to.
umiBouzuSekiHeki: A Yo-kai with a heart as vast as the ocean. And that's no surprise. In fact, he's an embodiment of the sea, and it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that he is the ocean itself.
ungaiSanmenkyoDeiKou: Mirapo has split into three faces, tripling his yokai power. He can now transcend not only space, but time itself. He is currently studying time paradoxes.
ungaikyouDeiKou: An ancient mirror of noble lineage that became a Yo-kai after a spirit took up residence within it. He possesses the mysterious ability to connect mirrors with the space within them. He polishes and maintains his mirror 3 times a day.
urakyuntaHanShou: A terrible Yo-kai that seems to embody every last one of Pinkipoo's devious traits. Anyone he inspirits becomes completely wicked, letting their scheming nature run wild.
urayamashirouChouIn: A Yo-kai that envies even the smallest things other people have. But he makes no effort to obtain those things himself.
urayameshiShuZen: A bento box Yo-kai made only of rice, who always looks enviously at everyone else's lunches. If you are inspirited by him, you will immediately become envious of others.
usacake: Usapyon is baking homemade cakes to celebrate the first anniversary. He couldn't settle for just the mini cakes, so he turned himself into a cake too! 「The best cake is me, dani!」
ushiJibanyan: Longing for the easygoing life of a cow, Jibanyan has fully transformed into one.「A leisurely, slow-paced life... Moo~ I don't think I can ever go back, nyan~」
wakameStarKanSaku: Wiglin has risen to become the top dancer of the seaweed world. Through the power of his dance alone, he fills live concert venues all across Japan with fans.
wakameKunKanSaku: Wiglin is a seaweed Yo-kai who dances gracefully in an effort to spread awareness of「Wiggling Wave,」the famous local dance from his hometown. He's very healthy thanks to the power of seaweed.
wakaretaro: ”Shmoopie lost all his love and reincarnated. The heart he carries is now a broken heart. Anyone inspirited by him will feel extremely heartbroken.
wangGuiren: A biwa Yo-kai and the sister-in-law of Da Ji. She's always in her own world, listening to the tunes that run through her head. Because of that, she doesn't listen to people, and she often gets into fights with Hu Ximei, who is always with her.
warautsuboHouKi: An eel-like Yo-kai that's always laughing, no matter what he finds so funny. He bursts into laughter at the slightest thing that tickles its funny bone. Maybe his sense of humor is just a little strange?
warunyanChouUn: This is Jibanyan in his rebellious, delinquent form. With his impressive pompadour and homemade tokko uniform, he has a style that really evokes a distinctly old-school style.
wasurenbouRyuuShou: He fits perfectly into a person's head and devours their memories. Sometimes, he can even make them forget unpleasant things.
wondernyanChouUn: A wondrous cat Yo-kai who has traveled across many continents and embarked on numerous grand adventures. He is searching for his next adventure, accompanied by his beloved bandana and sword.
yadokoumoriSoJu: A rare Abodabat that shuts itself away in a lodging house instead of his own house. Once a year, the rare sight of him changing houses can be witnessed.
yakkaiKakuWai: One of the Wicked Executives. A Yo-kai who finds joy in being a nuisance. He's the most spiteful of all the Wicked.
yamatanShikoutei: A Yo-kai formed by the fusion of eight dragons. Each dragon’s personality remains, and they switch rapidly from one personality to another. If you’re inspirited by him, people might think you’re an unreliable, two-faced person who talks out of both sides of their mouth.
yametaishiSouShoku: A monk who gets bored with everything almost immediately. He has magnificent eyebrows and a long beard, but rumor has it they're only that way because he's too lazy to bother trimming them.
yamiKagamiDeiKou: A Yo-kai that stores the power of darkness within the endless space that unfolds within the mirrors. He lends that power to evil Yo-kai with interest, gradually accumulating his own strength.
yamiKyuubiJunIku: Kyubi, who was captivated by the power of darkness and stained by it. Whether or not he wish for a day when all hope is trampled upon and the world is filled with despair.
yangJian: A Taoist priest of Mount Kunlun, the same as Taigong Wang. He has the ability to become a hermit, but he is an oddball who continues to call himself a Taoist. He specializes in the art of change, and is said to be able to manipulate 72 different techniques. His overconfidence is a flaw.
yaoBikuniSonShoukou: Sun Shangxiang, who fell in love with the hero Liu Bei, who became an emperor in ancient China. Had her power reside within Mermadonna, the legendary immortal said to gain eternal youth by being loved.
yokodoriJoEi: Anyone who is stared at by Peckpocket becomes consumed by the desire to possess other people's things, becoming incredibly greedy.
yomiTenguHouSei: A Yo-kai that came from the underworld, but became quiet after becoming fascinated with books from the human world. When he gets too noisy, he gets angry and unleashes his original terrifying power.
yoroiSanSouJin: He lives each day with all his heart, dreaming of the day he'll be reunited with the other half of his helmet.
yotsumeChouShou: This yokai has four eyes that can read a person's「date of birth,」「favorite food,」「name」and「soulmate.」She can't read what's in someone's heart, though.
zashikiWarashiChouRo: A mischievous child Yo-kai that lives quietly in old houses and storehouses. He brings a small amount of happiness to the house he takes up residence in.
zashikiWarashiKaiChouRo: The wicked form of Gnomey. Misfortune continues to befall the house he settles in, and eventually even the family living there falls apart.
zashikiWarashinChouRo: The deity of the Gnomey world. It is said that by enshrining just one strand of High Gnomey's hair, the household is guaranteed happiness for generations to come.
zekkouchouShouEn: This butterfly Yo-kai possesses the wonderful ability to put anyone he possesses into peak condition. He is often mistaken for Enefly.
zetsuOjiiMouKaku: He possesses absolute power, so much so that even his father fears him. His「Table Flip」technique, which can turn everything upside down, is extremely famous.
zhouWang: He was once the king of the Yin Dynasty. It is said that, bewitched by Da Ji, he lost sight of everything around him and became a tyrant. However, he was born with the pride of royalty, and was a wise, brave, and prudent ruler.
zoromeDaimyoujinKaiEtsu: If you're possessed by him, you'll end up getting caught up in all sorts of strange fates. Whether those things turn out to be good or bad, even Dubbles doesn't know.
zouoRiKaku: He holds grudges over the smallest things and strikes from behind. The sight of Rageon standing by your bedside with a hatchet in hand is terror itself.
zukyukyuntaHanShou: Thanks to his irresistible cuteness, he grew up receiving all kinds of love, earning him the title of Aristocrat of Love. He can charm anyone and make them act like his servant.
zuruzuruZuruRyuuKi: A crane Yo-kai with an unbelievably runny nose that just won't stop dripping. His biggest problem is that the snot is too heavy for him to fly.
platedArrow: The real design of this monster is in the form of vapor.
aquaspike: An Arrow Head well-adapted for the water. It has very few enemies living down there.
blixyKlingySub: Using infrasonic math, DJ {{IMDB|nm1818640|Kaz Gamble}} & Singer {{wk|wikipedia|Sisely Treasure}} decomposed sound into its most elementary frequencies, creating this stylish and trendy monster.
blixyKlingyDuckenSub: Blixy Klingy was found clinging to a rock on a gourd-shaped island. It's known to blow up in anger when people say it looks like a pirate. But we don't think that, do we?
caro: A monster who boasts fancy pink scissors. It feels uneasy about having its claws get dirty in battle.
canaloa: Canaloa’s body is covered in a rubbery shell. It can repel any attack!
ciseaux: Its claws' hardness is outstanding among the Arrow Heads. There is nothing in this world it can’t cut.
coralMonster: Its texture is soft like a sponge. It feels so good you want to sleep on its back.
cutieAntlan: Its fashionable color scheme is very effective. It’s anxious for a fight.
dodongoDragon: This dragon can only be seen in the desert area.
dragoonAntlan: Knick-named 'Hard-Puncher' for its two fists. Its body may be small, but its courage is huge.
dragoonCentaur: This monster is the mixture of a brave Dragon and a just Centaur.
dryadArk: It is usually laid back, but when it comes to those who destroy the environment, it transforms into a beautiful woman and bravely confronts them. It is good friends with the [[Earth-Keeper]] and [[Ecologuardia]].
evePixie: One who will obey you well. Born under the Devil's will.
fayPixie: I wonder what misery those dark eyes have seen? It's said Fay has been through such sadness that the tears have dyed the area around its eyes black...
fireGear: Pierces opponents with burning scissors. Although rare in Arrowheads, the reliable Fire Gear is water-averse.
gaiaXenon: It is named after one of the primordial gods. Its body color is strongly influenced by its Centaur DNA and it retains the great cavalry sense, even though it only has two legs.
geckoWorm: He keeps his body heat by being covered in scales.
gawainJoker: A unique-looking monster whose entire body is covered in armor. It is said to possess immense [[power]], and those who face it on the battlefield are struck with terror.
girtab: Girtab, which symbolizes death, is considered inauspicious. Only those who can overcome superstition have the qualifications to raise it.
goldieDurahan: Clad in magnificent golden armor, it would rather not dirty or damage it if not necessary.
graspecter: The central characteristic of a grasshopper is hopping and jumping around in grassy fields. Jumping around seems to be fun!
honeyHare: Honey is famous for its cute hips and round ears. No matter how hard it flaps its wings, it can only fly a couple inches at most.
ironclaw: There are many Arrowheads, but among them, when it comes to just the scissors, nothing surpasses this one. It has the strongest attack [[power]].
isisGuard: In the age of myth, it served to protect the [[Deities|gods]]. Because it had that role, its [[Defense|defensive power]] is absolutely overwhelming - it’s just that durable and sturdy.
javelineer: Its fast charge attack is the selling point of the Javelineer. Even if it’s dodged, you'll end up in trouble...
kirinZuum: This monster was once a decorative ornament at a shrine, but one day it came to life and ran away. Now it's worshipped as a god in some [[Eastern Continent|eastern provinces]].
landshark: Its super-strong scissors have destructive power comparable to a [[Shark]]’s jaw. If you get caught in them, you won’t survive!
landDiver: Its drills spin fast and crush rocks. It digs underground freely, just like swimming underwater.
leonBaku: 'Sleeping Lion' is the perfect phrase to describe Leon, because it is asleep just about all the time. Maybe a little bit too much.
logSawer: Its body is made out of solid oak and is not soft but inflammable.
liveriz: Liveriz is getting more and more popular with women for its angel-like fluff and lovely smile. It doesn't really like to be considered the Beata that's a little too peaceful.
luluMomo: Sometimes you will find a wild Lulu while fishing. Fisherpeople love to see Lulu's cute face emerging from the water.
lilyPixie: A mischievous child who likes to play in the water, its shiny skin has a slimy texture and apparently some people have a bad feeling about it.
magicBananaMonster: Naga ate a special banana rumored to alter its Lifespan and turned into this incredibly bizarre monster as a result.
merryArrow: It is said to have been created to be eaten during a celebratory season, but it evolved a resistance, and as a result, that custom disappeared.
mewhead: It was named that because of its cat-like friendliness. Be careful, as it will playfully come at you with its claws.
mermaidUndine: This monster appears in fairy tales once in a while.
meteoriteDino: This monster has a ferocity amplified by the Joker's blood. It wears a creepy mask that makes it impossible to read its expressions, making communication extremely difficult.
milkyWayGali: One of the real 'star-gazers' who likes to wish on them.
mustardArrow: Dropping tears does not always mean that it is sad.
oldovis: One of the monsters with the oldest history, but its [[Power]] still has not declined.
nutArrow: It is said that every time it cracks walnuts, its claws get stronger. A hard working monster.
paBilSag: Its name means 'The [[Night Scorpion|Scorpion]]’s Tail.' As its name suggests, it defeats opponents with its powerful tail. Its existence is almost god-like.
pepeMomo: Pepe is popular with children because of its cute walk, but Pepe actually does not like kids much because they always mess up its neat hair.
puddingelSuzurinSub: This Jell monster loves the sound of the [[Suzurin]]'s bell. It wishes it could be a bell and make such a pretty sound, too! (That's why it eats so much metal.).
puddingelSub: A very tasty-looking monster. It's true what they say, that the [[Tochika]]ns invented pudding after first seeing a Puddingel.
priarocks: This monster inhabits the desert and is nocturnal.
renocraft: This monster is a prototype made by engineers prior to Henger.
rainbowDoodle: This Doodle has returned in full color! It was already mysterious enough, but now it's become even more incomprehensible...
roseRiver: They appear in groups along the rivers in the spring, and it is said that their name was given because of the beauty of the scenery they create.
rubyTiger: The red body signifies the blood of [[Nagazi]], the strongest monster of all. Maybe there is a [[Breeder]] who can revive this monster.
salamanderZuum: Its IQ is lower than Dragon's. It is very fast and violent.
saintArrow: Its pure white body is proof of divine lineage. As a sacred monster, it is commonly worshipped in desert regions.
sabani: A rare monster that inhabits a [[Age|small island]] in the south. Even if you find it, it wanders off and disappears somewhere.
selketo: It has thousands of thorns, and stings whoever touches it.
scorpionMonsterRancher: A monster that possesses the soul of a [[Scorpion King|once-great king]]. Overflowing with confidence no matter what opponent it faces, it stands ready, challenging them: 'Come at me!'
shanxDuckenSub: It is said to have mastered a traditional dance from an ancient civilization. Where it learned the dance, however, remains a mystery.
silverFace: It has escaped from its trainer because of its hard training.
stalgunner: It's a battle monster that has been modified so extensively that you could even say it's closer to a machine than a monster.
stingerDinoSub: He can jump well and has an exceptional taste palette.
tanuta: It loves to sing with its striped tail wagging. It has a very playful personality and loves to travel, but it needs to be watched carefully if you don't want it to escape from your ranch.
tornadoPsiroller: This is Tornado. He is the expert of great tackles! No one can approach his dumbbell trained body.
tornadoHare: Likes the big moves. Able to charm unsuspecting people.
venomhead: Its striking appearance and graceful movements caught people's attention, so they gave it the same name as a legendary scorpion goddess. It is a beautiful monster.
vioscissor: It often appears in grasslands, where it neatly trims the grass. It's a very meticulous monster.
venomArrow: With a fierce temperament and claws filled with poison, it's the roughest, most unruly Arrow Head of them all.
verdeGali: Verde is a magical being called 'God of the Desert' by some. However, its moody character sometimes causes it to create sand storms on a whim, to the annoyance of many.
verdeGolem: Covered in a thin, emerald shell that is not durable.
wyvernDragon: Compared to other Dragons, it is notably more violent and aggressive. However, if it can be tamed, there is no greater ally.
goreMagala: Gore Magala is a very unique monster, sharing traits and similarities to that of other Elder Dragons, possessing six limbs, including the clawed wings on its back. This is because it is an immature elder dragon itself.
tenthAngelGoreMagala: Tenth Angel Gore Magala is a special individual of Gore Magala with the appearance that is inspired by the Tenth Angel, in Evangelion 2.0, Zeruel. Unlike its relatives, Tenth Angel Gore Magala has Zeruel's face, chest, shoulder plates, and arms in its wings. Tenth Angel Gore Magala also have visible bones appearing on its legs, silver claws, and spikes on its tail.
estrellian: Estrellian is an unclassified monster with a body visually similar to Elder Dragons such as Kushala Daora or Rukodiora, but without wings. The majority of its body is covered in orange-brown scales, with its underside being white. Antennas akin to the wings of a Star Butterfly protrude from behind an Estrellian, and orange energy can be seen flowing through transparent sections of their chest.
doomEstrellian: It looks like its relative Estrellian, but with a sinister appearance. Doom Estrellian has a pale color on the top its neck through tail, but the tail tip is a reddish color. It has a brown scale tone on the shoulders and upper legs while the front legs have a brownish color as well as its hind legs, but with a darker tone. Instead of orange scales on its face, Doom Estrellian has dark brown scales with three pairs of uneven pale feather-like spikes on its lower pale jaw.
arbiterEstrellian: Arbiter Estrellian resemble their relatives, Estrellian and Doom Estrellian, in body structure, but has a black slight dark brownish ash color on the top its neck through tail. It has a darker scale tone on the shoulders and upper legs while the front legs have a grayish color as well as its hind legs, but with a darker tone. Instead of orange scales on its face, Arbiter Estrellian has black scales with three pair of uneven red feather-like spikes on its lower pale jaw.
mernos: Mernos are wingdrakes that somewhat resemble certain species of rhamphorynchoid pterosaur like Dimorphodon. They have hatchet-like beaks, blue skin, and a long yellow-tipped tail.
noios: Noios are wingdrakes that resemble vultures in addition to pterosaurs. They have a large beak, a waddle hanging from their neck, light-brown skin, and a long tail.
raphinos: Raphinos are wingdrakes that resemble parrots or tapejarid pterosaurs. They have a light pink skin and wings with ribbon-like appendages hanging from them.
barnos: Barnos are wingdrakes that resemble retro-style Pterosaurs. They have a pointed beak filled with teeth (making their head resemble that of the Pterodactylus) and a pair of very large draconic wings.
fish: A variety of different fish species exist and can be generally classified as migratory, natatorial, or carnivorous fish. Fish are likely a favorite food source for numerous other aquatic or semi aquatic creatures.
cortos: Cortos are small Wingdrakes with white-and-blue hides and scales. Their heads are wide and snake-like with piercing red eyes. Their tails end in a sharpened spade-like tip. Their feet are orange and end in wicked talons.
chaoticGoreMagala: Despite the unique name, Chaotic Gore Magala is actually just a normal Gore Magala which has been traumatized or otherwise interrupted during the process of molting into a Shagaru Magala. Mature Shagaru Magala will use their virus to suppress the molting of all nearby Gore Magala, eliminating competition for their territory. Immature Gore Magala seem to only be left in their juvenile state, but those who were already in the process of molting will have their metamorphosis forcibly halted partway, leaving them as Chaotic Gore Magala.
nuUdra: Nu Udra is a massive monster heavily resembling an octopus. It has six large limbs which it uses for locomotion and attacking, with its remaining two limbs being reduced and used to shield its mouth. Its dark green skin is covered in blue and black stripes, but at most times appears dark due to the creature being covered in a thick layer of black oilsilt at all times, which can be ignited at will when Nu Udra is enraged. The tentacles and mantle of the monster are covered in many thorny spines. Its most striking features are its bioluminescent blue eye stalks, along with glowing spots on the end of it's main six limbs; these glowing spots act as sensory organs as the cephalopod itself is mostly blind.
talioth: The Talioth is a long and slender raptor-like creature with striking back spikes in the form of a serrated knife, these sharp scales are tan and copper/red in color. Their head possesses an elongated beak that curves in on itself, with sharp curved teeth along the edges and small eyes near the back of the mouth, but their tongue is short.
xuWu: Xu Wu is an eight-limbed cephalopod with a body structure similar to an octopus. Six of its limbs are long and flexible, located on the sides of its body, while another pair, heavily reduced, is located in front of its body. Its six limbs have golden, sharp spikes that acts as blades and spears. Its skin is a greenish-black color with a gnarled texture, and several gold and teal veins running through it. The underside of its body glows bright teal, and is lined with sharp spikes. Above them is a complex of root-like appendages, as well as a patch of hard plating. Atop Xu Wu's head is a crown that greatly resembles a mouth, although, the monster's real mouth is located at the underside of its body, glowing blue. Its head is similar in shape to mushrooms, and in some sort, aliens. It's dark color scheme and appearance also are somewhat reminiscent of a ninja.
omegaPlanetes: Omega Planetes is a quadrupedal beetle-like robot made from a dark metal with silver detailing. Its "eye" is a horizontal yellow/orange visor. Omega Planetes possesses thrusters that glow white when in use. Like the original Omega, it is presumably part of the Omicrons, a race of sentient machines known for their interplanetary conquests.
omegaMicros: Omega Micros look exactly like their giant counterpart, albeit in a much smaller scale, hence their moniker. In addition, the visor glows red instead of Planetes's yellow.
eclyptor: Eclyptor is a much larger wolf Coromon than its previous evolutions. The massive crescent moonstone it carries is now slung across its shoulder and back, and is dented with craters. It also has two smaller moonstones which hovers by each of its hind legs. All of the moonstones are suspended with visible ghostly power, and it has a large furry chest and mane.
arcturos: Arcturos is a floating ice crystal. The center of its body is spherical, and is the head as it has eyes and a mouth. A large ice crystal and two smaller crystals protrudes from the bottom of its head, and another crystal protrudes from the top. It also has two crystal clusters that float to its left and right.
beezel: Beezel is a Coromon that closely resembles a wasp or hornet. It is constantly flying with two rapidly flapping hindwings and no visible elytra. It has a large head with two bright, blinking eyes, and two large antennae on top. It has a black thorax that connects to its set of thin arms, pair of wings, and long abdomen. Both of its wiry arms are tipped with a large, curled, sickle-shaped claw.
